text.title: 阻止仪式
text.objectives: 干扰8块仪式宝石。
text.description: 我并不是有意要偷听，对伊莉亚娜的损失我感同身受，也明白她对复仇的渴望。不知道你去的时候，是不是能帮我们一个忙？$B$B毫无疑问，你也看见萨提纳尔和萨维亚的萨特所举行的邪恶仪式了。我认为他们准备这些仪式，是要将俘虏的暗夜精灵也腐化成萨特。我们德莱尼人若是暴露在邪能魔法下，也会有问题。$B$B你能不能到那里去，干扰那些仪式宝石呢？
text.completion: We are in your debt, $c.$B$BUnable to complete their nefarious rituals, the satyr are now fighting a losing battle where they are unable to replenish their numbers.

english.title: Stopping the Rituals
english.objectives: Disturb 8 Ritual Gems.
english.description: I could not help but overhear Illiyana's loss. I understand her need for revenge. I am wondering if while you are exacting it, you could do us a service?$B$BNo doubt you have already seen the satyr of Satyrnaar and Xavian conducting vile rituals. I believe that they are preparing their rituals to corrupt any of the night elves they capture, turning them into satyrs. We draenei also have problems with fel magic exposure.$B$BWould you disturb their ritual gems while you are there?
english.completion: We are in your debt, $c.$B$BUnable to complete their nefarious rituals, the satyr are now fighting a losing battle where they are unable to replenish their numbers.

text.title: A Valiant Of Stormwind
text.objectives: Speak with Marshal Jacob Alerius at the Argent Tournament Grounds to become a valiant of Stormwind.
text.description: You've proven yourself worthy of competing under the banner of Stormwind, $n. Now, you should introduce yourself to Marshal Jacob Alerius, who leads the Stormwind delegation. As Stormwind's grand champion, he will enter you into the tournament on behalf of the city and oversee your training and testing as valiant.$B$BIt has been an honor working with you, $n, and I wish you luck in the competition ahead.
text.completion: Welcome aboard then, Valiant $N. The Stormwind delegation is proud to count you among its members.

text.title: 奥格瑞玛的勇士
text.objectives: 与银色比武场的碎颅者莫克拉谈一谈，成为奥格瑞玛的勇士。
text.description: $n，你证明了自己有资格代表奥格瑞玛作战。现在你应该去和碎颅者莫克拉谈一谈，他是奥格瑞玛代表团的领队。作为奥格瑞玛的总冠军，他会安排你代表奥格瑞玛参加锦标赛，并监督你进行训练，以通过勇士的考验。$B$B和你一起工作是我的荣耀，$n，在今后的战斗中也祝你好运。
text.completion: So you want to compete for Orgrimmar? Just because you've beaten up a few dummies doesn't mean you'll win, but you'll be training with the best from now on.

As Orgrimmar's grand champion, he will enter you into the tournament on behalf of the city and oversee your training and testing as valiant.$B$BIt has been an honor working with you, $n, and I wish you luck in the competition ahead.
english.completion: So you want to compete for Orgrimmar? Just because you've beaten up a few dummies doesn't mean you'll win, but you'll be training with the best from now on.

text.title: The Sword and the Sea
text.objectives: Old Man Barlo in Crystalsong Forest wants you to bring him the Sword of Knighthood.
text.description: My sword was lost at sea.  Catch it and bring it back!

text.completion: You think you have what it takes to compete for Sen'jin? I think we'll be finding out.

text.description: $n，你证明了自己有资格代表银月城作战。现在你应该去和伊蕾希亚·晨歌谈一谈，她是银月城代表团的领队。作为银月城的总冠军，她会安排你代表银月城参加锦标赛，并监督你进行训练，以通过勇士的考验。$B$B和你一起工作是我的荣耀，$n，在今后的战斗中也祝你好运。
text.completion: So you want to compete for Silvermoon? Very well. I'll add you to the rolls and you may begin working with the other valiants immediately.

text.title: 勇士之战
text.objectives: 将25枚勇士的徽记交给银色比武场的碎颅者莫克拉。
text.description: 在勇士的训练中，你将有机会和来自其它城市的各位勇士较量，以检验自己的作战技术。虽然勇士之间的战斗并非比赛的正式内容，但仍然可以从中学到许多有价值的东西——比如对手的战斗风格，还有他们的弱点。$B$B斗志高昂的勇士经常互相比试，为了荣耀和名望而战。$B$B多参加一些勇士的训练吧。等到你有足够的自信成为勇士中的佼佼者之后，就把你所获得的徽记拿来给我。
text.progress: Are you ready to demonstrate your mastery of the valiant's skills?
text.completion: Impressive, valiant. I will make the arrangements for your test immediately.

english.title: The Valiant's Charge
english.objectives: Bring 25 Valiant's Seals to Mokra the Skullcrusher at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
english.description: In your training as a valiant, you'll have the chance to test your skills against valiants representing other cities. Although a valiant's battles are not a formal part of the competition, you will learn valuable lessons about the fighting styles and weaknesses of your opponents.$B$BThe valiants are a spirited lot, competing amongst themselves for honor and notoriety.$B$BTrain as a valiant until you are confident of your ability to best all who face you, then bring me the seals you have earned.
english.progress: Are you ready to demonstrate your mastery of the valiant's skills?
english.completion: Impressive, valiant. I will make the arrangements for your test immediately.

text.title: 粉碎炸药
text.objectives: 使用战歌伐木机摧毁8桶炸药。
text.description: 我真不愿意再把你派回去，但是根据你所描述的情况，我们可不能让他们使用那些储存起来的炸药！$B$B你一个人去摧毁它们实在是太危险了，不过要是你能把他们的伐木机偷一台来，我想就应该能承受住爆炸。$B$B你把他们的炸药摧毁后，把伐木机也开回来，这东西也不能让他们拿回去。
text.progress: Time's running out, $N.
text.completion: I saw those explosions all of the way from over here! Those filthy orcs and their goblin lackeys are going to have a hard time doing anything to despoil the forest now!$B$BWe can't thank you enough, $N. Will this do?

english.title: Explosives Shredding
english.objectives: Use a Warsong Shredder to destroy 8 Kegs of Explosives.
english.description: I hate to send you back in there, but based on your description of what's going on, we can't let them use all of those explosives they have stored up!$B$BIt's too dangerous for you to try to destroy them yourself, but if you were to steal one of their shredders, I'm sure they're tough enough to withstand the explosions.$B$BAfter you've destroyed their explosives, return here with the shredder. There's no sense in letting them have it back.
english.progress: Time's running out, $N.
english.completion: I saw those explosions all of the way from over here! Those filthy orcs and their goblin lackeys are going to have a hard time doing anything to despoil the forest now!$B$BWe can't thank you enough, $N. Will this do?

text.title: 勇士的挑战
text.objectives: 与侍从丹尼谈一谈，他会为你安排对手。击败银色勇士之后，回到银色比武场，向雅克布·奥勒留斯元帅复命。$B$B如果你丢失了长枪，可以在银色盟约大帐或者兽栏附近的长枪架上再拿一根。
text.description: 你很快就可以完成训练，代表暴风城参加总决赛了。为了证明你有资格代表我们的城市参加战斗，你必须击败银色北伐军的一名冠军。$B$B到大帐外面的兽栏旁去，拿上一把长枪，跨上你的坐骑。然后到场地西侧的银色勇士赛场去找侍从丹尼。当你做好战斗的准备之后，他会为你召来对手。$B$B这场战斗结束之后，我们再好好谈谈。
text.completion: You have proven yourself worthy of the title of champion, $N. You will compete at the tournament's highest level on behalf of Stormwind, riding in the grand melee with your weapon at the ready and our mighty pennant at your back.

english.title: The Valiant's Challenge
english.objectives: Speak with Squire Danny to summon your opponent. Once you have defeated the Argent Champion, return to Marshal Jacob Alerius at the Argent Tournament Grounds.$B$BIf you lose your lance, you can get another from any of the Lance Racks near the stables or in the Silver Covenant Pavilion.
english.description: You are nearly ready to compete on behalf of Stormwind in the grand melee. To prove yourself worthy to enter the lists on behalf of our city, you must defeat a champion of the Argent Crusade.$B$BGo to the stables outside the pavilion, equip your lance, and mount up. Speak to Squire Danny at the Argent Valiants' Ring on the western edge of the grounds. The squire will call out your opponent when you're ready.$B$BAfter the battle is concluded, we will speak of the outcome.
english.completion: You have proven yourself worthy of the title of champion, $N. You will compete at the tournament's highest level on behalf of Stormwind, riding in the grand melee with your weapon at the ready and our mighty pennant at your back.

text.title: 冠军诞生
text.objectives: 与银色比武场的裁决者玛蕾尔·图哈特谈一谈。
text.description: 恭喜你，$n。你已经掌握了多种战斗技巧，完成了你遇到的所有挑战。毫无疑问，你已经做好了准备，可以迎战来自各个主城的冠军了。$B$B裁决者玛蕾尔·图哈特要与你谈谈，$n，她会正式批准你参加总冠军的角逐。
text.completion: I welcome you as a champion of the tournament, $N. As a champion, you will be able to compete for the grand championship of the tournament. You may also choose to become a valiant with another Alliance city's delegation and in time, a champion for that city as well.$B$BAll champions must have the assistance of a squire, $N, and you are no exception. Allow me to appoint one of ours to accompany you in battle. He will proudly carry the banner of any city that has named you a champion.

english.title: A Champion Rises
english.objectives: Speak with Justicar Mariel Trueheart at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
english.description: Congratulations, $n. You have mastered many kinds of combat and overcome all the challenges you've faced. There can be no doubt that you are ready to compete with the best warriors who have gathered at the tournament, against the champions of the capital cities.$B$BJusticar Mariel Trueheart has asked to speak with you, $n, and to formally enter you in the champions' grand melee.
english.completion: I welcome you as a champion of the tournament, $N. As a champion, you will be able to compete for the grand championship of the tournament. You may also choose to become a valiant with another Alliance city's delegation and in time, a champion for that city as well.$B$BAll champions must have the assistance of a squire, $N, and you are no exception. Allow me to appoint one of ours to accompany you in battle. He will proudly carry the banner of any city that has named you a champion.

text.title: 铁炉堡的勇士
text.objectives: 如果你想要成为铁炉堡的勇士，就再找兰娜·硬锤谈一谈。
text.description: 欢迎你，冠军。对你英勇战斗的事迹，我们早有耳闻。你是否希望加入我们铁炉堡代表团，参加锦标赛？$B$B你可以像以前一样训练并提升自己的级别，不过如果你获得了铁炉堡冠军的称号，就可以在参赛时让你的侍从打出我们的旗帜。
text.completion: We are proud that you have decided to join us and I know you will shine on the field.

english.title: Valiant Of Ironforge
english.objectives: Speak with Lana Stouthammer again if you wish to become a valiant of Ironforge.
english.description: Welcome, champion. Word of your combat prowess has already reached my ears. Do you seek to join Ironforge's tournament delegation?$B$BYou will train and rise through the ranks as you have before, but when you are named a champion of Ironforge, your squire will have the option of carrying our banner into battle.
english.completion: We are proud that you have decided to join us and I know you will shine on the field.

text.description: 欢迎你，冠军。对你英勇战斗的事迹，我们早有耳闻。诺莫瑞根代表团欢迎像你这样强大的$c加入我们的行列。$B$B你可以像以前一样训练并提升自己的级别，不过如果你获得了诺莫瑞根冠军的称号，就可以在参赛时让你的侍从打出我们的旗帜。
text.completion: We're proud to count you among us, $n, and we look forward to training with you.

english.title: Valiant Of Gnomeregan
english.objectives: Speak with Ambrose Boltspark again if you wish to become a valiant of Gnomeregan.
english.description: Welcome, champion. Word of your combat prowess has already reached my ears. Gnomeregan's delegation could really benefit from a $c like you.$B$BYou will train and rise through the ranks as you have before, but when you are named a champion of Gnomeregan, your squire will have the option of carrying our banner into battle.
english.completion: We're proud to count you among us, $n, and we look forward to training with you.

text.description: 欢迎你，冠军。对你英勇战斗的事迹，我们早有耳闻。你愿意参加埃索达的锦标赛代表团吗？$B$B你可以像以前一样训练并提升自己的级别，不过如果你获得了埃索达冠军的称号，就可以在参赛时让你的侍从打出我们的旗帜。
text.completion: It's good to have you on our team, $n. We will all benefit from training with you.

english.objectives: Speak with Colosos again if you wish to become a valiant of the Exodar.
english.description: Welcome, champion. Word of your deeds has already reached my ears. Do you wish to join the Exodar's tournament delegation?$B$BYou will train and rise through the ranks as you have before, but when you are named a champion of the Exodar, your squire will have the option of carrying our banner into battle.
english.completion: It's good to have you on our team, $n. We will all benefit from training with you.

text.title: 达纳苏斯的勇士
text.objectives: 如果你想要成为达纳苏斯的勇士，就再找亚琳·永歌谈一谈。
text.description: 欢迎你，冠军。我们已经听说了你的光辉事迹，如果你能够加入达纳苏斯代表团，我们会感到非常骄傲的。$B$B你可以像以前一样训练并提升自己的级别，不过如果你获得了达纳苏斯冠军的称号，就可以在参赛时让你的侍从打出我们的旗帜。
text.completion: The warriors of Darnassus are honored to fight and train beside you.

english.title: Valiant Of Darnassus
english.objectives: Speak with Jaelyne Eveonsong again if you wish to become a valiant of Darnassus.
english.description: Welcome, champion. I have heard of your accomplishments and we would be honored if you would join the delegation from Darnassus.$B$BYou will train and rise through the ranks as you have before, but when you are named a champion of Darnassus, your squire will have the option of carrying our banner into battle.
english.completion: The warriors of Darnassus are honored to fight and train beside you.

text.title: 奥格瑞玛的勇士
text.objectives: 如果你想要成为奥格瑞玛的勇士，就再找碎颅者莫克拉谈一谈。
text.description: 这么说来，你已经成为冠军了？这说明你是一名称职的斗士，我很荣幸地邀请你参加奥格瑞玛代表团。$B$B你可以像以前一样训练并提升自己的级别，不过如果你获得了奥格瑞玛冠军的称号，就可以在参赛时让你的侍从打出我们的旗帜。
text.completion: Welcome, then, $n. I look forward to watching you train with my men.

english.title: Valiant Of Orgrimmar
english.objectives: Speak with Mokra the Skullcrusher again if you wish to become a valiant of Orgrimmar.
english.description: So, you have become a champion? Then, you have proven yourself a worthy combatant and I would proudly welcome you into Orgrimmar's delegation.$B$BYou will train and rise through the ranks as you have before, but when you are named a champion of Orgrimmar, your gruntling will have the option of carrying our banner into battle.
english.completion: Welcome, then, $n. I look forward to watching you train with my men.

text.title: 森金的勇士
text.objectives: 如果你想要成为森金的勇士，就再找祖尔托谈一谈。
text.description: 你好，冠军。对你英勇战斗的事迹，我们早有耳闻。如果你愿意的话，请允许我邀请你加入森金代表团。$B$B你可以像以前一样训练并提升自己的级别，不过如果你获得了森金冠军的称号，就可以在参赛时让你的侍从打出我们的旗帜。
text.completion: I am glad that you have decided to join us and look forward to seeing you in action.

english.title: Valiant Of Sen'jin
english.objectives: Speak with Zul'tore again if you wish to become a valiant of Sen'jin.
english.description: Greetings, champion. If you are willing, I would welcome you into Sen'jin's tournament delegation.$B$BYou will train and rise through the ranks as you have before, but when you are named a champion of Sen'jin, your gruntling will have the option of carrying our banner into battle.
english.completion: I am glad that you have decided to join us and look forward to seeing you in action.

text.title: Valiant Of Thunder Bluff
text.objectives: Speak with Runok Wildmane again if you wish to become a valiant of Thunder Bluff.
text.description: Welcome, champion. As grand champion of the Thunder Bluff delegation, I would be honored to welcome you into our ranks, if you are willing.$B$BYou will train and rise through the ranks as you have before, but when you are named a champion of Thunder Bluff, your gruntling will have the option of carrying our banner into battle.
text.completion: I am honored that you have chosen to join our delegation. I know you will make us proud, $N.

english.title: Valiant Of Thunder Bluff

text.title: 幽暗城的勇士
text.objectives: 如果你想要成为幽暗城的勇士，就再找死亡猎手维瑟里谈一谈。
text.description: 欢迎你，冠军。像你这样的$c肯定对幽暗城代表团大有帮助，你愿意加入我们吗？$B$B你可以像以前一样训练并提升自己的级别，不过如果你获得了幽暗城冠军的称号，就可以在参赛时让你的侍从打出我们的旗帜。
text.completion: You have chosen wisely, $n. Both of us will benefit from this arrangement.

english.title: Valiant Of Undercity
english.objectives: Speak with Deathstalker Visceri again if you wish to become a valiant of the Undercity.
english.description: Welcome, champion. The Forsaken delegation could always use more $cs like you. Would you join us?$B$BYou will train and rise through the ranks as you have before, but when you are named a champion of the Undecity, your gruntling will have the option of carrying our banner into battle.
english.completion: You have chosen wisely, $n. Both of us will benefit from this arrangement.

text.description: So, you have become a champion? Then, you have proven yourself a worthy combatant and I would proudly welcome you into Silvermoon's delegation.$B$BYou will train and rise through the ranks as you have before, but when you are named a champion of Silvermoon, your gruntling will have the option of carrying our banner into battle.
text.completion: It will be an honor training and competing with you, $n.

text.title: 雷霆救兵！
text.objectives: 跟莫尔杉农场的卡德拉克谈一谈，陪伴他前往碎木岗哨。
text.description: 你跟我来，$n。$b$b我手头没有多余的人了，咱们一定要守住碎木岗哨。$b$b做好准备，然后告诉我。

english.title: To the Rescue!
english.objectives: Speak to Kadrak at Mor'shan Ramparts and accompany him to Splintertree Post.
english.description: You're coming with me, $n.$b$bThere's no one else that I can spare, and we cannot afford for Splintertree to be lost.$b$bPrepare yourself, and speak to me again when you are ready.

text.title: 勇士的挑战
text.objectives: 与侍从丹尼谈一谈，他会为你安排对手。击败银色勇士之后，回到银色比武场，向兰娜·硬锤复命。$B$B如果你丢失了长枪，可以在银色盟约大帐或者兽栏附近的长枪架上再拿一根。
text.description: 你很快就可以完成训练，代表铁炉堡参加总决赛了。为了证明你有资格代表我们的城市参加战斗，你必须击败银色北伐军的一名冠军。$B$B到大帐外面的兽栏旁去，拿上一把长枪，跨上你的坐骑。然后到场地西侧的银色勇士赛场去找侍从丹尼。当你做好战斗的准备之后，他会为你召来对手。$B$B这场战斗结束之后，我们再好好谈谈。
text.completion: You have proven yourself worthy of the title of champion, $n. You will compete at the tournament's highest level on behalf of Ironforge, riding in the grand melee with your weapon at the ready and our mighty pennant at your back.

english.title: The Valiant's Challenge
english.objectives: Speak with Squire Danny to summon your opponent. Once you have defeated the Argent Champion, return to Lana Stouthammer at the Argent Tournament Grounds.$B$BIf you lose your lance, you can get another from any of the Lance Racks near the stables or in the Silver Covenant Pavilion.
english.description: You are nearly ready to compete on behalf of Ironforge in the grand melee. To prove yourself worthy to enter the lists on behalf of our city, you must defeat a champion of the Argent Crusade.$B$BGo to the stables outside the pavilion, equip your lance, and mount up. Speak to Squire Danny at the Argent Valiants' Ring on the western edge of the grounds. The squire will call out your opponent when you're ready.$B$BAfter the battle is concluded, we will speak of the outcome.
english.completion: You have proven yourself worthy of the title of champion, $n. You will compete at the tournament's highest level on behalf of Ironforge, riding in the grand melee with your weapon at the ready and our mighty pennant at your back.

text.title: 勇士之战
text.objectives: 将25枚勇士的徽记交给银色比武场的兰娜·硬锤。
text.description: 在勇士的训练中，你将有机会和来自其它城市的各位勇士较量，以检验自己的作战技术。虽然勇士之间的战斗并非比赛的正式内容，但仍然可以从中学到许多有价值的东西——比如对手的战斗风格，还有他们的弱点。$B$B斗志高昂的勇士经常互相比试，为了荣耀和名望而战。$B$B多参加一些勇士的训练吧。等到你有足够的自信成为勇士中的佼佼者之后，就把你所获得的徽记拿来给我。
text.progress: Are you ready to demonstrate your mastery of the valiant's skills?
text.completion: Impressive, valiant. I will make the arrangements for your test immediately.

english.title: The Valiant's Charge
english.objectives: Bring 25 Valiant's Seals to Lana Stouthammer at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
english.description: In your training as a valiant, you'll have the chance to test your skills against valiants representing other cities. Although a valiant's battles are not a formal part of the competition, you will learn valuable lessons about the fighting styles and weaknesses of your opponents.$B$BThe valiants are a spirited lot, competing amongst themselves for honor and notoriety.$B$BTrain as a valiant until you are confident of your ability to best all who face you, then bring me the seals you have earned.
english.progress: Are you ready to demonstrate your mastery of the valiant's skills?
english.completion: Impressive, valiant. I will make the arrangements for your test immediately.

text.description: 你很快就可以完成训练，代表诺莫瑞根参加总决赛了。为了证明你有资格代表我们的城市参加战斗，你必须击败银色北伐军的一名冠军。$B$B到大帐外面的兽栏旁去，拿上一把长枪，跨上你的坐骑。然后到场地西侧的银色勇士赛场去找侍从丹尼。当你做好战斗的准备之后，他会为你召来对手。$B$B这场战斗结束之后，我们再好好谈谈。
text.completion: You have proven yourself worthy of the title of champion, $n. You will compete at the tournament's highest level on behalf of Gnomeregan, riding in the grand melee with your weapon at the ready and our mighty pennant at your back.

english.title: The Valiant's Challenge
english.objectives: Speak with Squire Danny to summon your opponent. Once you have defeated the Argent Champion, return to Ambrose Boltspark at the Argent Tournament Grounds.$B$BIf you lose your lance, you can get another from any of the Lance Racks near the stables or in the Silver Covenant Pavilion.
english.description: You are nearly ready to compete on behalf of Gnomeregan in the grand melee. To prove yourself worthy to enter the lists on behalf of our city, you must defeat a champion of the Argent Crusade.$B$BGo to the stables outside the pavilion, equip your lance, and mount up. Speak to Squire Danny at the Argent Valiants' Ring on the western edge of the grounds. The squire will call out your opponent when you're ready.$B$BAfter the battle is concluded, we will speak of the outcome.
english.completion: You have proven yourself worthy of the title of champion, $n. You will compete at the tournament's highest level on behalf of Gnomeregan, riding in the grand melee with your weapon at the ready and our mighty pennant at your back.

text.title: 邪火烧身
text.objectives: 碎木岗哨的德娜卡要你去冥火岭用7团魔火装满加强型采集罐。
text.description: <德娜卡凑过来同你说道。>$b$b听着……你先别开口，我知道的很清楚，咱们不能染指恶魔能量……$b$b但是好好看看吧！情势危急，$c。$b$b不管怎样，我们反正都得死在这里。要我说，不如死得光荣！$b$b那么……你干不干？$b$b拿上这个采集罐，到东南边的冥火岭去。在魔火团附近使用它，装满了就把它带回来给我。$b$b哦，最好别和任何人说起这件事……
text.giverWindow: 我要是不经常施法，就烧得疼。你明白我的意思吗？
text.turninWindow: 我要是不经常施法，就烧得疼。你明白我的意思吗？

english.title: Playing With Felfire
english.objectives: Draaka in Splintertree wants you to fill the Reinforced Canister with 7 Felfires from Felfire Hill.
english.description: <Draaka leans down to speak to you.>$b$bListen... Before you say anything, I KNOW we're not to meddle with demonic energies....$b$bBut look around you! These are desperate times, $c.$b$bWe'll most likely die here, regardless. May as well go out in a blaze of glory, I say!$b$bSo... Are you in?$b$bTake this canister and go southeast to Felfire Hill. Use it near the patches of felfire and bring it back to me when you've filled it.$b$bOh, and best not to mention this to anyone....
english.giverWindow: It starts to burn if I don't fire off frequently. You know what I mean?
english.turninWindow: It starts to burn if I don't fire off frequently. You know what I mean?

text.title: A Champion Rises
text.objectives: Speak with Justicar Mariel Trueheart at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
text.description: Congratulations, $n. You have mastered many kinds of combat and overcome all the challenges you've faced. There can be no doubt that you are ready to compete with the best warriors who have gathered at the tournament, against the champions of the capital cities.$B$BJusticar Mariel Trueheart has asked to speak with you, $n, and to formally enter you in the grand melee.
text.completion: I welcome you as a champion of the tournament, $n. As a champion, you will be able to compete for the grand championship of the tournament. You may also choose to become a valiant with another Alliance city's delegation and in time, a champion for that city as well.$b$bAll champions must have the assistance of a squire, $n, and you are no exception. Allow me to appoint one of ours to accompany you in battle. He will proudly carry the banner of any city that has named you a champion.

text.objectives: Speak with Justicar Mariel Trueheart at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
text.description: You have earned my respect and the respect of your peers. You defeated all who challenged you and mastered the ways of tournament combat. I have no doubt that you are ready to face down the champions of other cities for the glory of Orgrimmar!$B$BJusticar Mariel Trueheart has asked to speak with you, $n, and to formally enter you in the champions' grand melee.
text.completion: I welcome you as a champion of the tournament, $n. As a champion, you will be able to compete for the grand championship of the tournament. You may also choose to become a valiant with another Horde city's delegation and in time, a champion for that city as well.$b$bAll champions must have the assistance of a squire, $n, and you are no exception. Allow me to appoint one of ours to accompany you in battle. He will proudly carry the banner of any city that has named you a champion.

text.title: 冠军诞生
text.objectives: 与银色比武场的裁决者玛蕾尔·图哈特谈一谈。
text.description: 你赢得了我的尊重，也赢得了高层的认可。你已经击败了所有的挑战者，掌握了在锦标赛中作战的方法。毫无疑问，你已经准备就绪，有能力面对其它主城的冠军，捍卫银月城的荣誉！$B$B裁决者玛蕾尔·图哈特要与你谈谈，$n，她会正式批准你参加总冠军的角逐。
text.completion: I welcome you as a champion of the tournament, $N. As a champion, you will be able to compete for the grand championship of the tournament. You may also choose to become a valiant with another Horde city's delegation and in time, a champion for that city as well.$B$BAll champions must have the assistance of a squire, $N, and you are no exception. text.title: A Blade Fit For A Champion
text.objectives: Retrieve the Ashwood Brand and bring it to Lana Stouthammer at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
text.description: Good, honest, honed steel may not carry the day. The other combatants are using enchanted blades and I find myself at a disadvantage, but all is not lost.$B$BThere's an old legend from Grizzly Hills about a maiden cursed with a frog's form to protect the blade she has long guarded. She lives among the lake frogs on the shore of Ashwood Lake, just east of Ashwood Post. The only thing said to break the curse is a kiss, freely given. Apply this balm before kissing anything, $n. Otherwise, you'll catch warts.
text.progress: Were you able to recover the blade?
text.completion: So the tales were true? This is a fine blade and I have no doubt that it will serve me well in the tournament. You have my thanks, $n.

text.title: 珍贵的武器
text.objectives: 将达克玛尔之剑交给银色比武场的兰娜·硬锤。
text.description: 为什么我的运气总是烂到家了呢？我的比赛用剑无影无踪了！$B$B在吟游诗人的传说里，如果哪位旅人能给一位孤独的女士带去几朵冬水仙，就可以获得她的礼物。那些花只生长在铁墙大坝下游的浮冰上，就在晶歌森林的西北部，与冰冠冰川交界的地方。去摘些这种花，然后把花带到龙骨荒野东北部的达克玛尔湖去，就在该地区与祖达克、灰熊丘陵交界处的灯环中找到那位孤独女士。把花献给她，她会回赠你一把优秀的利剑。
text.progress: Were the wandering bard's tales true? Have you brought a blade?
text.completion: <The grand champion accepts the Blade of Drak'Mar from you.>$b$bA fine weapon, and perfectly balanced. It will serve me well in the next match.

english.title: A Worthy Weapon
english.objectives: Bring the Blade of Drak'Mar to Lana Stouthammer at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
english.description: Of all the times to have such rotten luck!$B$BMy tournament blade has gone missing. I've heard the bards telling tales of travelers offering winter hyacinths to a lonely maiden in return for gifts. Those hyacinths grow only on the ice flowing from the Ironwall Dam, on Crystalsong Forest's northwestern border with Icecrown. Gather the flowers and take them to the circle of lamps in Drak'Mar Lake in northeastern Dragonblight, near Zul'Drak and Grizzly Hills. Ask the lonely maiden for a worthy blade.
english.progress: Were the wandering bard's tales true? Have you brought a blade?
english.completion: <The grand champion accepts the Blade of Drak'Mar from you.>$b$bA fine weapon, and perfectly balanced. It will serve me well in the next match.

text.title: 冬之利刃
text.objectives: 将冬之利刃交给银色比武场的兰娜·硬锤。
text.description: 那个天杀的死亡骑士，把我的剑给弄坏了！$B$B前往晶歌森林的南部，你可以在水晶裂痕的出口上方找到恒焰领主。杀死他，拿到他身上的恒焰灰烬。$B$B带着恒焰灰烬前往嚎风峡湾北部的冬息湖中心，解救一位被寒冰困在那里的女士。她守护着一把古代宝剑，能够解救她的人就可以获得那把宝剑作为奖励。$B$B证明你的能力，拿到她守护了许久的宝剑吧，$n。
text.progress: Did you win the blade I seek?
text.completion: The blade is as fine as the stories say. It would seem there's little reason to complete the repairs on my customary blade. Winter's Edge is far superior and I will continue to carry it. You have my thanks, $n.

english.title: The Edge Of Winter
english.objectives: Lana Stouthammer at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to bring her Winter's Edge.
english.description: Curse that death knight for breaking my sword!$B$BIn southern Crystalsong Forest, overlooking the Crystal Vice's exit, you will find Lord Everblaze. Kill him and take the everburning ember from his corpse.$B$BBring it to the center of Winter's Breath Lake in northern Howling Fjord, and use it to free the maiden encased in ice. She is the guardian of an ancient sword and will award it to whoever frees her.$B$BProve your worth and earn the weapon that she has guarded for so long, $n.
english.progress: Did you win the blade I seek?
english.completion: The blade is as fine as the stories say. It would seem there's little reason to complete the repairs on my customary blade. Winter's Edge is far superior and I will continue to carry it. You have my thanks, $n.

text.title: 勇士的实战训练
text.objectives: 银色比武场的鲁洛·强击要你消灭10名被转化的英雄。
text.description: 在锦标赛上，你可以和你的战友们一起练习技术，但是时刻都不要忘记，我们真正的敌人——天灾军团绝不会坐等灭亡。你不但要和队友切磋，还要在与敌人的战斗中磨砺自己的刀锋。$B$B到位于陨落英雄之谷西南和恐惧之门科雷萨以北的那个地区去。天灾军团正在那里复活死亡的英雄们，并将他们变成我们的敌人。击败那些天灾军团的爪牙，让我们的勇士得到安息，并在那里磨砺你的战斗技艺。
text.completion: Welcome back from your exercises, $n. Even while we practice for the competition, it's good to remind ourselves that the Scourge is still out there.

english.title: A Valiant's Field Training
english.objectives: Rollo Sureshot at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to kill 10 Converted Heroes.
english.description: The tournament is a time for testing your skills against your peers, but we must not forget that the real enemy, the Scourge, will not wait. As you hone your skills against others, so should you maintain your edge in combat against the enemy.$B$BTravel to the area southwest of the Valley of Fallen Heroes and north of Corp'rethar. There, the Scourge raises dead heroes and turns them against us. Defeat these minions of the Scourge, do honor to our allies, and keep yourself prepared for combat.
english.completion: Welcome back from your exercises, $n. Even while we practice for the competition, it's good to remind ourselves that the Scourge is still out there.

text.title: 总决赛
text.objectives: 将三枚勇士的印记交给银色比武场的克拉拉·沸酒。$B$B如果你丢失了长枪，可以在银色盟约大帐或者兽栏附近的长枪架上再拿一根。
text.description: 总决赛是锦标赛中最重要的一场比赛。铁炉堡的人民期待着我们胜利的消息。为了这个目标，我们要不断地与代表联盟其它城市出战的勇士们比武练习，提升自己的战斗能力。$B$B我建议你也参加。勇士们的练习场就在我们的帐篷外面。拿起你的长枪，到大帐外面的兽栏中去，骑上兽栏中的铁炉堡战羊，去挑战其他的联盟勇士吧。
text.progress: Have you completed your training for the grand melee?
text.completion: Well done. Training against the other valiants is one of the best ways to prepare yourself for tournament competition. I know you'll make Ironforge proud, $n.

english.title: The Grand Melee
english.objectives: Bring 3 Marks of the Valiant to Clara Tumblebrew at the Argent Tournament Grounds.$B$BIf you lose your lance, you can get another from any of the Lance Racks near the stables or in the Silver Covenant Pavilion.
english.description: The grand melee is the most important of the tournament's competitions. The people of Ironforge are looking forward to hearing of our success. To that end, they've been honing their skills against the valiants representing the other Alliance capitals.$B$BI suggest you do the same. The valiants practice in the ring just outside our tent. Equip your lance, go to the stables outside the pavilion and mount the stabled Ironforge ram, then challenge other Alliance valiants.
english.progress: Have you completed your training for the grand melee?
english.completion: Well done. Training against the other valiants is one of the best ways to prepare yourself for tournament competition. I know you'll make Ironforge proud, $n.

text.title: 冠军的利剑
text.objectives: 找到灰木之剑，把它交给银色比武场的安布罗斯·雷钉。
text.description: 啊，说实话，光靠锋利的钢剑是不足以获得胜利的。其他参赛者用的都是附有魔法的武器，这对我非常不利，不过这也不是什么大问题。$B$B一个流传于灰熊丘陵的古老传说中提到，那里有位女士为了守护一把剑受到诅咒，变成了一只青蛙。现在她就住在灰木哨站东边的灰木湖岸上，和其它的湖蛙生活在一起。根据传说，唯一能够解除这道诅咒的方法，是有人自愿去亲吻她。不过呢，你要记得先在嘴唇上涂抹这种药膏，然后再去亲吻湖蛙，不然你的嘴上会长疣的。
text.progress: Were you able to recover the blade?
text.completion: So the tales were true? This is a fine blade and I have no doubt that it will serve me well in the tournament. You have my thanks, $n.

text.objectives: 将三枚勇士的印记交给银色比武场的弗林克·扳钳。$B$B如果你丢失了长枪，可以在银色盟约大帐或者兽栏附近的长枪架上再拿一根。
text.description: 总决赛是锦标赛中最重要的一场比赛。大家都希望我们能够在竞赛中获胜，我们也不愿意让他们失望。为了这个目标，我们要不断地与其他的勇士们比武练习，提升自己的战斗能力。$B$B我建议你也参加。$B$B到大帐外面的兽栏中去，拿起你的长枪，骑上兽栏中的涡轮陆行鸟，去挑战其他的勇士吧。联盟勇士的练习场就在我们的帐篷外面，他们在那里等待你的挑战。
text.progress: Have you completed your training for the grand melee?
text.completion: Well done. Training against the other valiants is one of the best ways to prepare yourself for tournament competition. I know you'll make us proud, $N.

english.title: The Grand Melee
english.objectives: Bring 3 Marks of the Valiant to Flickin Gearspanner at the Argent Tournament Grounds.$B$BIf you lose your lance, you can get another from any of the Lance Racks near the stables or in the Silver Covenant Pavilion.
english.description: The grand melee is the most important of the tournament's competitions. We know everyone's looking forward to seeing us in the competition. To that end, we've been honing our skills against the valiants representing the other Alliance capitals.$B$BI suggest you do the same.$B$BGo to the stables outside the pavilion, equip your lance, mount the stabled turbostrider, and challenge the valiants. They wait in the Alliance Valiants' Ring just outside our tent.
english.progress: Have you completed your training for the grand melee?
english.completion: Well done. Training against the other valiants is one of the best ways to prepare yourself for tournament competition. I know you'll make us proud, $N.

text.title: 谁都别告诉！
text.objectives: 碎木岗哨的德娜卡要你把匆忙书写的字条带给杜莱克。
text.description: 好极了！$b$b就用这个让精灵知道，把部落逼急了的话，咱们什么都干得出来。$b$b听着，$n。你一定不可以把这事跟任何人提起！$b$b萨鲁法尔看到结果自然会网开一面，但要是我们事先就被发觉了，人头可不保！$b$b<德娜卡交给你一张匆忙书写的字条。>$b$b把这个交给杜莱克。你可以在我后面的矿井里找到他，就在北边。他会告诉你下面怎么做。
text.completed: 将匆忙书写的字条交给碎木岗哨的杜莱克。
text.giverWindow: 无论如何，你都别读那字条。

english.title: Tell No One!
english.objectives: Draaka in Splintertree wants you to bring the Hastily Written Note to Durak.
english.description: Perfect!$b$bThis will show the elves what the Horde is capable of when we're backed into a corner.$b$bListen, $n. You must say nothing of this to anyone!$b$bSaurfang will surely approve once he sees the results, but if we are found out beforehand, our heads will be placed on spikes!$b$b<Draaka hands you a hastily written note.>$b$bBring this to Durak. You can find him in the mines behind me, just to the north. He will instruct you further.
english.completed: Bring the Hastily Written Note to Durak in Splintertree Post.
english.giverWindow: Whatever you do, don't read that note.

text.title: A Blade Fit For A Champion
text.objectives: Retrieve the Ashwood Brand and bring it to Colosos at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
text.description: Good, honest, honed steel may not carry the day. The other combatants are using enchanted blades and I find myself at a disadvantage, but all is not lost.$B$BThere's an old legend from Grizzly Hills about a maiden cursed with a frog's form to protect the blade she has long guarded. She lives among the lake frogs on the shore of Ashwood Lake, just east of Ashwood Post. The only thing said to break the curse is a kiss, freely given. Apply this balm before kissing anything, $n. Otherwise, you'll catch warts.
text.progress: Were you able to recover the blade?
text.completion: So the tales were true? This is a fine blade and I have no doubt that it will serve me well in the tournament. You have my thanks, $n.

text.title: 珍贵的武器
text.objectives: 将达克玛尔之剑交给银色比武场的科鲁索斯。
text.description: 为什么我的运气总是烂到家了呢？我的比赛用剑无影无踪了！$B$B在吟游诗人的传说里，如果哪位旅人能给一位孤独的女士带去几朵冬水仙，就可以获得她的礼物。那些花只生长在铁墙大坝下游的浮冰上，就在晶歌森林的西北部，与冰冠冰川交界的地方。去摘些这种花，然后把花带到龙骨荒野东北部的达克玛尔湖去，就在该地区与祖达克、灰熊丘陵交界处的灯环中找到那位孤独女士。把花献给她，她会回赠你一把优秀的利剑。
text.progress: Were the wandering bard's tales true? Have you brought a blade?
text.completion: <The grand champion accepts the Blade of Drak'Mar from you.>$b$bA fine weapon, and perfectly balanced. It will serve me well in the next match.

english.title: A Worthy Weapon
english.objectives: Bring the Blade of Drak'Mar to Colosos at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
english.description: Of all the times to have such rotten luck!$B$BMy tournament blade has gone missing.I've heard the bards telling tales of travelers offering winter hyacinths to a lonely maiden in return for gifts. Those hyacinths grow only on the ice flowing from the Ironwall Dam, on Crystalsong Forest's northwestern border with Icecrown. Gather the flowers and take them to the circle of lamps in Drak'Mar Lake in northeastern Dragonblight, near Zul'Drak and Grizzly Hills. Ask the lonely maiden for a worthy blade.
english.progress: Were the wandering bard's tales true? Have you brought a blade?
english.completion: <The grand champion accepts the Blade of Drak'Mar from you.>$b$bA fine weapon, and perfectly balanced. It will serve me well in the next match.

text.title: 冬之利刃
text.objectives: 将冬之利刃交给银色比武场的科鲁索斯。
text.description: 上次我一时头脑发热，跟一个死亡骑士打了一架，结果……唉。$B$B前往晶歌森林的南部，你可以在水晶裂痕的出口上方找到恒焰领主。杀死他，拿到他身上的恒焰灰烬。$B$B带着恒焰灰烬前往嚎风峡湾北部的冬息湖中心，解救一位被寒冰困在那里的女士。她守护着一把古代宝剑，能够解救她的人就可以获得那把宝剑作为奖励。$B$B证明你的能力，拿到她守护了许久的宝剑吧，$n。
text.progress: Did you win the blade I seek?
text.completion: The blade is as fine as the stories say. It would seem there's little reason to complete the repairs on my customary blade. Winter's Edge is far superior and I will continue to carry it. You have my thanks, $n.

english.title: The Edge Of Winter
english.objectives: Colosos at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to bring him Winter's Edge.
english.description: That's the last time I ever spar with a death knight.$B$BIn southern Crystalsong Forest, overlooking the Crystal Vice's exit, you will find Lord Everblaze. Kill him and take the everburning ember from his corpse.$B$BBring it to the center of Winter's Breath Lake in northern Howling Fjord, and use it to free the maiden encased in ice. She is the guardian of an ancient sword and will award it to whoever frees her.$B$BProve your worth and earn the weapon that she has guarded for so long, $n.
english.progress: Did you win the blade I seek?
english.completion: The blade is as fine as the stories say. It would seem there's little reason to complete the repairs on my customary blade. Winter's Edge is far superior and I will continue to carry it. You have my thanks, $n.

text.title: 勇士的实战训练
text.objectives: 银色比武场的萨安度斯要你消灭10名被转化的英雄。
text.description: 在锦标赛上，你可以和你的战友们一起练习技术，但是时刻都不要忘记，我们真正的敌人——天灾军团绝不会坐等灭亡。你不但要和队友切磋，还要在与敌人的战斗中磨砺自己的刀锋。$B$B到位于陨落英雄之谷西南和恐惧之门科雷萨以北的那个地区去。天灾军团正在那里复活死亡的英雄们，并将他们变成我们的敌人。击败那些天灾军团的爪牙，让我们的勇士得到安息，并在那里磨砺你的战斗技艺。
text.completion: Welcome back from your exercises, $n. Even while we practice for the competition, it's good to remind ourselves that the Scourge is still out there.

english.title: A Valiant's Field Training
english.objectives: Saandos at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to kill 10 Converted Heroes.
english.description: The tournament is a time for testing your skills against your peers, but we must not forget that the real enemy, the Scourge, will not wait. As you hone your skills against others, so should you maintain your edge in combat against the enemy.$B$BTravel to the area southwest of the Valley of Fallen Heroes and north of Corp'rethar. There, the Scourge raises dead heroes and turns them against us. Defeat these minions of the Scourge, do honor to our allies, and keep yourself prepared for combat.
english.completion: Welcome back from your exercises, $n. Even while we practice for the competition, it's good to remind ourselves that the Scourge is still out there.

text.title: 总决赛
text.objectives: 将三枚勇士的印记交给银色比武场的兰妮。$B$B如果你丢失了长枪，可以在银色盟约大帐或者兽栏附近的长枪架上再拿一根。
text.description: 总决赛是锦标赛中最重要的一场比赛。埃索达的人民期待着我们能获得这场比赛的胜利。为了这个目标，我们要不断地与其他的勇士们比武练习，提升自己的战斗能力。$B$B我建议你也参加。$B$B到大帐外面的兽栏中去，拿起你的长枪，骑上兽栏中的秘蓝岛雷象，去挑战其他的勇士吧。联盟勇士的练习场就在我们的帐篷外面，他们在那里等待你的挑战。
text.progress: Have you completed your training for the grand melee?
text.completion: Well done. Training against the other valiants is one of the best ways to prepare yourself for tournament competition. I know you'll make us proud, $n.

text.title: 冠军的利剑
text.objectives: 找到灰木之剑，把它交给银色比武场的亚琳·永歌。
text.description: 啊，说实话，光靠锋利的钢剑是不足以获得胜利的。其他参赛者用的都是附有魔法的武器，这对我非常不利，不过这也不是什么大问题。$B$B一个流传于灰熊丘陵的古老传说中提到，那里有位女士为了守护一把剑受到诅咒，变成了一只青蛙。现在她就住在灰木哨站东边的灰木湖岸上，和其它的湖蛙生活在一起。根据传说，唯一能够解除这道诅咒的方法，是有人自愿去亲吻她。不过呢，你要记得先在嘴唇上涂抹这种药膏，然后再去亲吻湖蛙，不然你的嘴上会长疣的。

text.completion: So the tales were true? This is a fine blade and I have no doubt that it will serve me well in the tournament. You have my thanks, $n.

Gather the flowers and take them to the circle of lamps in Drak'Mar Lake in northeastern Dragonblight, near Zul'Drak and Grizzly Hills. Ask the lonely maiden for a worthy blade.
text.progress: Were the wandering bard's tales true? Have you brought a blade?
text.completion: This is a fine weapon that will help me crush the competition. Thank you, $n.

text.title: 冬之利刃
text.objectives: 将冬之利刃交给银色比武场的碎颅者莫克拉。
text.description: 那个天杀的死亡骑士，把我的剑给弄坏了！$B$B前往晶歌森林的南部，你可以在水晶裂痕的出口上方找到恒焰领主。杀死他，拿到他身上的恒焰灰烬。$B$B带着恒焰灰烬前往嚎风峡湾北部的冬息湖中心，解救一位被寒冰困在那里的女士。她守护着一把古代宝剑，能够解救她的人就可以获得那把宝剑作为奖励。$B$B证明你的能力，拿到她守护了许久的宝剑吧，$n。
text.progress: Did you win the blade?
text.completion: The blade is as fine as the stories say. It would seem there's little reason to complete the repairs on my customary blade. Winter's Edge is far superior and I will continue to carry it. You have my thanks, $n.

text.title: 勇士的实战训练
text.objectives: 银色比武场的埃基诺斯要你消灭10名被转化的英雄。
text.description: 在锦标赛上，你可以和你的战友们一起练习技术，但是时刻都不要忘记，我们真正的敌人——天灾军团绝不会坐等灭亡。你不但要和队友切磋，还要在与敌人的战斗中磨砺自己的刀锋。$B$B到位于陨落英雄之谷西南和恐惧之门科雷萨以北的那个地区去。天灾军团正在那里复活死亡的英雄们，并将他们变成我们的敌人。击败那些天灾军团的爪牙，让我们的勇士得到安息，并在那里磨砺你的战斗技艺。
text.progress: A good day of training will never hurt anyone. It's good to see you keeping up.
text.completion: A good day of training will never hurt anyone. It's good to see you keeping up.

english.title: A Valiant's Field Training
english.objectives: Akinos at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to kill 10 Converted Heroes.
english.description: The tournament is a time for testing your skills against your peers, but we must not forget that the real enemy, the Scourge, will not wait. As you hone your skills against others, so should you maintain your edge in combat against the enemy.$B$BTravel to the area southwest of the Valley of Fallen Heroes and north of Corp'rethar. There, the Scourge raises dead heroes and turns them against us. Defeat these minions of the Scourge, do honor to our allies, and keep yourself prepared for combat.
english.progress: A good day of training will never hurt anyone. It's good to see you keeping up.
english.completion: A good day of training will never hurt anyone. It's good to see you keeping up.

text.title: 自然关闭
text.objectives: 使用纳亚尔的树枝关闭10座恶魔之门。
text.description: 通过大地，我能感到恶魔正在被带到这个世界里来。不久他们就会数不胜数，我们将毫无反击的希望。$B$B带上我的树枝，回到冥火岭南边的屠魔峡谷和屠魔山，对准一扇恶魔之门并集中精神。我将森林的一部分生命力储存在这树枝中，它能够把大门关闭。
text.completion: With their gates closed and no further reinforcements coming, it is only a matter of time now before the demons are no more.$B$BYou are a $g hero : heroine; of the forest, $N. I give you thanks on behalf of all of Ashenvale's creatures!

english.title: Closure is Only Natural
english.objectives: Use Gnarl's Bough to close 10 Demon Gates.
english.description: Through the ground I can feel more demons being brought into our world. Soon there will be too many and we will be overrun without hope of turning them back.$B$BTake this piece of me and return to Demon Fall Canyon and Demon Fall Ridge, south of Felfire Hill. Aim the bough at a demon gate and concentrate. I have stored a portion of the forest's life force in its wood, and it will close the gate.
english.completion: With their gates closed and no further reinforcements coming, it is only a matter of time now before the demons are no more.$B$BYou are a $g hero : heroine; of the forest, $N. I give you thanks on behalf of all of Ashenvale's creatures!

text.title: 总决赛
text.objectives: 将三枚勇士的印记交给银色比武场的茉拉·狼女。$B$B如果你丢失了长枪，可以在夺日者大帐或者兽栏附近的长枪架上再拿一根。
text.description: 总决赛是锦标赛中最重要的一场比赛。胜利必然是来之不易的，但我们有必胜的信心。你必须严格训练你的坐骑，直到它和你融为一体。$B$B这可以帮助你保持战斗的活力。$B$B到大帐外面的兽栏中去，拿起你的长枪，骑上兽栏中的奥格瑞玛座狼，去挑战其他的勇士吧。部落勇士的练习场就在我们的帐篷外面，他们在那里等待你的挑战。
text.progress: Have you completed your training for the grand melee?
text.completion: Training against the other valiants will sharpen your claws and hone your battle insticts. When the competition begins, you will be ready.

english.title: The Grand Melee
english.objectives: Bring 3 Marks of the Valiant to Morah Worgsister at the Argent Tournament Grounds.$B$BIf you lose your lance, you can get another from any of the Lance Racks near the stables or in the Sunreaver Pavilion.
english.description: The grand melee is the most important of the tournament's competitions. Victory will not be easy, but I am confident that we will win. You must practice with your mount until the two of you work as one.$B$BIt will help prepare you for the rigors of tournament combat.$B$BGo to the stables outside the pavilion, equip your lance, mount the stabled Orgrimmar wolf, and challenge the valiants. They wait in the Horde Valiants' Ring just outside our tent.

text.title: 冠军的利剑
text.objectives: 找到灰木之剑，把它交给银色比武场的祖尔托。

text.completion: So the tales were true? This blade should be enough to best anything those Alliance entrants can come up with.

We can't afford to let them have that kind of advantage.$B$BThere's an old legend from Grizzly Hills about a maiden cursed with a frog's form to protect the blade she has long guarded. Otherwise, you'll catch warts.

text.description: 总决赛是锦标赛中最重要的一场比赛。胜利必然是来之不易的，但我们有必胜的信心。你必须严格训练你的坐骑，直到它和你融为一体。$B$B这可以帮助你保持战斗的活力。$B$B到大帐外面的兽栏中去，拿起你的长枪，骑上兽栏中的莫高雷科多兽，去挑战其他的勇士吧。部落勇士的练习场就在我们的帐篷外面，他们在那里等待你的挑战。
text.progress: Have you completed your training for the grand melee?
text.completion: Training against the other valiants will sharpen your claws and hone your battle insticts. When the competition begins, you will be ready.

english.title: The Grand Melee
english.objectives: Bring 3 Marks of the Valiant to Anka Clawhoof at the Argent Tournament Grounds.$B$BIf you lose your lance, you can get another from any of the Lance Racks near the stables or in the Sunreaver Pavilion.
english.description: The grand melee is the most important of the tournament's competitions. Victory will not be easy, but I am confident that we will win. You must practice with your mount until the two of you work as one.$B$BIt will help prepare you for the rigors of tournament combat.$B$BGo to the stables outside the pavilion, equip your lance, mount the stabled Mulgore kodo, and challenge the valiants. They wait in the Horde Valiants' Ring just outside our tent.
english.progress: Have you completed your training for the grand melee?
english.completion: Training against the other valiants will sharpen your claws and hone your battle insticts. When the competition begins, you will be ready.

text.title: 冠军的利剑
text.objectives: 找到灰木之剑，把它交给带给银色比武场的死亡猎手维瑟里。
text.description: 听说联盟的冠军都在为他们的战士寻找古代的兵器，我们可不能让他们占这个便宜。$B$B一个流传于灰熊丘陵的古老传说中提到，那里有位女士为了守护一把剑受到诅咒，变成了一只青蛙。现在她就住在灰木哨站东边的灰木湖岸上，和其它的湖蛙生活在一起。根据传说，唯一能够解除这道诅咒的方法，是有人自愿去亲吻她。不过呢，你要记得先在嘴唇上涂抹这种药膏，然后再去亲吻湖蛙，不然你的嘴上会长疣的。
text.progress: Were you able to recover the blade?
text.completion: So the tales were true? This blade should be enough to best anything those Alliance entrants can come up with.

english.title: A Blade Fit For A Champion
english.objectives: Retrieve the Ashwood Brand and bring it to Deathstalker Visceri at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
english.description: I've heard that the Alliance champions are seeking after ancient blades for their warriors. We can't afford to let them have that kind of advantage.$B$BThere's an old legend from Grizzly Hills about a maiden cursed with a frog's form to protect the blade she has long guarded. She lives among the lake frogs on the shore of Ashwood Lake, just east of Ashwood Post. The only thing said to break the curse is a kiss, freely given. Apply this balm before kissing anything, $n. Otherwise, you'll catch warts.
english.progress: Were you able to recover the blade?
english.completion: So the tales were true? This blade should be enough to best anything those Alliance entrants can come up with.

text.title: 珍贵的武器
text.objectives: 将达克玛尔之剑交给银色比武场的死亡猎手维瑟里。
text.description: 为什么我的运气总是烂到家了呢？我的比赛用剑无影无踪了！$B$B在吟游诗人的传说里，如果哪位旅人能给一位孤独的女士带去几朵冬水仙，就可以获得她的礼物。那些花只生长在铁墙大坝下游的浮冰上，就在晶歌森林的西北部，与冰冠冰川交界的地方。去摘些这种花，然后把花带到龙骨荒野东北部的达克玛尔湖去，就在该地区与祖达克、灰熊丘陵交界处的灯环中找到那位孤独女士。把花献给她，她会回赠你一把优秀的利剑。
text.progress: Were the wandering bard's tales true? Have you brought a blade?
text.completion: This is a fine weapon that will help me crush the competition. Thank you, $n.

english.title: A Worthy Weapon
english.objectives: Bring the Blade of Drak'Mar to Deathstalker Visceri at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
english.description: Of all the times to have such rotten luck!$B$BMy tournament blade has gone missing. I've heard the bards telling tales of travelers offering winter hyacinths to a lonely maiden in return for gifts. Those hyacinths grow only on the ice flowing from the Ironwall Dam, on Crystalsong Forest's northwestern border with Icecrown. Gather the flowers and take them to the circle of lamps in Drak'Mar Lake in northeastern Dragonblight, near Zul'Drak and Grizzly Hills. Ask the lonely maiden for a worthy blade.
english.progress: Were the wandering bard's tales true? Have you brought a blade?
english.completion: This is a fine weapon that will help me crush the competition. Thank you, $n.

text.title: 冬之利刃
text.objectives: 将冬之利刃交给银色比武场的死亡猎手维瑟里。
text.description: 那个天杀的死亡骑士，把我的剑给弄坏了！$B$B前往晶歌森林的南部，你可以在水晶裂痕的出口上方找到恒焰领主。杀死他，拿到他身上的恒焰灰烬。$B$B带着恒焰灰烬前往嚎风峡湾北部的冬息湖中心，解救一位被寒冰困在那里的女士。她守护着一把古代宝剑，能够解救她的人就可以获得那把宝剑作为奖励。$B$B证明你的能力，拿到她守护了许久的宝剑吧，$n。
text.progress: Did you win the blade?
text.completion: The blade is as fine as the stories say. It would seem there's little reason to complete the repairs on my customary blade. Winter's Edge is far superior and I will continue to carry it. You have my thanks, $n.

english.title: The Edge Of Winter
english.objectives: Deathstalker Visceri at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to bring him Winter's Edge.
english.description: Curse that death knight for breaking my sword!$B$BIn southern Crystalsong Forest, overlooking the Crystal Vice's exit, you will find Lord Everblaze. Kill him and take the everburning ember from his corpse.$B$BBring it to the center of Winter's Breath Lake in northern Howling Fjord, and use it to free the maiden encased in ice. She is the guardian of an ancient sword and will award it to whoever frees her.$B$BProve your worth and earn the weapon that she has guarded for so long, $n.
english.progress: Did you win the blade?
english.completion: The blade is as fine as the stories say. It would seem there's little reason to complete the repairs on my customary blade. Winter's Edge is far superior and I will continue to carry it. You have my thanks, $n.

text.title: 勇士的实战训练
text.objectives: 银色比武场的莎拉·查尔克要你消灭10名被转化的英雄。
text.description: 在锦标赛上，你可以和你的战友们一起练习技术，但是时刻都不要忘记，我们真正的敌人——天灾军团绝不会坐等灭亡。你不但要和队友切磋，还要在与敌人的战斗中磨砺自己的刀锋。$B$B到位于陨落英雄之谷西南和恐惧之门科雷萨以北的那个地区去。天灾军团正在那里复活死亡的英雄们，并将他们变成我们的敌人。击败那些天灾军团的爪牙，让我们的勇士得到安息，并在那里磨砺你的战斗技艺。
text.progress: A good day of training will never hurt anyone. It's good to see you keeping up.
text.completion: A good day of training will never hurt anyone. It's good to see you keeping up.

english.title: A Valiant's Field Training
english.objectives: Sarah Chalke at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to kill 10 Converted Heroes.
english.description: The tournament is a time for testing your skills against your peers, but we must not forget that the real enemy, the Scourge, will not wait. As you hone your skills against others, so should you maintain your edge in combat against the enemy.$B$BTravel to the area southwest of the Valley of Fallen Heroes and north of Corp'rethar. There, the Scourge raises dead heroes and turns them against us. Defeat these minions of the Scourge, do honor to our allies, and keep yourself prepared for combat.
english.progress: A good day of training will never hurt anyone. It's good to see you keeping up.
english.completion: A good day of training will never hurt anyone. It's good to see you keeping up.

text.title: 总决赛
text.objectives: 将三枚勇士的印记交给银色比武场的马夫德雷奇。$B$B如果你丢失了长枪，可以在夺日者大帐或者兽栏附近的长枪架上再拿一根。
text.description: 总决赛是锦标赛中最重要的一场比赛。胜利必然是来之不易的，但我们有必胜的信心。你必须严格训练你的坐骑，直到它和你融为一体。$B$B这可以帮助你保持战斗的活力。$B$B到大帐外面的兽栏中去，拿起你的长枪，骑上兽栏中的被遗忘者战马，去挑战其他的勇士吧。部落勇士的练习场就在我们的帐篷外面，他们在那里等待你的挑战。
text.progress: Have you completed your training for the grand melee?
text.completion: Training against the other valiants will sharpen your claws and hone your battle insticts. When the competition begins, you will be ready.

english.title: The Grand Melee
english.objectives: Bring 3 Marks of the Valiant to Handler Dretch at the Argent Tournament Grounds.$B$BIf you lose your lance, you can get another from any of the Lance Racks near the stables or in the Sunreaver Pavilion.
english.description: The grand melee is the most important of the tournament's competitions. Victory will not be easy, but I am confident that we will win. You must practice with your mount until the two of you work as one.$B$BIt will help prepare you for the rigors of tournament combat. $B$BGo to the stables outside the pavilion, equip your lance, mount the stabled Forsaken warhorse, and challenge the valiants. They wait in the Horde Valiants' Ring just outside our tent.
english.progress: Have you completed your training for the grand melee?
english.completion: Training against the other valiants will sharpen your claws and hone your battle insticts. When the competition begins, you will be ready.

text.title: 空中的威胁
text.objectives: 银色比武场的科罗克·斩亡者要你消灭3名诅咒教派投弹手，并击败冰喉。
text.description: 自从你揪出诅咒教派的间谍之后，银色北伐军已经把赛场中的卫兵数量增加了一倍。只要这里还没有被夷为平地，只要锦标赛还没有被完全破坏，诅咒教徒就不会善罢甘休。$B$B银色北伐军的斥候发现了一支诅咒教派的部队，他们在一条名叫冰喉的冰霜巨龙的带领下向我们奔袭。$B$B你必须在他们发动攻击之前阻止他们。根据斥候的报告，冰喉就盘旋在我们的西南方向，铁墙大坝和奥尔杜萨交界的地方。
text.progress: Have you defeated the Cult of the Damned raiding party?
text.completion: $N, you have spared the tournament from a devastating attack. The Argent Crusade and all who gather here are in our debt and we'll make certain they remember it. For all their bluster about providing protection, the peacekeepers and skytalons spend more time breaking up drunken brawls than keeping us safe from the Scourge.$b$bIt's no matter. We always protect our own.

english.title: Threat From Above
english.objectives: Crok Scourgebane at the Argent Tournament wants you to defeat Chillmaw and 3 Cultist Bombardiers.
english.description: The Argent Crusade has doubled the guard since your exposure of the Cult of the Damned's infiltrator. They know the cultists won't stop until they've destroyed this area and thwarted the tournament.$B$BThe Argent Crusade's scouts have reported sighting a frost wyrm named Chillmaw leading a cult raiding party.$B$BYou must intercept and destroy them before they attack. The scouts reporting seeing Chillmaw to the southwest, flying over the area between the Ironwall Rampart and Aldur'thar.
