text.title: 我的时候已经到了
text.objectives: 塔迪萨兰的弗瑞恩要你乘他的龙鹰前往弗瑞恩的哨站，去把他的死讯告诉他的姐姐瑟蕾莉亚。
text.description: <弗瑞虚弱地示意你凑近，挣扎着说道。>$b$b是我自己不当心……被联盟的火力打了下来……$b$b你必须……告诉我的姐姐。$b$b乘上我的坐骑，$r……它会把你带到她那里去……$b$b<弗瑞恩断了气。>
text.completion:
What!?

Furien!! My brother is no more?

They must pay! All of them!

english.title: My Time Has Passed
english.objectives: Furien at Tethris Aran wants you to ride his Dragonhawk to Furien's Post and inform his sister, Cerelia of his death.
english.description: <Weakly, Furien beckons you near and struggles to speak.>$b$bCareless... I was shot down by Alliance fire...$b$bYou must... inform my sister.$b$bTake my mount, $r... he'll bring you to her...$b$b<Furien expires.>
english.completion:
What!?

Furien!! My brother is no more?

They must pay! All of them!

text.title: 为弗瑞恩报仇！
text.objectives: 瑟蕾莉亚要你跟弗瑞恩的哨站的苏伦谈一谈。
text.description: 这不可能！$b$b我亲爱的弟弟——被联盟的混账杀了！$b$b他们要为此遭罪，$r！想办法让他们痛不欲生！除非大仇得报，否则我将永不罢休……$b$b弗瑞恩生前一直在东部区域研究远古神器。去跟苏伦谈一谈，也许他可以将你指引到我弟弟的足迹上去。
text.completion:
Furien's passing is... regrettable.

I shall do all that I can to assist you in avenging his death.

english.title: Avenge Furien!
english.objectives: Cerelia wants you to speak with Sorrem at Furien's Post.
english.description: This cannot be!$b$bMy dear brother - slain by Alliance scum!$b$bThey must be made to suffer, $r! Find a way to bring them pain! I shall not rest until it is so...$b$bFurien had been researching ancient artifacts in the eastern regions before his death. Speak to Sorrem. Perhaps he can direct you in my brother's footsteps.
english.completion:
Furien's passing is... regrettable.

I shall do all that I can to assist you in avenging his death.

text.title: 翻译
text.objectives: 苏伦要你找到远古石板。$b$b跟弗瑞恩的哨站的纳里玛谈一谈，乘坐骑到弗瑞恩的研究现场去。
text.description: 弗瑞恩在最后的日子里确实致力于一个特殊的研究计划。具体是什么，他不肯跟我说。$b$b幸运的是，我找到了他的日志，不过是由一种我无法破译的密码写成的。$b$b你或许能在东边他住过的地方，找到一些翻译的线索。$b$b拿上这本日志，$c，做好调查秘密的准备后，就去跟纳里玛谈一谈。
text.completion: Comparing the characters on the ancient tablet to those in Furien's journal, it is clear that there is a distinct correlation.

english.title: Translation
english.objectives: Sorrem wants you to find the Ancient Tablets.$b$bSpeak to Narimar at Furien's Post to ride to where Furien was known to study.
english.description: It is true that Furien dedicated his last days to a special research project. What that was, he would not share with me.$b$bFortunately, I was able to recover his journal, but it's written in a code that I cannot decipher.$b$bPerhaps there is a clue to its translation in the region to the east where he spent his time.$b$bTake the journal, $c, and speak with Narimar when you are ready to investigate this mystery.
english.completion: Comparing the characters on the ancient tablet to those in Furien's journal, it is clear that there is a distinct correlation.

text.title: 完美的棱镜
text.objectives: 从山麓矿场的塔伦迪斯破坏者身上获得一副水晶坠饰。
text.description: 一定有什么办法化解蜥蜴的石化术。那些潜伏在矿区烦人的暗夜精灵破坏者肯定知道些什么，他们好像就对畜牲的招数免疫！$B$B我要你去找出他们的秘密，$n，除掉几个在山麓矿场后面鬼鬼祟祟的塔伦迪斯破坏者，把他们身上戴的护符啊还是别的什么拿一件过来。成事之后在铸造主楼用无线电联系我。

english.title: The Perfect Prism
english.objectives: Acquire a Crystal Pendant from a Talrendis Saboteur in the Mountainfoot Strip Mine.
english.description: There's got to be a way to reverse the basilisks' stonification. Those irritating night elf saboteurs who have been lurking around my mine must know something we don't. They seem to be immune to the gaze of the beast!$B$BI want you to find out their secret, $n. Pick off a few of the Talrendis saboteurs skulking about in the rear of the strip mine and get a sample of whatever charm or ding-dong they're wearing to give them immunity. Radio me from the main forge building once you're successful.

text.title: 弗瑞恩的脚步
text.objectives: 艾露恩圣殿的远古石板指示你去拜访萨格隆的三处知名废墟。
text.description: 你可以破译一星半点的文字，但要想理解弗瑞恩的著作，就需要做大量的研究了。$b$b眼下，朝东北看去，你觉得你认出了日志上所记载的几处废墟。$b$b就你所知，这些废墟在弗瑞恩的研究中有着某种重要性。
text.completion:
It is clear to you now that these ruins are those that Furien recorded in his journal.

After examining the engravings upon the ruins themselves, you feel that you are able to decipher more of Furien's writings.

english.title: Furien's Footsteps
english.objectives: The Ancient Tablets at the Shrine of Elune have directed you to visit three of the prominent ruins in Sargeron.
english.description: You can decipher bits and pieces of the text, but it will require extensive study before Furien's work becomes coherent.$b$bFor now, as you look off to the northeast, you think you can make out some of the ruins depicted in the journal.$b$bFrom what you can tell, these ruins seem to have been of some significance to Furien's research.
english.completion:
It is clear to you now that these ruins are those that Furien recorded in his journal.

After examining the engravings upon the ruins themselves, you feel that you are able to decipher more of Furien's writings.

objectiveDetails.description: 造访艾露恩的教堂废墟
造访艾露恩的神庙废墟
造访艾露恩的庇护所废墟

text.title: 棱镜的粉碎
text.objectives: 把水晶坠饰带到山麓矿场总部的武器柜旁。
text.description: 假如你的棱镜被调校用来反射蜥蜴的石化视线，那么也可以利用它的晶体属性逆转这一过程。我们所需要的是一束能量源。$B$B你右边的武器柜里放着我们的激光矿钻样机，我爱那玩意儿，可每天都有肢解事故也挺烦人。拿上激光钻，把镜头用水晶换下来……

english.title: Prismbreak
english.objectives: Take the Crystal Pendant to the Weapons Cabinet in the Mountainfoot Strip Mine Headquarters.
english.description: If that prism of yours is tuned to refract a basilisk's gaze, we can use its crystal properties to reverse the process. All we need is a source of power.$B$BIn the weapons cabinet to your right, you'll find our prototype laser mining drill. I loved that thing but the near daily dismemberments got to be a real bother. Grab the laser drill and swap out the lens with that crystal of yours...

text.title: 没什么是几颗瓜解决不了的
text.objectives: 收集8枚瓜果。
text.description: 废墟上的标记，让你明白了一件事：艾露恩庇护所的旧喷泉有什么蹊跷。$b$b看样子，如果用泉水洗脸的话，人们就能获得特殊的力量。当然，首先，远古喷泉里得有某样用来洗的东西才行。$b$b你正在思忖着，突然在附近的大树脚下发现了一颗瓜果……
text.completion:
After filling it with liquid from the melons, you proceed to wash your eyes from the ancient font.

Upon opening your eyes, you are able to see the spirits of ancient elves, still faithfully carrying out rituals to their goddess.

english.title: Nothing a Couple of Melons Won't Fix
english.objectives: Gather 8 Melonfruit.
english.description: The markings on the ruins here make one thing clear: There is something special about the old fountain in the Sanctuary of Elune.$b$bIt would seem that one could expect special power from washing their face in the fountain. First, of course, there would need to be something in the ancient fountain with which to wash.$b$bPondering this problem, you spot a melonfruit at the base of a nearby tree....
english.completion:
After filling it with liquid from the melons, you proceed to wash your eyes from the ancient font.

Upon opening your eyes, you are able to see the spirits of ancient elves, still faithfully carrying out rituals to their goddess.

text.title: 重塑血肉
text.objectives: 用血肉重塑器活化8个山麓矿场里的山麓矿工。
text.description: <附近的无线电在呼叫你。>$B$B嗨，$n，你拿到枪了吗？好的！别直接对着自己的眼睛。$B$B瞄准石化工人，折射光应该就能逆转石化进程。要么就是烧化他们，管它的，我的工人得能给我挣钱，要是活化重塑过程让他们精神不正常，杀了他们还能拿份保险。霍扎克完毕！

english.title: Refleshification
english.objectives: Use The Refleshifier to de-stonify eight Mountainfoot Miners within the Mountainfoot Strip Mine.
english.description: <The nearby radio calls out to you.>$B$BHey $n, you got that gun? Good! Don't point it directly at your eye.$B$BAim that baby at my stonified workers and the refracted light should reverse the petrification process. Or it will melt them. Whatever. Return my workers to a state of profitability! And if the refleshification process makes them crazy-go-nuts, they should be killed for insurance purposes. Horzak OUT!

text.title: 一切都变得更加清楚了
text.objectives: 弗瑞恩的日志指示你在北萨格隆找到艾露恩的宫殿。
text.description: 发生了某种变化……也许是艾露恩净化仪式的副作用。$b$b尽管不可能完全掌握日志上的远古语言，但你对它们的理解还是突飞猛进。$b$b萨格隆北部山川里的废墟似乎是弗瑞恩最为热衷的。他觉得，那里有某种东西可以帮他把联盟从这一地区赶走。$b$b你合上日志，决心要找到废墟，发现它的秘密。
text.completion:
It is clear to you now why you were guided here.

You recognize this ancient runestone from Furien's final journal entry:

"The ancients revered the gems created by this mystical object, claiming that they were gifts from the goddess herself. It was believed that they were weapons capable of delivering them from any enemy."

english.title: All Becoming Clearer
english.objectives: Furien's Journal has directed you to find the ruined Palace of Elune in northern Sargeron.
english.description: Something has changed... perhaps a side-effect of Elune's cleansing ritual.$b$bWhile it's by no means perfect yet, your understanding of the ancient language in the journal has vastly improved.$b$bThe ruins in the northern mountains of Sargeron appear to be the main focus of Furien's enthusiasm. Something there, he felt, would aid him in driving the Alliance from this region.$b$bYou close the journal determined to find this ruin and discover its secrets.
english.completion:
It is clear to you now why you were guided here.

You recognize this ancient runestone from Furien's final journal entry:

"The ancients revered the gems created by this mystical object, claiming that they were gifts from the goddess herself. It was believed that they were weapons capable of delivering them from any enemy."

objectiveDetails.description: 找到艾露恩宫殿的废墟

text.title: 点火人
text.objectives: 你要以火焰风暴的形态打败7名艾露恩的信徒，形成一个盛怒漩涡。$b$b如果你丢失了漩涡宝石，就去上古漩涡符石那里去拿另一颗。
text.description: 你现在能明白日志上所写的文字了。$b$b符石边上的注解说，这些纪念碑上的宝石都附上了魔力，可以召唤火焰风暴。$b$b通过持续崇拜艾露恩，或是注入死者的灵魂能量，都能让风暴成长为一件强大的武器。$b$b看着刚显现的艾露恩信徒的鬼魂，你理智地认为自己既没有时间，也缺乏崇拜敌人女神的这个癖好……
text.completion:
It is done! Furien's exhaustive research was not in vain.

The raging Vortex is ready to be unleashed upon your enemies at last!

english.title: Firestarter
english.objectives: You are to create a Raging Vortex by defeating 7 Disciples of Elune in the presence of your firestorm.$b$bShould you lose your Vortex Gem, another can be obtained from the Ancient Vortex Runestone.
english.description: You are now able to understand the script in which the journal was written.$b$bAlong the runestone, it is explained that the monument's gemstones were imbued with the power to summon a firestorm.$b$bThe storm could grow to be a mighty weapon either through sustained worship of Elune, or charged by spiritual energies of the fallen.$b$bLooking down upon the newly revealed ghosts of Elune's disciples, you reason that you have neither the time, nor the inclination to worship the goddess of your enemy....
english.completion:
It is done! Furien's exhaustive research was not in vain.

The raging Vortex is ready to be unleashed upon your enemies at last!

text.title: 达成指标
text.objectives: 从艾萨拉的山麓矿场拿20块山麓铁矿。
text.description: 山麓铁矿是种脆弱的合金，但只要上下打点好了，它就能达到地精的安全标准。负责生产的齐格尼伯出了岔子，但我的工期不能变。我手头是有指标的！$B$B到山麓矿场里去拿上你能找到的山麓铁矿，它们应该已经提炼好了准备装货。
text.progress: Did you get my shipment together?

english.title: A Quota to Meet
english.objectives: Gather 20 ingots of Mountainfoot Iron from the Mountainfoot Strip Mine in Azshara.
english.description: Mountainfoot iron is a brittle alloy, but with the right bribes it meets goblin safety standards. Zignibble here is having trouble on the production end of things, but that doesn't change any of my deadlines. I've got a quota to fill!$B$BHead down into the Mountainfoot Strip Mine and gather up any ingots of Mountainfoot iron you find. There should be piles of it smelted and ready for shipment.
english.progress: Did you get my shipment together?

text.title: 风暴上的骑士
text.objectives: 在尼耶尔前哨站使用盛怒漩涡宝石。指挥你的火焰风暴，杀死40个尼耶尔前哨站防御者，烧死15名尼耶尔前哨站商人。$b$b如果你丢失了盛怒漩涡宝石，可以去上古漩涡符石那里去拿另一颗。
text.description: 艾露恩上古崇拜者们长期失落的秘密被你发现了，你不由得骄傲了起来。$b$b现在你拥有的力量可以给敌人造成巨大的伤害。$b$b正是弗瑞恩不懈的工作让它成为了可能，用这武器向那些夺走他生命的人头上砍去，自然再合乎情理不过。$b$b尼耶尔前哨站的联盟混账们将为攻击部落而付出代价！
text.completion:
Very impressive, $c.

You completed Furien's work and rained vengeance down upon his killers.

You have brought peace to my brother's soul, and to my mind. Please accept this gift for your diligence.

english.title: Rider on the Storm
english.objectives: Use the Raging Vortex Gem at Nijel's Point Ruin. While commanding your firestorm, kill 40 Nijel's Point Defenders and burn 15 Nijel's Point Merchants.$b$bShould you lose your Raging Vortex Gem, you may acquire another from the Ancient Vortex Runestone.
english.description: You cannot help but to feel a twinge of pride, having unlocked this long lost secret of the ancient worshippers of Elune.$b$bYou now possess the power to inflict great damage upon your enemy.$b$bAs it was Furien's tireless work that made this possible, it only seems right that the weapon should be unleashed upon those who took his life.$b$bThe Alliance scum at Nijel's Point shall pay for their offenses against the Horde!
english.completion:
Very impressive, $c.

You completed Furien's work and rained vengeance down upon his killers.

You have brought peace to my brother's soul, and to my mind. Please accept this gift for your diligence.

objectiveDetails.description: 击败尼耶尔前哨站防御者
击败尼耶尔前哨站商人

text.title: Proof of Demise: The Black Knight
text.objectives: Archmage Lan'dalock in Dalaran wants you to return with a Fragment of the Black Knight's Soul.$B$BThis quest may only be completed on Heroic difficulty.
text.description: My counterpart, Archmage Timear, has asked me to warn you of something dire. Soon, you will be participating in the Trial of the Champions at the Argent Coliseum in Icecrown. You must beware of interference from one known only as the Black Knight.$B$BBring me a fragment of his soul that the Kirin Tor will know he is dealt with. I am told that failing to do so will be your own undoing.
text.progress: Did the Black Knight appear unexpectedly as Timear foresaw?
text.completion: It is good to see that you have emerged victorious from the trial. Truly, you are a champion, not only of the Argent Crusade, but indeed of the Kirin Tor as well.$b$bOne can only hope that you have dealt the final blow to that dark villain and that's the last that we will see of him.

english.objectives: Archmage Lan'dalock in Dalaran wants you to return with a Fragment of the Black Knight's Soul.$B$BThis quest may only be completed on Heroic difficulty.
english.description: My counterpart, Archmage Timear, has asked me to warn you of something dire. Soon, you will be participating in the Trial of the Champions at the Argent Coliseum in Icecrown. You must beware of interference from one known only as the Black Knight.$B$BBring me a fragment of his soul that the Kirin Tor will know he is dealt with. I am told that failing to do so will be your own undoing.
english.progress: Did the Black Knight appear unexpectedly as Timear foresaw?
english.completion: It is good to see that you have emerged victorious from the trial. Truly, you are a champion, not only of the Argent Crusade, but indeed of the Kirin Tor as well.$b$bOne can only hope that you have dealt the final blow to that dark villain and that's the last that we will see of him.

text.title: 一沙一世界
text.objectives: 在艾萨拉的门纳尔湖遗迹附近收集5件重见天日的神器。
text.description: 在东边门纳尔湖附近，遗迹有着自己的故事。低等种族——比如那些粗鄙的矮人——会用铲子和锄头来寻找真实。<梅琳妮皱皱鼻子。>我们的方法要高雅得多。$B$B我的占卜法术或许生疏了，可只要道具齐全，我还是能窥透时间的叠嶂。先祖的尸骨已经腐朽，可他们的陪葬或许还在——给我带些来。

english.title: A Thousand Stories in the Sand
english.objectives: Collect 5 Recovered Artifacts from the ruins around Lake Mennar in Azshara.
english.description: The ruins around Lake Mennar, to our east, have a tale to tell. The lesser races - like those clumsy dwarves - would go after the truth with picks and shovels. <Malynea wrinkles her nose.> We'll be using more elegant methods.$B$BMy scrying magic is somewhat rusty, but with the right trinket I should be able to peer through the shrouds of time. The bones of my forefathers have long since rotted away but some of their personal treasures may remain - bring me some.

text.title: 调查湖畔
text.objectives: 护送一名初级地精勘测员前往门纳尔湖边的三处测量员设备处，并在抄取读数时保护她。你可以用勘测员的信标召唤另一名勘测员。
text.description: 要想挖掘艾萨拉的全部宝藏，这些脏兮兮的古代遗迹都得推平。往我的地图这儿瞧——你看到什么了？东边的门纳尔湖？告诉你，我在这儿看到了未来的火箭燃料仓贮一期工程！$B$B可在填湖造地，开山铺路之前，我们得有精确的地形测绘。我所有的勘测员都被这片地区的鬼脸嘟嘟吓跑了。护送一名初级勘测员到设置好的仪器那儿去抄取一下读数。

english.title: Survey the Lakeshore
english.objectives: Escort a Goblin Surveyor to the three pieces of Surveyor's Equipment that surround Lake Mennar, and defend her while she takes readings. Another Surveyor can always be summoned with your Surveyor's Beacon.
english.description: All these cruddy ancient ruins have to be bulldozed if we're ever to see Azshara's full potential. Look on my map here - you see Lake Mennar, to the East? I'll tell you what I see: a future rocket fuel depot!$B$BBut we need an accurate lay of the land before we can clearcut, bulldoze, landfill, and pave over that lake. All of my surveyors have been spooked off by the oogly-boogleys haunting that area. Escort one of my Jr. grade surveyors to the area and take readings from the equipment that's been set up.

text.title: Waterlogged Recipe
text.objectives: Bring the Waterlogged Recipe to Christi Stockton in the Dalaran city.
text.description: This appears to be the remains of a mixture for potent wine.  Perhaps the proprietor of One More Glass in Dalaran would be interested in it....
text.progress: Wine is only as fine as the person drinking it, I always say.
text.completion: This is quite a find, <name>. I can't have you selling this to anyone else, so I'm willing to offer generously.

english.title: Waterlogged Recipe
english.objectives: Bring the Waterlogged Recipe to Christi Stockton in the Dalaran city.
english.description: This appears to be the remains of a mixture for potent wine.  Perhaps the proprietor of One More Glass in Dalaran would be interested in it....
english.progress: Wine is only as fine as the person drinking it, I always say.
english.completion: This is quite a find, <name>. I can't have you selling this to anyone else, so I'm willing to offer generously.

text.title: 来自阴影
text.objectives: 击败6只血牙潜伏者。
text.description: 他也变成了怪物……是吗？我们要怎么才能去和那些会把我们变成怪物的东西作战？$B$B我想，好好利用我父亲的军械库会成为一个好的开端。$B$B狼人隐匿在前面的街巷中。我的猎犬可以帮你找出他们的踪迹。$B$B要搬运这些炮弹，就必须清掉沿途的障碍。
text.progress: Is it done yet, $N?
text.completion: Excellent.  I'll start rounding up some help to get these cannons positioned.

english.title: From the Shadows
english.objectives: Defeat 6 Bloodfang Lurkers.
english.description: He turned into one of them... didn't he?  How do we even begin to fight an enemy that can do this to us?$B$BMy father's arsenal's certainly a good start, I suppose.$B$BWorgen are hiding in the alleys ahead.  Take one of my mastiffs to find them more easily.$B$BWe're going to need to clear the way ahead if we're going to move these cannons above ground.
english.progress: Is it done yet, $N?
english.completion: Excellent.  I'll start rounding up some help to get these cannons positioned.

text.title: 黏糊糊的发动机
text.objectives: 检查克拉伯尼克的推土机，收集一份粘阻引擎的外溅液样本。
text.description: 那些古代遗迹历经了千万年的风吹雨打依然不倒，所以我让我最大最好的推土机出场来对付它们。我叫她“玛基尼”。$B$B但最近她让我挺失望。就在我开进那片闹鬼的林子时，只听引擎毛骨悚然的一声厉叫，熄火了。我的工程师说是阀门给什么堵住了。去检查一下玛基尼的发动机舱，把阻塞物给我带来。

english.title: Gunk in the Trunk
english.objectives: Inspect Clubnik's Dozer and collect a sample of the Ectosplatter that's gumming up the engine.
english.description: Those ancient ruins have survived ten thousand years of wind and weather, so I brought out my biggest and bestest bulldozer to flatten 'em. I call her "Margene."$B$BBut my dozer's been letting me down lately, $n. The moment I drove her into those haunted woods, her engine seized up with a spine-chilling howl. Now my engineers tell me something's clogging her valves. Go over there and inspect Margene's engine compartment, and bring me back a sample of whatever gunk has her stalled.

text.title: 牺牲
text.objectives: 与达利乌斯·克罗雷领主一同诱走30个血牙猎手。
text.description: $n，你不需要这样做。你给予我们的帮助已经够多了。$B$B当然如果你坚持留下的话……我也不会拒绝。$B$B我已经在教堂部署了防御兵力，随时准备迎敌。$B$B我正准备赶往那里，顺便诱走沿途那些浑身长虱的怪物。欢迎你与我同行。
text.completion: Brace yourself, $N.$B$BHere they come.

english.title: Sacrifices
english.objectives: Ride with Lord Darius Crowley and round up 30 Bloodfang Stalkers.
english.description: You don't have to do this, $n.  You've done more than enough already.$B$BBut if you decide to stay... I'd be a fool to turn you away.$B$BMy men have fortified their position inside the cathedral and are ready for what comes next.$B$BI'm about to head there and take as many of these flea-ridden devils with me as I can.  You're welcome to come along for the ride.
english.completion: Brace yourself, $N.$B$BHere they come.

text.title: 十枚魔印
text.objectives: 你要从萨格隆邪恶的萨特身上收集10枚萨特魔印，将它们放进艾露恩的火盆。
text.description: 根据弗瑞恩的日志，放在这里的远古火盆是为了举行牺牲仪式用的。$b$b就你从词条上所能辨认的来看，只要有人能将艾露恩敌人的魔印放进火盆的余烬中，他就能获得祝福。$b$b瞧了瞧四周，你认为现在支配着这一区域的萨特应该很合适。
text.completion: The divine brazier indiscriminately endows you with a blessing.

english.title: Ten Pounds of Flesh
english.objectives: You are to collect 10 pieces of Satyr Flesh from the various Satyrs in Sargeron, and place them on Elune's Brazier.
english.description: According to Furien's Journal, this ancient brazier was placed here for the performing of sacrifices.$b$bAs far as you can make out from the entry, a blessing is bestowed upon the being who places the flesh of Elune's enemies on the brazier's burning embers.$b$bLooking around, you determine that the satyrs who now possess this region would likely qualify.
english.completion: The divine brazier indiscriminately endows you with a blessing.

text.title: 给格雷迈恩的消息
text.objectives: 跟军事区的吉恩·格雷迈恩国王谈一谈。
text.description: $n，好啦。接下来的事情就交给我们来负责吧。$B$B请转告格雷迈恩国王，我父亲的军械库内的物资任由他支配。这里的军火储备足够将狼人轰到北海去。
text.completion: I knew Crowley would come through.  His weapons will be more than useful to us.

english.title: Message to Greymane
english.objectives: Speak to King Genn Greymane in the Military District.
english.description: It's time, $n.  We'll take it from here.$B$BTell King Greymane that my father's arsenal will be at his disposal.  There's more than enough firepower here to blow the worgen from here to the north sea.
english.completion: I knew Crowley would come through.  His weapons will be more than useful to us.

text.title: 亡者的回忆
text.objectives: 把卡莱莎的指环带往门纳尔湖岸。触碰卡莱莎的灵魂重温她的回忆，同其他灵魂交谈，了解门纳尔湖的秘密。
text.description: 你发现的这枚戒指上，符文依然清晰可鉴：它是“卡莱莎”在学院的入学纪念。假以魔法，这件私人物品就能成为与其灵魂沟通的桥梁。$B$B把戒指带回门纳尔湖，卡莱莎的灵魂将在湖边显现。触碰它，戒指就能把你带回她的世界，重温她的最后时光。刺探她的想法，$n！同其他幽灵交谈，找出门纳尔湖的秘密……

english.title: Memories of the Dead
english.objectives: Take Kalytha's Ring to the shores of Lake Mennar. Touch the Spirit of Kalytha to relive her memories. Speak to the other spirits until you've learned the secret of Lake Mennar.
english.description: The runes on this ring you found are still legible: it was given to "Kalytha" when she was granted admission to the Academy. With the right spell or two, this personal trinket of hers is the gateway to her soul.$B$BTake the ring back to Lake Mennar. Kalytha's spirit should now be visible to you on the shore of the lake. Touch her and the ring will allow you to see the world as she sees it, forever reliving her final hours. Probe her mind, $n! Speak to the others and learn the secrets of Lake Mennar...

text.title: 萨希恩之石的传说
text.objectives: 从门纳尔湖底找回萨希恩之石。
text.description: 临死之前，卡莱莎受人嘱托在湖底埋藏了一件东西，门纳尔的大法师们在生命最后一刻制造的强大神器。难怪梅琳妮·碎天者一定想要见识见识，只要它还存在。你定要在门纳尔湖底找到萨希恩之石。

english.title: Mystery of the Sarcen Stone
english.objectives: Retrieve the Sarcen Stone from the bottom of Lake Mennar.
english.description: Before she died, Kalytha was charged with burying something at the bottom of the lake, a powerful artifact that the archmages of Mennar spent their last moments creating. No doubt Malynea Skyreaver will want to see the artifact, presuming it still exists. You resolve to search the bottom of Lake Mennar for the Sarcen Stone.

text.title: 萨特贡品
text.objectives: 你要从萨格隆邪恶的萨特身上收集10枚萨特魔印，将它们放进艾露恩的火盆。
text.description: 远古遗迹就这样把本该赐予你敌人的祝福加持在了你的身上，你觉得很有意思。$b$b你决定尽量多占有一些这无心之赐。
text.completion: The divine brazier indiscriminately endows you with a blessing.

english.title: Satyrical Offerings
english.objectives: You are to collect 10 pieces of Satyr Flesh from the various Satyrs in Sargeron, and place them on Elune's Brazier.
english.description: You find it most amusing to think that this ancient relic is bestowing upon you a blessing meant for your enemies.$b$bYou determine to make as much as you can of this unintentional gift.
english.completion: The divine brazier indiscriminately endows you with a blessing.

text.title: 以鲜血与灰烬之名
text.objectives: 使用叛军大炮杀死80个血牙猎手。
text.description: $n，时机已经成熟。想要大规模地削减他们的数量，就得抓住眼前这个难得的机会。$B$B我们占据了有利的地理位置。$B$B我们拥有强大的火药。$B$B接下来就要看我们有没有勇气了……我相信，你绝不是个懦夫。
text.completion: You've done well, $N.  You've done more than could be asked of any Gilnean.$B$BWe're running low on ammunition.  It's time to regroup inside now.

english.title: By Blood and Ash
english.objectives: Slay 80 Bloodfang Stalkers using the Rebel Cannons.
english.description: The time has come, $n.  If we're going to put a dent in their numbers, the time is now.$B$BWe have the position.$B$BWe have the firepower.$B$BAll that remains to be seen is whether we have the courage... and I sure don't see a coward standing in front of me.
english.completion: You've done well, $N.  You've done more than could be asked of any Gilnean.$B$BWe're running low on ammunition.  It's time to regroup inside now.

text.title: 追根问柄！
text.objectives: 你要从这一地区的武器架和邪恶的萨特身上收集20把萨特军刀，将它们贡给艾露恩的侍女像。
text.description: 你立刻从弗瑞恩日志的草图上认出了这座雕像。$b$b尽管附注词条上的字眼你难以理解，但草图本身就足够说明问题了。在战斗过后，敌人的武器要被弃在盆里，作为某种神圣馈赠的交换。$b$b正在你琢磨这个仪式的时候，一旁武器架上钢铁的反光映入了你的眼帘……
text.completion:
With the ritual completed, you are awarded a divine gift.

You can't help but wonder what Elune would think of someone such as you receiving one of her boons.
text.end: 已完成艾露恩的战争仪式

english.title: To the Hilt!
english.objectives: You are to collect 20 Satyr Sabers from the weapon racks and various satyrs in the region, then place them upon the statue, Elune's Handmaiden.
english.description: You immediately recognize this statue from a sketch in Furien's Journal.$b$bThough the words associated with the entry elude you, the sketch seems self-explanatory. After battle, the enemies' weapons were to be cast upon the basin in exchange for a divine gift of some sort.$b$bAs you ponder this ritual, the glint of steel catches your eye from a nearby weapon rack....
english.completion:
With the ritual completed, you are awarded a divine gift.

You can't help but wonder what Elune would think of someone such as you receiving one of her boons.

text.title: 绝不投降，偶尔撤退
text.objectives: 跟圣光黎明大教堂的达利乌斯·克罗雷领主谈一谈。
text.description: 这批弹药原本是为内战储备的。如果打内战，再耗上一个月都没问题。但是狼人的数量实在是太多了，军械库已经快空了。$B$B一旦弹药耗尽，我们可不想束手就擒。返回教堂，向领主汇报这一情况。我相信老克罗雷会知道接下来该怎么做的。
text.completion: We've given them everything we have... yet still they come.  Do not worry, $N.  We'll slay many more before today is over.

english.title: Never Surrender, Sometimes Retreat
english.objectives: Speak to Lord Darius Crowley inside the Light's Dawn Cathedral.
english.description: We had enough ammunition to carry on the civil war for another month.  Yet the worgen's numbers are such that we're nearly spent.$B$BWe don't want to be caught out here in the open when that happens.  Fall back inside the cathedral and report to the boss.  I'm sure old Crowley will know what to do next.
english.completion: We've given them everything we have... yet still they come.  Do not worry, $N.  We'll slay many more before today is over.

text.title: 破釜沉舟
text.objectives: 杀死8个狂暴猎手。
text.description: $n，我们已经占据了有利的位置。如果你想要祷告，请随意。$B$B来吧，杀死这些渣滓。
text.completion: They... they've stopped coming.$B$BNo, $N.  That's not a good thing.

english.title: Last Stand
english.objectives: Kill 8 Frenzied Stalkers.
english.description: We've got a good chokepoint here, $n.  Feel free to say a prayer if that's your sort of thing.$B$BTake courage and let's kill these mutts.
english.completion: They... they've stopped coming.$B$BNo, $N.  That's not a good thing.

text.title: 心灵的平和
text.objectives: 弗瑞恩的哨站的苏伦要你去杀掉科霍。
text.description: 我们这里是一座前哨站，目的就是监视着潜在的对手。部落发动凄凉之地战役后，我们的工作就是要保证不遭到奇袭。$b$b最近，我们的一个斥候遭到火刃的俘虏，牺牲在了东边他们的要塞里。从那以后，一个叫做科霍的火刃恶徒就不停地威胁挑衅我们。$b$b他们在这里时日无多了，但我还是会出高价封那家伙的嘴！
text.completion:
It is done.

Sorrem should be able to sleep in peace now that Kohor's threats have been silenced.

english.title: Peace of Mind
english.objectives: Sorrem at Furien's Post wants you to kill Kohor.
english.description: We are a forward post, charged with monitoring potential adversaries. Once the Horde launches its Desolace campaign, our work here will ensure that nothing takes us by surprise.$b$bRecently, one of our scouts was caught and sacrificed by the Burning Blade at their stronghold to the east. Since then, we've been assaulted with threats and taunts from a Burning Blade wretch named Kohor.$b$bTheir days here are numbered, but I will pay handsomely for that one to be silenced now!
english.completion:
It is done.

Sorrem should be able to sleep in peace now that Kohor's threats have been silenced.

text.title: 等你看到就明白了
text.objectives: 弗瑞恩的哨站的苏伦要你在雷斧堡垒里找到远古召唤仪式羊皮卷。
text.description: 断气之前，科霍提到了一只可能威胁到整个地区的恶魔被召唤了出来。$b$b他也许在虚张声势，但我们不能冒这个险。$b$b必须在部落入侵凄凉之地前解决这件事。你要到雷斧堡垒去寻找线索，粉碎这潜在的威胁。
text.progress: The Burning Blade must not be allowed to succeed with their plan!
text.completion:
It is most fortunate that you took the time to search for this.

No one would have expected the Burning Blade to be in possession of something so powerful!

english.title: You'll Know It When You See It
english.objectives: Sorrem at Furien's Post wants you to find the Ancient Summoning Ritual in Thunder Axe Fortress.
english.description: With his dying breath, Kohor mentioned the summoning of a demon that could threaten the entire region.$b$bHe may have been bluffing, but that's not a chance worth taking.$b$bThis cannot wait for the Horde's invasion of Desolace to take shape. You must scour Thunder Axe Fortress for clues and bring an end to this potential threat.
english.progress: The Burning Blade must not be allowed to succeed with their plan!
english.completion:
It is most fortunate that you took the time to search for this.

No one would have expected the Burning Blade to be in possession of something so powerful!

text.title: 脚下的麻烦
text.objectives: 使用私人奥术助手将12名雷加什恶魔变成虫子碾死。
text.description: 瞧瞧你，都跑起腿来了。责任心挺强啊。你就这样天天向上，天天……向上！$B$B但是有恶魔在前，各种糟糕的恶魔，他们都要吃你的肚肠！雷加什恶魔开往东南方向，不过别紧张。别，别，别紧张。我给你来帮大忙！$B$B瞄准、变成虫子、一脚下去都死光。瞄准、变成虫子、一脚下去都死光！行之有效也很脏……不过真的别紧张。别，别，别紧张，因为完事之后我们不管打扫这地方！

english.title: Trouble Under Foot
english.objectives: Use your Personal Arcane Assistant to turn 12 Legash demons into insects and then squash them.
english.description: Look at you. Doing errands. Quite responsible of you. You're moving up up up, you are... up up!$B$BThere be demons ahead! Demons of many unpleasant kinds. Demons that would quite like your innards! Legash demons of a southeasternly heading! But do not worry. No no, no reason to worry, for I shall provide you with a companion!$B$BPoint, bugify, squash. Point, bugify, squash! Quite efficient. Quite messy too... but again, worry not. No no, worry not, for afterwards, we don't have to clean up!

starters.name: 大法师克希雷姆的影像

enders.name: 大法师克希雷姆的影像

text.title: 把它们都放一块儿
text.objectives: 在雷斧堡垒收集100个褪色的徽记，把它们放在火刃召唤法阵里，然后杀死纳扎尔贡。
text.description: 那么说是真的了……$b$b你在雷斧堡垒发现的羊皮卷细述了一个强大的召唤仪式。比火刃所掌握的所有其他仪式都要厉害。$b$b很显然，必须尽一切可能阻止它！$b$b也许把恶魔提前召唤出来，就能够化解这场危机。
text.completion:
You diverted what would have been a serious crisis, $c.

If that summoning was delayed just a bit longer, the demon would have become far too powerful for our small forces here to contend with.

Please accept this gift as our thanks for your service.

english.title: Putting Their Heads Together
english.objectives: Collect 100 Bleached Skulls from Thunder Axe Fortress, place them at the Burning Blade Summoning Circle, then kill Nazargen.
english.description: So it's true....$b$bThe parchment you discovered in Thunder Axe Fortress details a powerful summoning ritual. One stronger than the Burning Blade have ever been known to possess.$b$bClearly, this rite must be stopped at all costs!$b$bPerhaps if this demon were summoned forth prematurely the crisis could be averted.
english.completion:
You diverted what would have been a serious crisis, $c.

If that summoning was delayed just a bit longer, the demon would have become far too powerful for our small forces here to contend with.

Please accept this gift as our thanks for your service.

text.title: 体力劳动
text.objectives: 从雷加什营地拿回护法师手册。
text.description: 这里的恶魔似乎很喜欢把我们的奥术卷册偷走。我高度怀疑他们是不是有能耐读懂，还只是为了折腾我们。$B$B其他的书也就算了，但是他们把护法师手册也拿走了。没有它我完全无法保证能让像你这样的学徒活过克希雷姆的“试炼”。去东南方雷加什营地找到那些恶魔，把护法师手册拿回来。$B$B就这些，跑起来。

english.title: Manual Labor
english.objectives: Retrieve the Abjurer's Manual from the Lagash Encampment.
english.description: The local demons seem to get quite a kick out of stealing all of our arcane manuals. I highly doubt most of them can even read, so they're probably doing it just to spite us.$B$BI could care less about most of the books they've taken, but they took an Abjurer's Manual that I'm going to need if there's any hope of keeping apprentices like you alive amidst Xylem's "trials." Find the demons at the Lagash Encampment to the southeast and retrieve the Abjurer's Manual.$B$BThat's all. Scoot.

text.title: 耳饰在燃烧
text.objectives: 你要给弗瑞恩的哨站的苏伦收集25个火刃耳饰。
text.description: 苏伦毫不掩饰自己对雷斧堡垒里火刃部族的厌恶。$b$b显然，他们一命呜呼的证据能在他那里换个好价钱。
text.progress: What have you there, $c?
text.completion:
Ears of the Burning Blade?

<Sorrem smiles.>

Well done, $c. This is just a shadow of what will soon become of that vile cult!

english.title: Ears Are Burning
english.objectives: You are to bring 25 Burning Blade Ears to Sorrem at Furien's Post.
english.description: Sorrem has made no secret of his disdain for the Burning Blade at Thunder Axe Fortress.$b$bSurely, proof of their demise would be of value to him.
english.progress: What have you there, $c?
english.completion:
Ears of the Burning Blade?

<Sorrem smiles.>

Well done, $c. This is just a shadow of what will soon become of that vile cult!

text.title: 兽人会写字？
text.objectives: 将战地日记交给失落群岛船难海岸的莎希·硬钳。
text.description: 你在兽人的尸体上找到一本战地日记。书页严重浸水，勉强能辨认出上面的文字。$B$B你翻看着笔记，发现它记载了一个有趣的故事。还好你学过兽人语。$B$B和贸易大王的游艇一样，兽人的战舰也是被联盟击沉的。现在想想，在联盟开火前，你的确看到过一艘兽人战舰。或许联盟的目标本来就是兽人？$B$B愚蠢的兽人！都是因为他们，游艇才遭殃的！
text.progress: $N, find anything interesting in the cavern?
text.completion: Orcs?! They were sunk and stranded too?  And now the Alliance are on the island? Do you think they're going to kill us?$B$B<Sassy looks thoughtful.>$B$BI think it's time for a little sitdown with these orcs.

english.title: Orcs Can Write?
english.objectives: Take the Field Journal to Sassy Hardwrench at Shipwreck Shore on the Lost Isles.
english.description: Looking through the dead orc's belongings, you find a field journal. Though it is heavily water damaged, the writing is still legible, if barely.$B$BFlipping through the pages, an interesting story unfolds. Good thing you decided to study Orcish.$B$BLike the Trade Prince's yacht, the orcs were fired upon by Alliance warships. You do remember an orc warship that you passed right before the Alliance opened fire. Maybe they were firing on the orcs instead of your ship?$B$BStupid orcs! They got you sunk!
english.progress: $N, find anything interesting in the cavern?
english.completion: Orcs?! They were sunk and stranded too?  And now the Alliance are on the island? Do you think they're going to kill us?$B$B<Sassy looks thoughtful.>$B$BI think it's time for a little sitdown with these orcs.

text.title: 敌人的敌人就是……
text.objectives: 将战地日记交给失落群岛部落营地的阿格娜。
text.description: 我也不想让你跑这一趟，但是这不正是你的价值所在吗？将这本兽人的战地日记送去部落的营地吧。$B$B根据记载，沿着东南方卡亚矿洞旁边的斜坡一直走就可以抵达他们的营地。$B$B$n，祝你好运。我真的很喜欢你。
text.progress: <The orc narrows her eyes at you.>$B$BYou must have been on the goblin slave ship that was sunk. What's that you have in your hand?
text.completion: <The orc makes a move to grab the field journal from you, but then stops herself, exhaling deeply.>$B$BI apologize. It has been a very rough couple of days for all of us.$B$BI am Aggra. All of us here are what remains of the crew of the Draka's Fury.$B$BPerhaps we can work together. We have a common enemy in the Alliance. Their SI:7 assassins are all over this island and they're not going to stop until we're all dead.

english.title: The Enemy of My Enemy
english.objectives: Deliver the Field Journal to Aggra at the Horde Base Camp on the Lost Isles.
english.description: I hate to ask you to do this, but I guess it's why they pay you the big bucks. Can you deliver that dead orc's field journal to whoever is in charge up at their camp?$B$BBased on the writing in the book, they should be located at the top of the island, up the incline past the Kaja'mite cavern to the southeast.$B$BGood luck, $n. I always liked you.
english.progress: <The orc narrows her eyes at you.>$B$BYou must have been on the goblin slave ship that was sunk. What's that you have in your hand?
english.completion: <The orc makes a move to grab the field journal from you, but then stops herself, exhaling deeply.>$B$BI apologize. It has been a very rough couple of days for all of us.$B$BI am Aggra. All of us here are what remains of the crew of the Draka's Fury.$B$BPerhaps we can work together. We have a common enemy in the Alliance. Their SI:7 assassins are all over this island and they're not going to stop until we're all dead.

text.title: 恶花谷
text.objectives: 前往失落群岛的恶花谷，找到基拉格·血牙。
text.description: 猎手基拉格·血牙带领几名斥候去了西边坡道下的山谷。他们……是去寻找……“珍贵的货物”的。要不是联盟击沉了战舰，我们也不至于弄丢他。$B$B山谷里长满了致命的植物，他们没有办法深入其中。$B$B$n，作为一名地精$c，证明你的价值的时候到了。前往恶花谷寻找基拉格吧。
text.completion: Goblin, can you fight?$B$BFor your sake, I hope so. Otherwise, there may be no breaking through this hell of killer plants.

english.title: The Vicious Vale
english.objectives: Find Kilag Gorefang in the Vicious Vale on the Lost Isles.
english.description: Our hunter, Kilag Gorefang, and a few scouts, traveled into the vale down the path to the west. They're ...searching for... 'precious cargo'... that we were guarding when the filthy Alliance sunk our ship.$B$BThe way is blocked by deadly plants and they have not been able to break through.$B$B$n, prove your worth as a goblin and a $c. Journey into the Vicious Vale to find Kilag.
english.completion: Goblin, can you fight?$B$BFor your sake, I hope so. Otherwise, there may be no breaking through this hell of killer plants.

text.title: 除草无双
text.objectives: 使用地精百宝腰带中的杂草清理者，割掉恶花谷中的100株植物。
text.description: <基拉格忙于放枪，无暇跟你搭话；但是当他看到你的地精百宝腰带时，投来了赞赏的目光。>$B$B我们应该来点创造性的点子。不如你从腰带里拽出个什么来对付这些植物！$B$B<你思考了一会儿，蹦出个疯狂的想法来，说不定能起作用呢！>
text.completion: I saw it with my own eyes, and still I do not believe it!$B$BYou have our thanks and the debt of our lives, little goblin. I hope that soon we can repay you the honor.$B$BMay I ask a small favor of you while my scouts and I move on?

english.title: Weed Whacker
english.objectives: Use the Weed Whacker within your Goblin All-In-1der Belt to mow down 100 of the plants within the Vicious Vale.
english.description: <Kilag barely has time to acknowledge you between rifle shots, but his eye does linger a moment on your Goblin All-In-1-der Belt appreciatively.>$B$BNow is the time for creative solutions. Pull something out of that belt and get to work!$B$B<Thinking about the situation for a moment, an idea comes to your mind and it's just crazy enough to work!>
english.completion: I saw it with my own eyes, and still I do not believe it!$B$BYou have our thanks and the debt of our lives, little goblin. I hope that soon we can repay you the honor.$B$BMay I ask a small favor of you while my scouts and I move on?

text.title: 继续前进
text.objectives: 前往失落群岛的荒野瞭望台，找到基拉格·血牙和他的斥候。
text.description: 基拉格应该已经抵达荒野瞭望台了。你去那里跟他汇合吧。我们收拾好行李也就动身了。$B$B穿越恶花谷往西北走，嗯……有点名不副实了。$B$B基拉格和他的斥候应该会潜伏在路旁，但是相信军情七处的刺客很快就能找到他们，要快！
text.completion: Throm-Ka, $N. We have a problem.

english.title: Forward Movement
english.objectives: Find Kilag Gorefang and his scouts at the Wild Overlook on the Lost Isles.
english.description: Kilag should be in position by now. It is time for you to move forward to the Wild Overlook. The rest of us will pack up here and move out soon.$B$BJust follow the path northwest through the Vicious Vale. Not so vicious any longer thanks to you, eh?$B$BKilag and his scouts will be keeping themselves hidden just off the path, but the SI:7 assassins are sure to spot them soon, so hurry!
english.completion: Throm-Ka, $N. We have a problem.

text.title: 死亡的红外光
text.objectives: 杀死10名军情七处刺客。$B$B如果兽人斥候出了什么意外，就回去让基拉格为你配备新的队友。
text.description: 小点声。北边和西边的山谷里到处都是联盟的刺客。$B$B不幸的是，我们很难察觉他们的行踪。这帮懦夫！他们躲藏起来，不敢与我们正面交手。$B$B地精不是发明了某种神奇的护目镜，戴上就能看见隐身的目标吗？你肯定随身带着一副吧？$B$B我会派一名斥候跟你一起行动，杀死军情七处的刺客。
text.completion: Well done, $N, well done. We'll make an orc of you yet!$B$BTime to move on. We'd better hurry.

english.title: Infrared = Infradead
english.objectives: Kill 10 SI:7 Assassins.$B$BIf something happens to your Orc Scout, return to Kilag to see if he has another for you to team up with.
english.description: Keep your voice down. The glen north and west of here is crawling with Alliance assassins.$B$BUnfortunately, we haven't been able to spot them. The cowards! They hide and won't fight face-to-face.$B$BYou goblins are known for your wondrous goggles. Surely you have a pair that will allow you to see them?$B$BI need you to team up with one of my scouts and kill any of the SI:7 assassins that you spot.
english.completion: Well done, $N, well done. We'll make an orc of you yet!$B$BTime to move on. We'd better hurry.

text.title: 还不是见圣光的时候！
text.completion: It's up to you now. Are you going to come back to life and be the $g hero : heroine; that your fellow survivors need you to be, or are you going to rest for eternity here?$B$BOnly you can decide.$B$BDon't go into the Light, $N!

english.title: Don't Go Into the Light!
english.completion: It's up to you now. Are you going to come back to life and be the $g hero : heroine; that your fellow survivors need you to be, or are you going to rest for eternity here?$B$BOnly you can decide.$B$BDon't go into the Light, $N!

text.title: 前往峭壁
text.objectives: 沿着通往失落群岛蛮人谷北部峭壁的道路前进，跟斥候布拉克斯谈一谈。
text.description: 我派斥候布拉克斯沿着通往海岸峭壁的路继续向西视察海岸。$B$B骑上巴斯蒂亚去找他吧，告诉布拉克斯我选了另一条路线。$B$B待会我们会对联盟滩头发动攻击，到时候见啦！
text.completion: Hello, little goblin. Bastia is fast, no?$B$BWe have something very important that needs doing. Can you help us?

english.title: To the Cliffs
english.objectives: Speak with Scout Brax on the path down the cliffs north of the Savage Glen on the Lost Isles.
english.description: I sent Scout Brax forward along the road to the cliffs overlooking the beach to the west.$B$BI am going to put you onto Bastia. Travel down the path and let Brax know that we are going to take a different route.$B$BWe'll see you at the attack on the Alliance beachhead!
english.completion: Hello, little goblin. Bastia is fast, no?$B$BWe have something very important that needs doing. Can you help us?

text.title: 旋翼机！
text.objectives: 取得旋翼机钥匙。
text.description: 联盟从部落那里偷走了一件至关重要的东西，并将它藏在战舰里。$B$B海滩的另一端停着一架旋翼机。我们的战誓武士会掩护你过去的。$B$B从联盟特工身上夺得旋翼机的钥匙。$B$B乘坐旋翼机飞向他们的战舰复仇觉醒号，取回珍贵的货物！
text.progress: Hmm, looks like overly-complicated gnomish engineering with lots of unnecessary instrumentation and safety precautions.
text.completion: Hmm, where the heck is the ignition?$B$BIt'll be a wonder if it flies without doing something weird, like turning into a chicken or shrinking down to the size of an ant.$B$BHey look, someone left their loose change in the ashtray! What else is in there?

english.title: Get to the Gyrochoppa!
english.objectives: Retrieve the Gyrochoppa Keys.
english.description: The Alliance have stolen something of vital importance to the Horde. It is being held out on their ships.$B$BAt the other end of the beach is a gyrochoppa. Our battlesworn will cover your approach.$B$BGo retrieve the keys to the flying machine from one of their operatives.$B$BFly out to their flagship, the Vengeance Wake, and retrieve our precious cargo!
english.progress: Hmm, looks like overly-complicated gnomish engineering with lots of unnecessary instrumentation and safety precautions.
english.completion: Hmm, where the heck is the ignition?$B$BIt'll be a wonder if it flies without doing something weird, like turning into a chicken or shrinking down to the size of an ant.$B$BHey look, someone left their loose change in the ashtray! What else is in there?

text.title: 珍贵的货物
text.objectives: 登上停泊在失落群岛岸边的联盟战舰复仇觉醒号，在甲板下层寻找珍贵的货物。
text.description: 据说那件“珍贵的货物”就藏在联盟的战舰复仇觉醒号上。$B$B这倒简单了……乘坐旋翼机登上战舰，取回珍贵的货物！
text.completion: If not for you, I would surely be on my way back to Stormwind to be paraded as a trophy and a slave.$B$BThe Alliance dogs found me unconscious on the shore and put me in this magical cage. It was keeping me from connecting with the elements.$B$BNo longer!

english.title: Precious Cargo
english.objectives: Locate the precious cargo below deck on the Alliance ship, Vengeance Wake, off the shore of the Lost Isles.
english.description: They said that their "precious cargo", whatever that is, is being held out on the Alliance ship, the Vengeance Wake.$B$BThere's only one thing to do... fly this thing out there and retrieve it!
english.completion: If not for you, I would surely be on my way back to Stormwind to be paraded as a trophy and a slave.$B$BThe Alliance dogs found me unconscious on the shore and put me in this magical cage. It was keeping me from connecting with the elements.$B$BNo longer!

text.title: 酋长的复仇
text.objectives: 使用元素风暴的力量杀死50名水手。$B$B完成任务后，飓风会将你送往荒野瞭望台的。
text.description: 大地与火焰，水与空气，听从我的召唤吧！$B$B艾泽拉斯大陆几近崩溃，生命的气息稍纵即逝！我的先祖曾受惠于元素之力，现在，也请你们赐予我力量吧。让我将你们的意志传递给这位小地精。$B$B所有企图阻止我们治愈世界的人，统统要灭亡！
text.completion: You have done what few others could have, $N. Our world owes you a debt larger than you can possibly understand.

english.title: Warchief's Revenge
english.objectives: Use the powers of the Cyclone of the Elements to slay 50 Alliance Sailors.$B$BOnce this is done, you will be flown to the Wild Overlook.
english.description: Brothers of Earth and Fire, hear me! Sisters of the Water and Air, heed my call!$B$BAzeroth stands on the brink, its existence near an end! Lend me your power as in times past with my ancient ancestors. Allow me to channel your will through this child of Kezan.$B$BLet us put an end to those who would keep us from healing the world!
english.completion: You have done what few others could have, $N. Our world owes you a debt larger than you can possibly understand.

text.title: 爬升，爬升，火箭分离！
text.objectives: 使用火箭弹射器将自己发射到险峻海峡的对岸。
text.description: 在你从联盟手中营救酋长和我们时，工头戴姆维克建了这台火箭弹射器。它能将我们直接发射到对面的大岛，避开鲨鱼肆虐的海峡。$B$B工头还在游艇的残骸里找到了一座胶囊镇。等你启动胶囊镇，我们就有自己的镇子了。我真是迫不及待地想躺在温暖的床上睡一觉啦。$B$B戴姆维克在降落点等你。你不如搭乘下一班火箭到对岸去？
text.completion: $N, I sure am glad you survived the trip... not everyone did!

english.title: Up, Up & Away!
english.objectives: Survive the Rocket Sling shot across the Dire Strait.
english.description: While you were rescuing the Warchief and saving us all from the Alliance, Foreman Dampwick built this rocket sling to shoot us over the shark-infested strait to the bigger island.$B$BLuckily for us, the foreman managed to salvage a Town-In-A-Box from the shipwreck. Once you get it set up, we'll have a town of our own. I can't wait to sleep in a bed again!$B$BDampwick's down there at the Landing Site, waiting for you. Why don't you take the next rocket over?
english.completion: $N, I sure am glad you survived the trip... not everyone did!

text.title: 胶囊镇
text.objectives: 爬到炸药堆上，使用胶囊镇活塞。
text.description: 贸易大王的游艇上有一座胶囊镇！在你为地精一族的存亡而战时，我从一堆残骸里找到了它。$B$B你愿不愿意为胶囊镇剪彩啊？你只需要爬上炸药堆并推动活塞，接下来嘛，唵嘛呢叭咪吽！速成城镇！
text.completion: <cough, cough!>$B$BHey! Where's the dock?! Someone stole the dock and the oil refinery from our town-in-a-box!$B$BWho would do such a thing?$B$BWhere's the Trade Prince?

english.title: It's a Town-In-A-Box
english.objectives: Climb to the top of the mountain of explosives and use the Town-In-A-Box Plunger.
english.description: The trade prince had an entire town-in-a-box in the ship's hold! I managed to recover it while you were out saving all of our skins.$B$BDo you want to do the honors? All you have to do is climb to the top of that huge pile of explosives and push the plunger, and whamo kablamo, instant town!
english.completion: <cough, cough!>$B$BHey! Where's the dock?! Someone stole the dock and the oil refinery from our town-in-a-box!$B$BWho would do such a thing?$B$BWhere's the Trade Prince?

text.title: 提前领养
text.objectives: 将3枚猛鹫的蛋放在猛鹫之巢里，在它们被带走之前保护好。
text.description: 这一地区突然变得充满生机，沙漠生物的栖息环境也被迫变得拥挤起来。$b$b最为显著的负面结果就是当地猛鹫濒临灭绝。捕食者们以这些鸟儿和它们的蛋为食，侵占它们的巢穴。$b$b我从塔纳利斯得到了几枚猛鹫的蛋，在上面涂了难以抗拒的信息素。在你找到的鸟巢里放一个，然后保护它，直到一头猛鹫飞来将其带走。$b$b你将为大地的平衡做出贡献。
text.completion:
You have done well, $c.

This land is in your debt.

english.title: Early Adoption
english.objectives: Place 3 Swoop Eggs in Swoop Nests and protect them until they are collected.
english.description: As the region becomes more lush, the creatures of the desert are being forced into increasingly confined spaces.$b$bA particularly distressing result is the impending extinction of the local swoops. Predators feast on the birds and their eggs when they take nest.$b$bI have acquired some swoop eggs from Tanaris and coated them with an irresistible pheromone. Place one in each nest you find, then protect it until a swoop comes to carry it off.$b$bYou will be doing a service to the balance of this land.
english.completion:
You have done well, $c.

This land is in your debt.

text.title: 固执的大地
text.objectives: 桑克的住所的桑克要你找到不自然的岩石。
text.description: 在塞纳里奥议会的授权下，我负责将这些环境恶劣的土地变成生机盎然的草原。$b$b南边的大地生长状况良好，可这儿却有什么东西在阻碍进程——抵抗着绿化。$b$b也许你的眼睛比我尖。$b$b拜托你，$r。搜索这些土地，找到沙漠负隅顽抗的源头。
text.completion: You look around, scanning the horizon for what might be responsible for placing this stone here...

english.title: Stubborn Lands
english.objectives: Thunk at Thunk's Abode wants you to find the Unnatural Outcropping.
english.description: By authority of the Cenarion Circle, I am charged with turning these harsh lands into lush prairie.$b$bThe lands south of here welcomed the growth, but something here is fighting back - resisting the replenishment.$b$bPerhaps your eyes can succeed where mine have failed.$b$bPlease, $r. Scour these lands and discover the source of the desert's stubbornness.
english.completion: You look around, scanning the horizon for what might be responsible for placing this stone here...

text.title: 急需帮助
text.objectives: 跟失落群岛卡亚矿洞外的工头戴姆维克谈一谈。
text.description: 好消息！工头戴姆维克在岛上发现了一座储量丰富的卡亚矿洞！运气大好啊！$B$B当然，有好消息就有坏消息。他带走了一批幸存者，派他们进入矿洞进行开采，但是没有人能活着出来。$B$B这听起来很不可信，但是工头说洞里有很多猴子……拿着矿锄的猴子！它们在开采卡亚矿石！这怎么可能呢？$B$B你能不能跑一趟，去东南边的矿洞看看？工头就在矿洞的入口处。
text.completion: Boss! Er, well, I guess you're not the boss anymore, but still, good to see you!$B$BCan you believe it? We've got a cave full of intelligent killer monkeys mining kaja'mite!

english.title: Help Wanted
english.objectives: Speak with Foreman Dampwick outside of the Kaja'mite Cavern on the Lost Isles.
english.description: Great news! Foreman Dampwick has uncovered a cave full of kaja'mite on the island! What are the odds?$B$BOf course, there's a downside. He took some of the survivors with him to help mine the ore, but none of them have made it out.$B$BCrazy as it sounds, the foreman said that there are monkeys in the cave... with mining picks! They're mining the kaja'mite! How is that even possible?$B$BCan you head southeast to the cavern? The foreman is standing just outside the entrance.
english.completion: Boss! Er, well, I guess you're not the boss anymore, but still, good to see you!$B$BCan you believe it? We've got a cave full of intelligent killer monkeys mining kaja'mite!

text.title: 剪羽毛
text.objectives: 从诺德雷萨废墟附近的角鹰兽身上采集80根完整的雷首角鹰兽羽毛。
text.description: 我会很了不起！成为了不起的大法师！但他却瞧我不上，就因为我没有穿袍戴帽。嗤。$B$B这片土地上有史以来最为了不起的大法师行头可不能随便。我得让他知道我很特别，我知道该怎么做。$B$B出去杀掉那些角鹰兽什么的，给我带上成吨的羽毛回来。你没听错！成堆成堆的羽毛！快快快，等你回来时我的袍子就缝好等着装饰了。

english.title: Shear Will
english.objectives: Obtain 80 Pristine Thunderhead Feathers from the Hippogryphs near the Ruins of Nordressa.
english.description: I'd be amazing! At archmagery. Amazing! He won't even talk to me because I don't have a stupid robe and hat. Pffft.$B$BThe most amazing archmage this land has ever seen can't just have any robe and hat. I need to show him that I'm something special, and I know just how to do it.$B$BGo out there and kill some of those hippogryph things. Bring me back a TON of feathers.$B$BYou heard me! A whole bunch of feathers! Go go, I'll have the robe ready for them by the time you get back.

text.title: 可再生资源
text.objectives: 从诺德雷萨废墟的巴伯亚身上用奥术炸药收集5块活体玄武岩。
text.description: 我们还得要点儿活体玄武岩。附近只有一个可靠来源，一名叫做巴伯亚的高山巨人。杀鸡取卵的事情我们可不能做，得细水长流。$B$B你可以在东北和东边找到他的踪迹。预先放上炸药，藏好了等着引爆。等他清完场你就可以把玄武岩给带回来了。

english.title: Renewable Resource
english.objectives: Use the Arcane Charge to retrieve 5 Animate Basalt from Balboa near the Ruins of Nordressa.
english.description: We're going to need some more animate basalt. There's only one reliable source for that in the area, a mountain giant named Balboa. We can't be killing the mountain giant if we want to keep stocked in the stuff long term, so we've just been chipping off pieces at a time.$B$BYou'll be able to see his path northeast and east of here. Find him, place the charge ahead on the path, and then hide until it goes off. Once he's cleared the area, you should be able to retrieve the basalt and bring it back to me.

text.title: 新的开始
text.objectives: 收集15根蝎刺。
text.description: 半人马从来没有进犯到这么远的北方。一定是有谁挑唆的，肯定是这样！$b$b反正我彻底败了。我的投资全在这场战争中赔了。$b$b幸运的是，半人马再怎么厉害，也夺不走地精的聪明头脑！我决定重头再来，再创辉煌！$b$b<比兹比指着远处的一只蝎子。>$b$b毒药总是有市场的。朋友，你说呢？
text.progress: Let's have a look at those scorpion tails, friend.
text.completion:
This is how I got my start, you know.

Slingin' poison to the rogues in Orgrimmar. Ahh, those were the days...

english.title: New Beginnings
english.objectives: Collect 15 Scorpion Stingers.
english.description: There's never been danger of centaur attack this far north before. Someone put 'em up to it, I just know it!$b$bRegardless, I'm wiped out. I had everything invested in this haul.$b$bFortunately, there's one thing no centaur can take from me and that's goblin ingenuity! I'll start from scratch and build an empire!$b$b<Bizby spots a scorpion in the distance.>$b$bThere's always a market for poison. Whatdya say, friend?
english.progress: Let's have a look at those scorpion tails, friend.
english.completion:
This is how I got my start, you know.

Slingin' poison to the rogues in Orgrimmar. Ahh, those were the days...

text.title: 货次价高
text.objectives: 收集15条陈年蜥蜴尾。
text.description: 我需要一箱子尾巴，$c！不是随便什么动物的尾巴，要求是越老越好，越残越好！$b$b覆盖在蜥蜴尾部的鳞片非常奇特，它们会随着年龄的增长而变硬，丝毫不见破碎的迹象。这种硬化鳞片是制作护甲的上等材料。$b$b我已经好多年没做过蜥蜴鳞片的生意了，谁会料到呢，说不定我可以借此闯出一番新天地！如果可能的话……
text.progress: How's the search for tail coming, $N?
text.completion:
That'll do, $c.

A few more friends like you and I'll be back on my feet in no time!

english.title: Good Gold For Bad Tail
english.objectives: Find 15 Aged Basilisk Tails.
english.description: I need a crateload of tail, $c! And not just any kind of tail. The tail I'm after needs to be old - ancient even. The more decrepit the better.$b$bThe scales of a basilisk's tail are unique in that they harden with age without becoming brittle. The hardened scales are ideal for the production of certain armors.$b$bIt's been many years since I've been reduced to peddling lizard scales, but who knows, maybe it'll build even more character in me! If that's even possible....
english.progress: How's the search for tail coming, $N?
english.completion:
That'll do, $c.

A few more friends like you and I'll be back on my feet in no time!

text.title: 给我带些羽毛来！
text.objectives: 收集25根恐怖飞扑者之羽。
text.description: $c，在你探索这片沙漠时，不如顺便帮我个忙？$b$b留意一下恐怖飞扑者的踪迹。它们的油性羽毛是箭翎的绝佳材料，识货的买家愿意出大价钱购买的。$b$b幸运的是，我恰好认识所有识货的买家！
text.progress: How is the search for swoops coming?
text.completion:
Well now, that's quite a load of feathers, $c.

They'll make for a good pillow 'til I get 'em to market!

english.title: Fletch Me Some Plumage!
english.objectives: Collect 25 Dread Swoop Feathers.
english.description: Say, $c, while you're out there exploring the desert wastes, do me a favor?$b$bKeep an eye out for Dread Swoops. Their oily feathers make for the best fletching, and to the right buyer they can fetch a handsome price.$b$bLucky for you, I know all of the right buyers!
english.progress: How is the search for swoops coming?
english.completion:
Well now, that's quite a load of feathers, $c.

They'll make for a good pillow 'til I get 'em to market!

text.title: 重金属
text.objectives: 你要收集7份116号元素，将它们带给比兹比车队的比兹比。
text.description: 你有一种强烈的预感，正是这块石头使得该地区拒绝着接受再生的良机。$b$b朝西看去，你发现一道由焚烧过的残骸组成的痕迹，似乎和这个神秘的物件有关。$b$b你估计把这些残骸清理掉可能会对桑克的努力有所帮助。$b$b而且，谁知道这东西能派什么用场呢？
text.progress: Whatcha got there, $c?
text.completion:
What's this?

<Bizby examines the ore.>

Wahoo! I know someone who will be most interested in acquiring these samples.

Most generous in payment for them as well, I'll wager.

Here, $c. Take this as your finder's fee.

english.title: Heavy Metal
english.objectives: You are to collect 7 pieces of Element 116 and bring them to Bizby at Bizby's Caravan.
english.description: You have a strong feeling that this stone is somehow responsible for the region's refusal to accept the encroaching regrowth.$b$bLooking off to the west, you notice a trail of smoldering debris that appears to be related to this mystery.$b$bYou surmise that clearing the debris might assist Thunk's efforts here.$b$bAnd who knows what this stuff might be good for?
english.progress: Whatcha got there, $c?
english.completion:
What's this?

<Bizby examines the ore.>

Wahoo! I know someone who will be most interested in acquiring these samples.

Most generous in payment for them as well, I'll wager.

Here, $c. Take this as your finder's fee.

text.title: 艾瑟雷索
text.objectives: 弗瑞恩的哨站的瑟蕾莉亚要你去艾瑟雷索跟库拉谈一谈。
text.description: 我们在这一地区的敌人已经够多的了，没必要再惹火塞纳里奥议会。$b$b我们建立哨站的时候，曾经被拜托照看好他们的一名研究员。$b$b大家最后一次见到库拉的时候，是在西边的高塔那里。做个好心人，去拜访一下她。我们已经很久没有关心她了。
text.completion:
It is good that you have come.

There is grave danger looming here.

english.title: Ethel Rethor
english.objectives: Cerelia at Furien's Post wants you to speak to Korrah at Ethel Rethor.
english.description: We have plenty of enemies in this region without raising the ire of the Cenarion Circle.$b$bWhen we established our post here, we were asked to keep a watch over one of their researchers.$b$bKorrah was last seen at the tower to the west. Do be a dear and pay her a visit. It's been some time since we've bothered to check on her.
english.completion:
It is good that you have come.

There is grave danger looming here.

text.title: 新的威胁
text.objectives: 跟库拉谈一谈，她将为你展示纳迦的威胁。
text.description: 我和我的同伴奉命来到凄凉之地的海岸，查探这里的变化，如今只剩下我一个人了。$b$b我已经发出了纳迦数量剧增的报告，但是没有任何回应。$b$b同伴们都在关注其他事务，我只能请求你这样的陌生人帮助我继续研究。$b$b首先，请允许我为你展示我们所面临的威胁。
text.completion:
So now you see. These are not a simple band of displaced naga, but a well organized army, capable of great devastation.

Do you agree to assist me in my investigation?

english.title: The Emerging Threat
english.objectives: Korrah wants you to speak to her when you are ready to be shown the Naga threat.
english.description: I am all that remains of my company, sent to monitor the many changes on this coast of Desolace.$b$bI have reported of the dramatic increase of naga here, but to no effect.$b$bMy peers are focused on other crises, so I must ask you, a stranger, to assist me in my research.$b$bFirst, though, allow me to show you the threat we face.
english.completion:
So now you see. These are not a simple band of displaced naga, but a well organized army, capable of great devastation.

Do you agree to assist me in my investigation?

text.title: 滑刃之劫
text.objectives: 从滑刃纳迦身上收集10根滑刃之骨，从滑刃巫师身上收集30片滑刃鳞片，从滑刃战士身上收集4扇滑刃之鳍。
text.description: 纳迦一再地证明自己是自然平衡的大敌。对于挥洒他们的鲜血这种事，我毫无顾忌。$b$b就算你再努力，对他们的兵力而言也只是隔靴搔痒。一个倒下，就有两个站起来。$b$b我有个计划，$c。你的目标不仅仅是击败那些蛇怪，还要拿回一些鳞片、骨头和鱼鳍来，好进行后面的计划。
text.progress: Have you collected the components I require?
text.completion: You have done well, $c. But I'm afraid that your work here is just beginning.

english.title: Slitherblade Slaughter
english.objectives: Collect 10 Slitherblade Bones from Slitherblade Naga, 30 Slitherblade Scales from Slitherblade Sorceresses, and 4 Slitherblade Fins from Slitherblade Warriors.
english.description: Time and again, the naga have proven to be enemies to the balance of nature. I have no qualms with the spilling of their blood.$b$bYour best efforts though, would barely put a dent in their forces here. Where one falls, two seem to rise in their place.$b$bI have a plan, $c. Your objective is not merely to take the lives of the enemy, but to gather components necessary for the next stage of our investigation....
english.progress: Have you collected the components I require?
english.completion: You have done well, $c. But I'm afraid that your work here is just beginning.

text.title: 炮轰纳迦
text.objectives: 从艾萨拉的秘密实验室收集5颗地精迫击炮炮弹。
text.description: 我们建成火箭航站楼后，纳迦在半岛上开始有所行动。但世上没有什么问题是不可以用饱和炮火轰击来解决的！在出事之前，我爸常这么说。$B$B但是，我的补给不足了。帮我个忙，把我存放在西边秘密实验室的迫击炮弹运来。保证我的弹药，我就可以给你提供炮火打击！
text.progress: I hope you have more ammo for me. I've got nothing to shoot off over here but my mouth!

english.title: Mortar the Point
english.objectives: Collect 5 Goblin Mortar Shells from the Secret Lab complex in Azshara.
english.description: The Naga started making a move on the peninsula here after we finished building this rocketway terminal. But there's no problem in this world that can't be solved with gratuitous firepower! That's what my daddy used to say. Before the accident.$B$BI'm running short on supplies, though. Do me a favor and collect the mortar shells I left stockpiled in the Secret Lab just west of here. Keep me supplied and I'll let you call in the artillery strikes!
english.progress: I hope you have more ammo for me. I've got nothing to shoot off over here but my mouth!

text.title: More Mortars, More!
text.objectives: Collect 5 Goblin Mortar Shells from the Secret Lab complex in Azshara.
text.description: Thanks for helping me restock my supplies, $n.$B$BI'll tell you what, bring me more mortars from the lab, and I'll keep supplying you with artillery signals. With me on the trigger and you in the field, we'll blast these cliffs until they go crashing into the sea!
text.completed: Bring the shells to Bombardier Captain Smooks at the Southern Rocketway Terminus in Azshara.

english.title: More Mortars, More!
english.objectives: Collect 5 Goblin Mortar Shells from the Secret Lab complex in Azshara.
english.description: Thanks for helping me restock my supplies, $n.$B$BI'll tell you what, bring me more mortars from the lab, and I'll keep supplying you with artillery signals. With me on the trigger and you in the field, we'll blast these cliffs until they go crashing into the sea!
english.completed: Bring the shells to Bombardier Captain Smooks at the Southern Rocketway Terminus in Azshara.

text.title: 深入敌后
text.objectives: 使用滑刃之魅。
text.description: 我设计了一道咒符，可以让你混入纳迦中去，把你的外表变得和他们一样。$b$b有了这个伪装，你还可以理解他们的语言，同他们交谈。他们没有办法看破你的真身。$b$b但要小心，鲨鱼和其它的海洋生物会把你暴露给所有人。尽量避开它们。$b$b现在去吧，跟艾萨拉的女祭司谈一谈，尽你所能了解他们在这里的目的。
text.completion:
Don't just stand around, when there is so much to be done!

Must I instruct everyone on each detail?

english.title: Going Deep
english.objectives: Use the Slitherblade Charm.
english.description: I have fashioned a charm that will allow you to infiltrate the naga, giving you the appearance of one of their own.$b$bWith this disguise, you will be able to speak and understand their language. They will be unable to discern your true identity.$b$bBut beware! The sharks and other sea creatures here will expose you for all to see. Avoid them at all costs.$b$bNow go. Speak to the Priestess of Azshara and do what you must to learn of their purposes here.
english.completion:
Don't just stand around, when there is so much to be done!

Must I instruct everyone on each detail?

text.title: Ice Cold
text.objectives: Use the Cryomatic 16 to freeze and kill 8 Sable Drakes.
text.description: I've got the perfect solution to our drake problem. My very own Cryomatic 16.$B$BI originally developed it to freeze my workers during transport and between shifts so that I wouldn't have to feed and entertain them, but there were... complications. It should be perfect for dropping these drakes out of the sky though!

english.title: Ice Cold
english.objectives: Use the Cryomatic 16 to freeze and kill 8 Sable Drakes.
english.description: I've got the perfect solution to our drake problem. My very own Cryomatic 16.$B$BI originally developed it to freeze my workers during transport and between shifts so that I wouldn't have to feed and entertain them, but there were... complications. It should be perfect for dropping these drakes out of the sky though!

text.title: 刮鳞破肠
text.objectives: 杀掉6只恶鞭怒雷武士和6只恶鞭唤海者。
text.description: 这些海里来的生物神出鬼没，对付它们让我抓狂。可除非它们从艾萨拉上绝迹，不然我绝不退缩。$B$B恶鞭纳迦已经从东侧游上峭壁，围攻这座岗哨了。干掉他们，$n，把他们开膛破肚，让他们领教我部落的厉害。

english.title: To Gut a Fish
english.objectives: Slay 6 Spitelash Stormfuries and 6 Spitelash Seacallers.
english.description: It tries my patience, defending against creatures who can disappear into the sea at will and emerge where they please. But I will not back down until their like has been wiped from Azshara.$B$BSpitelash Naga have slithered up the cliff walls and are besieging this post from the east. Destroy them, $n. Gut them head to tail, so that they may know the full fury of my Horde.

text.title: 浪费百里香
text.objectives: 在诺德雷萨废墟附近采8束生命盛怒百里香。
text.description: 生命盛怒百里香！我还要！快给我弄点来成不？

english.title: Waste of Thyme
english.objectives: Collect 8 bundles of Living Ire Thyme near the Ruins of Nordressa.
english.description: Living Ire Thyme. I must have more! Be quick about it, will you?

text.title: 潮上加湿
text.objectives: 击败5名耐普图隆的仆从。（你必须以纳迦形态打败他们。）$b$b如果你丢失了滑刃三叉戟，就和瓦丽丝琪谈谈。$b$b如果你丢失了滑刃之魅，就和艾瑟雷索的库拉谈谈。
text.description: 耐普图隆的仆从来到这里，尽他们的一切努力来阻挠我们。很显然，他们已经发现了我们的动机。$b$b这恰恰证实了我的猜测，我们所寻找的东西就在废墟里某处！$b$b这些水元素同我们的大军相比不值一提！拿上这根三叉戟，用它消灭潮汐猎手的那些无足挂齿的仆役们。$b$b当我们找到了那样东西，耐普图隆就该担心自己的性命了！
text.completion:
The enemy's ranks are thinning, little minnow.

Perhaps you are worthy of assisting in our search...

english.title: Wetter Than Wet
english.objectives: Defeat 5 Servants of Neptulon. (You must be in naga form when you defeat them.)$b$bIf you lose your Slitherblade Trident, speak to Valishj.$b$bIf you lose your Slitherblade Charm, speak with Korrah at Ethel Rethor.
english.description: Neptulon's minions have arrived here and are doing all they can to thwart us. Clearly, they've discovered our motives.$b$bThis only confirms my suspicion that what we seek is indeed somewhere in these ruins!$b$bThese water elementals are no match for our forces! Take this trident and use it to destroy the worthless servants of the Tidehunter.$b$bWhen we find what we seek here, Neptulon himself shall fear for his life!
english.completion:
The enemy's ranks are thinning, little minnow.

Perhaps you are worthy of assisting in our search...

text.title: 你的导师
text.objectives: 跟军事区的克利希中士谈一谈。
text.description: 大多数人得以存活……但是这片区域仍有狼人出没。$B$B等一切准备妥当，我们就要继续往南推进了。$B$B这倒让我想起一件事来，有人想见你。是一个叫克利希的家伙，他说你是他的学生，想确认你是否安全。
text.completion: $N!  Where have you been?$B$BAnyway... it's great to see you in one piece.

english.title: Your Instructor
english.objectives: Speak to Sergeant Cleese in the Military District.
english.description: Most of us made it here alive... but there are worgen on this side of the city as well.$B$BWe're going to continue heading south once everyone's accounted for.$B$BThat reminds me, someone was asking about you.  A fellow by the name of Cleese said you were one of his students and wanted to make sure you were all right.
english.completion: $N!  Where have you been?$B$BAnyway... it's great to see you in one piece.

text.title: Charge
text.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Charge. Practice using Charge against a Bloodfang Worgen.
text.description: You're alive, $n!  That must mean I did something right.$B$BIt's a shame our lessons were cut off a little short.  But, as you go and learn on your own, you'll start to discover new techniques.$B$BGo get some more experience, learn something new, and then try it out against the bloodfang worgen to our west.
text.completion: Excellent work!
text.completed: Return to Sergeant Cleese in the Military District.

english.title: Charge
english.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Charge. Practice using Charge against a Bloodfang Worgen.
english.description: You're alive, $n!  That must mean I did something right.$B$BIt's a shame our lessons were cut off a little short.  But, as you go and learn on your own, you'll start to discover new techniques.$B$BGo get some more experience, learn something new, and then try it out against the bloodfang worgen to our west.
english.completion: Excellent work!
english.completed: Return to Sergeant Cleese in the Military District.

text.title: 调查海洋祭坛
text.objectives: 为托格·图卡斯调查纳迦祭坛。
text.description: 纳迦侵略者在悬崖边上矗立了一系列祭坛。我不知道是干吗用的，$n，但我肯定它们强化着我们的敌人。我需要有人去那儿清除这个威胁。$B$B附近有个祭坛防守不严：过了西边第一座桥然后向北朝海湾走，就在一个小岩包上。调查一下，帮我弄些有用的情报来。
text.completed: 为托格·图卡斯调查风暴悬崖的纳迦祭坛。

english.title: Investigating the Sea Shrine
english.objectives: Investigate the Naga shrine for Torg Twocrush.
english.description: The Naga invaders have set up a series of shrines along the cliffs. I don't know their purpose, $n, but I believe they're strengthening our foes. I need someone to get in there and root out this threat.$B$BOne nearby shrine is lightly defended: Cross the first bridge east of here and then head north towards the bay. You'll find it on a small outcropping. Investigate that shrine and come back with some info I can use.
english.completed: Investigate the Naga shrine at the Storm Cliffs for Torg Twocrush.

text.title: 深度撞击
text.objectives: 女祭司瓦丽丝琪要你找到耐普图隆的石板。
text.description: 艾萨拉女王寻找的是水元素位面的入口，至于为了什么，我就不清楚了。$b$b她相信这些废墟中藏有发现入口位置所在的关键。$b$b我被亲自受命搜查这片区域的废墟，找不到我们所要的秘密，谁都不准休息！$b$b北边是一处被淹没的废墟集中地。用这根法杖搜索瓦砾。$b$b找不到我们要的东西就别回来！
text.progress: Could it be...?
text.completion:
Yes! You've found it!

Neptulon's engravings... there can be no mistake!

english.title: Deep Impact
english.objectives: Priestess Valishj wants you to find the Ancient Engravings of Neptulon.
english.description: Queen Azshara seeks entrance into the plane of water, for what I do not know.$b$bShe believes that the ancients held the keys to finding its location.$b$bI have personally been charged with scouring the ruins in this region, and none shall rest until we discover the secrets we seek!$b$bSubmerged just to the north are a concentration of ruins. Use this staff to search through the rubble.$b$bReturn to me only when you have located that which we seek!
english.progress: Could it be...?
english.completion:
Yes! You've found it!

Neptulon's engravings... there can be no mistake!

text.title: 有人在找你
text.objectives: 跟军事区的侠盗萝伦谈一谈。
text.description: 大多数人得以存活……但是这片区域仍有狼人出没。$B$B等一切准备妥当，我们就要继续往南推进了。$B$B这倒让我想起一件事来，有人想见你。是一个叫萝伦的女人……我告诉她你一切安好的时候，她似乎有点失望。$B$B她好像提过还欠你一笔钱什么的。

english.title: Someone's Looking for You
english.objectives: Speak to Loren the Fence in the Military District.
english.description: Most of us made it here alive... but there are worgen on this side of the city as well.$B$BWe're going to continue heading south once everyone's accounted for.$B$BThat reminds me, someone was asking about you.  A woman named Loren... she seemed a little disappointed when I told her you were all right.$B$BI think she mentioned she owes you money.

text.title: 钥石碎片
text.objectives: 在附近找到钥石碎片。
text.description: 这块奇怪的石头冰冷平滑，发散的能量扰动着周围的空气，用手抚摸上去，能感到一阵阵脉动，又如惊涛拍岸。$B$B神器顶部的楔形部分似乎遗落了，“钥石碎片”看来就是解开这块石头秘密的关键，在神庙附近找找看。

english.title: The Keystone Shard
english.objectives: Find the Keystone Shard nearby.
english.description: The air around this strange stone crackles with energy. The stone itself is smooth and icy cold. It pulses periodically as you run your hands over it, like the crashing of surf.$B$BA wedge-shaped piece appears to be missing from the top surface of the artifact. This 'keystone shard' is likely the key to unlocking the secrets of the stone. Search the grounds near the temple and locate the keystone shard.

text.title: 向图卡斯汇报
text.objectives: 回到艾萨拉，向南部火箭车终点站的托格·图卡斯报告，告诉他你的发现。
text.description: 一道魔法屏障在你周身搏动，冷峭彻骨，你身置其中刀枪不入。$B$B托格·图卡斯会想要知道你在这儿究竟发现了什么！
text.completed: 回到艾萨拉，向南部火箭车终点站的托格·图卡斯报告，告诉他你的发现。

english.title: Report to Twocrush
english.objectives: Return to Torg Twocrush at the Southern Rocketway Terminus in Azshara with news of your discovery.
english.description: A magical barrier pulses around you, chilling your bones. You feel secure behind this enchanted wall.$B$BTorg Twocrush will want to know what you've discovered here!
english.completed: Return to Torg Twocrush at the Southern Rocketway Terminus in Azshara with news of your discovery.

text.title: Eviscerate
text.objectives: Reach Level 3 to Learn Eviscerate, then practice using Eviscerate against a Bloodfang Worgen.
text.description: Good to see you alive!$B$BNo, of course I don't have that gold I owe you.  Now's not really the time to bring that up is it?$B$BListen, maybe I can show you the ropes, save your skin with all the carnage going on. $B$BAs you learn how to fight, you'll start to learn new things. Go get some more experience, and then when you figure out something new, try it on the Bloodfang Worgen. I'll be watching

english.objectives: Reach Level 3 to Learn Eviscerate, then practice using Eviscerate against a Bloodfang Worgen.
english.description: Good to see you alive!$B$BNo, of course I don't have that gold I owe you.  Now's not really the time to bring that up is it?$B$BListen, maybe I can show you the ropes, save your skin with all the carnage going on. $B$BAs you learn how to fight, you'll start to learn new things. text.title: 神秘的联系人
text.objectives: 跟军事区的维图斯·暗行者谈一谈。
text.description: 大多数人得以存活……但是这片区域仍有狼人出没。$B$B等一切准备妥当，我们就要继续往南推进了。$B$B这倒让我想起一件事来，有人想见你。是一个叫维图斯·暗行者的怪人……那家伙还真让我毛骨悚然。$B$B他一直念叨着说自己发现了什么“禁断的知识”之类的。

english.title: Shady Associates
english.objectives: Speak to Vitus Darkwalker in the Military District.
english.description: Most of us made it here alive... but there are worgen on this side of the city as well.$B$BWe're going to continue heading south once everyone's accounted for.$B$BThat reminds me, someone was asking about you.  A strange fellow named Vitus... he was really giving me the creeps.$B$BHe kept talking about some "forbidden knowledge" he'd uncovered.

text.title: Corruption
text.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Corruption. Practice casting it on a Bloodfang Worgen.
text.description: It is true then!  You live!$B$BI never got a chance to share my greatest discovery with you.  After I began my training, and began to become accomplished, I heard the voice Balcephoth of the felshadows in my head... he taught me the forbidden secrets of...$B$BCorruption!$B$BGo now, gain some more experience, maybe you'll learn a new spell, too. You can go use it against the Bloodfang Worgen to our west.
text.completed: Return to Vitus Darkwalker in the Military District.

english.title: Corruption
english.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Corruption. Practice casting it on a Bloodfang Worgen.
english.description: It is true then!  You live!$B$BI never got a chance to share my greatest discovery with you.  After I began my training, and began to become accomplished, I heard the voice Balcephoth of the felshadows in my head... he taught me the forbidden secrets of...$B$BCorruption!$B$BGo now, gain some more experience, maybe you'll learn a new spell, too. You can go use it against the Bloodfang Worgen to our west.
english.completed: Return to Vitus Darkwalker in the Military District.

text.title: 有人想联系你
text.objectives: 跟军事区的猎手布雷克谈一谈。
text.description: 大多数人得以存活……但是这片区域仍有狼人出没。$B$B等一切准备妥当，我们就要继续往南推进了。$B$B这倒让我想起一件事来，有人想见你。是一个叫布雷克的男人，他大概要跟你谈谈转战丛林的计划。

english.title: Someone's Keeping Track of You
english.objectives: Speak to Huntsman Blake in the Military District.
english.description: Most of us made it here alive... but there are worgen on this side of the city as well.$B$BWe're going to continue heading south once everyone's accounted for.$B$BThat reminds me, someone was asking about you.  A man named Blake.  Said something about a plan to escape into the woods.

text.title: Steady Shot
text.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Steady Shot. Practice using Steady Shot 2 times against a Bloodfang Worgen.
text.description: So I've got good news and bad news.$B$BThe bad news is that there are more worgen in the woods than in here... so we really have no safe place to go to.$B$BThe good news is that you're starting to get the hang of this. As you get more experience, you'll start to learn how to do new things.$B$BOnce you learn your first new ability, try your hand at it against the bloodfang worgen to our west.

As you get more experience, you'll start to learn how to do new things.$B$BOnce you learn your first new ability, try your hand at it against the bloodfang worgen to our west.

objectiveDetails.description: Reach Level 3 to Learn Steady Shot

text.title: 探究奥术
text.objectives: 跟军事区的米莉安·唤法者谈一谈。
text.description: 大多数人得以存活……但是这片区域仍有狼人出没。$B$B等一切准备妥当，我们就要继续往南推进了。$B$B这倒让我想起一件事来，有人想见你。是法师米莉安，她好像提到你已经“准备好了”之类的。
text.completion: A disciple of the arcane always finds a way forward.  I'm glad to see you, $N.

english.title: Arcane Inquiries
english.objectives: Speak to Myriam Spellwaker in the Military District.
english.description: Most of us made it here alive... but there are worgen on this side of the city as well.$B$BWe're going to continue heading south once everyone's accounted for.$B$BThat reminds me, someone was asking about you.  It was a mage named Myriam.  She mentioned something about you being "ready."
english.completion: A disciple of the arcane always finds a way forward.  I'm glad to see you, $N.

text.title: 寻找修女
text.objectives: 跟军事区的艾尔米拉修女谈一谈。
text.description: 大多数人得以存活……但是这片区域仍有狼人出没。$B$B等一切准备妥当，我们就要继续往南推进了。$B$B这倒让我想起一件事来，有人想见你。对，就是教会的艾尔米拉修女，她说你面临巨大的危险，急需圣光的庇护。$B$B你应该跟她谈谈。她很关心你的安危。

english.objectives: Speak to Sister Almyra in the Military District.

A member of the clergy, Sister Almyra, said that you were in great peril and needed the Light's protection.$B$BYou should go talk to her.  She seemed very concerned.

text.title: Learning the Word
text.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Shadow Word: Pain. Use it 2 times on a bloodfang worgen.
text.description:
You have much to learn, $n.  And I've much to teach you.$B$BThese are perilous times, however, and I fear that you may need to learn much on your own$B$BHave no fear, $g brother:sister;.  The Light will guide us through this.

Go, get more experience, and learn a new skill. Use it against the bloodfang worgen nearby.
