text.title: 风中的名字
text.objectives: 跟军事区的丰收女巫塞莱斯廷谈一谈。
text.description: 大多数人得以存活……但是这片区域仍有狼人出没。$B$B等一切准备妥当，我们就要继续往南推进了。$B$B这倒让我想起一件事来，有人想见你。是女巫塞莱斯廷，她说风中传来了你的名字。$B$B$n，你最好抓紧时间。等你完成与自然的谈话，就赶紧回来吧。我们还需要你来对付狼人呢。
text.completion: We have been blessed today!  You are alive and well!

english.title: The Winds Know Your Name... Apparently
english.objectives: Speak to Celestine of the Harvest in the Military District.
english.description: Most of us made it here alive... but there are worgen on this side of the city as well.$B$BWe're going to continue heading south once everyone's accounted for.$B$BThat reminds me, someone was asking about you.  It was that harvest-witch, Celestine; she said the winds spoke your name.$B$BYou'd best hurry, $n.  We're going to need you to get back to the worgen-smashing once you're done conversing with nature.
english.completion: We have been blessed today!  You are alive and well!

text.title: Frost Nova
text.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Frost Nova. Use it against a Bloodfang Worgen.
text.description:
The path ahead is difficult, $n.  We must devote the entirety of our mental power to the task at hand.$B$BAs you begin to grow in power, new pathways to the arcane will begin to materialize in your mind. You'll begin to develop spells you did not know before.

Go, get more experience, and then use what you learn against the Bloodfang Worgen.
text.completion: You've learned with such speed and ease.  Soon you'll be the one doing the teaching.
text.completed: Return to Myriam Spellwaker in the Military District.

text.title: 谜题解开了
text.objectives: 你得把耐普图隆的石板带给塞纳里奥研究员库拉。
text.description: 你的努力得到了回报。你所冒的巨大风险是值得的。$b$b你发现了纳迦所渴求的物品，也弄清了他们遍布凄凉之地海岸的原因。$b$b至于你找到的雕文，处理办法很明显……
text.progress: What have you learned, $c?
text.completion:
The vision was true!

You have singlehandedly succeeded where others have failed.

The Circle will be have no choice but to pay attention to these findings.

english.title: Mystery Solved
english.objectives: You are to bring the Ancient Engravings of Neptulon to Cenarion Researcher Korrah.
english.description: Your efforts have paid off. The great risks you have taken have proven worthwhile.$b$bYou have discovered the object of the nagas' desire and their reason for overrunning the coast of Desolace.$b$bAs for the engravings you've discovered, your duty is clear...
english.progress: What have you learned, $c?
english.completion:
The vision was true!

You have singlehandedly succeeded where others have failed.

The Circle will be have no choice but to pay attention to these findings.

text.title: Moonfire
text.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Moonfire, then use it against a Bloodfang Worgen.
text.description:
We were driven to the edge of extinction once before, $n.  But we druids, keepers of the old ways, saved our people from famine.$B$BWhen we cut ourselves off from the outside world and our crops failed, it was our order who called upon the earth's blessings and restored the harvest.$B$BJust as our powers restored the crops, your growth in power will develop your connection to our ancient arts.

Go, develop your powers, and use what you learn against the Bloodfang Worgen.
text.progress: The earth speaks to us, $N.  It will not abandon us even in these perilous times.
text.completion: Not bad at all.  Perhaps there is still hope for the old ways.

text.title: 亡魂的复仇
text.objectives: 海卓尼斯要你骑在他的身上打败女祭司瓦丽丝琪。
text.description: 我乃海卓尼斯，是四海的君王、猎潮者耐普图隆的仆从。$b$b艾萨拉和她那些罪恶的纳迦陈兵攻打我的主人，向他发起挑战。这还是头一次要打的旷日持久的战斗。$b$b我苦苦奋战，$r，我有点力不能支了。$b$b看来我的行动引起了他们女祭司的注意。$b$b独自一人的我是无力与她抗衡的。不过也许携起手来，我们能够获胜。
text.completion: The priestess is no more...

english.title: A Revenant's Vengeance
english.objectives: Hydronis wants you to mount him and defeat Priestess Valishj.
english.description: I am Hydronis, a servant of Neptulon the Tidehunter, Lord over all waters.$b$bAzshara and her sinister naga have arrayed themselves against my master, and seek a war with him. This is the first battle in what shall surely be a long struggle.$b$bI have fought bitterly, $r, and have grown weary.$b$bIt seems that my actions here have attracted the attention of their priestess.$b$bAlone, I haven't the strength to overcome her. but perhaps together, we may prevail.
english.completion: The priestess is no more...

text.title: 人多安全
text.objectives: 跟军事区的吉恩·格雷迈恩国王谈一谈。
text.description: 狼人的攻击一波接着一波，我能教你的也就这么些了。$B$B我们应该考虑一下要不要跟其他的幸存者一同前往南边。据说格雷迈恩国王就在此地。$B$B大家聚集起来的话，生存的机会也会大一点……如果你身旁的人会治疗法术，那就更好了。

english.title: Safety in Numbers
english.objectives: Speak to King Genn Greymane in the military district.
english.description: There's only so much I can teach right now with all these worgen trying to dismember us.$B$BWe really should think about heading south with the other survivors.  We've been told that King Greymane is there.$B$BIf we stick together our chances of survival will increase... especially if you choose someone nutritious-looking to stand next to.

text.title: 人多安全
text.objectives: 跟军事区的吉恩·格雷迈恩国王谈一谈。
text.description: 我已经将所有实用的技能传授给你了。$B$B与其他幸存者汇合的时候到了。据说格雷迈恩国王和他的皇家卫队就在此地以南。$B$B我们应该赶往那里，寻求庇护。人多的话，也会安全一点。
text.completion: You've done well in coming here.  If we Gilneans stick together we might yet defeat this terrible enemy.

english.title: Safety in Numbers
english.objectives: Speak to King Genn Greymane in the military district.
english.description: I've taught you all that is practical for now.$B$BIt is time we joined with the other survivors.  The others mentioned that King Greymane and his royal guard are just south of here.$B$BWe should go there and seek safety in numbers.
english.completion: You've done well in coming here.  If we Gilneans stick together we might yet defeat this terrible enemy.

text.title: 我们敌人的敌人
text.objectives: 塞纳里奥研究员库拉要你跟元素勋爵海卓尼斯谈一谈。
text.description: 你为我们做出了巨大的贡献，$c。$b$b尽管他们的兵力依然庞大，但你还是让一件重要的神器免入纳迦之手。$b$b我将把你的发现写信报告给我的同僚们。与此同时，拉纳加尔岛上的水流亡魂独力抵挡着纳迦的猛攻。$b$b我想让你去找到他，看我们是不是有什么办法可以帮助他。
text.completion:
I have witnessed your actions here, $r.

Your presence here is both welcome and timely.

english.title: The Enemy of Our Enemy
english.objectives: Cenarion Researcher Korrah wants you to speak with Lord Hydronis.
english.description: You have done us a great service, $c.$b$bWhile they remain an imposing force, your efforts have kept an important artifact from the naga.$b$bI shall write to my peers of your findings. Meanwhile, the water revenant on Ranazjar Isle has stood alone against a steady onslaught of naga.$b$bI would have you find him and determine if there is some way we can assist him.
english.completion:
I have witnessed your actions here, $r.

Your presence here is both welcome and timely.

text.title: 救援克雷南·阿朗纳斯
text.objectives: 营救克雷南·阿朗纳斯。
text.description: 内战已经结束多年，克罗雷竟然还能在地窖里藏匿这样一批军火，其威力足以摧毁半座城镇。$B$B真不幸，我们现在也许真得这么干了。$B$B但是现在还不能开火，有一位城民被困在监狱的另一头。$B$B他可不是普通的平民，克雷南·阿朗纳斯是位举世闻名的炼金师。$B$B我的女儿出生时十分虚弱，靠他配制的药水才得以保命。$B$B骑上我的马去营救他吧。克雷南必须活着。
text.completion: Well done, $N.  We'll make sure Krennan makes it out of the city alive.

english.title: Save Krennan Aranas
english.objectives: Rescue Krennan Aranas.
english.description: All these years after the war and Crowley was still hiding enough firepower in that cellar to level half of the district.$B$BIt might have to come to that, unfortunately.$B$BWe can't open fire just yet, there is a civilian trapped on the other side of the prison.$B$BNot just any civilian, either.  Krennan Aranas is one of the most brilliant alchemists this world has known.$B$BOne of his potions saved my daughter, Tess, from dying soon after being born.$B$BTake my horse and rescue him.  Krennan must live.
english.completion: Well done, $N.  We'll make sure Krennan makes it out of the city alive.

text.title: 重整旗鼓
text.objectives: 跟吉尔尼斯城格雷迈恩皇家庭院的吉恩·格雷迈恩国王谈一谈。
text.description: 请转告格雷迈恩国王，我们已经竭尽所能，总算争取到了一点时间。$B$B但我感觉狼人很快就会再次发动进攻，时间紧迫。$B$B看来，我们得撤回到西边的格雷迈恩皇家庭院。那是我们最后的据守点。如果庭院失守，我们都将成为瓮中之鳖。
text.completion: We're left with very few choices, $N.  What we do next will be a critical decision.

english.title: Time to Regroup
english.objectives: Speak to King Genn Greymane at Greymane Court in Gilneas City.
english.description: We've done all we can here.  Let King Greymane know we've bought some time.$B$BI've a feeling it won't be long 'til the worgen are back in force.$B$BWe'll need to fall back to Greymane Court to the west, if that's the case.  It's the last place we can hold out without being trapped like fish in a barrel.
english.completion: We're left with very few choices, $N.  What we do next will be a critical decision.

text.title: 海的姐妹
text.objectives: 破坏希莉丝拉女士和薇丝拉女士的能量石，杀了她们。
text.description: 对我们岗哨的进攻是由两个纳迦女巫主导的，她们把我最好的手下打得落花流水，但你能人所不能。$B$B去悬崖东边，古代暗夜精灵巨像遗迹附近，把希莉丝拉女士和薇丝拉女士找出来，杀了她们。你得先摧毁她们的能量石，不要让我失望，$c！

english.title: Sisters of the Sea
english.objectives: Kill Lady Silisthra and Lady Vesthra by disabling their power stones.
english.description: Two Naga witches have been masterminding the assault on this outpost. They've repelled direct attacks from some of my best grunts, but you can finish the job where others have failed.$B$BSeek out and slay Lady Silisthra and Lady Vesthra at the eastern edge of the cliffs, around the ruins of the ancient night elven colossus. You will first need to destroy the powerstones that give them their strength. Do not disappoint me, $c!

text.title: 当心脚下
text.objectives: 在通往奥术之巅顶部的路上借助能量传导器收集6束能量束。
text.description: 说简单也简单，说不简单也不简单。往上面去一路上都有能量传导器。就跟这儿的这个差不多！没错，差不多。$B$B而现在呢，你要用我的弹跳板超越巅峰，一路上还要触碰所有你看见的传导器。等你到了顶上，应该就充满了能量了，因为这事它就是这样的。$B$B记得别停下来，不然你将会有一次难忘的旅行！

english.title: Watch Your Step
english.objectives: Receive 6 Energized charges from the Energy Conduits as you ascend to the top of the Arcane Pinnacle.
english.description: This is somewhat simple and somewhat not simple. All the way up there are Energy Conduits. Rather like this one right here one might say! Indeed, I do say.$B$BNow for you. You must use my jump pads to ascend the pinnacle, and you must touch all of the conduits you see along the way. When you get to me at the top, you should be all juicy with energy, because really that's the only way to be.$B$BAnd be sure to keep moving or you're likely to be sent for quite a trip!

starters.name: 大法师克希雷姆的影像

enders.name: 大法师克希雷姆的影像

text.title: 提前解放
text.objectives: 用教徒和龙人身上的铁铸钥匙释放漆黑山脊的4名地精工人。
text.description: 刚开始建这座塔的时候我就知道这些家伙会是个麻烦。拒绝我们的打点，偷走我们的工人。$B$B艾萨拉工程繁多，人工可不便宜。我得把我的人弄回来！

english.title: Pro-liberation
english.objectives: Use Ironwrought Keys from cultists and dragonkin to free 4 Goblin Workers in Sable Ridge.
english.description: I knew these guys would be trouble as soon as we started building this tower. Scoffing our bribes. Stealing our workers.$B$BLabor isn't cheap with all the construction in Azshara. I need those men back!

enders.name: 大法师克希雷姆的影像

text.title: 克希雷姆疯人院
text.objectives: 进入传送门，回到大法师克希雷姆的高塔，去找乔安娜。
text.description: 真是太了不起了你！能观察你是我的荣幸。挺有研究意义的。$B$B去吧，回到我的塔里，乔安娜会安排下一步。我来给你开一道传送门。

english.title: Xylem's Asylum
english.objectives: Take the portal to Archmage Xylem's tower and seek out Joanna inside.
english.description: Quite marvelous of you! A pleasure to observe. Much to study.$B$BOff you go now, retire to my tower. Joanna will get you situated. I shall open a portal for you.

starters.name: 大法师克希雷姆的影像

text.title: 火焰试炼
text.objectives: 在火焰符文中保持连续10波不被击中以完成火焰试炼。
text.description: 火焰试炼……哦呵呵……听上去很吓人吧？没有吗？好吧我也这么觉得。一件件来，首先你碰一下火焰水晶，试炼的传送门就打开了。$B$B想要过关，你就得在火焰符文内不停的跳舞，并且不能被火焰击中。只要你在一定时间里还没被点着，就算过关！$B$B这儿有几个小提示——在符文冷却的时候，火焰会飞向新的符文位置，重新开始燃烧。你愿意可以自己去弄明白，或者干脆靠猜！大多数人都是那么干的。

english.title: The Trial of Fire
english.objectives: Complete the Trial of Fire by standing in the fire runes without getting hit by flame for 10 consecutive bursts.
english.description: The Trial of Fire... oooh... sounds intimidating, doesn't it? No? Hm. Well I kind of thought so. Firsts are first, you touch the fire crystal and the portal to the trial opens.$B$BTo beat this trial, you have to hop around in the fire runes without getting hit by the fire. If you stay unflamed long enough, you win!$B$BThere are little signs to help you - fire hopping to its new rune, fizzles when a rune goes cold. You can figure that stuff out if you want. Or just guess! That's what most people do.

starters.name: 大法师克希雷姆的影像

enders.name: 大法师克希雷姆的影像
大法师克希雷姆的影像
大法师克希雷姆的影像

text.title: 复命
text.objectives: 返回艾瑟雷索，向塞纳里奥研究员库拉复命。
text.description: 成功了！我们共同击败了可怕的敌人。$b$b$c，你的英雄事迹肯定会传到耐普图隆耳中的。请允许我代他向你致谢……$b$b你应该离开了。这里的安宁不会维持太久的。纳迦们很快就会卷土重来，为他们的女祭司复仇。
text.completion:
Please accept this reward for your heroic accomplishments, $N.

You have bought us precious time!

english.title: Return and Report
english.objectives: You are to return to Cenarion Researcher Korrah at Ethel Rethor.
english.description: It is done! Together we were able to bring down a dangerous adversary.$b$bNeptulon himself shall hear of your exploits here, $c. Allow me to extend you his thanks...$b$bYou should leave now. This place will not remain safe for long. Soon, the naga will seek vengeance for their priestess.
english.completion:
Please accept this reward for your heroic accomplishments, $N.

You have bought us precious time!

text.title: 官方评估
text.objectives: 塞纳里奥研究员库拉要你将库拉的报告带给卡隆林地的卡隆。
text.description: 你在对抗纳迦的努力中成果显著，$n。但恐怕这还远远不够……$b$b这是我对纳迦势力的官方评估。$b$b我肯定旷野中的同僚们会采取必要的行动。$b$b将它带给东南边塞纳里奥旷野中央林地里的卡隆。他知道该怎么做。$b$b谢谢你，$n。再会了。
text.completion:
<Karnum opens and reads Korrah's Report.>

This is alarming news, indeeed, $r - something we have no shortage of here.

I shall call a council regarding the issue. You will be summoned if you are needed.

english.title: Official Assessment
english.objectives: Cenarion Researcher Korrah wants you to take Korrah's Report to Karnum at Karnum's Grove.
english.description: You have accomplished much in your efforts against the naga, $n. But I fear it is not nearly enough....$b$bThis is my official assessment of the naga presence.$b$bI'm confident that my peers in the wildlands will take the necessary action.$b$bBring this to Karnum at the grove in the center of the Cenarion Wildlands to the southeast. He will know what to do.$b$bThank you, $n. And farewell.
english.completion:
<Karnum opens and reads Korrah's Report.>

This is alarming news, indeeed, $r - something we have no shortage of here.

I shall call a council regarding the issue. You will be summoned if you are needed.

text.title: 向阿格娜复命
text.objectives: 返回失落群岛的部落营地，告诉阿格娜发生了什么事。
text.description: $n，请返回部落营地，告诉阿格娜我们还活着。$B$B告诉她我要赶去荒野瞭望台，然后在岛屿西北边跟大家汇合。希望能在那里见到你。$B$B沿途我们会追踪联盟并杀光他们！
text.completion: <Aggra gives you the eye as if she doesn't quite believe what you are telling her.>$B$BI am not easily impressed, but if what you are telling me is true, then I have never before heard of such a thing.$B$BYou have my thanks, $N.

english.title: Back to Aggra
english.objectives: Inform Aggra at the Horde Base Camp on the Lost Isles of all that has transpired.
english.description: Return to the Horde Base Camp and let Aggra know that we still live, $n.$B$BTell her that I am moving on to the Wild Overlook and that we will all meet up on the northwest side of the island. I expect to see you there.$B$BWe will track down the Alliance and slay them to the last!
english.completion: <Aggra gives you the eye as if she doesn't quite believe what you are telling her.>$B$BI am not easily impressed, but if what you are telling me is true, then I have never before heard of such a thing.$B$BYou have my thanks, $N.

text.title: 血之理论
text.objectives: 收集10条吸满血的水蛭。
text.description: 凄凉之地并非只有地貌发生了变化。在这里，野生动植物以奇怪的方式适应新的环境，有的方式着实令人兴奋。$b$b我对西边那些返祖的雷霆蜥蜴很感兴趣。$b$b我需要蜥蜴的血样。$b$b将这些水蛭抛向蜥蜴。$b$b待它们吸饱血后，拿回来给我。
text.progress: Were you able to recover the samples I require?
text.completion:
This should be enough.

Thank you, $c.

english.title: Blood Theory
english.objectives: Collect 10 Blood-filled Leeches.
english.description: The land is not all that has changed in Desolace. Here, the wildlife has responded to their new environment in strange and sometimes exciting ways.$b$bI am particularly interested in the Rejuvenated Thunder Lizards that roam just to the west.$b$bI need a sample of their blood.$b$bYou may begin helping me by using this jar of leeches on a few of them.$b$bOnce they've filled on the blood of those beasts, return them to me.
english.progress: Were you able to recover the samples I require?
english.completion:
This should be enough.

Thank you, $c.

text.title: 收割时节
text.objectives: 收集10棵芦蓟草。
text.description: 只有塞纳里奥议会明白，这片绿洲很可能会迅速干涸，如同它的出现一样快。$b$b我们必须小心翼翼，绝不能干涉这一自然变迁，而应该保护这块绿地。$b$b大灾变后，绿洲附近密密麻麻地长出了一种新植株。$b$b请帮我收集它们的样本，或许我能研究出其中的奥秘。
text.progress: Have you collected the samples I require?
text.completion:
These are fine specimens, $r.

I shall commence my studies immediately.

english.title: A Time to Reap
english.objectives: Collect 10 Aloe Thistles.
english.description: No one knows better than the Cenarion Circle that this lush oasis could dry up as quickly as it appeared.$b$bWe must take care not to interfere with the processes taking place here, but to support and preserve them,$b$bA new species of plant, very plentiful in the surrounding region, has appeared since the great change.$b$bCollect samples of these for me, that I might study them and learn what they have to teach us,
english.progress: Have you collected the samples I require?
english.completion:
These are fine specimens, $r.

I shall commence my studies immediately.

text.title: 清理杂草
text.objectives: 杀死7个拔根鞭笞者。
text.description: 自然生态在遭遇如此突变之后，某些植物和动物很可能会出现一些我们意想不到的反应。$B$B拔根鞭笞者就是个棘手的例子。游荡在绿洲的东部和南部的它们，对这个地区的环境是一个威胁，必须将它们除掉。$B$B如果你撞见了任何的拔根鞭笞者，就清理掉它们。
text.completion:
On behalf of Desolace herself, I thank you, $r.

Please accept our deepest gratitude.

english.title: Pulling Weeds
english.objectives: Kill 7 Uprooted Lashers.
english.description: With such an abrupt change to the ecology, it is to be expected that some of the flora and fauna don't react as well as we'd hope.$b$bThe uprooted lashers are a troublesome example of this. Roaming the fields to the east and south they are a detriment to the region and must be disposed of.$b$bWhile you're about, please deal with any of these pests that you find.
english.completion:
On behalf of Desolace herself, I thank you, $r.

Please accept our deepest gratitude.

text.title: 固执的风
text.objectives: 消灭5名旋风雷暴行者。
text.description: 风向正在变化，$r。这一点毫无疑问。$b$b我们被许多紧要事务搞得焦头烂额。最为主要的就是我们日益扩大的绿洲的散布。$b$b它们的生长超出了我们的预期，也超出了我们的理解，而现在它遇到了麻烦。$b$b在西边，草地和沙石交界的地方，旋风阻挡了它进入沙漠的势头。$b$b去消灭那些阻碍生命的敌对分子！
text.completion:
You have done well, $c.

We will doubtlessly call upon you for assistance with more significant matters in the future.

english.title: Stubborn Winds
english.objectives: Destroy 5 Whirlwind Stormwalkers.
english.description: The winds of change are blowing, $r. Of that there can be no doubt.$b$bThere are many pressing issues vying for our attention and action. Chief among them is the spreading of our growing oasis.$b$bIts growth has surpassed our hopes as well as our understanding, yet now it faces opposition.$b$bTo the west, where the grass meets the sand, whirlwinds prevent its penetration into the desert.$b$bGo and eliminate this hostile obstacle to life!
english.completion:
You have done well, $c.

We will doubtlessly call upon you for assistance with more significant matters in the future.

text.title: 科学发火了
text.objectives: 使用X-21型灭火器扑灭8处火场，从秘密实验室的烈焰中救出6名实习研究员。$B$B如果你丢失了X-21型灭火器，就去找南部火箭车终点站的助手格瑞里。
text.description: 你来的时候看见爆炸了么？秘密实验室再一次陷入一片火海！要是我们不把火扑灭，温控警戒就会超标，从而进入熔融连锁。$B$B给，我把这罐超低温高压液凝胶交给你：它是科学史上最具挥发性的阻燃剂！（让罐子远离明火。）把火扑灭，把我的实习生们带出来，然后用控制中心的通话器联系我。
text.progress: <Greely's squeaky voice peels through a set of speakers.>$B$BRocketway to Secret Lab! Rocketway to Secret Lab! Come in, Secret Lab...
text.completion: Nice work, $N! Now, we need to decouple the reaction core matrix from the fuel sumps, or that whole place is gonna blow itself to Outland...

english.title: When Science Attacks
english.objectives: Use the Fireliminator X-21 to extinguish 8 fires and to rescue 6 Research Interns from the inferno at the Secret Lab.$B$BSee Assistant Greely at the Southern Rocketway Terminus if you lose your Fireliminator.
english.description: Did you see the explosions on the way in? The Secret Lab is engulfed in flames! Again! If we don't stamp out those flames we're going to hit critical temperatacity and resonate into a meltdown cascade.$B$BHere, I'm entrusting you with a canister of experimental hypercooled pressurized liquigel: The most volatile fire retardant known to science! (Keep that canister away from open flame.) Put out the fires and hose down my interns, then contact me via the squawkbox in central control.
english.progress: <Greely's squeaky voice peels through a set of speakers.>$B$BRocketway to Secret Lab! Rocketway to Secret Lab! Come in, Secret Lab...
english.completion: Nice work, $N! Now, we need to decouple the reaction core matrix from the fuel sumps, or that whole place is gonna blow itself to Outland...

text.title: 安抚科多兽
text.objectives: 在5只暴怒的科多兽旁使用科多药汤。
text.description: 你也许已经看到了，这一地区的迅速变化对本地生物而言既有正面影响，也有负面影响。$b$b东面和南面，暴怒的科多兽已经对附近的人们形成了持续的威胁。$b$b该是把我的理论付诸实践的时候了。我用回春处理过的雷霆蜥蜴血制造了这药剂。希望当科多兽喝下后能够平静下来。$b$b把它放在一头暴怒的科多兽附近，一定要保持安全距离！
text.completion:
Wonderful! Karnum will be so pleased!

Please, accept this as my thanks.

english.title: Calming the Kodo
english.objectives: Use the Kodo Concoction near 5 Enraged Kodos.
english.description: As you have by now witnessed, the rapid changes to this region can have both positive and negative effects on the native creatures.$b$bTo the south and east of here, enraged kodo are a constant threat to anyone nearby.$b$bIt's time to put my theory to the test. I've used the rejuvenated thunder lizard's blood in the making of this concoction. I'm hoping it will soothe the kodo when they eat it.$b$bPlace it near an enraged kodo and make sure you do it from a safe distance!
english.completion:
Wonderful! Karnum will be so pleased!

Please, accept this as my thanks.

text.title: 总结段错误：卸除核心
text.objectives: 激活反应堆控制台，将艾萨莱特水晶核心送回南部火箭车终点站。万一核心过热，使用X-21型灭火器。
text.description: 一旦我们熄灭中央反应堆，你就把核心给我带回来。它是一颗100%精炼艾萨莱特水晶，威力巨大又危险，还很美妙。哦艾萨莱特水晶，改天换地的宝贝啊！$B$B拉动左手边的巨型杠杆，卸下核心用轨道系统送回来。它会过热，所以你一路上要经常性地用灭火器降温……不要让它升到临界温度！
text.progress: Don't worry about the residual effects of all those burning chemicals in the lab. Hair grows back!
text.completion: Whew, the sample is secure. And it's still steaming! Thank you, $N.$B$BAzsharite is a complex mystery wrapped in a velvety enigma of danger. Grapplehammer insists that we learn more about this strange substance.

english.title: Segmentation Fault: Core Dumped
english.objectives: Activate the Reactor Control Console and escort the Azsharite Core back to the Southern Rocketway Terminus. Use the Fireliminator X-21 on the Core if it starts to overheat.
english.description: Once we flush the central reactor, I need you to return the core to me. It's 100% refined azsharite crystal, which is both powerful and dangerous. And lovely. Oh precious azsharite, the shaper of worlds to come!$B$BThe giant lever to your left will dump the core and send it to me via the rail system. The core will be superheated, so you'll need to periodically douse it with the Fireliminator on the way here... don't let it reach critical temperature!
english.progress: Don't worry about the residual effects of all those burning chemicals in the lab. Hair grows back!
english.completion: Whew, the sample is secure. And it's still steaming! Thank you, $N.$B$BAzsharite is a complex mystery wrapped in a velvety enigma of danger. Grapplehammer insists that we learn more about this strange substance.

objectiveDetails.description: 交付艾萨莱特水晶核心

text.title: 参与其中
text.objectives: 前往塞纳里奥旷野，对5处肥沃土堆使用塞纳里奥之种。
text.description: 我们生活的时代是多么美好啊！$b$b曾经的荒土凄凉之地如今变得生机盎然。$c，想象一下，如果艾泽拉斯所有的废土都以这样的方式复苏！说不定有一天……$b$b当然，我们还面临着不少棘手的问题，但是没有理由不坐下来好好地欣赏这场生命的奇迹。$b$b事实上，我们应该参与其中。这是塞纳里奥之种。将它们撒在肥沃的土堆上。$b$b对疲惫的灵魂来说，这是完美的解药！
text.completion: The rejuvenation is so invigorating! Don't you think?

english.title: Taking Part
english.objectives: Use the Cenarion Seeds next to 5 of the Fertile Mounds around the Cenarion Wildlands.
english.description: What a glorious time we live in!$b$bThe former wastelands of Desolace are blooming, bursting with life. Imagine, $c, if all of Azeroth's wastelands awoke in such a fashion! Perhaps someday...$b$bIt's true that there are weighty issues at hand here, but why not take a moment to appreciate the wondrous miracle we are witnessing?$b$bIn fact, why not take part in it? Here are some Cenarion Seeds. Use them at the more fertile spots of the wildlands.$b$bPerfect medicine for lifting a weary soul!
english.completion: The rejuvenation is so invigorating! Don't you think?

text.title: 准备见面
text.objectives: 卡隆林地的格伦·暗风要你去跟力普拉可汗谈一谈。
text.description: 我听说了你在凄凉之地的事迹，$n。我们欠你人情。$b$b但我恐怕得让你卷入另一场危机之中，而且比其它的还要紧迫。$b$b近来这里风云突变。旧的纷争形成了新的冲突，更加险恶。我应该让我们的客人来进一步地解释……$b$b一度统治整个东凄凉之地的科卡尔部落，如今门庭冷落，力普拉可汗是仅存的族人之一。我们在边境发现了奄奄一息的他。听听他怎么说吧。
text.completion: Be not afraid, $r. I mean you no harm.

english.title: An Introduction Is In Order
english.objectives: Garren Darkwind at Karnum's Glade wants you to speak to Khan Leh'prah.
english.description: I have heard of your exploits here in Desolace, $n. We are in your debt.$b$bI'm afraid I must involve you in yet another crisis, one more pressing than the rest.$b$bThe landscape is not all that has changed here of late. Old conflicts have made way for new, more dire ones. I should allow our guest to explain further....$b$bKhan Leh'prah is among the last of the Kolkar tribe that once possessed all of eastern Desolace. We found him near death on our borders. Listen to his words.
english.completion: Be not afraid, $r. I mean you no harm.

text.title: 恢复人性
text.objectives: 跟暮湾镇的克雷南·阿朗纳斯谈一谈。
text.description: 克雷南的药剂让你恢复了人性？$B$B看来我不用处决你了。至少现在不用。$B$B快去把这个好消息告诉克雷南·阿朗纳斯吧。他正负责管理……我们关押你的同类的那幢房子。$B$B记住，$n。小心点，我会注意你的一举一动，如果你有什么异常，我会毫不犹豫开枪的。
text.completion: It worked!  By the Light, it worked!

english.title: Among Humans Again
english.objectives: Speak to Krennan Aranas in Duskhaven.
english.description: So Krennan's potion did not kill you?  Well, I suppose that means the human inside of you is in control then.$B$BI guess I won't be shooting you after all.  At least not yet.$B$BGo speak to Krennan Aranas and give him the good news.  He's in charge of the house where we keep... your kind.$B$BJust remember, $n.  I've got my eye on you.  You so much as try anything funny and you'll get a bullet between the eyes.
english.completion: It worked!  By the Light, it worked!

text.title: 突围！
text.objectives: 杀死玛格拉姆村的玛格拉姆看守者。
text.description: 一开始，我反复梦到同样的场景，昭示着即将到来的危险。我看见恶魔军团朝我们袭来，席卷了整个大地。$b$b梦境已然成真。火刃氏族和他们的恶魔主子将玛格拉姆半人马逐出了南部的居住地。因此，玛格拉姆半人马调转矛头，强占了我们的家园。$b$b那场战斗异常激烈。只有一小部分科卡尔半人马得以生还。我要你去东边，进入原本属于我们的家园营救科卡尔半人马囚犯。
text.completion:
I thank you, $r.

Our tribe may not have survived without your aid.

english.title: Breakout!
english.objectives: Kill the Magram Warden at the Magram Village.
english.description: It began with a dream that repeatedly warned me of the danger to come. I saw the demonic legions bearing down upon our kind, overrunning our lands.$b$bThe dream has become real. The Burning Blade and their demon masters have pushed the Magram out of their lands in the south. In turn, the Magram have defeated my people and taken over our homes.$b$bThe fight was ferocious. Only a handful of the Kolkar still live. I would ask that you visit what was once my land in the east, and free them from their prison.
english.completion:
I thank you, $r.

Our tribe may not have survived without your aid.

text.title: Liam's Stupor
text.objectives: Speak to Gwen Armstead in Duskhaven.
text.description: Go away!  You're just inside my head... You're not real.... you're dead!$B$BYou died in Gilneas City... the worgen... they got you...$B$BIt should've been me... it should've been me...$B$BAughhh... first the earth won't stop moving... and now I'm seeing things...  too much rye...$B$B<The prince seems out of it.  Perhaps you can find someone else to speak to.>

english.title: Liam's Stupor
english.objectives: Speak to Gwen Armstead in Duskhaven.
english.description: Go away!  You're just inside my head... You're not real.... you're dead!$B$BYou died in Gilneas City... the worgen... they got you...$B$BIt should've been me... it should've been me...$B$BAughhh... first the earth won't stop moving... and now I'm seeing things...  too much rye...$B$B<The prince seems out of it.  Perhaps you can find someone else to speak to.>

text.title: 塞纳里奥的财产
text.objectives: 在玛格拉姆领地收集7个塞纳里奥补给箱。
text.description: 自从家园被恶魔侵占后，玛格拉姆半人马就与邻近的势力进入了敌对状态。$b$b他们变得多疑而好战，甚至舍弃了自给自足的传统，开始偷窃他人的财物。$b$b最近我们的补给品总是莫名其妙地不知所踪，很可能是玛格拉姆半人马干的。$b$b$n，去东边的玛格拉姆领地寻找我们的财物吧。
text.progress: Were you able to find our belongings, $N?
text.completion:
As we suspected, the Magram have been stealing our supplies.

We shall guard them more closely.

english.title: Cenarion Property
english.objectives: Collect 7 Cenarion Supply Crates from the Magram Lands.
english.description: Since the demons have invaded their lands, the Magram have broken all ties with any outsiders.$b$bThey are untrusting and hostile and have taken to stealing from others instead of providing for themselves.$b$bMany of our needed supplies have gone missing of late and we suspect that the Magram are to blame.$b$bPlease, $n, go to their lands in the east and search for our belongings.
english.progress: Were you able to find our belongings, $N?
english.completion:
As we suspected, the Magram have been stealing our supplies.

We shall guard them more closely.

text.title: Tremors
text.objectives: Gwen Armstead wants you to investigate the Queen's Gate.
text.description: $N!  We thought we wouldn't see you again!$B$BListen -- we need your help. A huge earthquake hit us and the aftershocks haven't stopped.  Prince Liam isn't going to be of much use either.$B$BWe need to make sure our defenses are still holding up.  The Queen's Gate is the only thing standing between us and a mess of frothing-at-the-mouth rabid worgen from the Blackwald.$B$BJust follow the road east, out of town.  Let me know if the gate has held up.

english.title: Tremors
english.objectives: Gwen Armstead wants you to investigate the Queen's Gate.
english.description: $N!  We thought we wouldn't see you again!$B$BListen -- we need your help. A huge earthquake hit us and the aftershocks haven't stopped.  Prince Liam isn't going to be of much use either.$B$BWe need to make sure our defenses are still holding up.  The Queen's Gate is the only thing standing between us and a mess of frothing-at-the-mouth rabid worgen from the Blackwald.$B$BJust follow the road east, out of town.  Let me know if the gate has held up.

text.title: 微妙的谈判
text.objectives: 力普拉可汗要你将科卡尔可汗之矛插在先祖之石上，并从玛格拉姆的手中保护它，直到坎玛可汗出现。$b$b你做好前往战场的准备后就跟力普拉可汗谈一谈。
text.description: 只有一种方法才能赢得玛格拉姆的信任和忠诚。$b$b就是把他们打服。$b$b他们在同我的氏族交战时损失惨重。现在他们占有着一块不熟悉的土地，挣扎着力求生存。$b$b如今正是出击的时候。$b$b准备好就跟我说，挥骑杀入，将我的长矛插在先祖之石上。消灭一定数量之后，他们的可汗就只能屈服于我们的意志了。
text.completion: Why is it that you meddle in centaur affairs, $r?

english.title: Delicate Negotiations
english.objectives: Khan Leh'prah wants you to place the Spear of the Kolkar Khan in the Fatherstone and defend it from the Magram until Khan Kammah appears.$b$bSpeak to Khan Leh'prah when you are ready to ride to the battle site.
english.description: There is but one way to win the trust and loyalty of the Magram.$b$bIt must be beaten out of them.$b$bThey have suffered many losses in their war against my clan. They now possess an unfamiliar land, where they struggle just to feed themselves.$b$bNow is the time to strike.$b$bSpeak to me when you are ready, then ride in and plant my spear in the Fatherstone. If we can kill enough of them, their Khan will submit to our will.
english.completion: Why is it that you meddle in centaur affairs, $r?

text.title: Further Treatment
text.objectives: Speak to Krennan Aranas in Duskhaven.
text.description: Listen, $N.  I'm not going to beat around the bush.$B$BThere's a good chance the potion Krennan made for you wasn't a complete success.  Or perhaps you need more of it.$B$BEither way, he's probably better equipped to advise you than I am.  Go see him.

english.title: Further Treatment
english.objectives: Speak to Krennan Aranas in Duskhaven.
english.description: Listen, $N.  I'm not going to beat around the bush.$B$BThere's a good chance the potion Krennan made for you wasn't a complete success.  Or perhaps you need more of it.$B$BEither way, he's probably better equipped to advise you than I am.  Go see him.

text.title: 急需药材
text.objectives: 找到一箱毒参茄精萃。
text.description: 是的。就目前所知，狼人的诅咒是不可能完全治愈的。$B$B但是经过治疗，你可以拥有自我意识……摆脱兽性。$B$B很幸运，药剂在你身上生效了。通常我只能治愈感染诅咒时间不长的病患。$B$B想要摆脱诅咒的影响，你还得继续服药。$B$B我需要毒参茄精萃配制新的血清。你可以在镇子西南的小屋下找到装有毒参茄精萃的箱子。
text.completion: The crate has been smashed and the vials inside of it appear to have been broken.

english.title: In Need of Ingredients
english.objectives: Find the Crate of Mandrake Essence.
english.description: Ah, yes.  The effects of the Curse cannot ever be fully cured as far as we know.$B$BWith treatment, however, your mind will remain yours... and not that of a wild animal.$B$BWe are fortunate that the treatment worked on you.  Normally, I can only treat recent infections.$B$BWe'll need to continue your medication if we're to have you reverse the Curse.$B$BI will need mandrake essence to brew another batch of my serum for you.  You will find a crate stashed beneath a shed southwest of town.
english.completion: The crate has been smashed and the vials inside of it appear to have been broken.

text.title: 入侵
text.objectives: 跟暮湾镇的格温·阿姆斯特谈一谈。
text.description: <民兵的肋骨处插着一柄长刀，刀柄上镶嵌有被遗忘者的印记。你四下寻找线索，在海岸边发现了两艘军舰，其装饰风格非常野性。>$B$B<吉尔尼斯遭到了攻击。将这个消息转告暮湾镇的镇长格温·阿姆斯特吧。>
text.completion: Forsaken!  Quick, $N!  We must mount a defense.

english.title: Invasion
english.objectives: Speak to Gwen Armstead in Duskhaven.
english.description: <A long knife with a skull ornament on its hilt sticks out of the militiaman's ribs.  As you look around for clues, you spot a pair of savage-looking warships at the shore.>$B$B<Gilneas is being invaded.  Bring word back to Duskhaven's Mayor, Gwen Armstead.>
english.completion: Forsaken!  Quick, $N!  We must mount a defense.

text.title: 悲剧的科学！悲剧！
text.objectives: 杀掉8头静电充能角鹰兽。
text.description: 本来我是打算用电击法驯化野生角鹰兽的，可不知道为什么它们狂暴了！现在我的实验对象把这地方闹了个底儿掉！$C，在它们找上我之前，把那些失败产品杀掉。

english.title: Bad Science! Bad!
english.objectives: Kill 8 Static-Charged Hippogryphs.
english.description: I was trying to domesticate the indigenous hippogryphs here using a series of debilitating electrical shocks, when for some reason they went berserk! Now my test subjects are tearing up this place for no good reason! $C, go slaughter my failed experiments before they find me.

text.title: 吸水
text.objectives: 从亚考兰神殿废墟东边的邪恶水滴身上收集20份临近沸腾的水滴。
text.description: 还有一件事。热水。$B$B这附近可不大好整。又没有温泉，也没有朋友可以蹭。有个好办法。这块海绵拿上……超吸水的！用它到东头的沙洲上去吸些邪恶水滴。$B$B够了之后在塔边上再挤出来，好召唤大元素。他有热水。

english.title: Absorbent
english.objectives: Collect 20 Simmering Water Droplets from the Vile Splashes east of the Ruins of Arkkoran.
english.description: One other thing I need. Hot water.$B$BNot easy around here. Not hot springs, no friends to share. One good way though. Have this sponge... it's ultra absorbent! Use it to go soak Vile Splashes at the sandbar eastish.$B$BWith enough, go squeeze them out over near the tower to summon jumbo elemental. He has hot water.

text.title: 好多热水
text.objectives: 从埃达拉之塔处滚烫的水元素领主身上获得沸水之球。
text.description: 厄格尔罗告诉你用饱胀的艾萨拉海绵去东北方的埃达拉之塔召唤一个“大”元素。
text.giverWindow: 滚烫水元素在商业层面的娱乐替代应用方案已被证明过于危险。

english.title: Full of Hot Water
english.objectives: Obtain a Globe of Boiling Water from a Scalding Water Lord at the Tower of Eldara.
english.description: Ergll indicated that you should be able to use the Engorged Azshara Sea Sponge to summon a "jumbo" elemental near the Tower of Eldara to the northeast.
english.giverWindow: Alternative recreational uses for scalding water elementals have proven too dangerous to pursue on a commercial level.

text.title: 有吃的就干
text.objectives: 收集5块蜥蜴的肋肉。
text.description: <坎玛可汗听你说明了恶魔的威胁，以及力普拉可汗预见的景象。>$b$b不需要用恶魔来给我们上课，$r。正是他们把我们氏族从祖先的土地上赶了出来。$b$b正是他们强迫我们占据科卡尔的废土，在那里苟延残喘。$b$b对科卡尔的战争让我的人民饱受其苦，余下来的这点人不知温饱。$b$b给我的人带点吃的来，然后咱们再来谈谈恶魔的事情。
text.progress: Have you brought food for my clan, $r?
text.completion:
Very good, $r.

This will sustain us for now.

english.title: Will Work For Food
english.objectives: Collect 5 Basilisk Flanks.
english.description: <Khan Kammah listens as you explain the demonic threat, and Khan Leh'prah's visions.>$b$bNo one need lecture us about the demons, $r. It is they who drove our clan from our ancestral lands.$b$bIt is they who forced us to take over the Kolkar wastelands, where we struggle just to exist.$b$bThe war against the Kolkar took a heavy toll on my people. What few of us remain are weary and hungry.$b$bBring food for my people and then we shall discuss the demons.
english.progress: Have you brought food for my clan, $r?
english.completion:
Very good, $r.

This will sustain us for now.

text.title: 甲板上见
text.objectives: 爬上停泊在失落群岛岸边的复仇觉醒号的甲板上层，跟萨尔谈一谈。
text.description: 没想到我再次沦为了联盟的囚犯。我对你的感激之情溢于言表……$n。$B$B甲板上见吧，我们要好好对付这帮家伙。
text.completion: My mission is too critical to let these meddlers continue to dog us. It's up to you and I to put an end to this once and for all!

english.title: Meet Me Up Top
english.objectives: Make your way up top on the upper deck of the Vengeance Wake off the shore of the Lost Isles and speak with Thrall.
english.description: I never thought that I would be a prisoner of the Alliance again. I cannot begin to express my gratitude to you... $n, is it?$B$BI will meet you up top and from there we will deal with them.
english.completion: My mission is too critical to let these meddlers continue to dog us. It's up to you and I to put an end to this once and for all!

text.title: 言行一致
text.objectives: 坎玛可汗要你跟力普拉可汗谈一谈。
text.description: 看来我们已别无选择了。$b$b虽然我很不情愿跟科卡尔半人马联手，但是科卡尔可汗的话还是很有道理的。$b$b请转告他，我愿意举起长矛，与他们并肩作战。
text.completion:
You have done well, $c.

Now we must convince the Gelkis...

english.title: My Word is My Bond
english.objectives: Khan Kammah wants you to speak to Khan Leh'prah.
english.description: It would seem that we have no choice.$b$bAs reluctant as I am to cooperate with the Kolkar, there is wisdom in the words of their Khan.$b$bYou may give him my word that we shall lend our spears to the battle.
english.completion:
You have done well, $c.

Now we must convince the Gelkis...

text.title: 三个王子
text.objectives: 杀死洛忽、舍利克和觉伦斯，然后跟苏度可汗谈一谈。
text.description: 吉尔吉斯半人马居住在凄凉之地的西南部。他们跟玛格拉姆半人马一样固执，由于没有受过战争和迁移的影响，他们的体格显得更加强壮。$b$b必须展示强大的力量，才可能挫败吉尔吉斯半人马的锐气。$b$b苏度可汗和他的三个儿子统领整个氏族。苏度可汗年老体弱，且受到旧时战伤的折磨。他整天待在洞穴深处，完全不露面了。实权都落在他那三个儿子手里。$b$b杀死他们，迫使苏度答应我们的条件。
text.completion:
My sons all slain... my clan in ruins...

Were I in my youth, I would tear you limb from limb!

Go now... kill me or leave me to mourn alone, $r.

english.title: Three Princes
english.objectives: Slay Rhoho, Sherik, and Jorreth.
english.description: The Gelkis reside in southwest Desolace. They are just as stubborn as the Magram, and since they have not suffered war and relocation, they are considerably stronger.$b$bHumbling the Gelkis will require an extreme show of force.$b$bKhan Shodo and his three sons rule the clan. Shodo is aging, and suffers from old war wounds. He never leaves the depths of his cave. The strength of his rule lies in his sons.$b$bSlay them, and persuade the Khan to commit to our cause.
english.completion:
My sons all slain... my clan in ruins...

Were I in my youth, I would tear you limb from limb!

Go now... kill me or leave me to mourn alone, $r.

text.title: 慢着！
text.objectives: 苏度可汗要你在长矛谷中杀死10名玛洛迪虐待者。$b$b你可以在他们的尸体上搜寻关于柯尔拉下落的线索。
text.description: <在你描述恶魔的威胁以及力普拉可汗的梦境时，吉尔吉斯可汗用空洞的眼神盯着你。>$b$b我已经不关心凄凉之地会变成什么样子了。我令氏族和先祖蒙羞……$b$b这世上只剩一件事能告慰我这苍老的灵魂，而她可能也已经不复存在了。$b$b玛洛迪氏族掳走了我的女儿柯尔拉。如果你能将她活着带回来，我就考虑接受你的提议。
text.completion: As you slaughter their enemy, the Gelkis clan cannot help but to acknowledge your prowess.

english.title: Not So Fast!
english.objectives: Khan Shodo wants you to kill 10 Maraudine Maulers in the Valley of Spears.$b$bYou are to search their corpses for clues to Kherrah's whereabouts.
english.description: <The Khan of the Gelkis clan stares at you with an empty gaze as you detail the demon threat and Leh'prah's visions.>$b$bIt matters not to me what becomes of this land now. I have failed my clan and my forefathers....$b$bThere is but one thing left in this world that might bring my old soul hope, and she's likely dead as well.$b$bMy precious daughter, Kherrah, was taken from me by the Maraudine clan. If you can bring her back to me alive, I shall consider your proposal.
english.completion: As you slaughter their enemy, the Gelkis clan cannot help but to acknowledge your prowess.

text.title: 被囚的公主
text.objectives: 进入玛拉顿，寻找柯尔拉。
text.description: 你查到了苏度可汗的女儿柯尔拉的下落。她被关押在玛拉顿！$b$b营救行动是有风险的，但是如果想与吉尔吉斯氏族达成同盟，就必须救出可汗的女儿。
text.completion: Is it safe for me to leave, $r?

english.title: Behind Closed Doors
english.objectives: You are to find Kherrah somewhere behind the doors to Maraudon.
english.description: You've discovered the location of Khan Shodo's daughter, Kherrah. She is being held behind the doors to Maraudon!$b$bThe rescue attempt is certain to be risky, but if you seek the Gelkis clan's cooperation, you must free the Khan's daughter.
english.completion: Is it safe for me to leave, $r?

text.title: 化敌为友
text.objectives: 柯尔拉要你跟力普拉可汗谈一谈。
text.description: <柯尔拉听你讲述最近发生的事件。>$b$b我同意科卡尔可汗的话。氏族世代的仇恨应该划上句号了。恶魔的威胁才促使半人马齐心一致，这真是莫大的耻辱。$b$b我会回去说服父王，让他答应与你们结盟。相信我，他会听我的。$b$b请转告力普拉可汗，吉尔吉斯氏族随时听候调遣。
text.completion:
You have done well, $r.

And not a moment too soon...

english.title: Time For Change
english.objectives: Kherrah wants you to speak with Khan Leh'prah.
english.description: <Kherrah listens to you as you explain recent events.>$b$bI agree with the words of the Kolkar Khan. The time for ancient grudges is over. It is a shame that it has taken a demonic crisis to unite the tribes.$b$bI shall return to my father and convince him to join your cause. You have my word that he will comply.$b$bReturn to Khan Leh'prah and inform him that the Gelkis will be ready when called upon.
english.completion:
You have done well, $r.

And not a moment too soon...

text.title: 你既然来了
text.objectives: 搜寻长矛谷，找到6件被亵渎的圣物。
text.description: 玛洛迪氏族骚扰吉尔吉斯营地已经好些年了，这些强盗什么都偷。$b$b他们最喜欢做的一件事就是亵渎偷来的吉尔吉斯圣物。$b$b如果你能找到并摧毁这些被亵渎的古器，吉尔吉斯氏族肯定会非常感激。
text.completion:
The destruction of those defiled relics will ease the minds of the Gelkis, and will strengthen their resolve.

You have done well.

english.title: While You're Here
english.objectives: You are to scour the Valley of Spears to find 6 Defiled Relics.
english.description: The Maraudine have raided the Gelkis camps for many years, stealing anything they could get their hands on.$b$bOne of their favorite torments is to take these relics of power which the Gelkis hold sacred, and bring them here to be defiled.$b$bThe Gelkis clan would certainly be grateful if you were to find and destroy these defiled artifacts.
english.completion:
The destruction of those defiled relics will ease the minds of the Gelkis, and will strengthen their resolve.

You have done well.

text.title: 肥肠
text.objectives: 麦拉斯要你去杀掉肥肠。
text.description: 啊嘿，伙计！$b$b你觉得你能给村子出点力吗？$b$b我们能对付大多数的鲸鱼，可有一条特别大的，矛叉不进。$b$b肥肠把我们赖以生存的鱼都吃光了，变得越来越大！$b$b去找到那畜生，看它还敢贪嘴！
text.completion:
Oy, mon! Ya did it!

We soon be havin' fish to eat, thanks be to you.

english.title: Blubbergut
english.objectives: Mai'Lahii wants you to kill Blubbergut.
english.description: Ahoy, mon!$b$bYou think you be able ta do something for da village here?$b$bMost whales we can handle fine, but there be a special whale out there that be too big for our spears.$b$bBlubbergut been gettin' bigger an' bigger - eatin' up the fish we use to live on!$b$bGet out there and find the thing, then make him pay for his gluttony!
english.completion:
Oy, mon! Ya did it!

We soon be havin' fish to eat, thanks be to you.

text.title: 插足
text.objectives: 杀死5名枯钳龙虾人和5名枯钳巨螯龙虾人。
text.description: 你显然也注意到了，大地最近的变化有其副作用。有些是有益的，而有些则产生了严重的问题。$b$b南边本地的龙虾人从海里走了上来，挡住了通往村子的道路。$b$b拜托你，$c，消灭掉一点这些害虫。
text.completion: On behalf of us all at Shadowprey Village, I thank you, $r.

english.title: Chipping In
english.objectives: Kill 5 Drysnap Crawlers and 5 Drysnap Pincers.
english.description: As you have no doubt noticed by now, the recent changes to the land have had many side-effects. Some of these are beneficial, while others pose serious problems.$b$bJust south of the village the local lobstrok are emerging from the sea and choking off the road to the village.$b$bPlease, $c, go and thin the numbers of this pest.
english.completion: On behalf of us all at Shadowprey Village, I thank you, $r.

text.title: 猎物还是猎人
text.objectives: 跟暮湾镇外的利亚姆·格雷迈恩王子谈一谈。
text.description: 一直以来，礁石群都让我们远离来自海岸的骚扰。但是地震为被遗忘者的舰队开辟出一条通道。$B$B快，$n。在我和其他士兵备战的同时，希望你可以减缓敌人前进的步伐。$B$B前方已经传来了王子与被遗忘者激战的声音。跟利亚姆谈一谈，看看你能不能帮得上忙。$B$B对了……请保护王子。我总觉得他最近有点莽撞。
text.completion: $N!!!  You ARE alive!$B$BI thought I was having dreams about the old days when I heard your voice...

english.title: Kill or Be Killed
english.objectives: Speak to Prince Liam Greymane outside of Duskhaven.
english.description: The reefs have always protected us from a coastal attack.  The earthquakes must've opened a passage for the Forsaken ships.$B$BQuick, $n.  Slow down the attackers while I get the rest of the militia ready.$B$BI think I can hear the Prince and some of our men engaging the Forsaken even as we speak.  Speak to Liam and see how you can be of use.$B$BOh... and make sure he doesn't get himself killed.  I'm afraid he might be a little reckless in his current state.
english.completion: $N!!!  You ARE alive!$B$BI thought I was having dreams about the old days when I heard your voice...

text.title: 葬影村
text.objectives: 卡隆·沼织要你去跟麦拉斯谈一谈。
text.description: 又见面了，$c。$b$b我最近收到消息说，葬影村需要援助。我们手头实在是紧，所以我把你叫来帮助他们。$b$b村子就在海岸的西南方。你到了以后，去找一个叫麦拉斯的人。
text.completion:
Welcome to Shadowprey Village, $r.

I was not sure the Cenarion Circle would send anyone.

english.title: Shadowprey Village
english.objectives: Karnum Marshweaver wants you to speak with Mai'Lahii.
english.description: Hello again, $c.$b$bI have received news that Shadowprey Village is in need of some assistance. Our hands are more than full here, so I must call upon you to travel there and be of assistance to them.$b$bThe village lies on the coast to the southwest of here. When you arrive, seek out the one named Mai'Lahii.
english.completion:
Welcome to Shadowprey Village, $r.

I was not sure the Cenarion Circle would send anyone.

text.title: 幽灵岗哨
text.objectives: 卡隆·沼织要你去跟玛乌林·碎骨谈一谈。
text.description: 你好，$c。$b$b看见你还在喘气可真好。我召唤你效力的时候到了。$b$b这片林地的西南就是幽灵岗哨，你在那里可以找到一个叫做玛乌林·碎骨的被遗忘者。$b$b他或许有办法，可以解决我们这里所要面对的众多问题之一。$b$b跟他谈一谈，看你能帮什么忙。
text.completion:
Greetings, $c.

It is good that you have finally arrived...

english.title: Ghost Walker Post
english.objectives: Karnum Marshweaver wants you to speak with Maurin Bonesplitter.
english.description: Greetings, $c.$b$bIt is good to see that you still draw breath. The time has come for me to call upon your services.$b$bJust southwest of this glade stands Ghost Walker Post. There you will find a forsaken by the name of Maurin Bonesplitter.$b$bHe may have a solution for one of the problems we face here.$b$bSpeak with him and do what you can to assist him.
english.completion:
Greetings, $c.

It is good that you have finally arrived...

text.title: 发射装置
text.objectives: 玛乌林·碎骨要你从濒死的科多兽身上收集3个中空的科多兽角。
text.description: 命运使然，这里有件特殊的使命要完成——一件能让塞纳里奥议会和我都有所得益的事情。$b$b你瞧，$c，我要制作一种特别的，这么说吧……药剂，压力不小。我相信我的工作就要完成了，但是我得经过试验才能确定。$b$b试验的目标就是西边威胁着这一地区的纳迦。他们的消失对议会来说显然是求之不得的好事。$b$b不过首先，我需要一个发射装置。濒死的科多兽身上那种中空的角就很不错。
text.progress: Back so soon, $c?
text.completion:
Yes, yes.

These will do nicely...

english.title: Delivery Device
english.objectives: Maurin Bonesplitter wants you to collect 3 Hollow Kodo Horns from Dying Kodo.
english.description: As fate would have it, there's a special deed that needs doing - one that will benefit the Cenarion Circle as well as myself.$b$bYou see, $c, I am under pressure to create a special... concoction, shall we say. I believe my work to be complete, but I need to have it tested to be certain.$b$bThe target of this test is to be the naga, who threaten this region from the west. Their demise would surely aid the Circle.$b$bFirst though, I need a delivery device. Hollow horns from the dying kodo should do nicely.
english.progress: Back so soon, $c?
english.completion:
Yes, yes.

These will do nicely...

text.title: 打扮整齐
text.objectives: 戴上你的新法师帽，同北方火箭车换乘站东北面大法师克希雷姆的影像交谈。
text.description: 吃一堑长一智吧。$B$B给，拿上我的法师帽。我敢说只要你看起来像那么回事，他没准真会收你为徒……当然你要先跳跳那些火圈，小火圈，底下还有尖刺，另一头是滚刀片儿。$B$B东北方向的那座山上你应该就能找到克希雷姆的影像了。
text.end: 戴着法师帽接近大法师克希雷姆。

english.title: Dressed to Impress
english.objectives: Put on your new wizard hat and then speak to the Image of Archmage Xylem just northeast of the Northern Rocketway Exchange.
english.description: Every man's got to learn his own lessons I suppose.$B$BHere, take my wizard hat. I have no doubt that he'll take you on as an apprentice if you look the role... you just might have to jump through some hoops first. Tiny flaming hoops, suspended over spikes, with spinning blades on the other side.$B$BYou should be able to find an image of Xylem on top of that hill to the northeast.
english.end: Approach Archmage Xylem while wearing your Wizard Hat

enders.name: 大法师克希雷姆的影像

text.title: 斯米德的挽具
text.objectives: 幽灵岗哨的纳塔卡要你将斯米德的挽具交给斯米德。
text.description: 请原谅，年轻的$r。$b$b我需要一点帮助。我刚完成了一份挽具的订单，需要马上送出去。$b$b我也老了，走不了这么远，尤其考虑到最近事态又变得这么危险。$b$b你能帮帮忙吗？$b$b请把它们送给斯米德，那个地精就住在东南边。
text.completion:
Ahh, my harnesses!

Thanks, friend!

english.title: Smeed's Harnesses
english.objectives: Nataka at Ghost Walker Post wants you to deliver Smeed's Harnesses to Smeed.
english.description: Pardon me, young $r.$b$bI'm in need of a little help. I've just finished filling an order for harnesses that must be delivered right away.$b$bI'm a bit old for the trip, especially considering how dangerous things have become lately.$b$bWould you mind?$b$bThey need to go to Smeed, a goblin who lives just southeast of here.
english.completion:
Ahh, my harnesses!

Thanks, friend!

text.title: 地狱火入侵
text.objectives: 费古尔·双刃要你消灭10名次级地狱火。
text.description: 恶魔开始行动了，$r！不做些什么的话，我们不出一星期就会被包围。我刚从玛诺洛克集会所过来，地狱火在那里从天而降！$b$b我们至少要给自己争取一点时间。去那儿把我没完成的事情做完！
text.completion:
Well done, $r!

The danger persists, but you have bought us some time.

english.title: Infernal Encroachment
english.objectives: Felgur Twocuts wants you to destroy 10 Lesser Infernals.
english.description: The demons are on the move, $r!$b$bIf nothing is done, we'll be overrun in a matter of weeks. I've just returned from Mannoroc Coven, where the infernals there are falling from the sky!$b$bWe need to at least buy ourselves some time. Get down there and pick up where I left off!
english.completion:
Well done, $r!

The danger persists, but you have bought us some time.

text.title: 玛乌林的调和物
text.objectives: 玛乌林要你将玛乌林的调和物交给卡隆林地的卡隆。
text.description: <玛乌林小心地将调和物封在中空的科多兽角里。>$b$b给你，$c。$b$b把这些交给卡隆。现在他想怎么用这些对付纳迦就怎么用。$b$b我会进行观察，好对配方的效果做一番评估！
text.completion: I hate to use such unnatural measures, but I fear we simply have no choice...

english.title: Maurin's Concoction
english.objectives: Maurin wants you to deliver Maurin's Concoction to Karnum at Karnum's Grove.
english.description: <Maurin carefully seals his concoction into the hollow kodo horns.>$b$bHere you are, $c.$b$bBring these to Karnum. It's up to him how he wants to use them on the naga. $b$bI'll be watching to gauge the effectiveness of my formula!
english.completion: I hate to use such unnatural measures, but I fear we simply have no choice...

text.title: 祖格卡的垮台
text.objectives: 你要在祖格卡的祭坛使用地狱动力核心控制魔王阿兹雷索克，用它的力量消灭祖格卡。
text.description: 你辨认出来，这是一个被召唤的恶魔的精华。$b$b难以理解的危险能量在它的表面吐纳。$b$b你瞧着它，脑子里出现了一幅影像——你自己控制着恶魔的影像。一想象要使用这样的力量，激动之情就掠过你的全身。$b$b你四下看了看，试图找到能够用来对付这名恶魔敌人的宝贝……
text.completion:
You should be proud of how you manipulated the enemy's power and used it against them.

You've dealt the demons of Mannoroc a severe blow...

english.title: Jugkar's Undoing
english.objectives: You are to use the Infernal Power Core to take control of Lord Azrethoc at Jugkar's Altar, and use its powers to slay Jugkar Grim'rod.
english.description: You recognize this as the essence of a summoned demon.$b$bDangerous and rarely understood energies weave in and out of its surface.$b$bAs you gaze upon it, a vision fills your mind - an image of yourself controlling demonic minions. A rush of excitement flows through you as you imagine wielding such power.$b$bLooking at your surroundings, you wonder how this treasure might be used against this demonic enemy....
english.completion:
You should be proud of how you manipulated the enemy's power and used it against them.

You've dealt the demons of Mannoroc a severe blow...

text.title: 被淘汰者
text.objectives: 同北方火箭车换乘站的索纳塔·火舞交谈
text.description: 爽啊！$B$B小艾常说要弄点儿神器来，说他打算和那个大法师什么的交朋友。克希雷姆！$B$B克希雷姆有好多学徒。他什么人都要，然后让他们往死里干，接着就撒手不管了。员工流失率很高。$B$B昨晚就有一个。朝西边，地精大塔一样的东西那儿去了。莫不成他可以帮你引见克希雷姆？莫不成克希雷姆知道小艾在哪儿？$B$B加勒个油啊！

english.title: Wash Out
english.objectives: Speak to Sorata Firespinner at the Northern Rocketway Exchange.
english.description: Delicious!$B$BAzy always trying to get his hands on magic artifacts. Said he was trying to make friends with that archmage person. Xylem!$B$BXylem has LOTS of apprentices. Takes in all kinds, burns'm out, leaves them wandering all over. High turnover.$B$BLast one was last night. Headed over towards that big goblin tower construction thing, way west. Maybe he'll help you meet Xylem? Maybe Xylem knows where Azy is?$B$BPlay nice!

text.title: 清理我们的裂口
text.objectives: 卡隆·沼织要你使用玛乌林的调和物杀死10名滑刃入侵者和10名滑刃海妖，以及3名海洋巨人。
text.description: 你当然也知道，$n，这一地区的纳迦依然是个严重的威胁。是该把他们赶回大海的时候了！$b$b你准备好了之后，恐羽就会将你带往裂口，他们在正那里准备一次强烈的进攻。$b$b在他们身上使用玛乌林的调和物，给他们一次难忘的教训。
text.completion:
Your deeds continue to impress me, $N.

Please accept this gift on behalf of the Cenarion Circle.

english.title: Cleansing Our Crevasse
english.objectives: Karnum Marshweaver wants you to use Maurin's Concoction to kill 10 Slitherblade Invaders, 10 Slitherblade Sirens, and 3 Sea Giants.
english.description: As you of course know, $n, the naga remain a serious threat to the region. The time has come for us to drive them back into the sea!$b$bWhen you are ready, Grimfeather will take you to the crevasse where they are preparing a violent assault. Once there, use Maurin's Concoction to teach them a lesson they shall not soon forget.
english.completion:
Your deeds continue to impress me, $N.

Please accept this gift on behalf of the Cenarion Circle.

text.title: 坚守阵地
text.objectives: 击败10名入侵的被遗忘者。
text.description: $n！我真的搞不清楚你究竟是活着还是死了……是人类还是狼人……$B$B我甚至不确定自己是不是在做梦。我只能肯定一件事……$B$B那就是，我们要将这些入侵的被遗忘者赶出我们的国土！
text.completion: Yes, $N!  Just like old times...$B$BI'm going to have to work hard at not shooting you, but Krennan explained everything to us.

english.title: Hold the Line
english.objectives: Kill 10 Forsaken Invaders.
english.description: $n!  I'm still not sure if you're alive or dead... human or worgen...$B$BI'm not even sure if I'm really awake.  But THIS I am sure of...$B$BWe're going to kill a great many of these motherless Forsaken.
english.completion: Yes, $N!  Just like old times...$B$BI'm going to have to work hard at not shooting you, but Krennan explained everything to us.

text.title: 合作
text.objectives: 使用黑色火药桶炸死4只恐怖憎恶。
text.description: $n，瞧。那些死胖子——憎恶，他们很难对付，所以你最好别招惹他们。$B$B但我有一个疯狂的点子，说不定会派上用场。但是一旦处理失当，也可能会要了你的性命。$B$B小屋和风车旁散落着不少火药桶。拎起火药桶，朝憎恶的脑袋抛过去。接下来就交给我手中这柄老霰弹枪吧。
text.completion: You and me, $N.  We make a great team...$B$BIt's good to have you back.

english.title: You Can't Take 'Em Alone
english.objectives: Use the Black Gunpowder Kegs to blow up 4 Horrid Abominations.
english.description: Look here, $n.  The big fat ones -- abominations, they're called -- they don't go down easy, so don't tackle them on your own.$B$BBut I have an idea so crazy it might just work.  Or it might get you killed, if we're not careful, I suppose.$B$BThere's barrels of gunpowder beneath the sheds and by the windmills.  Grab them and toss 'em right on the abominations' heads.  I'll take care of the rest with this trusty old blunderbuss.
english.completion: You and me, $N.  We make a great team...$B$BIt's good to have you back.

text.title: The Call to Command
text.objectives: Travel to the Undercity and speak with Lady Sylvanas Windrunner.
text.description: The order has come down, $c. Sylvanas herself has requested that I send my most 'capable' agents back to the Undercity for a highly sensitive tactical operation.$B$BUnfortunately, my most capable agents were killed over three years ago. In their stead I have a collection of brain dead riff-raff.$B$B<Nathanos stares coldly at you.>$B$BTravel to the Undercity at once and report to the Dark Lady. Do not embarrass me, $c!

english.title: The Call to Command
english.objectives: Travel to the Undercity and speak with Lady Sylvanas Windrunner.
english.description: The order has come down, $c. Sylvanas herself has requested that I send my most 'capable' agents back to the Undercity for a highly sensitive tactical operation.$B$BUnfortunately, my most capable agents were killed over three years ago. In their stead I have a collection of brain dead riff-raff.$B$B<Nathanos stares coldly at you.>$B$BTravel to the Undercity at once and report to the Dark Lady. Do not embarrass me, $c!

text.title: The Crimson Courier
text.objectives: Return to Eastern Plaguelands and track down the Crimson Courier. Kill the Courier and recover the Grand Crusader's Command.$B$BTake the command to Nathanos Blightcaller for further instruction.
text.description: We cannot attack the Scarlet Crusade's command directly; they are too well defended. But there's more than one way to skin a cat. They'll be nothing without their main force.$B$BThe Deathstalkers have been collecting data on the activity of the Crusade outside of Stratholme. Each day, a report is sent from their central command to Tyr's Hand. This report is the key, $r! Find the Crimson Courier and recover that report. Bring it to Nathanos.
text.completed: Return to Nathanos Blightcaller at Morris Stead in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: The Crimson Courier
english.objectives: Return to Eastern Plaguelands and track down the Crimson Courier. Kill the Courier and recover the Grand Crusader's Command.$B$BTake the command to Nathanos Blightcaller for further instruction.

They'll be nothing without their main force.$B$BThe Deathstalkers have been collecting data on the activity of the Crusade outside of Stratholme. Each day, a report is sent from their central command to Tyr's Hand. This report is the key, $r! Find the Crimson Courier and recover that report. Bring it to Nathanos.
english.completed: Return to Nathanos Blightcaller at Morris Stead in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: [DEPRECATED] Battle of Hillsbrad
text.objectives: Take Darthalia's Sealed Commendation to Bragor Bloodfist in the Undercity.
text.description: Because you fought with such valor and perseverance in the Battle of Hillsbrad, I have written this commendation, extolling your heroics in combat for the high command to recognize.$b$bTake this sealed commendation to Bragor Bloodfist in the Undercity.  Go with pride, $c.
text.completed: Return to Bragor Bloodfist at Lordamere Lake in Silverpine Forest.

english.title: [DEPRECATED] Battle of Hillsbrad
english.objectives: Take Darthalia's Sealed Commendation to Bragor Bloodfist in the Undercity.
english.description: Because you fought with such valor and perseverance in the Battle of Hillsbrad, I have written this commendation, extolling your heroics in combat for the high command to recognize.$b$bTake this sealed commendation to Bragor Bloodfist in the Undercity.  Go with pride, $c.
english.completed: Return to Bragor Bloodfist at Lordamere Lake in Silverpine Forest.

text.title: An Unholy Alliance
text.objectives: Take the Small Scroll to Bragor Bloodfist in the Undercity.
text.description: My Lady,$B$BYou know very well what it is we are offering. The opportunity for you to take the Barrens and the lands beyond is a great one. We simply want your aid in return. By aid we mean nothing more than your giving us the freedom to take action in the area.$B$BPlease, allow us to discuss this further. We have great power and are willing to share with those wise enough to join us. I will remain outside Razorfen Downs for the time being.$B$BBest Regards,$BAmbassador Malcin
text.completed: Return to Bragor Bloodfist at Lordamere Lake in Silverpine Forest.

english.objectives: Take the Small Scroll to Bragor Bloodfist in the Undercity.
english.description: My Lady,$B$BYou know very well what it is we are offering. The opportunity for you to take the Barrens and the lands beyond is a great one. We simply want your aid in return. By aid we mean nothing more than your giving us the freedom to take action in the area.$B$BPlease, allow us to discuss this further. We have great power and are willing to share with those wise enough to join us. I will remain outside Razorfen Downs for the time being.$B$BBest Regards,$BAmbassador Malcin
english.completed: Return to Bragor Bloodfist at Lordamere Lake in Silverpine Forest.

text.title: An Unholy Alliance
text.objectives: Bring Ambassador Malcin's Head to Bragor Bloodfist in the Undercity.
text.description: Supposedly this Malcin is outside Razorfen Downs. There's no question - he has to die.$b$bMy contacts in Orgrimmar tell me their scouts have found signs of the Plague down there. The quilboar are showing signs of being plagued, too; they're much more powerful. Whatever the Scourge are doing down there needs to end. Now.$b$bFind this Malcin and kill him. Report back here when he's dead.
text.completed: Return to Bragor Bloodfist at the Royal Quarter in the Undercity.

english.objectives: Bring Ambassador Malcin's Head to Bragor Bloodfist in the Undercity.

Report back here when he's dead.
english.completed: Return to Bragor Bloodfist at the Royal Quarter in the Undercity.

text.title: 艾露恩的礼物
text.objectives: 造访萨格隆的艾露恩的遗迹。
text.description: 简直难以忍受！$b$b萨特亵渎了神圣的土地……$b$b我向你保证，他们没几天可活了。一旦凑够人手，我就会率军发动攻击，杀光这些邪恶的生物。$b$b但是现在，或许你能帮我舒缓一下紧张愤怒的情绪？$b$b前往东边的萨格隆，搜查那片废墟，确保艾露恩的遗迹完好无损。$b$b我会付给你应得的酬劳的。
text.completion:
The relics are intact! Well, indeed, that is something.

You have put my mind at ease, $r. Please accept this as my gift to you.

english.title: Elune's Gifts
english.objectives: Visit Elune's Relics in Sargeron.
english.description: Simply intolerable!$b$bSatyrs of all things, desecrating our sacred lands...$b$bTheir days are numbered, $r. I can assure you of that. As soon as we have the numbers, I shall lead a charge that will rid this land of the wicked creatures.$b$bFor now, though, perhaps you could put my mind at ease?$b$bTravel just east of here to Sargeron and scour the ruins. Find the relics of Elune and ensure that they are in good condition.$b$bI'll pay you well for this favor.
english.completion:
The relics are intact! Well, indeed, that is something.

You have put my mind at ease, $r. Please accept this as my gift to you.

text.title: Into The Scarlet Monastery
text.objectives: Kill High Inquisitor Whitemane, Scarlet Commander Mograine, Herod, the Scarlet Champion and Houndmaster Loksey and then report back to Bragor Bloodfist in the Undercity.
text.description: One of my duties while I'm stationed here is to help the Forsaken take care of their borders, and that, $c, is exactly what you're going to do for me.$b$bI might live and breathe, but the Scarlet Crusade will cut down my people as quickly as they will one of the undead. They're a problem here, a big one, and you're going to do something about it.$b$bGo to the Monastery and slay High Inquisitor Whitemane and her lieutenants.

english.title: Into The Scarlet Monastery
english.objectives: Kill High Inquisitor Whitemane, Scarlet Commander Mograine, Herod, the Scarlet Champion and Houndmaster Loksey and then report back to Bragor Bloodfist in the Undercity.
english.description: One of my duties while I'm stationed here is to help the Forsaken take care of their borders, and that, $c, is exactly what you're going to do for me.$b$bI might live and breathe, but the Scarlet Crusade will cut down my people as quickly as they will one of the undead. They're a problem here, a big one, and you're going to do something about it.$b$bGo to the Monastery and slay High Inquisitor Whitemane and her lieutenants.

text.title: The Power to Destroy...
text.objectives: Bring the books Spells of Shadow and Incantations from the Nether to Bragor Bloodfist in Undercity.
text.description: Listen up, $c.$b$bYou may not know this, but Orgrimmar's got a problem. Deep in Ragefire Chasm, a sect of the Shadow Council called the Searing Blade performs their sinister work. They're mainly orcs, and I can't trust sensitive information in the hands of the grunts there. That's where you come in.$b$bThey should have two books in their possession. I want them kept out of the hands of the Searing Blade and the Forsaken alike. Bring them to me directly.
text.progress: There are a hundred other tasks awaiting my attention, $C. Do you have the books?
text.completion: Good, $C. You have done well in serving the Dark Lady. Your continued perseverance and ambition will be of great use to the Lady's subjects. Return to me again in the future. Perhaps I will have other tasks for you that will aid the Dark Lady in her attempts at overtaking the Lich King and completely freeing the Scourge.
