text.title: 净化军刀！
text.objectives: 从武器架以及各种萨特身上收集20把萨特军刀。
text.description: 艾露恩的侍女像！它比传闻中描述的更加光彩夺目。$b$b当你靠近它时，脑海中浮现出关于这件古器的传说：$b$b在上古时期，战争结束后，敌人的武器会被抛入火盆以完成净化。$b$b你想象着仪式的场景，突然间，附近武器架上的金属闪光吸引了你的注意……
text.completion:
With the ritual completed, you are awarded a divine gift.

You can't help but to feel a great sense of honor as you receive one of Elune's boons.
text.end: 已完成艾露恩的战争仪式
text.completed: 将萨特军刀放在凄凉之地萨格隆的艾露恩侍女雕像上。

english.title: To the Hilt!
english.objectives: Collect 20 Satyr Sabers from the weapon racks and various satyrs in the region.
english.description: The handmaiden of Elune! It's even more glorious than the stories tell.$b$bThe legends surrounding this relic come to your mind as you draw near it:$b$bIn ancient time, after battle, the enemies' weapons were to be cast upon the basin in exchange for a divine gift of some sort.$b$bAs you ponder this ritual, the glint of steel catches your eye from a nearby weapon rack....
english.completion:
With the ritual completed, you are awarded a divine gift.

You can't help but to feel a great sense of honor as you receive one of Elune's boons.
english.completed: Place the Satyr Sabers upon the statue of Elune's Handmaiden at Sargeron in Desolace.

text.title: 十枚魔印
text.objectives: 从萨格隆的各种萨特身上收集10枚萨特魔印。
text.description: 远古的传说指出，这只古老的火盆是用来执行献祭仪式的。$b$b你只记得传闻的只言片语，据说如果有人剐下月神的敌人的血肉，并将其放入火盆燃烧的余烬，那么这个人将得到祝福。$b$b环视四周，你觉得盘踞在此地的萨特就是完美的祭品。
text.completion: The divine brazier graciously endows you with a blessing.

english.title: Ten Pounds of Flesh
english.objectives: Collect 10 pieces of Satyr Flesh from the various satyrs in Sargeron.
english.description: According to ancient legend, this ancient brazier was placed here for the performing of sacrifices.$b$bFrom what little you remember of the stories, a blessing is bestowed upon the being who places the flesh of Elune's enemies on the brazier's burning embers.$b$bLooking around, you determine that the satyrs who now possess this region would likely qualify.
english.completion: The divine brazier graciously endows you with a blessing.

text.title: 来自上天的恩赐
text.objectives: 从萨格隆的各种萨特身上收集10枚萨特魔印，将它们放在艾露恩的火盆上。
text.description: 你接受了来自古器的赐福，感觉自己与上古时代的世界产生了强烈的羁绊。$b$b你决定尽可能地利用这神圣的礼物。
text.completion: The divine brazier graciously endows you with a blessing.

english.title: Blessings From Above
english.objectives: You are to collect 10 pieces of Satyr Flesh from the various Satyrs in Sargeron, and place them on Elune's Brazier.
english.description: You feel a deep connection to the distant past having partaken of the ancient blessing granted by this relic.$b$bYou determine to make as much as you can of this divine gift.
english.completion: The divine brazier graciously endows you with a blessing.

text.title: 没什么是几颗瓜解决不了的
text.objectives: 收集8枚瓜果，将它们的汁水挤到萨格隆的艾露恩之杯中去。
text.description: 萨格隆废墟上的标记，以及从弗瑞恩的文字里收集的点滴资料，让你明白了一件事：$b$b艾露恩庇护所的旧喷泉有什么蹊跷。$b$b看样子，如果用泉水洗脸的话，人们就能获得特殊的力量。当然，首先，远古喷泉里得有某样用来洗的东西才行。$b$b你正在思忖着，突然在附近的大树脚下发现了一颗瓜果……
text.completion:
After filling it with liquid from the melons, you proceed to wash your eyes from the ancient font.

Upon opening your eyes, you are able to see the spirits of ancient elves, still faithfully carrying out rituals to their goddess.

You ponder the significance of this revelation and determine to study Furien's research for more clues...

english.title: Nothing a Couple of Melons Won't Fix
english.objectives: You must gather 8 Melonfruit and squeeze their juices into the Cup of Elune at Sargeron.
english.description: The markings on the Sargeron ruins, combined with what you've gleaned from Furien's text make one thing clear:$b$bThere is something special about the old fountain in the Sanctuary of Elune.$b$bIt would seem that one could expect special power from washing their face in the fountain. First, of course, there would need to be something in the ancient fountain with which to wash.$b$bPondering this problem, you spot a melonfruit at the base of a nearby tree....
english.completion:
After filling it with liquid from the melons, you proceed to wash your eyes from the ancient font.

Upon opening your eyes, you are able to see the spirits of ancient elves, still faithfully carrying out rituals to their goddess.

You ponder the significance of this revelation and determine to study Furien's research for more clues...

text.title: 心平气和
text.objectives: 杀死科霍。
text.description: 前哨站肩负着监视潜在的敌对势力的重任。一旦联盟对凄凉之地发动攻击，我们的工作可以确保这项行动不受干扰。$b$b最近，一名侦察兵在西边的火刃氏族要塞不幸被捕，敌人残忍地杀害了他。从那之后，我们就不断遭到火刃兽人科霍的戏弄和攻击。$b$b他们的日子活不长了，但是我愿意花大价钱让科霍这个混蛋现在就去死！
text.completion:
It is done.

Captain Pentigast should be able to sleep in peace now that Kohor's threats have been silenced.

english.title: Peace of Mind
english.objectives: Kill Kohor.
english.description: We are a forward post, charged with monitoring potential adversaries. Once the Alliance launches its Desolace campaign, our work here will ensure that there are no surprises.$b$bRecently, one of our scouts was caught and sacrificed by the Burning Blade at their stronghold to the west. Since then, we've been assaulted with threats and taunts from a Burning Blade wretch named Kohor.$b$bTheir days here are numbered, but I will pay handsomely for that one to be silenced now!
english.completion:
It is done.

Captain Pentigast should be able to sleep in peace now that Kohor's threats have been silenced.

text.title: 火刃耳饰
text.objectives: 收集25个火刃耳饰。
text.description: 本迪加斯上尉对雷斧堡垒的火刃兽人恨之入骨。$b$b如果带回诛杀火刃兽人的证据，他应该会很满意吧。
text.progress: What have you there, $c?
text.completion:
Ears of the Burning Blade?

<Captain Pentigast smiles.>

Well done, $c. This is just a shadow of what will soon become of that vile cult!

english.title: Ears Are Burning
english.objectives: Collect 25 Burning Blade Ears.
english.description: Captain Pentigast has made no secret of his disdain for the Burning Blade at Thunder Axe Fortress.$b$bSurely, proof of their demise would be of value to him.
english.progress: What have you there, $c?
english.completion:
Ears of the Burning Blade?

<Captain Pentigast smiles.>

Well done, $c. This is just a shadow of what will soon become of that vile cult!

text.title: 眼见为实
text.objectives: 前往雷斧堡垒，寻找远古召唤仪式羊皮卷。
text.description: 科霍临死的时候提到，火刃氏族正在召唤一只足以威胁整个凄凉之地的恶魔。$b$b他的话或许有恫吓的成分，但是我们不能掉以轻心。$b$b这件事不能拖到联盟攻击凄凉之地时再解决。你必须调查雷斧堡垒，收集线索并终结这个可能的威胁。
text.progress: The Burning Blade must not be allowed to succeed with their plan!
text.completion:
It is most fortunate that you took the time to search for this.

No one would have expected the Burning Blade to be in possession of something so powerful!

english.title: You'll Know It When You See It
english.objectives: Find the Ancient Summoning Ritual in Thunder Axe Fortress.
english.description: With his dying breath, Kohor mentioned the summoning of a demon that could threaten the entire region.$b$bHe may have been bluffing, but that's not a chance worth taking.$b$bThis cannot wait for the Alliance's invasion of Desolace to take shape. You must scour Thunder Axe Fortress for clues and bring an end to this potential threat.
english.progress: The Burning Blade must not be allowed to succeed with their plan!
english.completion:
It is most fortunate that you took the time to search for this.

No one would have expected the Burning Blade to be in possession of something so powerful!

text.title: 收集徽记
text.objectives: 在雷斧堡垒收集100个褪色的徽记，将它们放入火刃召唤法阵，然后杀死纳扎尔贡。
text.description: 看来是真的……$b$b你在雷斧堡垒找到的羊皮纸上详细地记载着恶魔召唤仪式的步骤。它比火刃氏族掌握的所有召唤法阵还要强大。$b$b很明显，我们必须不惜代价破坏这个仪式！$b$b如果能提前将恶魔召唤出来，那么这场危机或许有化解的机会。
text.completion:
You diverted what would have been a serious crisis, $c.

If that summoning was delayed just a bit longer, the demon would have become far too powerful for our small forces here to contend with.

Please accept this gift as our thanks for your service.

english.title: Putting Their Heads Together
english.objectives: Collect 100 Bleached Skulls from Thunder Axe Fortress, then place them at the Burning Blade Summoning Circle, then kill Nazargen.
english.description: So it's true....$b$bThe parchment you discovered in Thunder Axe Fortress details a powerful summoning ritual. One stronger than the Burning Blade have ever been known to possess.$b$bClearly, this rite must be stopped at all costs!$b$bPerhaps if this demon were summoned forth prematurely the crisis could be averted.
english.completion:
You diverted what would have been a serious crisis, $c.

If that summoning was delayed just a bit longer, the demon would have become far too powerful for our small forces here to contend with.

Please accept this gift as our thanks for your service.

text.title: 艾瑟雷索
text.objectives: 麦尔金斯下士要你去艾瑟雷索跟库拉谈一谈。
text.description: 最近我们收到一份来自塞纳里奥议会研究员的求救。$b$b我们手上没有多余的人，所以我要你代表我们去拜访一下她。$b$b库拉的位置就在西边海岸上的艾瑟雷索高塔废墟附近。
text.completion:
It is good that you have come.

There is grave danger looming here.

english.title: Ethel Rethor
english.objectives: Corporal Melkins wants you to speak to Korrah at Ethel Rethor.
english.description: We have recently received a plea for help from a researcher of the Cenarion Circle.$b$bWe have no one we can spare to send, so I ask that you pay her a visit on our behalf.$b$bKorrah is posted near the ruined tower of Ethel Rethor, on the coast to the west.
english.completion:
It is good that you have come.

There is grave danger looming here.

text.title: 沉着迎敌
text.objectives: 跟暮湾镇的格温·阿姆斯特谈一谈。
text.description: $n，接下来的事情交给我们负责吧。向阿姆斯特镇长报到。$B$B我们所遭遇的不过是被遗忘者的一支小分队。如果不赶紧转移，麻烦就大了。$B$B前往敌人的登陆点，看看你能不能帮上什么忙。
text.completion: Great news, $N.  I've sent the remaining militia to the shore to meet the Forsaken force head on.

english.title: Holding Steady
english.objectives: Speak to Gwen Armstead in Duskhaven.
english.description: We can take it from here, $n.  Check in with Mayor Armstead.$B$BThese are only a small part of the Forsaken's forces.  If we don't move quickly we're going to have bigger problems on our hands.$B$BSee what you can do to engage the Forsaken army at their landing location.
english.completion: Great news, $N.  I've sent the remaining militia to the shore to meet the Forsaken force head on.

text.title: 艾伦农场的防风地窖
text.objectives: 进入吉尔尼斯艾伦农场的防风地窖，跟高弗雷勋爵谈一谈。
text.description: 高弗雷勋爵率军在被遗忘者的登陆点附近布防。看看你能不能帮助我们击退敌人。$B$B此地往西就是艾伦农场，听说高弗雷勋爵征用了那里的防风地窖。去找他吧。
text.completion: The Forsaken are here in full strength, $N.  We barely have enough men to hold them back.

english.title: The Allens' Storm Cellar
english.objectives: Speak to Lord Godfrey inside the storm cellar of the Allen Farmstead in Gilneas.
english.description: Lord Godfrey is leading the attack near the Forsaken's landing area.  See what you can do to help us keep the Forsaken back.$B$BI've been told Godfrey has commandeered the storm cellar in the Allen Farmstead, far to the west.  Seek him there.
english.completion: The Forsaken are here in full strength, $N.  We barely have enough men to hold them back.

text.title: 救救我的孩子！
text.objectives: 营救哈蒙德农场的辛西娅、阿什莉和詹姆斯。
text.description: 士兵们不允许我离开这里，但是我的孩子们还待在农场！求求你找到他们。$B$B被遗忘者根本没有怜悯之心……我的孩子们随时都有性命之忧！$B$B他们叫辛西娅、阿什莉和詹姆斯。请你将他们带回来。我会感激不尽的。
text.completion: My children are safe!  You've done a wonderful thing, $N.  I don't know how to thank you!

english.title: Save the Children!
english.objectives: Rescue Cynthia, Ashley and James in the Hammond Farmstead.
english.description: The military will not allow me outside the cellar, but my children are still in my farm!  Please, you must go find them.$B$BThe Forsaken have no regard for innocent life -- my kids are in great danger!$B$BTheir names are Cynthia, Ashley and James.  If you find them, bring them back here.  I'll be forever in your debt.
english.completion: My children are safe!  You've done a wonderful thing, $N.  I don't know how to thank you!

text.title: 释放兽性
text.objectives: 杀死8名被遗忘者步兵或是被遗忘者水手。
text.description: $n，我不想说谎。我不喜欢与狼人为伍。$B$B谁知道克雷南的药剂究竟能持续多久，到时候说不定你会咬下我们的脑袋。$B$B不过在那之前，我们可以好好利用你的野性。$B$B我要你前往战场奋力杀敌，消灭那些被遗忘者，尽可能地宣泄你的怒火。$B$B$n，让他们尝尝狼人的厉害吧。
text.completion: Not bad, $N.  It's a good thing you're on our side.

english.title: Unleash the Beast
english.objectives: Kill 8 Forsaken Footsoldiers or Sailors.
english.description: I'm not going to lie, $n.  I don't like the idea of having worgen among our ranks.$B$BWho knows how long 'til Krennan's concoction wears off and you're trying to chomp one of our heads off.$B$BUntil that time, however, we can make ample use of your ferocity.$B$BI want you to go out in the battlefield and kill as many of those Forsaken as you can, in as brutal a way as you can.$B$BWe're going to put the fear of the worgen in them, $n.
english.completion: Not bad, $N.  It's a good thing you're on our side.

objectiveDetails.description: 杀死被遗忘者战斗人员

text.title: 神秘的艾萨莱特水晶
text.objectives: 在附近的悬崖收集五份艾萨莱特水晶样本。
text.description: 艾萨莱特水晶！这一神秘的结晶物质一度用来铸炼邪能武器。可我们也发现它拥有高度聚能性。这是地精自发现卡亚矿石之后最伟大的新发现，足以载入史册。$B$B可它究竟从哪儿来？是什么？为什么偏偏在这儿才有？科研问题必须得有一个解！我需要更多的研究样本。去悬崖附近的艾萨莱特水晶矿脉多找找看。
text.progress: Have you got more samples? Careless adventurers have been looting this stuff for years - they don't know how precious it is!
text.completion: Ah, excellent. Some of these samples look fresh. I'm going to be up to my neck in this stuff trying to solve this mystery!

english.title: Mysterious Azsharite
english.objectives: Collect 5 Azsharite Samples from the nearby cliffs.
english.description: Azsharite! This mysterious crystalline substance has been used to forge weapons of fel power, but in our hands, we've discovered that it's capable of focusing enormous amounts of energy. It may be the biggest goblin discovery since kaja'mite.$B$BBut what is it? Where does it come from? Why is it located only here? Science demands an answer! I need more samples to study. Search out Azsharite deposits all along the nearby cliffs.
english.progress: Have you got more samples? Careless adventurers have been looting this stuff for years - they don't know how precious it is!
english.completion: Ah, excellent. Some of these samples look fresh. I'm going to be up to my neck in this stuff trying to solve this mystery!

text.title: 巨型茶点
text.objectives: 杀死雾翼崖居者，收集8具残缺的雾翼遗骸。
text.description: 你在悬崖边晃悠的时候或许能帮我找另一个调查切入点。巨人们从天地之初就徜徉在这些山崖上了。也许他们有艾萨莱特水晶的头绪？若能同巨人们打好交道那是最好。$B$B去为他们备份大餐以示诚意！杀掉那些滋扰我们研究的雾翼崖居者，把它们的尸首带来给我。
text.progress: I probably should've warned you that mistwing chimaeras can shoot lightning.
text.completion: Phew! The stench! Well, hopefully that massive heap of carcasses smells more appetizing to a giant.

english.title: A Gigantic Snack
english.objectives: Collect 8 Mutilated Mistwing Carcasses from Mistwing Cliffdwellers.
english.description: While you're here running around the cliffs, perhaps you can help me with another line of investigation. The giants who walk these cliffs have been here since these mountains formed. Maybe they know where the Azsharite comes from? It's in our best interest to befriend these giants and find out.$B$BGather up a gigantic meal for me as a peace offering! Kill the mistwing cliffdwellers that have been such a nuisance to our studies and collect their carcasses for me.
english.progress: I probably should've warned you that mistwing chimaeras can shoot lightning.
english.completion: Phew! The stench! Well, hopefully that massive heap of carcasses smells more appetizing to a giant.

text.title: Thargad's Camp
text.objectives: Karnum Marshweaver wants you to speak to Thargad.
text.description: It pleases me to see that you still draw breath, $c. I have been sent word that the demon activity in the south has been intensifying.$b$bThere is a camp on the borderlands there that is in danger of being cut off if the demons move northward.$b$bPerhaps you could lend them a hand?$b$bI know the leader of the camp there is Thargad. He will be able to direct you wisely.$b$bThank you, friend. Be well.
text.completion:
Demons?

Oh, there be lots I can tell yeh 'bout demons!

english.title: Thargad's Camp
english.objectives: Karnum Marshweaver wants you to speak to Thargad.
english.description: It pleases me to see that you still draw breath, $c. I have been sent word that the demon activity in the south has been intensifying.$b$bThere is a camp on the borderlands there that is in danger of being cut off if the demons move northward.$b$bPerhaps you could lend them a hand?$b$bI know the leader of the camp there is Thargad. He will be able to direct you wisely.$b$bThank you, friend. Be well.
english.completion:
Demons?

Oh, there be lots I can tell yeh 'bout demons!

text.title: 入侵的地狱火
text.objectives: 杀死10个次级地狱火。
text.description: 听着。你瞧。$b$b<萨加德指向东方。>$b$b看见那些从天而降的绿色大火球了吗？$b$b大批的恶魔源源不断地降落到陆地上，几乎没有遇到任何阻碍。嗯，也不完全是这样啦……至少我一直在努力，让这些家伙不至于太过嚣张。$b$b你能不能去那里帮我完成未竟的任务？
text.completion:
Well, lad!

Don't hesitate to knock a few more down for good measure!

english.title: Infernal Encroachment
english.objectives: Destroy 10 Lesser Infernals.
english.description: Listen up, now. An' lookie here.$b$b<Thargad points off to the east.>$b$bYeh see them big green glowin' balls that be fallin' from the sky?$b$bThose be a nasty buncha demons roamin' the lands unchecked. Well, almost unchecked... I've been keepin' 'em on their toes, givin' 'em sumthin' ta think about.$b$bHow 'bout you get over there an' pick up where I left off?
english.completion:
Well, lad!

Don't hesitate to knock a few more down for good measure!

text.title: 军团的传送门
text.objectives: 放逐玛诺洛克集会所的6扇传送门。
text.description: 就是这个——埃鲁索斯之手。$b$b我亲自从一个火刃首领那儿缴来的。$B$B厉害玩意！瞧，你对恶魔的传送门一用，它们就消失了！诡异的魔法，但如今局势紧迫……$b$b恶魔要按这个速度冲过来，我的营地眨眼就得被吞没。$b$b现在把它拿好，去放手干吧。
text.completion:
Aye, that'll buy us some time, $c.

Thank yeh.

english.title: Portals of the Legion
english.objectives: Banish 6 Portals at Mannoroc Coven.
english.description: Here it is - the Hand of Iruxos.$b$bGot it from one o' them Burning Blade leaders myself.$B$BPowerful thing! See, yeh use it on demon portals and they just disappear! Spooky magic, but these be desperate times...$b$bThe demons keep comin' at this rate, and my camp will get overrun before ya know it.$b$bHere ya go, now. Get on with it.
english.completion:
Aye, that'll buy us some time, $c.

Thank yeh.

text.title: 人性的最后希望
text.completion: I need you to pull through, $N.  This dosage is strong enough to kill a horse.$B$BBut I know you.  I know what you're made of.  You will be fine.$B$BTrust me.  I know what you're going through.$B$BNow drink up and close your eyes.

english.title: Last Chance at Humanity
english.completion: I need you to pull through, $N.  This dosage is strong enough to kill a horse.$B$BBut I know you.  I know what you're made of.  You will be fine.$B$BTrust me.  I know what you're going through.$B$BNow drink up and close your eyes.

text.title: 祖格卡的垮台
text.objectives: 你要在祖格卡的祭坛使用地狱动力核心控制魔王阿兹雷索克，用它的力量消灭祖格卡。
text.description: 你辨认出来，这是一个被召唤的恶魔的精华。$b$b难以理解的危险能量在它的表面吐纳。$b$b你瞧着它，脑子里出现了一幅影像——你自己控制着恶魔的影像。一想象要使用这样的力量，激动之情就掠过你的全身。$b$b你四下看了看，试图找到能够用来对付这名恶魔敌人的宝贝……
text.completion:
You should be proud of how you manipulated the enemy's power and used it against them.

You've dealt the demons of Mannoroc a severe blow...

english.title: Jugkar's Undoing
english.objectives: You are to use the Infernal Power Core to take control of Lord Azrethoc at Jugkar's Altar, and use its powers to slay Jugkar Grim'rod.
english.description: You recognize this as the essence of a summoned demon.$b$bDangerous and rarely understood energies weave in and out of its surface.$b$bAs you gaze upon it, a vision fills your mind - an image of yourself controlling demonic minions. A rush of excitement flows through you as you imagine wielding such power.$b$bLooking at your surroundings, you wonder how this treasure might be used against this demonic enemy....
english.completion:
You should be proud of how you manipulated the enemy's power and used it against them.

You've dealt the demons of Mannoroc a severe blow...

text.title: 亲近巨人
text.objectives: 同南部火箭车终点站外的格蒙刚交谈，找出艾萨莱特水晶的秘密
text.description: 初步研究表明，你带来的艾萨莱特水晶既非生物体，也不是自然形成。艾萨拉还有一种造物与其类似：那些悬崖上蹒跚的巨人。$B$B其中一个貌似愿意帮助我们进行研究。把你给格蒙刚的肉带上，他就在西边等着。好生款待——看看他是否知道艾萨莱特水晶的秘密！
text.completion: Speak slower - what are you saying? Am I hearing you right? Those formations of azsharite are actually where the giants have - oh my. Groady!! Let's not tell Dr. Grapplehammer, he's made this stuff his life's work.$B$BWell, at least now we know where azsharite comes from, and why it's so rare. We've got to figure out a way to speed up, uh, "production!"

english.title: Befriending Giants
english.objectives: Talk to Gormungan outside of the Southern Rocketway Terminus and discover the secret of azsharite.
english.description: A cursory study of the azsharite you brought me reveals that it's not biological in nature, nor is it naturally formed. There's another creature in Azshara with similar properties: the cliff giants that lumber around these cliffs.$B$BOne of the giants seems willing to help our research along. Take the meat you collected to Gormungan, the giant standing just west of here. Befriend him, then grill him - find out if he knows the secret of azsharite!
english.completion: Speak slower - what are you saying? Am I hearing you right? Those formations of azsharite are actually where the giants have - oh my. Groady!! Let's not tell Dr. Grapplehammer, he's made this stuff his life's work.$B$BWell, at least now we know where azsharite comes from, and why it's so rare. We've got to figure out a way to speed up, uh, "production!"

objectiveDetails.description: 发现艾萨莱特水晶的秘密

text.title: 诛杀布伦多
text.objectives: 找到布伦多的背包。
text.description: 我终日忙于收集古器，根本无暇料理其他事务，不过有件小事令我耿耿于怀。$b$b这阵子有个被遗忘者炼金师跑来这里偷东西。我通常都假装视而不见，但是他先后溜进来三次，偷走了不少补给品……我受够了！$b$b找到这名小偷，夺回我失窃的财物！
text.progress: Well, $c? Did yeh find the cretin?
text.completion:
Justice is done!

Now let's have a peek at what's left of my goods...

english.title: Hunting Brendol
english.objectives: Recover Brendol's Satchel.
english.description: I'm too busy collectin' artifacts to busy myself with much else, but there is a bit of an issue here I wouldn't mind sortin' out.$b$bThere's a forsaken apothecary who's been pokin' around these parts for a while now. Normally, I'd ignore him, but three times now he's snuck into my camp and pilfered my supplies.... enough's enough!$b$bFind the thief and bring me whatever's left o' my things!
english.progress: Well, $c? Did yeh find the cretin?
english.completion:
Justice is done!

Now let's have a peek at what's left of my goods...

text.title: 嫩虾尾！
text.objectives: 收集7条嫩虾尾。
text.description: 萨加德一心扑在泰坦古器的搜寻工作上。要不是我，他会忙得连饭都忘记吃了！$b$b说到饮食，我正想为他准备一顿特别的美餐——你愿意帮我吗？$b$b西边的海岸生活着一群龙虾。我可打不过它们，如果你能取回一些嫩虾尾的话，我就可以烹制一顿大餐！
text.progress: Were you able to collect some lobstrock tails, $r?
text.completion:
Ohhh, these will do nicely!

Thargad will be so surprised!

english.title: Rock Lobstrock!
english.objectives: Get 7 Tender Lobstrock Tails.
english.description: Thargad works practically nonstop chasing after ancient Titan relics. He stays so busy that if it weren't for me, he'd probably forget to eat!$b$bSpeaking of eating, I'd like to prepare him something special - perhaps you could help me out?$b$bLobstrock roam all over the coast to the west. I'd never last in a fight with them myself, but I could make a great meal if you were to bring me some of their tails!
english.progress: Were you able to collect some lobstrock tails, $r?
english.completion:
Ohhh, these will do nicely!

Thargad will be so surprised!

text.title: 令人瞩目的发现
text.objectives: 将神秘的调和物交给卡隆林地的卡隆。
text.description: <萨加德翻看着背包，拽出一件奇怪的东西。>$b$b咦，太奇怪了……这只中空的科多兽角里装有某种药水。$b$b<萨加德闻了闻药水。>$b$b哇！这肯定不是治病疗伤的药剂。它更像是一种……毒剂。$b$b赶紧把它交给卡隆吧，看看他有什么说法……
text.completion:
<Karnum examines the concoction.>

Yes, $c. Not only do I know what this is, I know just how you should use it...

english.title: An Impactful Discovery
english.objectives: Take the Mysterious Concoction to Karnum at Karnum's Glade.
english.description: <Thargad rummages through the satchel and pulls out a curious object.>$b$bWell now, this is odd... it's a hollow kodo horn with some sort of potion inside.$b$b<Thargad sniffs the potion.>$b$bWHEW! Definitely not any kind of healthy elixir. This mess is meant for one thing... killin'.$b$bHow 'bout yeh run it back up to Karnum and see if there's anything he can do with it...
english.completion:
<Karnum examines the concoction.>

Yes, $c. Not only do I know what this is, I know just how you should use it...

text.title: 清理我们的裂口
text.objectives: 使用玛乌林的调和物杀死10名滑刃入侵者和10名滑刃海妖，以及3名海洋巨人。
text.description: 我认得这邪恶的造物。它是一种可怕的疾病，杀人于瞬间，残忍无情。尽管我厌恶使用这些装置，但恐怕这里没有别的选择。$b$b你当然也知道，这一地区的纳迦依然是个严重的威胁。是该把他们赶回大海的时候了！$b$b你准备好了之后，恐羽就会将你带往裂口，他们在正那里准备一次强烈的进攻。$b$b在纳迦和他们的盟军身上使用这调和物，确保凄凉之地的安全！
text.completion:
Your deeds continue to impress me, $N.

Please accept this gift on behalf of the Cenarion Circle.

english.title: Cleansing Our Crevasse
english.objectives: Use Maurin's Concoction to kill 10 Slitherblade Invaders, 10 Slitherblade Sirens, and 3 Sea Giants.
english.description: I recognize this foul creation. It's a terrible disease that kills almost instantly, and in a most violent manner. Loathe as I am to employ such devices, I fear we have no choice here.$b$bAs you of course know, the naga remain a serious threat to the region. The time has come for us to drive them back into the sea!$b$bWhen you are ready, Grimfeather will take you to the crevasse where they are preparing a violent assault.$b$bUse the concoction on the naga and their allies to make Desolace safe!
english.completion:
Your deeds continue to impress me, $N.

Please accept this gift on behalf of the Cenarion Circle.

text.title: 海边的船长
text.objectives: 使用被遗忘者投石车登上被遗忘者战船，击败莫里斯船长和安森船长。
text.description: 被遗忘者投石车快把我们搞死了，$n。即使毁掉它们，还有两艘装配重炮的战舰泊在海湾呢。$B$B我有个一石二鸟的作战计划。你，就是计划中的石头。$B$B消灭操纵投石车的机械师，然后使用投石车将自己发射到被遗忘者的战舰上。$B$B只要你的瞄准技术不是太差，应该可以安全地着陆。登上战舰后，进入甲板下的船舱，消灭两艘战舰的船长。$c，祝你好运。
text.completion: Well done, $N.  You might be a bloody beast, but you're our beast.

english.title: Two By Sea
english.objectives: Use the Forsaken Catapults to board the Forsaken ships and slay Captain Morris and Captain Anson.
english.description: The Forsaken catapults are kicking the snot out of us, $n.  And even if we do take care of them, they've two ships with rows of cannons at the ready.$B$BI've a plan to kill two birds with one stone.  You're the stone in this plan.$B$BTake out the machinists manning the catapults.  After this, use the catapults to launch yourself aboard the Forsaken ships.$B$BIf your aim isn't terrible, you should be able to land safely.  Once onboard, go below decks and take care of each ship's captain.  Good luck, $c.
english.completion: Well done, $N.  You might be a bloody beast, but you're our beast.

text.title: 废墟海岸的邪恶侏儒
text.objectives: 击败废墟海岸里的宾汉姆，顺带干掉4名网枪侏儒和6名光枪侏儒。
text.description: 无赖！异端！自从我开始在艾萨拉的研究后，加基斯宾家就没少扯后腿、搞破坏。而现在一帮子二流工匠居然也被撺掇着来助拳。我有要事缠身：务必要让那些侏儒完蛋大吉。$B$B从我的秘密实验室往南，到海边的废墟海岸去，把他们那些不成比例的大头给我剁下来。
text.completion: Oh - marvelous. Tell me more. And that precocious young Gadgetspring? Dead as well? Ah, wonderful. My work here is important but at times I do miss the carnage of demolishing my enemies on a more personal level. Here, perhaps you can make use of some of my discarded equipment.
text.giverWindow: 留着大胡子的危险人物。

english.title: The Terrible Tinkers of the Ruined Reaches
english.objectives: Slay Bingham Gadgetspring in the Ruined Reaches, along with 4 Netgun Gnomes and 6 Zapper Gnomes.
english.description: Scoundrels! Infidels! Ever since I started my operation here in Azshara the Gadgetspring family has hampered my studies and sabotaged my research. And now a mob of middling, second-rate tinkers have rallied to their aid! I have pressing business to attend to: see to it that those gnomes are finished for good.$B$BHead to the Ruined Reaches on the coast, south of my Secret Lab, and start rolling some of their disproportionately enormous heads for me.
english.completion: Oh - marvelous. Tell me more. And that precocious young Gadgetspring? Dead as well? Ah, wonderful. My work here is important but at times I do miss the carnage of demolishing my enemies on a more personal level. Here, perhaps you can make use of some of my discarded equipment.
english.giverWindow: The mustachioed menace.

text.title: 被抓了！
text.objectives: 军官金妮要你乘她的坐骑前往尼耶尔前哨站去跟麦尔金斯下士谈一谈。
text.description: 站住！$b$b以尼耶尔前哨站守卫的名义，我受命让所有壮丁前往麦尔金斯下士处报到。$b$b我无权透露其他信息。$b$b我所能提供的只是交通工具。你可以用我的坐骑，它将直接把你送到。$b$b解散。
text.completion:
Welcome to Nijel's Point, $r.

Now, let's see about getting you briefed on our situation here.

english.title: Rerouted!
english.objectives: Officer Jankie wants you to ride her mount to Nijel's Point and speak to Corporal Melkins.
english.description: Halt!$b$bOn behalf of the Nijel's Point Guard, I am under orders to send all able-bodied allies to report directly to Corporal Melkins.$b$bI am not authorized to offer any other information.$b$bWhat I can offer is transportation. You are free to use my mount. It will deliver you directly.$b$bDismissed.
english.completion:
Welcome to Nijel's Point, $r.

Now, let's see about getting you briefed on our situation here.

text.title: 艾萨莱特水晶实验一号
text.objectives: 从废墟海岸的侏儒塔里拿一剂巨人用量的泻药。想办法喂给格蒙刚吃。
text.description: 说起来，我想到了一个万全之策，不过你不会喜欢的。要让巨人上厕所，我们需要一种……大号的……泻药。哦嘿！你还别不信，侏儒们正好有这种玩意儿。这可不是巧合。我倒想知道他们打算替谁通肠胃。$B$B我们的探子报告说泻药已经被运往加基斯宾的塔里，就沿着秘密实验室南部的海岸线。把泻药弄到手，去给格蒙刚尝尝！
text.progress: Once you have the laxative, try to feed it to Gormungan. And maybe give him a magazine or something. Do it for science!
text.completion: So it was a no-go? Literally? Well, Grapplehammer won't take no for an answer. We'll have to try something else.$B$BMaybe I'll have my interns smuggle this laxative into the night elf encampment. That'll be good for a laugh, at least.

english.title: Azsharite Experiment Number One
english.objectives: Grab a giant-sized laxative from the gnomish tower in the Ruined Reaches. Try to feed the laxative to Gormungan the giant.
english.description: Well, I can think of one surefire way to send a giant running to the bathroom, but you're not going to like it. What we need is a ... massive ... laxative. Oh hey! Would you believe the gnomes have something of the sort? That can't be a coincidence. I wonder what they're trying to push through over there?$B$BOur intelligence reports that the laxative was delivered to Gadgetspring's tower, down on the shoreline south of the Secret Lab. Retrieve that laxative and feed it to Gormungan!
english.progress: Once you have the laxative, try to feed it to Gormungan. And maybe give him a magazine or something. Do it for science!
english.completion: So it was a no-go? Literally? Well, Grapplehammer won't take no for an answer. We'll have to try something else.$B$BMaybe I'll have my interns smuggle this laxative into the night elf encampment. That'll be good for a laugh, at least.

text.title: 敌军的首领
text.objectives: 使用训犬口哨，在猎犬的帮助下击败黑暗游侠西亚拉。
text.description: $n，到目前为止，你都表现得很好。侦察兵已经发现了被遗忘者的陆军首领。$B$B希尔瓦娜斯亲自挑选了一名黑暗游侠作为前线的统帅，她就在海边沃登的房子处。当你靠近她时，吹响这枚口哨。$B$B我会派出凶猛的猎犬将她扑倒。$n，当心。你最好不要跟她单打独斗。
text.completion: You did it, $N.  That should take the wind out of their sails.
text.giverWindow: 别忘了用哨子！

english.title: Leader of the Pack
english.objectives: Use the Mastiff Whistle to help you slay Dark Ranger Thyala.
english.description: Excellent work so far, $n.  Our scouts have identified the leader of the Forsaken ground assault.$B$BOne of Sylvanas' handpicked dark rangers is overseeing the battlefront from the Walden house near the shore.  Take this whistle and use it when you're close to her.$B$BI'll have my men let loose our attack mastiffs to take her down.  Be careful, $n.  You don't want to engage her alone.
english.completion: You did it, $N.  That should take the wind out of their sails.
english.giverWindow: Don't forget to use the whistle!

text.title: 形势
text.objectives: 本迪加斯上尉要你去跟尼耶尔前哨站的瓦拉里尔谈一谈。
text.description: 是的，是的。欢迎来到凄凉之地，$r。$b$b抱歉我们一切从简，这一地区有不少大麻烦——大多数都十万火急。$b$b一句话：能招来的帮手我们都要。$b$b首先，那边的瓦拉里尔一直急着坚持让我们往东边的废墟派遣小分队。$b$b你干嘛不去介绍一下自己呢……
text.completion: A pleasure to meet you, $c.

english.title: Lay of the Land
english.objectives: Captain Pentigast wants you to speak to Vahlarriel in Nijel's Point.
english.description: Yes, yes. Welcome to Desolace, $r.$b$bSorry we had to be so insistent, but we're a small outpost, and there are big problems in this region - most of them quite urgent.$b$bBottom line: We need all the help we can muster.$b$bTo start with, our friend Vahlarriel over there has been getting pretty antsy, insisting that we send a contingent to visit the ruins to the east.$b$bWhy don't you go introduce yourself....
english.completion: A pleasure to meet you, $c.

text.title: 艾萨莱特水晶实验二号
text.objectives: 同助手格瑞里谈谈，让他把你缩成老鼠一般大小。再骑一只火箭老鼠去吓唬巨人格蒙刚。
text.description: 好了，新方案。我们把它吓出来！根据我的经验多数大个子都害怕小家伙——比方说老鼠。唔。这地方老鼠满地爬，可我们怎么才能把它们赶到巨人那儿呢？$B$B嘿！你不介意把你的细胞结构打破重组吧？就疼那么一会儿。我能把你缩成老鼠那般大，然后那些畜生就可以给你当马骑了。这计划够疯狂，所以一定能成！等你做好缩小准备了就跟我说一声……

english.title: Azsharite Experiment Number Two
english.objectives: Speak with Assistant Greely to be shrunken down to rat-size. Mount a Rocketway Rat and use it to terrify Gormungan the giant.
english.description: Okay, new plan. We'll SCARE it out of 'em! In my experience most large creatures are terrified of tiny ones - like rats. Hmm. This place is crawling with rats, but how do we coax them over to the giant?$B$BHey! You don't mind having your cellular matrix broken down and reassembled do you? It's only painful while it's happening. I can shrink you down to rat-sized and you can ride one of these brutes over there like a horse. It's so crazy it's got to work! Speak with me when you're ready for shrinkage...

text.title: 难道不是很明显吗？
text.objectives: 使用克希雷姆高塔里乔安娜后面的传送门找到灵魂医者安娜拉——可能的话，还有艾索雷苟斯。
text.description: 艾索雷苟斯！是啊，当然啦。可怜的老家伙，心肠却不坏。我敢说，这些年来那些流浪者没少对他造成伤害。最近他显得有些奇怪。$B$B就在不久之前，他还来找我们的灵魂医者安娜拉，我无意发现他们俩处得挺好。她现在多半还跟他在一起。$B$B我身后的传送门可能是找到她的最快途径，不过使用时可能会造成一点点刺痛。
text.end: 找到安娜拉——可能的话，还有艾索雷苟斯。

english.title: Wasn't It Obvious?
english.objectives: Use the portal behind Joanna at Xylem's tower to find Anara the Spirit Healer and--hopefully--Azuregos.
english.description: Azuregos! Yes, of course. Troubled old dragon, but lovely heart. I don't think all the years of vagabonds assaulting him have done him much good. He's a mite strange these days.$B$BNot long ago, when returning yet again to our local Spirit Healer, Anara, I couldn't help but notice that her and Azuregos seemed to be hitting it off. I imagine he's still keeping her company.$B$BThe portal behind me is probably the quickest way to reach her. It might sting a little though.

text.title: 好事多磨
text.objectives: 说服艾索雷苟斯返回生者的世界与卡雷苟斯汇合。
text.description: 历经曲折，漫漫求索后，你终于找到了艾索雷苟斯。$B$B现在只剩下说服他回去见卡雷苟斯，好结束黑龙军团对艾萨拉的威胁。
text.end: 说服艾索雷苟斯去见卡雷苟斯。

english.title: Easy is Boring
english.objectives: Convince Azuregos to return to the world of the living and rendezvous with Kalecgos.
english.description: After a long search with some questionable turns, you've finally found Azuregos.$B$BNow it's just a matter of convincing him to meet up with Kalecgos and put an end to the threat of the black dragonflight in Azshara.
english.end: Convince Azuregos to meet with Kalecgos.

text.title: 扭转局面
text.objectives: 同安娜拉交谈，返回生者世界，然后与卡雷苟斯在北部火箭车终点站见面。
text.description: 艾索雷苟斯和卡雷苟斯会在北部火箭车终点站见面。你应该到那里跟他们碰头，以防卡雷苟斯需要额外的帮助。$B$B要是你不想保持死亡状态，安娜拉可以帮上忙。

english.title: Turning the Tables
english.objectives: Speak to Anara to return to the world of the living, then meet with Kalecgos at the Northern Rocketway Terminus.
english.description: Azuregos and Kalecgos are due to meet up at the Northern Rocketway Terminus. You should meet with them there to make sure that Kalecgos doesn't require any additional help.$B$BShould you prefer to not be dead, Anara will likely be able to help.

text.title: Farewell, Minnow
text.objectives: Speak to Sorata Firespinner in Bilgewater Harbor.
text.description: Thank you, little one.$B$BSometimes it's easy to get lost in the throes of love and lose sight of things, even as a dragon. I plan to rededicate myself entirely to making sure Kalec never steps up to take Malygos' place. It's the most noble cause I can think of.$B$BYou should head back to the harbor. I believe someone's waiting for you there.$B$BTry not to get squashed or eaten by anything.

english.title: Farewell, Minnow
english.objectives: Speak to Sorata Firespinner in Bilgewater Harbor.
english.description: Thank you, little one.$B$BSometimes it's easy to get lost in the throes of love and lose sight of things, even as a dragon. I plan to rededicate myself entirely to making sure Kalec never steps up to take Malygos' place. It's the most noble cause I can think of.$B$BYou should head back to the harbor. I believe someone's waiting for you there.$B$BTry not to get squashed or eaten by anything.

text.title: 开战吧！
text.objectives: 力普拉可汗要你击败15名火刃术士、3名末日守卫入侵者以及女祭司桑德丽萨。$b$b跟力普拉可汗交谈，发动攻击。
text.description: 半人马氏族多年来四分五裂，互相争斗的日子结束了。$b$b在你的努力下，我们达成同盟，拿起武器对抗共同的敌人。我们誓从恶魔手中夺回先祖的家园，否则就与兄弟们一起战死沙场。$b$b你有什么打算，$n？$b$b你赢得了与我们并肩作战的权利。我会将我最优秀的一队半人马士兵交给你统领。$b$b你愿意参战吗？
text.completion:
Well done, $N!

Let us finish this!

english.title: Into the Fray!
english.objectives: Khan Leh'prah wants you to defeat 15 Burning Blade Warlocks, 3 Doomguard Invaders, and Priestess Than'darissa.$b$bSpeak to Khan Leh'prah to ride into battle.
english.description: For untold generations, the centaur clans have fought against one another, but no more.$b$bBecause of your deeds, we stand here together fighting a common foe. We shall win our ancestral lands back from these demons, or we shall die as brothers.$b$bWhat of you, $n?$b$bYou have earned the right to fight alongside us. I have a group of my best centaurs for you to lead into battle.$b$bWill you take up the spear?
english.completion:
Well done, $N!

Let us finish this!

text.title: 埃高戈里登的死亡
text.objectives: 击败埃高戈里登。
text.description: 我们的目标就在眼前，$n！$b$b如果扳倒他们的领袖，我们就能击垮恶魔的意志。若是成功，凄凉之地就是我们的了！$b$b做好准备后，带一队半人马通过南面的小径，进入破影峡谷。找到埃高戈里登的藏身之处！$b$b我将召集其他可汗，在那里同你共同面对他。
text.completion:
Agogridon is no more.

The demons shall never again take hold in our lands!

english.title: Death to Agogridon
english.objectives: Defeat Agogridon.
english.description: Our goal is within sight, $n!$b$bWe can break the will of this demon army by bringing down the one who leads them. If we can succeed, Desolace will be ours!$b$bWhen you are ready, lead a group of centaurs through the pass to the south, into Shadowbreak Ravine. Find where Agogridon hides!$b$bI will gather the other khans and meet you there to face him in battle.
english.completion:
Agogridon is no more.

The demons shall never again take hold in our lands!

text.title: 屏住呼吸
text.objectives: 营救4名溺水的哨兵。
text.description: $n！地震发生时，我正在赶路。$B$B时间宝贵。近一半的哨兵随着地势塌陷沉入海中。快去救人吧。$B$B将溺水者拖到岸上，我会确保他们得到妥善的援助。
text.progress: There aren't many of us left, $N.  We have to look out for those remaining Gilneans.
text.completion: You did what you could, $N.  With any luck a few others will find their way to shore.

english.title: Gasping for Breath
english.objectives: Rescue 4 Drowning Watchmen.
english.description: $n!  I was on my way when it happened.$B$BNo time to waste.  A good half of the town watch was in the area that collapsed.  Get in there and save as many as you can.$B$BMake sure to get them out of the water and onto shore.  I'll make sure they get any aid they need.
english.progress: There aren't many of us left, $N.  We have to look out for those remaining Gilneans.
english.completion: You did what you could, $N.  With any luck a few others will find their way to shore.

text.title: 天崩地裂
text.objectives: 跟艾伦农场的利亚姆·格雷迈恩王子谈一谈。
text.description: $n，刚才那声轰天巨响是怎么回事？$B$B肯定不是大炮，也不是投石车。$B$B去外面看看究竟出了什么事。
text.completion: The ocean, $N.  It swallowed everything... the land... the Forsaken... our men!

english.title: As the Land Shatters
english.objectives: Speak to Prince Liam Greymane at the Allen Farmstead.
english.description: What in the world was that, $n?$B$BThose were not cannons or catapults, that is for sure.$B$BGo outside and see what is going on.
english.completion: The ocean, $N.  It swallowed everything... the land... the Forsaken... our men!

text.title: 撤退行动
text.objectives: 跟暮湾镇的格温·阿姆斯特谈一谈。
text.description: $n，我们没死真是撞了大运。但不是每次都能这么好运的。$B$B瞧，海水在不断地上涨。照这个情形来看，我们脚下的陆地是保不住的。$B$B我很不想做出这个决定，但是我们得离开这里。$n，狼人的诅咒……还有地震，我竟然两次目睹家园被毁……但是自然灾害不是我们能抗衡的。$B$B让格温·阿姆斯特准备撤离吧。
text.completion: Liam is right.  We must get everyone to higher ground.$B$BYou must help me spread the word while I manage the logistics of the evacuation.

english.title: Evacuation
english.objectives: Speak to Gwen Armstead in Duskhaven.
english.description: We've escaped death through dumb luck, $n.  But luck is running out.$B$BThe coast is becoming flooded even as we speak.  And from the look of it, the landmass beneath us hasn't quite settled yet.$B$BI hate to say this, but we have to leave.  Curses, $n.... I cannot lose my homeland twice in one lifetime.  Yet these earthquakes are not an enemy we can defeat.$B$BTell Gwen Armstead to start the evacuation.
english.completion: Liam is right.  We must get everyone to higher ground.$B$BYou must help me spread the word while I manage the logistics of the evacuation.

text.title: 薇儿外婆
text.objectives: 前往薇儿小屋，找到薇儿外婆。
text.description: 要让薇儿外婆跟我们一起撤离可不是件容易的事。但是你必须想办法说服她。$B$B她就在薇儿小屋。$n，求你了。要有耐心。她是个思想古板的老太太，还有点神志不清。
text.completion: A visitor!  Are you staying for tea, sweetheart?

english.title: Grandma Wahl
english.objectives: Find Grandma Wahl at the Wahl Cottage.
english.description: It's not going to be easy to get Grandma Wahl to come with us.  You must do whatever you can to convince her, though.$B$BYou'll find her at the Wahl Cottage.  Please, $n.  Do not lose your patience with her.  Her mind is old and she's not entirely lucid.
english.completion: A visitor!  Are you staying for tea, sweetheart?

text.title: 失踪的宝贝
text.objectives: 找到亚麻布包裹的书籍。
text.description: 撤离？现在？$B$B好吧，走就走咯。但是你能不能帮我找件东西呢，宝贝儿？$B$B我丢了一本心爱的书，找不到的话我就不走。$B$B<你向薇儿外婆解释了形势的严重性，她却委屈地摇着头。>$B$B亲爱的，就帮我找找吧，好吗？
text.progress: How goes it, dear?  Will you be staying for tea?
text.completion: Why thank you, $N.  I hope you didn't peek!$B$BWhere are your manners, dear?

english.title: Grandma's Lost It Alright
english.objectives: Find the Linen-Wrapped Book.
english.description: Leave?  Now?$B$BWell, if I must, then I must.  But will you be a sweetheart and find something for me?$B$BI've lost my favorite book and won't leave without it.$B$B<After you explain the gravity of the situation, Grandma Wahl shakes her head condescendingly.>$B$BDear, just find the book will you?
english.progress: How goes it, dear?  Will you be staying for tea?
english.completion: Why thank you, $N.  I hope you didn't peek!$B$BWhere are your manners, dear?

text.title: 我不要穿成这样
text.objectives: 取回外婆的漂亮衣服。
text.description: 你想让我干嘛来着？$B$B噢，是了。撤离。$B$B我可不能穿成这样就出门，对吧？$B$B去把我的好衣服拿来，就在外面的晾衣架上。$B$B<你试图说服薇儿外婆这身衣服还不错，但是她不听。>$B$B现在的年轻人真是没有教养。你是被兽人养大的吗？行啦，快去取我的衣服来。
text.progress: Did you find everything okay, dear?
text.completion: You're a peach, $N.  Thanks!

english.title: I Can't Wear This
english.objectives: Get Grandma's Good Clothes.
english.description: What was it you wanted again?$B$BOh, right.  The evacuation orders.$B$BWell I can't be expected to go out in public like this, can I?$B$BGo get me my good clothes.  They're on the clothesline right outside.$B$B<You struggle in vain to convince Grandma Wahl that what she's wearing will do.>$B$BYou young people truly have no manners.  Were you raised by ogres?  Now go get my clothes, sweetie.
english.progress: Did you find everything okay, dear?
english.completion: You're a peach, $N.  Thanks!

text.title: 外婆的猫咪
text.objectives: 找回黄猫小运。
text.description: 嗯哼！撤退。$B$B我要我的猫咪，不然我就不走。他是一只黄色的虎斑猫，非常可爱。$B$B这里的东北边有一棵大树，树下有一辆破损的货车，小运最喜欢在那里玩耍了。$B$B你去把他找回来，然后我们就可以动身了。
text.progress: You're such a charming young $gman:lady;, $N.
text.completion: There he is!  Grandma's special boy!$B$BThank you so much for finding him.  I hope it wasn't too much trouble.$B$BMy... what manner of dirt found its way underneath my fingernails!

english.title: Grandma's Cat
english.objectives: Retrieve Chance the cat.
english.description: Right!  About the evacuation, dear.$B$BI just cannot leave without my cat.  He's an adorable orange tabby.$B$BChance's favorite spot to play is a broken down cart near an arbor northeast of here.$B$BBring him here and we'll be on our way.
english.progress: You're such a charming young $gman:lady;, $N.
english.completion: There he is!  Grandma's special boy!$B$BThank you so much for finding him.  I hope it wasn't too much trouble.$B$BMy... what manner of dirt found its way underneath my fingernails!

text.title: 准备就绪
text.objectives: 跟暮湾镇的格温·阿姆斯特谈一谈。
text.description: 好吧，我觉得可以动身了。$B$B我穿上了最好看的衣服，带着我最喜欢的书还有我心爱的猫咪。$B$B应该没有忘记什么。$B$B去告诉镇长，我这就上路。那么，待会在城里碰面咯！
text.completion: You did the impossible, $N.  You convinced Grandma Wahl to leave her home.$B$BYou are something else, let me tell you.

english.title: Ready to Go
english.objectives: Speak to Gwen Armstead in Duskhaven.
english.description: I suppose now is as good a time to leave as any.$B$BI have my best outfit, my favorite book and my loving cat.$B$BI hope I'm not forgetting anything.$B$BTell that mayor of yours that I'll be on my way.  I suppose I'll see you in town with the others!
english.completion: You did the impossible, $N.  You convinced Grandma Wahl to leave her home.$B$BYou are something else, let me tell you.

text.title: 海瓦尔德兄弟
text.objectives: 跟海瓦尔德渔场的塞巴斯蒂安·海瓦尔德谈一谈。
text.description: 南面的远方是海瓦尔德渔场。多年来，海瓦尔德兄弟一直经营着这座渔场。$B$B除了卖鱼，他们很少进城。去通知他们准备撤离吧。
text.completion: You here to give us a hand?

english.title: The Hayward Brothers
english.objectives: Speak to Sebastian Hayward at the Hayward Fishery.
english.description: The Hayward Fishery can be found far to the south.  The Hayward brothers have been running it for years.$B$BThey don't make it to town very often, except to trade their fish.  Send word to them that the evacuation is underway.
english.completion: You here to give us a hand?

text.title: 丢三落四
text.objectives: 找到厚木板、煤焦油和造船者的工具。
text.description: 撤离？说实话，自打被遗忘者出现后，我们就有了离开的念头。$B$B海路应该是最安全的撤离途径。$B$B但是我们的船只在地震中受损严重。$B$B我需要一些材料来修葺：厚木板、煤焦油和造船者的工具。请帮我找到它们，这样我和我的兄弟们就可以安全撤离了。
text.progress: Do you have my supplies, $N?
text.completion: This is great, $N.  I should be able to finish the repairs in no time.

english.title: Not Quite Shipshape
english.objectives: Obtain Planks of Wood, Coal Tar and Shipwright's Tools.
english.description: Evacuation, you say?  Well, we had that very same idea all on our own after these Forsaken started showing up.$B$BWe were thinking the water would be the safest way out of here.$B$BUnfortunately our boats didn't come out from that last earthquake unscathed.$B$BI need some additional supplies to finish my repairs: wood, tar and my tools.  Get them for me so that my brothers and I can make it out of here.
english.progress: Do you have my supplies, $N?
english.completion: This is great, $N.  I should be able to finish the repairs in no time.

text.title: 海路出逃
text.objectives: 返回暮湾镇，向格温·阿姆斯特复命。
text.description: $n，谢谢你。船只可以扬帆出海了。$B$B请转告阿姆斯特小姐，我们就不从陆地撤离了。$B$B海瓦尔德家族世代以海为生。就算要离开家园，我们也宁愿选择海路。
text.completion: It's just as well, $N.  Maybe the Haywards will fare better than us.

english.title: Escape By Sea
english.objectives: Return to Gwen Armstead in Duskhaven.
english.description: Thanks for your help, $n.  This ship is ready to sail.$B$BNow you go and tell Miss Armstead that we're not going to be part of the land evacuation.$B$BWe Haywards have been men of the sea for generations.  If we're to leave our home, then we'll do so by sea.
english.completion: It's just as well, $N.  Maybe the Haywards will fare better than us.

text.title: 克罗雷果园
text.objectives: 跟克罗雷果园的罗娜·克罗雷谈一谈。
text.description: 还记得达利乌斯·克罗雷领主的女儿罗娜吗？$B$B她一直沉浸在父亲逝世的悲痛之中，过着隐士般的生活。之前，她只允许克雷南踏进她的屋子……但是克雷南不愿向她提起撤退的计划。$B$B去把这件事告诉她吧。
text.completion: Stay back! Don't make me...$B$BIs it you?  By the Light!  It's you, $N!

english.title: The Crowley Orchard
english.objectives: Speak to Lorna Crowley at the Crowley Orchard.
english.description: Of course you remember Lord Darius Crowley's daughter, Lorna.$B$BShe never quite recovered after losing her father in Gilneas City.  She's basically led the life of a hermit.  The only visitor she's allowed into her house has been Krennan... and he won't say a word about the whole thing.$B$BSend word to her about the evacuation.
english.completion: Stay back! Don't make me...$B$BIs it you?  By the Light!  It's you, $N!

text.title: 艾萨拉的蓝龙
text.objectives: 同锈水港的卡雷会面。
text.description: 嘿！可算找着你了。$B$B我代表我的主人卡雷而来。他需要你的帮助。赶快去贫民窟的桥下找他吧！

english.title: Azshara Blues
english.objectives: Meet with Kalec in Bilgewater Harbor.
english.description: Hey! I'm glad I caught you.$B$BI come on behalf of my master, Kalec. He requires your aid. Find him under the bridge in the slums as soon as you can!

text.title: 九号实验品的计划
text.objectives: 从秘密实验室东头的实验室档案馆里获取秘密火箭图纸。按下实验室的门铃并杀掉出现的实验室主管。
text.description: 我的赞助人用他们的小脑袋瓜造了这么个星际交通工具。就像设计得那样，这枚所谓的“火箭”十分不安全。但我觉得用一道简单的半折叠燃油催化工序，就能重新生成稳定混合物，提供可呼吸的氧气副产品。要想实现这一改变，我需要原始的工程图样。$B$B要是没被烧成灰的话，它们应该就在实验室档案馆里，试着进去找找看。图样也有可能在实验室主管本人手上，如果他还活着的话。
text.progress: I suspect the archives are close, $N. Locate those plans!

english.title: Nine's Plan
english.objectives: Acquire the Secret Rocket Plans from the Laboratory Archives building at the eastern end of the Secret Lab. Ring the door buzzer outside and kill the lab director when he emerges.
english.description: My benefactors used their diminutive intellect to construct an interplanetary transport. As designed, this so-called "Rocket" is a death trap. But I suspect a simple re-engineering of the fuel catalyst semifold would render a stable mixture, providing a breathable oxygen byproduct. To implement such changes, I require the original engineering plans.$B$BLocate the Laboratory Archives and ring the doorbell to gain entry. The plans will be held by the lab director himself, presuming he still lives.
english.progress: I suspect the archives are close, $N. Locate those plans!

text.title: A Cautious Return
text.objectives: Bring Daros' Journal to Mordent Evenshade in Darnassus.
text.description: A moment of your time, $c.$b$bChange is coming. It has drawn us out of the ruins of Eldre'Thalas and into the wide world once more. I have come to research this city and cannot stray from it, but if you are inclined, I have an errand for you.$b$bMy colleague set out for Darnassus to speak with the High Priestess there, that we might come to an understanding. Take this journal to Mordent Evenshade in the temple. It may help in his diplomacy mission.
text.progress: It seems I have time to talk. What is this regarding?
text.completion: Ah, the writings of Daros. He always was meticulous about tracking progress. His words may aid in explaining how far we've come.$b$bYou have my thanks for bringing this to me, $r. Perhaps we will see more of each other once it is understood we mean no harm.

english.title: A Cautious Return
english.objectives: Bring Daros' Journal to Mordent Evenshade in Darnassus.
english.description: A moment of your time, $c.$b$bChange is coming. It has drawn us out of the ruins of Eldre'Thalas and into the wide world once more. I have come to research this city and cannot stray from it, but if you are inclined, I have an errand for you.$b$bMy colleague set out for Darnassus to speak with the High Priestess there, that we might come to an understanding. Take this journal to Mordent Evenshade in the temple. It may help in his diplomacy mission.
english.progress: It seems I have time to talk. What is this regarding?
english.completion: Ah, the writings of Daros. He always was meticulous about tracking progress. His words may aid in explaining how far we've come.$b$bYou have my thanks for bringing this to me, $r. Perhaps we will see more of each other once it is understood we mean no harm.

text.title: 菲拉斯的荒野
text.objectives: 到菲拉斯去跟梦游者栖地的特拉隆·风程谈一谈。
text.description: 你能来帮助我们保护这片土地，真是勇气可嘉，英雄。假如你愿意为荒野付出更多，还有其他人需要你的援助。$B$B菲拉斯的青翠森林就在南方。那里，在伟岸的双塔山庇荫下，你可以找到我们的特拉隆·风程。他和他的利爪德鲁伊同伴们在梦游者栖地发现了一种恶疾的迹象。$B$B他们会需要你的帮助的，$c。一路平安。

english.title: The Wilds of Feralas
english.objectives: Travel to Feralas and speak with Telaron Windflight at Dreamer's Rest.
english.description: You are truly brave to help us protect these lands, hero. If you wish to do more for the wilds, there are others in need of your aid.$B$BThe verdant forests of Feralas lie to the south. There, in the shade of the mighty Twin Colossals, you must seek out Telaron Windflight. At Dreamer's Rest, he and his fellow druids of the talon have found signs of a disturbing illness.$B$BThey will need your help, $c. Go in peace.

text.title: Feralas Breadcrumb [PH]
text.description: One day I will grow up to be a real breadcrumb! To Feralas!!!!1

english.title: Feralas Breadcrumb [PH]
english.description: One day I will grow up to be a real breadcrumb! To Feralas!!!!1

text.title: 清理渔场
text.objectives: 杀死6名流窜的被遗忘者。
text.description: 被遗忘者战船的沉没点离我们的渔场太近了。很多幸存者涌来这里，你也看见了，我们在数量上有点寡不敌众。$B$B请帮助我们击退他们，我会继续修理船只的。
text.completion: Excellent!  I'm almost done here.

english.title: Washed Up
english.objectives: Kill 6 Forsaken Castaways.
english.description: Those Forsaken ships sank way too close to our Fishery.  All the survivors are making their way here and, as you can see, we're a bit outnumbered.$B$BHelp us hold them back while I finish making repairs to the boats.
english.completion: Excellent!  I'm almost done here.

text.title: 学习之巅
text.objectives: 在奥术之巅底部同大法师克希雷姆的影像交谈。
text.description: 太令人激动了！你要问是什么令人激动？当然就是这个啦！$B$B试炼……是你接受试炼的时候了。那么多的挑战要克服，那么多的知识要了解。你要了解试炼，我要了解你。$B$B所以现在，你可以走了。到奥术之巅去，当然我会在那儿同你汇合，因为我可说是无所不在。

english.title: The Pinnacle of Learning
english.objectives: Speak to the Image of Archmage Xylem at the base of the Arcane Pinnacle.
english.description: This is so exciting! What's exciting you might ask? Well THIS is of course!$B$BTime to trial... time for YOU to trial. So many challenges to overcome, so much learning to be done. You learning about trials. Me learning about you.$B$BSo now, off you go. To my Arcane Pinnacle. I will meet you there of course, because I'm quite everywhere.

starters.name: 大法师克希雷姆的影像

enders.name: 大法师克希雷姆的影像

text.description: One day I will grow up to be a real breadcrumb! To Feralas!!!!1

english.description: One day I will grow up to be a real breadcrumb! To Feralas!!!!1

text.title: Apparitions in the Orchard
text.objectives: Investigate the Crowley Orchard.
text.description: Listen, $N.  I heard about what happened to you and I trust you regardless of your... affliction.  After all, you were with my father until the end.$B$BBut I'm not going to go out there.  It's not safe.$B$BThe earthquake opened a passage from the mountains and an ettin has decided to pay us a visit.$B$BNot only that, but after I holed up in the house, I started seeing ghostly wolf forms in the orchard.$B$BI can't come out until we at least have some idea about what's going on.

english.objectives: Investigate the Crowley Orchard.

After all, you were with my father until the end.$B$BBut I'm not going to go out there.  It's not safe.$B$BThe earthquake opened a passage from the mountains and an ettin has decided to pay us a visit.$B$BNot only that, but after I holed up in the house, I started seeing ghostly wolf forms in the orchard.$B$BI can't come out until we at least have some idea about what's going on.

text.title: 饥饿的双头怪
text.objectives: 克罗雷果园的罗娜·克罗雷要你带回5匹高山马。
text.description: 听着，$n，如果我们没有坐骑，根本跑不了多远。$B$B就算是能跑出这里，被遗忘者也会立刻追上我们。$B$B从东南方的马厩里弄些马匹本来不是难事。但现在我们遇到了一个障碍。$B$B最近这次地面的震动一定是那个叫克洛斯的双头怪造成的。他从群山中一直杀到了这里。如果我们不尽快找到那些马匹，恐怕他会把那些马全都杀光。
text.completion: We've got the horses, I'll make sure Duskhaven gets them.

english.title: The Hungry Ettin
english.objectives: Bring 5 Mountain Horses to Lorna Crowley at the Crowley Orchard.
english.description: Listen, $n.  We're not going to make it very far without transportation, are we?$B$BIf we just hightail it out of here, the forsaken will catch up to us in no time at all.$B$BRounding up some horses from the stable grounds southeast of here would normally be a breeze, but there's one snag.$B$BThat last quake must've spooked Koroth, the ettin, down from the mountains.  If we don't get our horses soon, I fear that he will.
english.completion: We've got the horses, I'll make sure Duskhaven gets them.

text.title: The Deathstalkers
text.objectives: Deliver Andron's Ledger to Aleric Hawkins in the Hall of the Dark Lady in the Undercity.
text.description: The Syndicate? I would never have suspected. It seems the lords of Alterac have fallen far in the years since their betrayal.$b$bHawkins will be pleased to learn of this, and as you were so instrumental in this discovery, it would be fitting if you were the one to deliver it to him.$b$bAh, and how could I forget?$b$bWelcome to the Deathstalkers.
text.completed: Return to Aleric Hawkins at Lordamere Lake in Silverpine Forest.

english.objectives: Deliver Andron's Ledger to Aleric Hawkins in the Hall of the Dark Lady in the Undercity.
english.description: The Syndicate? I would never have suspected. It seems the lords of Alterac have fallen far in the years since their betrayal.$b$bHawkins will be pleased to learn of this, and as you were so instrumental in this discovery, it would be fitting if you were the one to deliver it to him.$b$bAh, and how could I forget?$b$bWelcome to the Deathstalkers.
english.completed: Return to Aleric Hawkins at Lordamere Lake in Silverpine Forest.

text.title: The Deathstalkers
text.objectives: Speak with Andron Gant in the Undercity.
text.description: The letter of introduction should be enough to convince Andron that you are the messenger he's been waiting for. I've met Andron before, he doesn't quite have the mental capacity to be that suspicious.$b$bOur leader suspects that Andron has been providing aid to some other group. He wishes to know what organization this is and requires proof of it.$b$bI want you to speak with Andron, and obtain this information. You'll find him at his shop near the Apothecarium.
text.completed: Return to Andron Gant at Lordamere Lake in Alterac Mountains.

text.title: The Deathstalkers
text.objectives: Get Astor's Letter of Introduction and return it to Mennet Carkad in the Rogues' Quarter.
text.description: If you wish to join the Deathstalkers, the Dark Lady's elite guard, you will have to prove your worth.$b$bI will not lie to you, $n, this task could mean your death.$b$bI have some things that need attending to. I require the personal effects of Astor Hadren, a messenger who travels between Silverpine and the Undercity. I will leave the method of procurement to your discretion.$b$bIt will be better for you if you know less of the nature of this business. Succeed and I shall tell you more.

english.objectives: Get Astor's Letter of Introduction and return it to Mennet Carkad in the Rogues' Quarter.

I will leave the method of procurement to your discretion.$b$bIt will be better for you if you know less of the nature of this business. Succeed and I shall tell you more.

text.title: The Deathstalkers
text.objectives: Bring Andron's Ledger to Mennet Carkad in the Rogues' Quarter of Undercity.
text.description: You'll find the ledger with the information your employers seek on the bookshelf behind me. Deliver it with my regards, and tell them that I would prefer it if they sent you, if they find enough value that they should wish to continue our arrangement.
text.completed: Return to Mennet Carkad at Ruins of Lordaeron in Tirisfal Glades.

english.objectives: Bring Andron's Ledger to Mennet Carkad in the Rogues' Quarter of Undercity.
english.description: You'll find the ledger with the information your employers seek on the bookshelf behind me. Deliver it with my regards, and tell them that I would prefer it if they sent you, if they find enough value that they should wish to continue our arrangement.
english.completed: Return to Mennet Carkad at Ruins of Lordaeron in Tirisfal Glades.

text.title: 飞向外太空的迅猛龙
text.objectives: 释放秘密实验室里的5只试验迅猛龙，把它们和九号实验品送上火箭。
text.description: 就在智力突飞猛进之后，为了繁殖出一个高度智慧的迅猛龙种族，我和四号实验品进行过交配。可之后四号实验品就再也没找过我，下次见面我非得把他活剥了不可。$B$B先不提这个，在这个实验室里关了不少幼年迅猛龙，足以为种族繁衍提供足够多样的基因库。请把他们从笼子里放出来，带他们上火箭。

english.title: Raptor Raptor Rocket
english.objectives: Release five Experimental Raptors from their cages in the Secret Lab and deliver them to the rocket beside Subject Nine.
english.description: Shortly after my intellect was augmented, I bred with Subject Four in order to create a unique race of cognitively superior raptors. Subsequently, Subject Four neither called nor wrote: I have determined to disembowel him upon our next encounter.$B$BNonetheless, there are enough raptor children imprisoned in this lab to provide adequate genetic stock for repopulating my race. Please release them from their cages and carry them to the rocket.

text.title: 推土驱魔术
text.objectives: 在克拉伯尼克的推土机旁使用圣佑信号枪，召唤牧师为推土机“驱魔”。
text.description: ……我们得找个牧师！$B$B好在我专门为此留了一小笔预算。带上这支信号枪，到我那小可怜玛基尼那儿去，发射信号弹，会有一个我们最棒的空降牧师跳下来处理情况。等我的推土机没事儿了再回来！

english.title: Dozercism
english.objectives: Use the Blessed Flare Gun near Clubnik's Dozer to summon in help, then 'Exorcise' the bulldozer.
english.description: ...what we need is a priest!$B$BFortunately I have a small budget set aside for the blessing of machinery. Take this flare gun and head over to Margene, my poor sweet busted bulldozer. Fire off the signal and one of our finest airborne priests should airdrop in to get a handle on the situation. Come back when my bulldozer is taken care of!

objectiveDetails.description: 为克拉伯尼克的推土机驱魔

text.title: 再来点科学
text.objectives: 在南部火箭车终点站找到助手格瑞里。使用地精火箭车可以在艾萨拉快速行进。
text.description: <克拉伯尼克拭去一滴泪水，决毅地咬紧了牙关。>$B$B不能这样下去了，$n！玛基尼这样的推土机不该是这个下场。我们要进行工业驱魔，这桩活只有顶尖的科学家才干得了，而我正好认识这样一位！去南部火箭车终点站找助手格瑞里，她是艾萨拉举世闻名的秘密实验室主管，她还欠我一个人情。
text.completed: 在南部火箭车终点站找到助手格瑞里。使用地精火箭换乘站可以在艾萨拉快速行进。

english.title: Need More Science
english.objectives: Locate Assistant Greely at the Southern Rocketway Terminus. The Goblin Rocketway can be used to quickly move around Azshara.
english.description: <Clubnik wipes away a tear, then juts his chin out with determination.>$B$BNever again, $n! No bulldozer deserves the fate of my Margene. We're going to need some industrial ghostproofing. This is a job for our top scientists, and I know just the woman for the job! Look for Assistant Greely at the Southern Rocketway Terminus. She's the administrator for Azshara's world-famous Secret Lab, and she owes me a favor.
english.completed: Locate Assistant Greely at the Southern Rocketway Terminus. The Goblin Rocketway can be used to quickly move around Azshara.

text.title: The First Quest
text.objectives: Test Thrall wants you to kill something.
text.description: Greetings, $n, this is a test.  Accept and kill stuff

english.description: Greetings, $n, this is a test.  Accept and kill stuff

text.objectives: Santa Thrall wants you to collect 5 boozles, whatever those are.
text.description: This is the second quest!  This time you won't have to kill stuff.

text.title: 物品任務
text.objectives: 拿東西
text.description: 物品收集任務

english.title: Item Quest
english.objectives: Get the items
english.description: Item collection quest

text.title: 珀风的手记
text.objectives: 击败达纳希恩营地的博学者珀风，夺走她的手记。
text.description: 假如我的情报确切，博学者珀风监管着联盟对东部遗迹的调查。我还没探到她的深浅：但我希望你能借着与她交锋并取其性命的机会，给我一份全面报告。$B$B既然顶着“博学者”的头衔，那么我猜珀风一定带着她的手记，从中可知那些暗夜精灵究竟做何打算。给我把手记弄到手，别费劲跑回来了，就用他们的占卜石同我远程联系。
text.giverWindow: 希望她带着我们需要的信息。

english.title: Amberwind's Journal
english.objectives: Slay Lorekeeper Amberwind at the Darnassian Base Camp and retrieve her journal.
english.description: If my sources are trustworthy, Lorekeeper Amberwind is overseeing the Alliance investigation of the ruins to the east. I have not yet probed the extent of her abilities: I'm hoping you can give me a full report by engaging her in combat and destroying her.$B$BWith a title like 'Lorekeeper,' I'm guessing Amberwind will have a journal on her that'll tell us exactly what those night elves are up to. Fetch that journal for me. No need to run back; use their own scrying stones to contact me remotely.
english.giverWindow: Hopefully she carries the information we need.

text.title: 奥术解构
text.objectives: 杀掉调查员学徒和夜明者学徒，收集10颗调和过的符文石。
text.description: 奥术构造体源于纯粹的法力和智慧。使用得当，它能让人迅速消化海量的奥术知识。可它们也很危险，$n。智能！强大！难以抵御外部干预……$B$B让我们给这些门外汉上一课，叫他们尝尝自食其果的味道。杀掉学徒们，收集他们的符文石，完事后用占卜石联系我。

english.title: Arcane De-Construction
english.objectives: Slay Apprentice Investigators and Apprentice Illuminators to collect 10 Attuned Runestones.
english.description: Arcane constructs are creatures spawned of pure mana and intellect. In the right hands, a construct allows its user to quickly assimilate vast riches of arcane knowledge. But they're dangerous, $n. So intelligent! So powerful! So very vulnerable to external tampering...$B$BLet's teach these amateurs a lesson and use their own magic against them. Slay Apprentices and collect their runestones for me. Contact me via the lower scrying stone when you're done.

text.title: 构造体黑客
text.objectives: 同达纳希恩营地的奥术构造体对话，讲出奥术控制指令。
text.description: 现在我们来破解他们的奥术构造体，闹个天翻地覆。你以前用过这样的魔法没有，$n？没有吗？哈！那我的计划就更赞了。在你边上应该有具他们召唤的强大构造体，多亏你收集的符文石，我们才知道该怎么和它们沟通。对构造体说“Al'teth la c'tolgar”。听明白了么？重复一遍，差不多。回头向我报告，告诉我发生了什么。
text.completed: 向艾萨拉北部火箭车换乘站的安多瑞尔·誓日复命。

english.title: Hacking the Construct
english.objectives: Speak with the Arcane Construct at the Darnassian Base Camp and utter the words of arcane power.
english.description: Now we will hack their arcane construct and use it to wreak havoc. Have you done this type of magic before, $n? No? Hah! That makes my plan all the more delicious. Nearby you should see a formidable arcane construct they've summoned. Thanks to the runestones you gathered, we know how to communicate with it. Talk to the construct and say "Al'teth la c'tolgar." Got that? Repeat it? Close enough. Report back to me and let me know what happens!
english.completed: Report back to Andorel Sunsworn at the Northern Rocketway Exchange in Azshara.

text.title: 黑喉裂谷
text.objectives: 杀掉8名塔伦迪斯生物学家，从其中一具尸体上收集黑喉情报。
text.description: 就当我们在艾萨拉大肆扩张的时候，栖息在这一地区的黑喉熊怪和他们的胞亲木喉熊怪闹翻了。他们无法无天，$c，动辄就前来骚扰。更糟的是，我们发现他们还和塔伦迪斯的暗夜精灵勾搭上了。这两股力量可不能联合起来！$B$B打这儿西南边你会找到一条大裂谷，我的探子报称暗夜精灵在那儿有所活动。干掉他们，尽可能收集点情报来。

english.title: The Blackmaw Scar
english.objectives: Slay 8 Talrendis Biologists and gather up Blackmaw Intelligence from one of the bodies.
english.description: The Blackmaw furbolg that live in this area have broken rank with their Timbermaw brethren as we began to aggressively settle Azshara. They've gone wild, $c, and harass our forces at every turn. Worse, we have seen them engaging the night elves from Talrendis on friendly terms. We cannot allow the two to ally!$B$BJust southwest of here you will find a great scar across the earth where my scouts report night elven activity. Slay them and gather any intelligence you find.

text.title: 苦酒
text.objectives: 在黑喉要塞外收集10份石南根特酿样本。
text.description: 看起来我们的联盟对头已经操起熊怪语，同黑喉熊怪进行会谈了。要破坏他们的协议，咱们也得能讲才行。$B$B听上去难，其实很简单，$n。黑喉熊怪常煮一种药茶，茶氲会让人迷离恍惚，开始说胡话。确切地说，是黑喉熊怪话。到西南边的黑喉村去给我搞些石南根特酿样本来！

english.title: A Pale Brew
english.objectives: Gather up 10 samples of Briaroot Brew from outside Blackmaw Hold.
english.description: It looks like our Alliance foes have been making headway with their Blackmaw talks by conducting negotiations in the furbolg tongue. If we're to sabotage the treaty, we're going to have to do the same.$B$BIt's not as hard as it sounds, $n. The Blackmaw make a potent herbal tea, the fumes of which will place one in a trance-like state where you'll start speaking in tongues. The Blackmaw tongue, specifically. Go to Blackmaw Hold southwest of here and get me some samples of that briaroot brew!

text.title: 另类的外交
text.objectives: 去黑喉营地截取一份黑喉会面日程，杀掉一名塔伦迪斯使节，把她的使者的长袍带回来。
text.description: 想要混进去破坏黑喉熊怪的谈判，我们还得知道谈判的地方。我猜你能在西南边的黑喉村里找到暗夜精灵大使，他们在那儿扎堆作准备呢。$B$B<哈格鲁姆朝地上啐了一口。>$B$B有空就去干掉他们，找找看有没有重要的文件。哦还有，给我搞套他们的大使袍子来，有用。

english.title: Diplomacy by Another Means
english.objectives: Gather a Blackmaw Meeting Agenda at Blackmaw Hold, and kill a Talrendis Ambassador to collect her Ambassador's Robes.
english.description: In order to infiltrate and disrupt the Blackmaw negotiations, we'll need to know where they're happening. In Blackmaw Hold to the southwest, I suspect you'll find night elven ambassadors milling around, making preparations.$B$B<Haggrum spits on the ground.>$B$BKill them at your leisure, and search the area for important documents. Oh, and grab a set of their ambassador's robes, we'll need them.

text.title: 鲁瑟兰村
text.completion: Are you ready to set sail, $N?  Your people have been granted shelter in the lands of the kaldorei.$B$BDo not worry, $r.  Your people will get a chance to fight for Gilneas again.  This time, with the full strength of the Alliance.

english.title: Rut'theran Village
english.completion: Are you ready to set sail, $N?  Your people have been granted shelter in the lands of the kaldorei.$B$BDo not worry, $r.  Your people will get a chance to fight for Gilneas again.  This time, with the full strength of the Alliance.

text.title: 黑喉离间计
text.objectives: 穿上使者伪装服同安多瑞尔·誓日交谈，让他把你传送到黑喉要塞。同乌加尔对话，破坏谈判，杀死4名黑喉战士和4名黑喉萨满。
text.description: 安多瑞尔帮我稍稍施展了一点魔法。来，站在火边，让茶香药气通透全身，披上长袍，黑喉熊怪看你就如暗夜精灵大使无二。$B$B伪装齐整，去找营地的安多瑞尔，他会把你传送到谈判地点，黑喉要塞的中心。同乌加尔酋长对话，破坏他们的协议，杀出来的时候尽可能多干掉些黑喉熊怪！
text.giverWindow: 离间一只熊怪应该没什么难度吧？

english.title: The Blackmaw Doublecross
english.objectives: Wear the Ambassador Disguise and talk to Andorel Sunsworn to teleport into Blackmaw Hold. Speak with Ungarl to wreck the negotiations, then kill 4 Blackmaw Warriors and 4 Blackmaw Shaman on your way out.
english.description: Andorel here has crafted a little bit of magic for me. Come, stand next to my fire, and steep yourself in the fumes from the tea. Drape the robes around you and you'll take on the appearance of a night elven ambassador to the Blackmaw.$B$BDon your disguise and speak to Andorel here in camp. He'll teleport you to the heart of Blackmaw hold, where the negotiations are to take place. Speak with Chieftain Ungarl and sabotage the treaty. Then, kill as many Blackmaw as you can on the way back!
english.giverWindow: Think you can manage to outwit a furbolg?

text.title: Dwarven Digging
text.objectives: Collect 5 Prospector's Picks.$B$BAt a forge, smash the Prospector's Picks to create Broken Tools.$B$BBring 5 Broken Tools to Ahmo Thunderhorn in Bloodhoof Village.
text.description: There are dwarves preparing a dig site to the northwest.  They think secrets lie in the earth, and that is true, but hollowing and defiling the land is no way to earn its teachings.$B$BCollect the dwarven tools of digging, smash them, and return to me with the dwarves' broken tools.$B$BYou can smash the tools at a forge.  You will find one in Thunder Bluff, but any forge -- even a forge at the dwarven camp -- will suffice.

english.title: Dwarven Digging
english.objectives: Collect 5 Prospector's Picks.$B$BAt a forge, smash the Prospector's Picks to create Broken Tools.$B$BBring 5 Broken Tools to Ahmo Thunderhorn in Bloodhoof Village.
english.description: There are dwarves preparing a dig site to the northwest.  They think secrets lie in the earth, and that is true, but hollowing and defiling the land is no way to earn its teachings.$B$BCollect the dwarven tools of digging, smash them, and return to me with the dwarves' broken tools.$B$BYou can smash the tools at a forge.  You will find one in Thunder Bluff, but any forge -- even a forge at the dwarven camp -- will suffice.

text.title: Rites of the Earthmother
text.objectives: Take the Totem of Hawkwind to Ahmo Thunderhorn in Bloodhoof Village. Follow the road out of Camp Narache.
text.description: For you to continue with the Rites of the Earthmother you must pass two more tests. It is time for you to broaden your experience, $n.$b$bTravel to Bloodhoof Village and seek out the Ahmo Thunderhorn. There you may continue your journey and earn the acceptance of the elders of Thunder Bluff.$b$bTake this totem to Ahmo. He will recognize my carvings and help you on your path.$b$bFollow the road out of Camp Narache and travel with haste. Do not stray or you will lose your way.
text.completed: Return to Ahmo Thunderhorn at Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore.

english.title: Rites of the Earthmother
english.objectives: Take the Totem of Hawkwind to Ahmo Thunderhorn in Bloodhoof Village. Follow the road out of Camp Narache.
english.description: For you to continue with the Rites of the Earthmother you must pass two more tests. It is time for you to broaden your experience, $n.$b$bTravel to Bloodhoof Village and seek out the Ahmo Thunderhorn. There you may continue your journey and earn the acceptance of the elders of Thunder Bluff.$b$bTake this totem to Ahmo. He will recognize my carvings and help you on your path.$b$bFollow the road out of Camp Narache and travel with haste. Do not stray or you will lose your way.
english.completed: Return to Ahmo Thunderhorn at Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore.

text.title: 土地之争
text.objectives: 杀死15个白鬃豺狼人，然后回到血蹄村向艾莫·雷角复命。
text.description: 这片土地上有很多纷争，$n。我希望你不会象我们的长老一样经历那么多的战争，不过我还是希望你去做一件事，让你可以了解到，一个看似不值一提的小小威胁如果不加制止的话，会对我们的领土带来多大的危害。$B$B白鬃豺狼人已经在西边的一个洞穴中和血蹄村的南边扎了营。我们曾试图和他们交流，却被他们无理地拒绝了，而且他们还大肆屠杀莫高雷的野生动物。$B$B现在语言已经不能解决问题了，我们必须有所行动。
text.completion: $N, it is good you've taken the task seriously. Respect of the land and its creatures is important. Death and life are a circle... a necessity. One cannot exist without the other. Take time to ponder this and do well to never forget it.

english.title: Sharing the Land
english.objectives: Kill 15 Palemane Gnolls then return to Ahmo Thunderhorn in Bloodhoof Village.
english.description: $n, there are many conflicts that wound this land. It is my hope that you will not bear witness to as many of them as our elders have. Yet there is one that I would ask you to seek. It will give you some sense of how terrible, if left unchecked, even a small threat can be to the land.$B$BPalemane gnolls have settled to the south of Bloodhoof and in a cave to the west. They disrespect our attempts to communicate with them, and they slay the wildlife of Mulgore unbridled.$B$BWords are no longer the answer.
english.completion: $N, it is good you've taken the task seriously. Respect of the land and its creatures is important. Death and life are a circle... a necessity. One cannot exist without the other. Take time to ponder this and do well to never forget it.

text.title: Journey into Thunder Bluff
text.objectives: Speak with Baine Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff.
text.description: You will now be revered within our great city. Any $r worthy of completing the Rites of the Earthmother earns that honor.$b$bFor your final quest, seek out our young leader, Baine Bloodhoof, who dwells atop the highest mesa in Thunder Bluff.

english.title: Journey into Thunder Bluff
english.objectives: Speak with Baine Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff.
english.description: You will now be revered within our great city. Any $r worthy of completing the Rites of the Earthmother earns that honor.$b$bFor your final quest, seek out our young leader, Baine Bloodhoof, who dwells atop the highest mesa in Thunder Bluff.

text.title: Rites of the Earthmother
text.objectives: Baine Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff wants you to bring him the Horn of Arra'chea.
text.description: You have passed the Rites of the Earthmother and earned your place in Thunder Bluff.$b$bBut in order to maintain the spot that you strived so hard to achieve, you must continue to prove your worth to your people.$b$bWe are hunters, $n. Down below in Mulgore there is a mighty kodo named Arra'chea. Show me your skills in the ways of tracking and hunting by bringing me the Horn of Arra'chea.
text.completed: Return to Baine Bloodhoof (Leader) in Desolace.

english.title: Rites of the Earthmother
english.objectives: Baine Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff wants you to bring him the Horn of Arra'chea.
english.description: You have passed the Rites of the Earthmother and earned your place in Thunder Bluff.$b$bBut in order to maintain the spot that you strived so hard to achieve, you must continue to prove your worth to your people.$b$bWe are hunters, $n. Down below in Mulgore there is a mighty kodo named Arra'chea. Show me your skills in the ways of tracking and hunting by bringing me the Horn of Arra'chea.
english.completed: Return to Baine Bloodhoof (Leader) in Desolace.

text.title: Garrosh's Autograph
text.objectives: Travel to Grommash Hold in the heart of Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength to see about getting Garrosh Hellscream's autograph for your ward.
text.description: They say that Garrosh Hellscream is one of the greatest heroes in the Horde! When I grow up, I want to be a hero of the Horde too!$B$BDo you know Garrosh, $N? Could you do me a favor, please? Could you get his autograph for me? I dunno how to ask him, and he probably wouldn't listen to someone like me... but you! You're an adventurer, like him! I bet he'd give you his autograph easy!$B$BPlease?
text.completed: Return to Orcish Orphan.

english.objectives: Travel to Grommash Hold in the heart of Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength to see about getting Garrosh Hellscream's autograph for your ward.
