I bet he'd give you his autograph easy!$B$BPlease?
english.completed: Return to Orcish Orphan.

text.title: 钟爱的实验品
text.objectives: 在艾萨拉的秘密实验室附近找到九号实验品。
text.description: 我不知道你注意到没有，$n，整个秘密实验室已经一锅粥了！角鹰兽都损失掉也就算了，可我最重要的实验体失踪了：九号实验品！$B$B九号实验品是我们从贫瘠之地进口的一只迅猛龙。我寻思她还活着么？去主楼西侧上面看看，就在秘密火箭附近，你准能找到。
text.completed: 在艾萨拉的秘密实验室附近找到九号实验品。

english.title: My Favorite Subject
english.objectives: Locate Subject Nine somewhere near the Secret Lab complex in Azshara.
english.description: I don't know if you've noticed $n, but this whole lab complex has gone south of cheese! I don't mind writing off all those hippogryphs, but my most prized experiment has gone missing: Subject Nine!$B$BSubject Nine is a raptor we imported from the Barrens. I wonder - is she still alive? Try checking above the main complex west of here, near the giant top secret rocket. You can't miss it.
english.completed: Locate Subject Nine somewhere near the Secret Lab complex in Azshara.

text.title: 残破的剑柄
text.objectives: 将残破的剑柄交给奎尔德拉之冢的卡莱迪斯·亮矛。他就在银色比武场的南边。
text.description: 这把残破的剑柄也有过好日子。当它的剑刃还没有折断的时候，它应该是代表着高超铸造工艺的一件杰出作品。$B$B它上面的精致雕刻和奇异宝石表明这件武器可能属于一个非常强大的人。银色盟约一定会对它感兴趣的。去找到他们在奎尔德拉之冢的代表人。他应该就在银色比武场的南边。

english.title: The Battered Hilt
english.objectives: Bring the Battered Hilt to Caladis Brightspear at Quel'Delar's rest, south of the Argent Tournament Grounds.
english.description: This battered old sword hilt has seen better days. Before the hilt was snapped from the blade, it must've been a magnificent example of the blacksmith's art.$B$BThe graceful symbols and exotic gemstones decorating the hilt suggest that the weapon may have belonged to a powerful person. Surely, the Silver Covenant members would be interested in hearing about the recovery of such an artifact. Seek out their representative at Quel'Delar's Rest, south of the Argent Tournament Grounds.

text.title: 巨龙所知道的
text.objectives: 同龙眠神殿顶端的克拉苏斯交谈。
text.description: 肯定错不了——这把剑柄曾经是一件古老强大的武器。但具体情况我就不清楚了。我从没有见过或听说过有这种花纹标记的剑。但这不代表没有人认识它。$B$B克里奥斯塔兹，他更广为人知的名字是克拉苏斯。他一直都是奎尔多雷和肯瑞托的朋友，并拥有广博无边的知识学养。对此他一定知道些什么。到龙眠神殿的顶端，向他询问一下这件事。然后向达拉然银色领地的奥术师泰拜林报告。

english.title: What The Dragons Know
english.objectives: Speak to Krasus at the top of Wyrmrest Temple.
english.description: There's no mistaking it - this hilt comes from a powerful, ancient weapon, but which one? I do not recall seeing or hearing of a sword with these markings, but that doesn't mean that all is lost.$B$BKorialstrasz, better known as Krasus, has long been a friend to the quel'dorei and the Kirin Tor. With his vast knowledge and resources, he's certain to know something. Travel to the top of Wyrmrest Temple and seek his counsel, then report to Arcanist Tybalin inside the Silver Enclave in Dalaran.

objectiveDetails.description: 询问克拉苏斯关于刀柄的来历

text.title: 暂时的离别
text.objectives: 跟失落群岛荒野瞭望台的莎希·硬钳谈一谈。
text.description: 我们的命运永远交织在一起。某种诡异的力量正在重塑这个世界，最终将摧毁我们生活的家园。我们必须尽快阻止惨剧的发生。$B$B$g兄弟:姐妹;，记住，我永远是你值得信赖的朋友！我们会在对岸再见面的。祝你平安，$n。
text.completion: Wow, oh wow! Is that who I think it is?$B$BYou rescued Thrall, Warchief of the Horde?!!!$B$B<Sassy $g gives you an appraising look : looks envious of you;.>$B$BWell, let's see about getting over to that larger island. I sure as heck don't want to swim the strait with all of those sharks down there.

english.title: Farewell, For Now
english.objectives: Speak with Sassy Hardwrench at the Wild Overlook on the Lost Isles.
english.description: Our destinies are forever intertwined. There are events taking place that are reshaping our world and ultimately will destroy it. We must put an end to them before it is too late.$B$BKnow that you can always count on me, $g brother : sister;! We will meet again on the larger island. May you find peace until then, $n.
english.completion: Wow, oh wow! Is that who I think it is?$B$BYou rescued Thrall, Warchief of the Horde?!!!$B$B<Sassy $g gives you an appraising look : looks envious of you;.>$B$BWell, let's see about getting over to that larger island. I sure as heck don't want to swim the strait with all of those sharks down there.

text.title: Cataclysm!
text.objectives: Nambria wants you to peer into the Waters of Farseeing.
text.description: Hear my words, $c!$b$bThe winds of change have gathered into a violent storm that sweeps across Azeroth.$b$bHave you the courage to face the true cause of our plight?$b$bMuster your resolve, $r, and pray for the strength and fortune to see you through the trials that await.$b$bAn unexpected ally has issued a call for all that would hear. Peer into the Waters of Farseeing and behold the fate of the world!

english.objectives: Nambria wants you to peer into the Waters of Farseeing.
english.description: Hear my words, $c!$b$bThe winds of change have gathered into a violent storm that sweeps across Azeroth.$b$bHave you the courage to face the true cause of our plight?$b$bMuster your resolve, $r, and pray for the strength and fortune to see you through the trials that await.$b$bAn unexpected ally has issued a call for all that would hear. Peer into the Waters of Farseeing and behold the fate of the world!

objectiveDetails.description: Peer into the Waters of Farseeing

text.title: Takes One to Know One
text.objectives: Sky-Reaver Korm wants you to speak to Koltira Deathweaver on Orgrim's Hammer.
text.description: While we should never miss an opportunity to strike out against the Alliance, we mustn't forget about the Scourge.$b$bWe won't have the numbers here to make a proper assault in the glacier for weeks, but that won't keep us from learning all we can know about their defenses.$b$bI have asked our resident death knight to advise you in this effort. After all, who better knows this enemy than they?$b$bAllow me to introduce Koltira Deathweaver.

text.title: 第一步
text.objectives: 从纳拉其营地往东，沿着小径去找格鲁尔·鹰风。
text.description: 你看到的这些都是野猪人的杰作，年轻人。他们年复一年地侵害我们的村子。大灾变最终把他们从巢穴里赶了出来，让他们如蝗虫般蔓延在大地上，于是就有了现在你看到的这种结果。我的母亲，也是死在他们的暴行之下。$B$B今天，你成年了。今天，你将拿起武器，为部落而战，为我的母亲复仇。沿着小径往东，找到我的儿子格鲁尔。他会带领你攻打野猪人。
text.completion: Welcome to your first true test as a $r.

english.title: The First Step
english.objectives: Follow the path East out of Camp Narache and find Grull Hawkwind.
english.description: What you see here is the work of the quilboar, young one. Year after year they have encroached on our village. The great cataclysm finally drove them from their dens to spread like locusts across the land, and now you see the result; my own mother, dead from their savagery.$B$BToday, you are of age. Today, you will take up your weapon and fight for the tribe, and avenge the Greatmother. Follow the path to the east, and find my son, Grull. He will lead you in our strike against the quilboar.
english.completion: Welcome to your first true test as a $r.

text.title: 隨機掉落物測試過程
text.objectives: 取得10份運作中的小裝置。
text.description: 這個任務測試的隨機掉寶機率會逐漸提高。

english.title: Random Drop Test Progressive
english.objectives: Get 10 Progressive Widgets.
english.description: This quest tests random drops with progressive drop percentage.

text.title: 隨機掉落物相同機率
text.objectives: 取得10份扁平的小裝置。
text.description: 這個任務測試的隨機掉寶機率百分比會始終保持相同。

english.title: Random Drop Flat Rate
english.objectives: Get 10 Flat Widgets.
english.description: This quest tests random drops with flat rate drop percentage.

text.title: 力量仪祭
text.objectives: 杀死6头刺背野猪人。
text.description: 看吧，$n。刺背野猪人的存在就是一个祸害。他们所到之处留下的只有尸体和贫瘠的土地。要不了几天，纳拉其营地也会变得和这里一样，除非我们奋起反抗。$B$B这将是你的力量仪祭，一名牛头人勇士的第一道试炼。到纠棘荒地的心脏地带去，消灭刺背野猪人，然后回来找我。
text.completion: You've fought well, $N. We may yet be saved.

english.title: Rite of Strength
english.objectives: Kill 6 Bristleback Invaders.
english.description: Behold, $n. The very presence of the Bristleback is a blight. Nothing is left in their wake but corpses and barren land. Camp Narache could become what we see here in but a few days, unless we stand and fight.$B$BThis will be your Rite of Strength; the first ceremony of a tauren brave. Go into the heart of the thornsnarl and kill Bristleback quilboar, then return to me.
english.completion: You've fought well, $N. We may yet be saved.

text.title: A Humble Task
text.objectives: Chief Hawkwind wants you to search for his mother near the water well to the southeast of Camp Narache.
text.description: All members of the tribe share in the harmony of life. We live together and work together.$b$bOur commitment to one another carries with it a high degree of responsibility. I ask of you now a humble task.$b$bMy mother set out this morning to fetch water from the well to the southeast of Narache. It has been quite some time now. Perhaps you could check on her for me while I attend to tribal matters here?

english.title: A Humble Task
english.objectives: Chief Hawkwind wants you to search for his mother near the water well to the southeast of Camp Narache.
english.description: All members of the tribe share in the harmony of life. We live together and work together.$b$bOur commitment to one another carries with it a high degree of responsibility. I ask of you now a humble task.$b$bMy mother set out this morning to fetch water from the well to the southeast of Narache. It has been quite some time now. Perhaps you could check on her for me while I attend to tribal matters here?

text.title: The Captured Warrior
text.objectives: Obtain a Crude Key from one of the Bristleback Quilboar, and use it to unlock the Quilboar Cage holding Brave Sharphorn.
text.description: The quilboar have not only razed our buildings, but have taken tauren captives. I saw them take Brave Sharphorn, a young warrior trainer of ours, away in one of their foul cages.  Please, find a key on one of the quilboar's bodies and go save him!

english.title: The Captured Warrior
english.objectives: Obtain a Crude Key from one of the Bristleback Quilboar, and use it to unlock the Quilboar Cage holding Brave Sharphorn.
english.description: The quilboar have not only razed our buildings, but have taken tauren captives. I saw them take Brave Sharphorn, a young warrior trainer of ours, away in one of their foul cages.  Please, find a key on one of the quilboar's bodies and go save him!

text.title: 阻止号角手
text.objectives: 杀死7名刺背号角手。
text.description: 了解你的猎物是狩猎的另一个重要部分。在他们的老家，这些野猪人居住在巨大荆棘树根的树荫庇护下。他们搬家的时候，萨满祭司就会种下新的树根，让他们居住。$B$B这些荆棘玷污着大地，扼杀了其他的生命，将周围的土地变得贫瘠不堪。到南方去，$n，在这些号角手们得以继续之前阻止他们。
text.completion: With the corruptors slain, the Earth Mother will mend her own wounds in due time.  The roots are not meant to thrive here, and will wither.  Balance will return.

english.title: Stop the Thorncallers
english.objectives: Kill 7 Bristleback Thorncallers.
english.description: Knowing the ways of your prey is another aspect of the hunt. In the lands they come from, quilboar live in the shade and protection of huge thorned roots. When they move, their shamans seed and grow new roots for them to live in.$B$BThese thorns mar the land and choke out other life, turning the earth around them barren.  Go to the south and stop these thorncallers before they have a chance to continue, $n.
english.completion: With the corruptors slain, the Earth Mother will mend her own wounds in due time.  The roots are not meant to thrive here, and will wither.  Balance will return.

text.title: 勇气仪祭
text.objectives: 从刺背枪匪身上夺回7把被偷走的步枪。
text.description: 你要学的第一课，$n，就是绝不要低估你的猎物。$B$B我们被纳拉其营地的攻击所吸引的时候，更多的刺背野猪人偷偷地冲了进来，偷走了我们的一箱步枪。你可以到南边找到他们，正在朝天乱开枪。$B$B这是你的勇气仪祭：冒着枪林弹雨，猎杀刺背枪匪，把我们的步枪夺回来。
text.progress: How many have you brought me, initiate?
text.completion: Well done, $n. Respect your prey, and the danger it carries, but never fear it. In fear, you become prey yourself.

english.title: Rite of Courage
english.objectives: Recover 7 Stolen Rifles from Bristleback Gun Thieves.
english.description: One of the first lessons you should learn, $n, is to never underestimate your prey.$B$BWhile we were distracted by the attack on Camp Narache, more of the Bristleback swept in unnoticed and stole a cache of our rifles. You can see them to the south now, filling the air with lead.$B$BThis is your Rite of Courage: brave the hail of gunfire, hunt the Bristleback gun thieves, and bring back our rifles.
english.progress: How many have you brought me, initiate?
english.completion: Well done, $n. Respect your prey, and the danger it carries, but never fear it. In fear, you become prey yourself.

text.title: 夺日者的计划
text.objectives: 取得夺日者命令。
text.description: 我在达拉然下水道的一个线人发现一名夺日者密探正在从黑市的一名商人手里购买药剂。夺日者通常不会出现在那些下水道里。他们在那里一定有着某种不可告人的计划。$B$B到达拉然下水道去，找到那名夺日者密探，把他处理掉，然后在他身上寻找一切有用的情报。也许我们能从他身上知道那部龙眠宝典的所在位置。我们绝不能让夺日者的人把它带回到冰冠冰川去。

english.title: The Sunreaver Plan
english.objectives: Obtain the Sunreaver Orders.
english.description: One of my contacts in the Underbelly caught sight of a Sunreaver agent buying reagents from a dealer in the Black Market area. The Sunreavers normally aren't known for their interest in what goes on down in the sewers, so that's a big indication that they're planning something.$B$BHead into the Underbelly, find this Sunreaver agent, and take care of him. Search the body for any information that might give us a lead on the location of that tome from Wyrmrest. We can't let them get it back to Icecrown first.

text.title: 去找阿达娜
text.objectives: 去找西南方的阿达娜·雷角。
text.description: 我们对野猪人造成了不小的一击。我将留在这里，守卫阵线，但你还得继续前进。$B$B去找阿达娜·雷角，她带了几个卫兵前往西南方剿除剩下的刺背野猪人去了。
text.completion: More trials lay ahead, $N. I hope you're prepared.

english.title: Go to Adana
english.objectives: Go to Adana Thunderhorn to the Southwest.
english.description: We've struck a great blow against the quilboar here. I will stay here, and hold the line, but you need to move on.$B$BSeek Adana Thunderhorn; she has taken a few braves to the southwest to root out the rest of the Bristleback.
english.completion: More trials lay ahead, $N. I hope you're prepared.

text.title: 斗猪
text.objectives: 杀死10头重甲斗猪。
text.description: 还有很多其他威胁需要对付。刺背野猪人正在驯化野猪对付我们。$B$B这些重甲斗猪已经丧失了恢复的希望，为了我们的安全和它们的平和，必须将其打倒。到南边的围栏去把它们杀掉，$n。然后再回来找我。
text.completion: Good work, $n.  Those beasts could have been a greater threat than the quilboar themselves, if we had not taken action now.

english.title: The Battleboars
english.objectives: Kill 10 Armored Battleboars.
english.description: There are more threats to be dealt with here.  The Bristleback are taming wild boars to be used against us.$B$BThese armored battleboars have been abused beyond hope of recovery; they must be put down, for our safety and their peace.  Go to the pens to the south and slay them, $n. Return to me afterwards.
english.completion: Good work, $n.  Those beasts could have been a greater threat than the quilboar themselves, if we had not taken action now.

text.title: 荣誉仪祭
text.objectives: 杀掉尖啸·刺鬃酋长。
text.description: 领导这些野猪人的是尖啸·刺鬃酋长。就是他攻击了鹰风酋长的母亲，夺走了她的性命，指挥着对纳拉其营地的进攻。在此之后，他逃遁隐匿了起来，但我们已经找到他了。他就潜伏在西边肮脏的荆棘洞穴里，抵抗着我们派去的卫兵。$B$B你已经证明了自己是一名勇敢的保卫者，$n。杀掉刺鬃，把他的鬃毛带给鹰风酋长，为了鹰风酋长的母亲的荣誉！
text.progress: Have you completed your trials, young one?
text.completion: <Chief Hawkwind holds the mane of Thornmantle over his head.>$B$BThe Chief of the Bristleback is slain. Greatmother Hawkwind's spirit has been avenged!

english.title: Rite of Honor
english.objectives: Kill Chief Squealer Thornmantle.
english.description: Chief Squealer Thornmantle leads these quilboar. It was he that set upon Greatmother Hawkwind and took her life, leading the attack on Camp Narache. He fled and hid afterwards, but we've found him. He lurks to the west within his foul den of thorns, fending off any braves we send in after him.$B$BYou've proven yourself as a brave defender of our people, $n. Kill Thornmantle and bring his mane back to Chief Hawkwind, in honor of our Greatmother!
english.progress: Have you completed your trials, young one?
english.completion: <Chief Hawkwind holds the mane of Thornmantle over his head.>$B$BThe Chief of the Bristleback is slain. Greatmother Hawkwind's spirit has been avenged!

text.title: 邪恶的食粮
text.objectives: 用阿达娜的火炬烧掉斗猪围栏里的3处食槽。
text.description: 我们不能光是捕杀野猪。留在这片土地上的污糟必须被净化。$B$B为了让斗猪疯狂嗜血，它们被强迫喂食生肉。拿上这把火炬，用它把盛有血肉的食槽烧毁。
text.completion: You've not only wiped the boar pens clean, but put a stop to a horrible desecration.  Well done.

english.title: Feed of Evil
english.objectives: Use Adana's Torch to set fire to all 3 Troughs in the Battleboar Pens.
english.description: We must do more than simply hunt boars here. The eyesore that has been left upon the land must be purged.$B$BTo give them a wild thirst for blood, the battleboars are force-fed raw flesh. Take this torch, and use it to burn the troughs of meat and gore to cinders.
english.completion: You've not only wiped the boar pens clean, but put a stop to a horrible desecration.  Well done.

text.title: 我的头呢？
text.objectives: 你被派去塔伦迪斯营地北部塔底同地精刺客史莉琪·剃刀会面。
text.description: 他来了，$n！格伦沃德队长是从北方城堡调来的联盟高级军官，无疑是来协同暗夜精灵盟军攻打奥格瑞玛的。我们观察到他进驻了西南边的高塔。我要他的项上人头，$c，我要把它送回北方城堡煞煞敌人的威风！$B$B我已经派了地精刺客史莉琪·剃刀前去，可她至今未归。到塔那儿去找她，把我要的人头带来！
text.completed: 在艾萨拉塔伦迪斯营地的北部哨塔与地精刺客史莉琪·剃刀会面。

english.title: Where's My Head?
english.objectives: You've been sent to meet with the goblin assassin Slinky Sharpshiv at the base of the northern tower of Talrendis Point.
english.description: He's here, $n! Captain Grunwald is a high-ranking Alliance officer from Northwatch Hold, no doubt here to coordinate an assault on Orgrimmar with his night elven allies. We have observed him entering the tower southwest of here. I want his head, $c. I want to send it back to Northwatch to drive a wedge between our enemies!$B$BI've sent a goblin assassin, Slinky Sharpshiv, to the tower but she hasn't returned. Go find her. And get me that head!
english.completed: Meet with the goblin assassin Slinky Sharpshiv at the base of the northern tower of Talrendis Point in Azshara.

text.title: 暮湾镇的马匹
text.objectives: 跟暮湾镇的格温·阿姆斯特谈一谈。
text.description: 这些马匹或许能拯救镇上的居民。暮湾镇有很多马车，却没有足够马匹驱使。$B$B请转告阿姆斯特镇长，你救回来的马匹任由她处置。$B$B我还有点事要准备，之后就会跟你们汇合了。
text.completion: Excellent work, $N.  I think I speak for everyone when I say the sooner we get out of here, the better.

english.title: Horses for Duskhaven
english.objectives: Speak to Gwen Armstead in Duskhaven.
english.description: Saving the horses might've saved the rest of the town.  They have plenty of carriages in Duskhaven, but not enough horses to pull them.$B$BGo tell Mayor Armstead that the horses you saved are at her disposal.$B$BI'll get things ready and join you in a bit.
english.completion: Excellent work, $N.  I think I speak for everyone when I say the sooner we get out of here, the better.

text.title: 一闪必杀
text.objectives: 同史莉琪·剃刀对话，然后爬上塔顶，刺杀格伦沃德队长，拿下格伦沃德的徽记。
text.description: 塔底下有队长的精英守卫把守，所以我们的计划是这样的：用钩爪直接爬到顶，把VIP大卸八块，用我的便携式低空降落伞跳下来。我会用炸药把塔掀上天，格伦沃德队长的徽记就交给你了，卡乌格要。明白了吗？$B$B除非你非常强力，否则就不要接下这桩差事，懂不懂？
text.giverWindow: 你需要拿到他的徽记。干活儿吧。

english.title: Lightning Strike Assassination
english.objectives: Talk to Slinky Sharpshiv to ascend the tower and assassinate Captain Grunwald. Collect Captain Grunwald's head.
english.description: The base of the tower is patrolled by the Captain's elite guards. So here's what we're going to do: we're going to grapple straight up to the top, slice-and-dice the VIPs, and bail out using my portable low-altitude parachute. I'll rig the tower to explode behind us. You be sure to grab Captain Grunwald's head for Chawg. Got it?$B$BDo NOT accept this mission unless you are prepared for UNMITIGATED BADASSERY. Is that clear?
english.giverWindow: Here's the head you need to collect. Let's roll.

text.title: 前往格雷迈恩庄园
text.objectives: 跟格雷迈恩庄园的米亚·格雷迈恩王后谈一谈。
text.description: 撤离的时候到了。$n，你也走吧。去格雷迈恩庄园，其他人很快就到。$B$B别担心我，我会确保所有人安全地离开这里，包括围栏里的那几只野性未驯的小兽。$B$B跟格雷迈恩王后谈一谈，向她解释形势的严重性。
text.completion: $N.  I've heard much about you.$B$BI understand you were crucial in my family's survival during the outbreak in Gilneas City.

english.title: To Greymane Manor
english.objectives: Speak to Queen Mia Greymane inside Greymane Manor.
english.description: It's time for everyone to head to safety.  That includes you, $n.  Head to Greymane Manor, the others will be there shortly.$B$BDon't worry about me, I'll make sure that everyone makes it out of here in one piece.  Yes, even the few ferals we have in the pens.$B$BOnce you get there, speak to Queen Greymane about the gravity of the situation.
english.completion: $N.  I've heard much about you.$B$BI understand you were crucial in my family's survival during the outbreak in Gilneas City.

text.title: 国王的瞭望台
text.objectives: 跟格雷迈恩庄园瞭望台的吉恩·格雷迈恩国王谈一谈。
text.description: 你应该跟吉恩·格雷迈恩国王谈一谈。这场灾难爆发以来，他就一直把自己锁在瞭望台中。$B$B我知道，他在思考如何才能拯救吉尔尼斯的子民。他是一个坚强的国王。
text.completion: There you are, $N.  I've been expecting you.$B$BI got word of your recovery and... wait -- do you feel that?

english.title: The King's Observatory
english.objectives: Speak to King Genn Greymane in the observatory inside Greymane Manor.
english.description: You ought to speak to Genn.  He's been locked up in his observatory ever since this ordeal started.$B$BI'm sure he's working on a plan for his people.  He's a very stubborn individual.
english.completion: There you are, $N.  I've been expecting you.$B$BI got word of your recovery and... wait -- do you feel that?

text.title: 天哪，吉尔尼斯！
text.completion: Look, $N!  Look at what's become of Duskhaven!$B$BLook at what's become of the last safe place in Gilneas!

english.title: Alas, Gilneas!
english.completion: Look, $N!  Look at what's become of Duskhaven!$B$BLook at what's become of the last safe place in Gilneas!

text.title: 天降美差
text.objectives: 向凄凉山的指挥官莫洛托夫报到。
text.description: 哦我要给你个好差事！感受异国风情，进行史诗般的冒险，大显身手，还能赚个腰包鼓鼓！听上去挺忽悠人的是吗？其实不然——我们就是干这个的！$B$B要是你有意，到北边凄凉山上的加里维克斯防御站去找指挥官莫洛托夫便是。

english.title: Another Warm Body
english.objectives: Report to Commander Molotov on Forlorn Ridge.
english.description: Oh have I got a deal for you! Immerse yourself in foreign cultures, go on epic adventures, blow things up, and get paid to do it! Sound too good to be true? Well it's not - this is what we do!$B$BIf you're interested, head over to Gallywix Defense Post on Forlorn Ridge to the north and look for Commander Molotov.

text.title: 接过同志的包
text.objectives: 从中央雷区回收12个军事补给包。
text.description: 要紧事排第一——我们得给你和别的新兵弄些补给。北边雷区里，上一拨新兵的尸体上正有些新发下来的标准补给包。$B$B记住他们的教训，我建议你别踩雷上。

english.title: Hand-me-downs
english.objectives: Retrieve 12 Military Supply Packs from the central minefield.
english.description: First things first - we need more supplies for you and the other new recruits. There are some perfectly good standard issue packs on the bodies of our last round of recruits, in the minefield to the north.$B$BTaking their lessons to heart, I'd recommend you avoid stepping on mines yourself.

text.title: 军事突破
text.objectives: 杀死军阀克雷利安并夺回SFG。
text.description: 我们和部署在中央雷区北部山脊的戴纳莫中士失去了联系。多半被敌人消灭了。$B$B他手上拿着我们最后一挺SFG。去把它夺回来，干掉那些突破防线的纳迦。

english.title: Military Breakthrough
english.objectives: Kill Warlord Krellian and recover the SFG.
english.description: We've lost contact with Sergeant Dynamo, stationed at the next ridge to the north of the central minefield. They were probably overrun.$B$BHe had our last SFG. Go over there and get it back. Clear out any naga that have broken through while you're there.

text.title: 一级准备
text.objectives: 用地精迫击炮杀掉60只恶鞭攻击者。
text.description: 嘿老兄！喜欢炸药么？你当然喜欢啦。谁不喜欢炸药？！$B$B我在东边山脊上架了几挺迫击炮压制纳迦。去吧，新兵。炸了他们……把他们全炸了！啊哈哈哈。

english.title: First Degree Mortar
english.objectives: Use a Goblin Mortar to slaughter 60 Spitelash Attackers.
english.description: Hey bud! Like explosions? Of course you do. Who doesn't like explosions?!$B$BI've got mortars set up on the ridge to the east to hold the naga back. Go forth, recruit. Mortar them... mortar them all! Ahahahah.

objectiveDetails.description: 将恶鞭攻击者炸成碎片

text.title: 正中面门！
text.objectives: 用SFG杀掉南部雷区的被奴役的亚考罗克之子。
text.description: 纳迦在用巨人趟雷。该SFG大显身手了！$B$B到南部雷区入口去——我想你了解其余的步骤。

english.title: In The Face!
english.objectives: Use an SFG to kill an Enslaved Son of Arkkoroc in the southern minefield.
english.description: The naga are using those giants to stamp paths through our minefields. Time to put that SFG to use!$B$BHead over to the entrance to the southern minefield - I think you can figure out the rest.

text.title: 收拾烂摊子
text.objectives: 杀死6只刺角雏龙。
text.description: 这些死猴子什么都偷！竟然连刺角龙母的蛋也偷来了，惹得那只母兽发了狂。更糟糕的是，蛋陆续开始孵化了！这里到处都是饥饿的刺角雏龙，想把我们当做美餐！$B$B本来是死猴子的错，却要我们来收拾烂摊子。进入丛林杀死刺角雏龙，不然我们都会被吃掉的。
text.completion: Let's just hope we don't have to deal with their mommy later. That would be very bad.

english.title: It's Our Problem Now
english.objectives: Slay 6 Teraptor Hatchlings.
english.description: Looks like those monkeys will steal anything! Those thieving little monsters have driven the teraptor matriarch into a frenzy by stealing her eggs. Worse yet, the eggs have started to hatch! We've got hungry teraptor hatchlings running around all over the place, looking to make a quick meal out of us!$B$BWe didn't start this, but it's our problem now. You'll have to head into the jungle and kill those hungry teraptor hatchlings before they kill us all.
english.completion: Let's just hope we don't have to deal with their mommy later. That would be very bad.

text.title: 地精逃生舱
text.objectives: 营救6名地精幸存者。
text.description: $n，对不起，我以为你死了！$B$B太可怕了。我们的船卷进了联盟与部落的混战！$B$B落难的兄弟姐妹们还在等待救援。$B$B<他指着漂浮在附近海面上的逃生舱。>$B$B我得再坐会儿喘口气。你去救他们如何？穿上这双热电液压蛙蹼吧，它可以提升游泳速度。$B$B请转告莎希，我待会就跟她汇合。
text.completion: Oh, thank heavens that you survived, $N! I thought for sure that you'd drowned when I saw you go over the side!$B$B<Sassy's eyes fill up with tears as she hugs you.>$B$BLook at all of these folks you saved!

english.title: Goblin Escape Pods
english.objectives: Rescue 6 Goblin Survivors.
english.description: $n, I'm sorry, I thought you were dead!$B$BThis is just crazy. We sailed into a fight between the Alliance and Horde!$B$BYou know, our brothers and sisters still need to be rescued.$B$B<He points out all of the escape pods in the water around you.>$B$BI think I'm going to sit here a while longer and catch my breath. Can you swim around and let them out? Take my pair of thermohydratic flippers so you can get around faster.$B$BLet Sassy know that I'll swim in shortly.
english.completion: Oh, thank heavens that you survived, $N! I thought for sure that you'd drowned when I saw you go over the side!$B$B<Sassy's eyes fill up with tears as she hugs you.>$B$BLook at all of these folks you saved!

text.title: 落地！
text.objectives: 在塔伦迪斯营地最南边的暗夜精灵塔找到掷弹兵队长斯莫科斯。
text.description: 你知道这些驭风者的问题在哪儿么，$n？它们驭不了什么风！我送上天的每一头都叫暗夜精灵狙击手给拍下来了。$B$B塔伦迪斯神射手在最南边的塔里藏着，依山靠险。我派一个地精矬子去端掉它，可就没收到回音。去把掷弹兵队长斯莫科斯找出来，抽上几下催活儿鞭子。
text.completed: 在艾萨拉塔伦迪斯营地的南部暗夜精灵塔找到掷弹兵队长斯莫科斯。

english.title: Grounded!
english.objectives: Find Bombardier Captain Smooks at the southernmost night elf tower at Talrendis Point.
english.description: Do you see a problem with these wind riders, $n? They're not riding the wind! Every flight I send aloft gets peppered by night elf snipers.$B$BTalrendis sharpshooters are holed up in the southern-most tower, against the mountains. I sent one of these little goblin scrubs to take care of the tower, but I haven't heard a word from him. Go find Bombardier Captain Smooks and beat him with the hurry stick!
english.completed: Find Bombardier Captain Smooks at the southernmost night elf tower at Talrendis Point in Azshara.

text.title: 遥控引爆
text.objectives: 在塔伦迪斯营地南部塔底附近给3个炸药束接上引信。
text.description: 这座塔位于大炮射程之外，所以我想，我们要不就使老法子，派人去装炸药炸掉它。所有的炸药都装好了，可要接起爆器的时候我们给打了回来。$B$B$n！去那儿把我们在塔底安好的三个起爆器点上。

english.title: Rigged to Blow
english.objectives: Arm the three Explosive Charges located around the base of the southern-most tower at Talrendis Point.
english.description: This tower was out of cannon range, so I thought we'd blow it up the old-fashioned way - in person. We set all the main charges but the guards fought us back before we could arm the detonators.$B$B$n! Get up there and arm the three detonators we placed around the base of the tower. Those things are wired into a pack of thermals I set up along the spine... It'll be some show!

text.title: 摁开关！
text.objectives: 引爆炸药！
text.description: 让我查一下连线……没问题了。您赏脸，$n。摁。摁开关！$B$B摁开关啊，$n！$B$B焰火放完后去瓦罗莫克找克隆姆，告诉他天上安全了。$B$B你倒是摁哪！
text.completed: 向艾萨拉瓦罗莫克的克隆姆复命。

english.title: Push the Button!
english.objectives: Detonate the explosives!
english.description: Lemme check the connections... and we're set. You do the honors, $n. Push it. Push the button!$B$BPush the button, $n!$B$BAfter the fireworks, go tell Kroum back at Valormok that his skies are clear.$B$BPush the button!
english.completed: Report to Kroum at Valormok in Azshara.

text.title: 鱼肚行动
text.objectives: 向锈水港主炮下的指挥官莫洛托夫报到。
text.description: 锈水营现在为鱼肚行动开始征兵。$B$B工钱1个金币，任务完成后结清，童叟无欺。死了没钱拿。因公殉职，复活每次20银币。$B$B所有新兵都要向主炮下的指挥官莫洛托夫报到。

english.title: Operation Fishgut
english.objectives: Report for active duty to Commander Molotov under the main cannon in Bilgewater Harbor.
english.description: The Bilgewater Battalion are now accepting recruits for OPERATION FISHGUT.$B$BWages will consist of 1 gold piece at the time of operation completion for all active soldiers in good standing. All wages will be forfeited in the event of death. A fee of 20 silver will be charged for any resurrections performed in the line of duty.$B$BAll recruits are to report for duty directly to Commander Molotov under the main cannon.

text.title: 人手多的是
text.objectives: 乘火箭前往破碎海岸，向德雷克斯中尉报到。
text.description: 家常就唠到这儿。赶快行动起来，上火箭了，士兵。$B$B记住了，死了不给钱。

english.title: There Are Many Like It
english.objectives: Use a rocket to reach the Shattered Strand, and then report for duty to Lieutenant Drex.
english.description: Enough small talk. Get off your butt and onto a rocket, soldier.$B$BAnd remember, you don't get paid if you're dead.

text.title: 灭绝
text.objectives: 在埃达拉斯废墟里杀死30只恶鞭纳迦。
text.description: 我们派你去清理这次纳迦泛滥。准许使用致命武力。$B$B地精小队这次会给你作支援，所以应该是小菜一碟。

english.title: Extermination
english.objectives: Kill 30 Spitelash Naga in the Ruins of Eldarath.
english.description: We're sending you in there to clean up this naga infestation. Lethal force has been authorized.$B$BGob Squad will be backing you up on this one, so it should be a cakewalk.

text.title: Into The Abyss
text.objectives: Nambria wants you to speak to Recruiter Burns at Stormwind Harbor.
text.description: The Horde and Alliance are locked in battle with one another in the seas to the west.$b$bBelow them, a great host of enemies prepares to carry out a plan that could be the undoing of us all.$b$bI am sending you to speak with the admiral of the alliance forces. Share with him the vision you have seen. Convince him to focus his attention on the true threat below, before it grows too late...$b$bTo gain audience with the admiral, you must first enlist with the recruiter at the harbor.

english.title: Into The Abyss
english.objectives: Nambria wants you to speak to Recruiter Burns at Stormwind Harbor.
english.description: The Horde and Alliance are locked in battle with one another in the seas to the west.$b$bBelow them, a great host of enemies prepares to carry out a plan that could be the undoing of us all.$b$bI am sending you to speak with the admiral of the alliance forces. Share with him the vision you have seen. Convince him to focus his attention on the true threat below, before it grows too late...$b$bTo gain audience with the admiral, you must first enlist with the recruiter at the harbor.

text.title: 使命召唤
text.objectives: 乘坐雇佣船只参加战斗。
text.description: 公民！$b$b你也许已经听说了，部落正在从海上向我们大举进攻，战斗非常惨烈。$b$b我们要团结一致，击退敌人！$b$b立即到最北边的码头上去报到，搭乘运输船参加战斗。$b$b哦，对了，我们的军方战舰……呃，还没有返航。不过别担心，我们委任了一些雇佣船只服役。$B$B快一点，$c。暴风城需要你！
text.completion: Not exactly the battle you had anticipated, I'll wager. But a battle nonetheless, as you shall soon see....
text.end: 乘坐雇佣船只前往瓦丝琪尔

english.title: Call of Duty
english.objectives: Ride the mercenary ship to battle.
english.description: Citizen!$b$bAs you may have heard, the Horde's attacking just offshore. The fighting's been fierce and relentless.$b$bWe need every able body out there repelling the enemy!$b$bReport to the northernmost dock at once for transport to the battle.$b$bOh, and our official warships are... err, a bit late in their scheduled return. Don't worry though, we've commissioned mercenary vessels to serve in the meantime.$b$bHurry along now, $c. Stormwind needs you!
english.completion: Not exactly the battle you had anticipated, I'll wager. But a battle nonetheless, as you shall soon see....
english.end: Ride the mercenary ship to Vashj'ir

objectiveDetails.description: 乘坐雇佣船只前往瓦丝琪尔

text.title: 微妙的气氛（肯定不是爱）
text.objectives: 将褪色的情人节卡片交给奥格瑞玛的侦探斯奈普·滑栓。
text.description: 这张卡片里面记录了一个疯狂而详细的计划。其目的是感染艾泽拉斯的全部生物。你应该立刻把它交给热砂集团的一名调查员！
text.progress: Did you take care of those no-good scheming villains?
text.completion: What've you got there?$B$BOh hey, this is big. Real big. Most of the crazy details in one little package. Thanks - you really helped us reel this all in. Good working with ya.

english.title: Something is in the Air (and it Ain't Love)
english.objectives: Bring the Faded Lovely Greeting Card to Detective Snap Snagglebolt in Orgrimmar.
english.description: The inside of the card is scribbled with mad, detailed plans to infect most of Azeroth.  You should show this to one of Steamwheedle's investigators immediately!
english.progress: Did you take care of those no-good scheming villains?
english.completion: What've you got there?$B$BOh hey, this is big. Real big. Most of the crazy details in one little package. Thanks - you really helped us reel this all in. Good working with ya.

text.title: 七寸
text.objectives: 杀掉辛玛洛神殿里的卡萨鲁斯领主。
text.description: 士官营里他们总教我们打蛇要七寸。听上去没啥用，因为我们从来没和蛇交过手。不过我想现在这话在理。$B$B带上你的人去把卡萨鲁斯领主宰了。
text.giverWindow: 他们的块头越大，炸弹的效果越好。

english.title: Head of the Snake
english.objectives: Kill Lord Kassarus in the Temple of Zin-Malor.
english.description: They taught us at officers camp to always cut off the head of the snake. Seemed dumb considering we never fought any snakes, but I guess it kind of makes sense now.$B$BTake your men in there and kill Lord Kassarus.
english.giverWindow: The bigger they are, the bigger the bomb you use on them.

text.title: 还少个钟摆
text.objectives: 把钟摆带到遗迹里去，掩护他在3颗恶鞭符文石处埋设炸弹。
text.description: 我们最好的爆破手，钟摆，和地精小队有个任务。他的炸药足够轻松炸飞遗迹里所有的符文石。$B$B你要做的就是带上他，打好掩护——他会处理剩下来的事情。

english.title: Ticker Required
english.objectives: Bring Ticker into the ruins and cover him as he sets up bombs at 3 of the Spitelash Runestones.
english.description: Our best demo-man, Ticker, is on assignment with the Gob Squad. He's got WAY more than enough explosives for all the runestones in the ruins.$B$BAll you have to do is get him there and keep him covered - he'll handle the rest.

text.title: 货物买办
text.objectives: 从埃达拉斯废墟收集12块上层精灵石板。
text.description: 这儿呢，兄弟。想挣点儿零花吗？$B$B把你从遗迹里能找到的上层精灵石板都给我带来。

english.title: Handling the Goods
english.objectives: Collect 12 Highborne Tablets from the Ruins of Eldarath.
english.description: Hey there, buddy. Want to make a quick buck?$B$BBring me back any highborne tablets you find in the ruins.

text.title: 仍在跳动的心
text.objectives: 从埃达拉斯废墟中央回收亚考罗克的精华。
text.description: 指挥官莫洛托夫在秘密实验室找到了一些愿意为你之前发现的神器出价的买家。$B$B毫无疑问，它现在仍在你最先发现它的地方，也就是废墟中央的高阶祭祀的手上。完好无损地把它带回来，士兵。

english.title: Still Beating Heart
english.objectives: Recover the Heart of Arkkoroc from the center of the Ruins of Eldarath.
english.description: Commander Molotov found a party at the Secret Lab willing to act as buyer for the artifact that you scouted out earlier.$B$BUndoubtedly, it's still in the center of the ruins with the High Priestess, where you initially spotted it. Get it back here undamaged, soldier.

text.title: You've Been Served
text.objectives: Serve the Court Subpoena to Apothecary Hummel in Shadowfang Keep.
text.description: You made it, huh? Good. I've been waiting for help. No time like the present to act, right?$b$bTake this kit and head deeper inside to serve papers to the leader of that scumbag chemical company, Hummel. The paper's inside. So's a little something to protect you from any chemical tricks they might pull. Use one of the neutralizers when the time comes, all right?

english.title: You've Been Served
english.objectives: Serve the Court Subpoena to Apothecary Hummel in Shadowfang Keep.
english.description: You made it, huh? Good. I've been waiting for help. No time like the present to act, right?$b$bTake this kit and head deeper inside to serve papers to the leader of that scumbag chemical company, Hummel. The paper's inside. So's a little something to protect you from any chemical tricks they might pull. Use one of the neutralizers when the time comes, all right?

text.title: 不休的大地
text.objectives: 使用宁静大地之鼓安抚6名躁动的大地之魂。
text.description: 就在最近，一组矮人侵入了西边我们的土地，无情地开凿着大地，寻找宝藏。当土地被撕开的时候，灌注其中的大地之魂奋起复仇。$B$B躁动的大地之魂依然游荡在曾经的挖掘场里，$n。我们必须让它们获得平息。$B$B带上这面鼓，到西边对灵魂敲打。鼓的旋律或许能平抚它们的怒火和迷茫。
text.completion:
The land is clearly still in great upheaval if it took such effort to calm.

Remember this, $N.  Do not forget seeing the fate of those who would scar the Earth Mother.

english.title: The Restless Earth
english.objectives: Use the Drums of the Soothed Earth to calm 6 Agitated Earth Spirits.
english.description: Until recently, a group of dwarves intruded on our lands to the west, carving the earth apart senselessly to search for treasure.  When the very earth itself tore apart, the spirits of the land they had abused rose up and took their revenge.$B$BThe agitated earth spirits still roam the former dig site, $n.  We must offer them appeasement.$B$BTake this drum with you to the west and play to the spirits.  The rhythm may calm their fury and confusion.
english.completion:
The land is clearly still in great upheaval if it took such effort to calm.

Remember this, $N.  Do not forget seeing the fate of those who would scar the Earth Mother.

text.title: 适当的伪装
text.objectives: 从山迪·格罗斯那里取得“借来的战袍”。
text.description: 进入夺日者圣殿绝不是说说那样简单。只有那些穿着夺日者制服的人才能进入圣殿。如果我们能得到一件这种制服，只要一个简单的法术就能解决所有问题了。$B$B在命运丝线上方的露台上，你会找到山迪·格罗斯。过去我帮过他几次，他欠我一个情。他负责为这座城市中的各种人洗涤衣物。也许他能想办法“暂借”你一件衣服。

english.title: A Suitable Disguise
english.objectives: Obtain a Borrowed Tabard from Shandy Glossgleam.
english.description: Getting you inside the Sunreaver's Sanctuary will be tougher than it appears. Only those who possess Sunreaver tabards are permitted entry to sanctuary. If we can get our hands on one, a simple enchantment will do the rest of the work.$B$BOn the balcony above Threads of Fate, you'll find Shandy Glossgleam. I've helped him a few times in the past, so he owes me a favor. He handles laundry for a wide variety of people in the city. Maybe he can find a way to 'lend' you a tabard for a while.

text.title: 与魔导师会面
text.objectives: 从魔导师哈瑟尔那里取得上古龙铸之刃典籍。
text.description: 我已经在这件衣服上施加了魔法。你穿上它，就能在短时间内进入夺日者圣殿的防御。你应该有足够的时间找路进入那里的一座建筑：“肮脏的野兽”，与夺日者的联系人见面。那个人是魔导师哈瑟尔。$B$B你要借助伪装取得上古龙铸之刃的抄本。那是魔导师哈瑟尔的部下从龙眠神殿借来的。取得那本书以后，就把它交给我。
text.progress: Have you recovered that book?
text.completion: Excellent work. Now that this is in our hands, we must get it to Caladis Brightspear as soon as possible. We can't risk the book falling back into Sunreaver hands.$BI'll ensure that Shandy Glossgleam gets his tabard back without incident, along with a healthy reward for his help

english.title: A Meeting With The Magister
english.objectives: Retrieve the Ancient Dragonforged Blades tome from Magister Hathorel.
english.description: I've placed an enchantment on the tabard that should allow you to slip past the Sunreaver Sanctuary's defenses for a short period of time. You should have enough time to find your way into The Filthy Animal and meet up with the Sunreaver contact there, one Magister Hathorel.$B$BObtain the copy of Ancient Dragonforged Blades that his men borrowed from Wyrmrest while your disguise holds, and return it to me.
english.progress: Have you recovered that book?
english.completion: Excellent work. Now that this is in our hands, we must get it to Caladis Brightspear as soon as possible. We can't risk the book falling back into Sunreaver hands.$BI'll ensure that Shandy Glossgleam gets his tabard back without incident, along with a healthy reward for his help

text.title: 有毒的水
text.objectives: 获取6只草原狼的爪子和4只平原陆行鸟的爪子。
text.description: 我们的圣井遭到了污染，我需要你的帮助才能令它复原。$B$B为了净化水井，我必须制作一根净化图腾，而你则要把它带到井边，举行净化仪式。$B$B首先我们要为冰蹄水井制作净化图腾。为此，必须获得大地的帮助。捕杀草原狼和平原陆行鸟，割下它们的爪子。它们都在西南方。$B$B把两种爪子都带给我，$n。
text.progress: Do you have the paws and talons, $N?
text.completion: You have done well, $N.  I will take these and bind their power into a totem of cleansing.

english.title: Poison Water
english.objectives: Collect 6 Prairie Wolf Paws and 4 Plainstrider Talons.
english.description: Our sacred wells have been tainted, and I will need your help to fix this.$B$BTo cleanse each well, I must create a cleansing totem, then you must bring the totem to the well and perform a cleansing ritual.$B$BFirst we will create a cleansing totem for the Winterhoof Water Well.  To do this, the land must offer its aid. Hunt prairie wolves for their paws and adult plainstriders for their talons.  They are to the southwest.$B$BReturn to me with the paws and talons, $n.
english.progress: Do you have the paws and talons, $N?
english.completion: You have done well, $N.  I will take these and bind their power into a totem of cleansing.

text.title: 幻象仪祭
text.objectives: 在血蹄村的部族营火前将视像之水喝下。
text.description: 再次确保你做好离开血蹄村的准备了，$n。旅程的下一步将把你带往远方。$b$b你的道路继续往前延伸，穿过莫高雷的原野，大地之母的眼睛将随时注视着你。当你准备好之后，就将这水在部族营火前喝下。等你将圣水消化，你的双眼就会睁开，神灵自然会指引你。
text.completion: Be not afraid, $N. You have successfully passed the Rite of Vision.

english.title: Rite of Vision
english.objectives: Consume the Water of Vision in front of the tribal fire in Bloodhoof Village.
english.description: Again, be sure you are ready to leave Bloodhoof Village behind, $n. The next step on your journey will take you far from here.$b$bYour path continues to lead onward, across the fields of Mulgore, the eyes of the Earth Mother on you at all times. When you are ready, consume the waters near the tribal fire. Once you have ingested the holy waters, your eyes will be opened, and the spirits will guide you.
english.completion: Be not afraid, $N. You have successfully passed the Rite of Vision.

text.title: 大地母亲的仪式
text.objectives: 与远眺台地顶部的德亚米·翱风交谈。
text.description: 今天，你通过了一项试炼仪式，它的困难程度远远超越我们通常让年轻人参加的仪式。你应该感到骄傲。现在，是时候让你继续展开旅程了。$B$B到西边去，穿过我们的墓地之后，你会找到一条通往台地顶端的小路。沿着那条路一直走到上面去，跟德亚米·翱风谈谈。$B$B与大地母亲同行吧，朋友。欢迎你随时回来。
text.completion: If you are prepared to leave Camp Narache behind, I will help call the spirits to guide you onwards.

english.title: Rites of the Earthmother
english.objectives: Speak to Dyami Windsoar atop Fargaze Mesa.
english.description: Today, you have undertaken a rite of passage far more difficult than we ask of most of our youths. Be proud. Now, it is time for you to continue on your journey.$B$BTo the west, beyond our burial ground, you will find a path winding up the mesa. Follow it to the top, and speak with Dyami Windsoar.$B$BWalk with the Earth Mother, friend. You will always be welcome here.
english.completion: If you are prepared to leave Camp Narache behind, I will help call the spirits to guide you onwards.

text.title: 风之仪式
text.objectives: 饮下视像之水。
text.description: 看吧，$n。一望无际的莫高雷平原在你眼前展开，这是我们的家，大地母亲的摇篮。在这里，她提供了我们需要的一切，一片平静而青翠的草原。这就是你要为之战斗到底的地方。$B$B你的旅途将把你带到远离她的臂弯的地方，深入这个世界中最遥远、最残酷的角落，并走得更远。$B$B我们下面就是血蹄村。你即将踏出冒险旅途的第一步，喝下视像之水，让灵魂指引你前进吧。
text.completion: Welcome to Bloodhoof Village, hero.  I am glad the spirits have guided you safely here.

english.title: Rite of the Winds
english.objectives: Drink the Water of Vision.
english.description: Look, $n. The rolling plains of Mulgore stretch before you: our home, the cradle of the Earth Mother. Here she provides us with all we could ever need, a peaceful and verdant land. This is what you will fight to protect.$B$BYour journey will take you far beyond her sheltering arms, to the farthest and cruelest regions of this world, and beyond.$B$BBelow us is Bloodhoof Village. The first step on your true path begins now. Drink deep of the Water of Vision, and let the spirits guide you onward.
english.completion: Welcome to Bloodhoof Village, hero.  I am glad the spirits have guided you safely here.

text.title: 战斗的召唤：战歌峡谷
text.objectives: 在战歌峡谷战场中获得一场胜利，然后向任意部落主城、冬拥湖、达拉然或沙塔斯城中的部落战争使者复命。
text.description: 联盟真是个阴险的敌人，$n。他们张口闭口说在保护灰谷的森林，以此证明他们对我们贫瘠之地领土的进攻行动是正当的。$B$B今天，我们有机会把敌人彻底赶出部落的领土。去战歌峡谷，夺回一切本属于我们的东西！
text.completed: 去找部落战争使者。

english.title: Call to Arms: Warsong Gulch
english.objectives: Win a Warsong Gulch battleground match and return to a Horde Warbringer at any Horde capital city, Wintergrasp, Dalaran, or Shattrath.
english.description: The Alliance is an insidious enemy, $n.  They claim to defend the Ashenvale forests to justify their acts of aggression against our territories in the Barrens.$B$BToday we have an opportunity to drive the enemy from our lands once and for all.  Go to Warsong Gulch and take back what is rightfully ours!
english.completed: Return to Horde Warbringer.

text.title: Call to Arms: Warsong Gulch
text.objectives: Win a Warsong Gulch battleground match and return to an Alliance Brigadier General at any Alliance capital city, Wintergrasp, Dalaran, or Shattrath.
text.description: The Silverwing Sentinels fight to protect the forest in Warsong Gulch.  We aid them, not because we're tree-lovers, but because the forest forms a natural protective barrier for Alliance territory.$B$BTheir need is greater today than it's ever been.  We need to deploy reinforcements right away unless we want to see Ashenvale annexed to the Barrens!
text.completed: Return to Alliance Brigadier General.

text.title: 战斗的召唤：战歌峡谷
text.objectives: 在战歌峡谷战场中获得一场胜利，然后向任意联盟主城、冬拥湖、达拉然或沙塔斯城中的联盟准将复命。
text.description: 银翼哨兵通过战斗来保护战歌峡谷的森林。我们帮助他们，并不是因为我们爱好树木，而是因为森林为联盟领地提供了天然的屏障。$B$B今天他们那里的情势非常危急，远远超过以往任何时候。我们必须立刻派出援军，除非我们希望看到灰谷成为贫瘠之地的附属地！
text.completed: 去找联盟准将。

english.title: Call to Arms: Warsong Gulch
english.objectives: Win a Warsong Gulch battleground match and return to an Alliance Brigadier General at any Alliance capital city, Wintergrasp, Dalaran, or Shattrath.

We aid them, not because we're tree-lovers, but because the forest forms a natural protective barrier for Alliance territory.$B$BTheir need is greater today than it's ever been.  We need to deploy reinforcements right away unless we want to see Ashenvale annexed to the Barrens!
english.completed: Return to Alliance Brigadier General.

text.title: Call to Arms: Arathi Basin
text.objectives: Win an Arathi Basin battleground match and return to an Alliance Brigadier General at any Alliance capital city, Wintergrasp, Dalaran, or Shattrath.
text.description: The reality of fighting on multiple fronts, $g lad : lass;, is that we cannot spread our forces too thin or we risk losing it all!$B$BCritical troop deployments are necessary on a day by day basis.  Today it is the battle of Arathi Basin that demands immediate reinforcements.$B$BReturn to me with news of victory, $n.  We cannot allow the Horde scum to secure the resources that are rightfully ours!
text.completion: Excellent news, $c!  If our tactical deployments continue to be this successful, the Horde will be in full retreat before long.
text.completed: Return to Alliance Brigadier General.

text.title: 战斗的召唤：阿拉希盆地
text.objectives: 在阿拉希盆地战场中获得一场胜利，然后向任意部落主城、冬拥湖、达拉然或沙塔斯城中的部落战争使者复命。
text.description: 阿拉希盆地快要让联盟夺走了，我们必须尽快派出援兵，否则我们所做的一切都将成为徒劳。$B$B不要拖延了，$c。去阿拉希盆地消灭敌人，胜利属于部落！
text.completed: 去找部落战争使者。

english.title: Call to Arms: Arathi Basin
english.objectives: Win an Arathi Basin battleground match and return to a Horde Warbringer at any Horde capital city, Wintergrasp, Dalaran, or Shattrath.
english.description: Arathi Basin is on the verge of being lost to Alliance forces.  We must send reinforcements at this very moment or all our efforts will have been in vain.$B$BDo not delay, $c, go to Arathi Basin and crush the enemy.  Victory to the Horde!
english.completed: Return to Horde Warbringer.

text.title: Call to Arms: Eye of the Storm DEPRECATED
text.objectives: Win an Eye of the Storm battleground match and return to a Horde Warbringer at any Horde capital city, Wintergrasp, Dalaran,  or Shattrath.
text.description: We will fight and crush the enemy wherever we find them.  Azeroth, Outland, the place makes no difference.$B$BWe cannot allow the Alliance to establish superiority in the Eye of the Storm.  Take the battle to them today... tomorrow it might be too late!
text.end: Victory in Eye of the Storm
text.completed: Return to Horde Warbringer.

english.description: The Silverwing Sentinels fight to protect the forest in Warsong Gulch.  We aid them, not because we're tree-lovers, but because the forest forms a natural protective barrier for Alliance territory.$B$BTheir need is greater today than it's ever been.  We need to deploy reinforcements right away unless we want to see Ashenvale annexed to the Barrens!
english.completed: Return to Alliance Brigadier General.

text.title: Call to Arms: Warsong Gulch
text.objectives: Win a Warsong Gulch battleground match and return to a Horde Warbringer at any Horde capital city, Wintergrasp, Dalaran, or Shattrath.
text.description: The Alliance is an insidious enemy, $n.  They claim to defend the Ashenvale forests to justify their acts of aggression against our territories in the Barrens.$B$BToday we have an opportunity to drive the enemy from our lands once and for all.  Go to Warsong Gulch and take back what is rightfully ours!
text.completed: Return to Horde Warbringer.

english.title: Call to Arms: Warsong Gulch
english.objectives: Win a Warsong Gulch battleground match and return to a Horde Warbringer at any Horde capital city, Wintergrasp, Dalaran, or Shattrath.
english.description: The Alliance is an insidious enemy, $n.  They claim to defend the Ashenvale forests to justify their acts of aggression against our territories in the Barrens.$B$BToday we have an opportunity to drive the enemy from our lands once and for all.  Go to Warsong Gulch and take back what is rightfully ours!
english.completed: Return to Horde Warbringer.

text.title: 战斗的召唤：阿拉希盆地
text.objectives: 在阿拉希盆地战场中获得一场胜利，然后向任意部落主城、冬拥湖、达拉然或沙塔斯城中的部落战争使者复命。
text.description: 阿拉希盆地快要让联盟夺走了，我们必须尽快派出援兵，否则我们所做的一切都将成为徒劳。$B$B不要拖延了，$c。去阿拉希盆地消灭敌人，胜利属于部落！
text.completed: 去找部落战争使者。

english.title: Call to Arms: Arathi Basin
english.objectives: Win an Arathi Basin battleground match and return to a Horde Warbringer at any Horde capital city, Wintergrasp, Dalaran, or Shattrath.
english.description: Arathi Basin is on the verge of being lost to Alliance forces.  We must send reinforcements at this very moment or all our efforts will have been in vain.$B$BDo not delay, $c, go to Arathi Basin and crush the enemy.  Victory to the Horde!
english.completed: Return to Horde Warbringer.

text.title: DEPRECATED
text.objectives: Win an Eye of the Storm battleground match and return to an Alliance Brigadier General at any Alliance capital city, Wintergrasp, Dalaran, or Shattrath.
text.description: The fight against the Horde knows no boundaries, $N.  Even in Outland, territorial disputes and old hatreds are enough to tip the scales in favor of war.$B$BGo into the Eye of the Storm and make sure the Alliance prevails in Outland just like it has in Azeroth.
text.end: Victory in the Eye of the Storm
text.completed: Return to Alliance Brigadier General.

english.title: DEPRECATED
english.objectives: Win an Eye of the Storm battleground match and return to an Alliance Brigadier General at any Alliance capital city, Wintergrasp, Dalaran, or Shattrath.
english.description: The fight against the Horde knows no boundaries, $N.  Even in Outland, territorial disputes and old hatreds are enough to tip the scales in favor of war.$B$BGo into the Eye of the Storm and make sure the Alliance prevails in Outland just like it has in Azeroth.
english.end: Victory in the Eye of the Storm
english.completed: Return to Alliance Brigadier General.

text.title: Call to Arms: Alterac Valley
text.objectives: Win an Alterac Valley battleground match and return to a Horde Warbringer at any Horde capital city, Wintergrasp, Dalaran or Shattrath.
text.description: We've recently come extremely close to driving the Stormpike invaders from Alterac Valley.  As a result we're redirecting all our reinforcements to aid the Frostwolf Clan.$B$BA decisive victory there would free up the resources we need to crush the Alliance scum on all the other battlefronts.$B$BGo, $n.  Earn great honor by heeding the call of the brave Frostwolf warriors.
text.completed: Return to Horde Warbringer.

english.title: Call to Arms: Alterac Valley
english.objectives: Win an Alterac Valley battleground match and return to a Horde Warbringer at any Horde capital city, Wintergrasp, Dalaran or Shattrath.
english.description: We've recently come extremely close to driving the Stormpike invaders from Alterac Valley.  As a result we're redirecting all our reinforcements to aid the Frostwolf Clan.$B$BA decisive victory there would free up the resources we need to crush the Alliance scum on all the other battlefronts.$B$BGo, $n.  Earn great honor by heeding the call of the brave Frostwolf warriors.
english.completed: Return to Horde Warbringer.

text.title: Call to Arms: Alterac Valley
text.objectives: Win an Alterac Valley battleground match and return to an Alliance Brigadier General at any Alliance capital city, Wintergrasp, Dalaran or Shattrath.
text.description: The reality of fighting on multiple fronts, $g lad : lass;, is that we cannot spread our forces too thin or we risk losing it all!$B$BCritical troop deployments are necessary on a day by day basis.  Today it is the battle for Alterac Valley that's in most need of brave combatants.$B$BGo now, $n, and aid the Stormpike Expedition.  We cannot allow the Frostwolf Clan to get away with the violence they've inflicted on our brethren!
text.completed: Return to Alliance Brigadier General.

english.title: Call to Arms: Alterac Valley
english.objectives: Win an Alterac Valley battleground match and return to an Alliance Brigadier General at any Alliance capital city, Wintergrasp, Dalaran or Shattrath.
english.description: The reality of fighting on multiple fronts, $g lad : lass;, is that we cannot spread our forces too thin or we risk losing it all!$B$BCritical troop deployments are necessary on a day by day basis.  Today it is the battle for Alterac Valley that's in most need of brave combatants.$B$BGo now, $n, and aid the Stormpike Expedition.  We cannot allow the Frostwolf Clan to get away with the violence they've inflicted on our brethren!
english.completed: Return to Alliance Brigadier General.

text.title: 诡秘的事件
text.objectives: 将奥妮克希亚的头颅交给黑爪加尔德斯。他就在已宰的羔羊旅店的地下室里。
text.description: 你完成了绝对不可能的任务——黑龙公主的尸体就躺在你的脚边。取下她的头颅，将这颗龙首交给黑爪加尔德斯。
text.progress: By Nozdormu's teeth!
text.completion: What? How did you get this? Isn't she... Never mind the details, I suppose. You'll be wanting one of these baubles as recompense, no doubt.

english.title: A Most Puzzling Circumstance
english.objectives: Take the Head of Onyxia to Zardeth of the Black Claw in the basement of the Slaughtered Lamb.
english.description: You have accomplished the truly impossible. The brood mother of the Black Dragonflight lies dead at your feet. Seize her head and deliver it to Zardeth of the Black Claw.
english.progress: By Nozdormu's teeth!
english.completion: What? How did you get this? Isn't she... Never mind the details, I suppose. You'll be wanting one of these baubles as recompense, no doubt.

text.title: 诡秘的事件
text.objectives: 将奥妮克希亚的头颅交给阿纳克·火刃。他就在暗影裂口里。
text.description: 你完成了绝对不可能的任务——黑龙公主的尸体就躺在你的脚边。取下她的头颅，将这颗龙首交给阿纳克·火刃。
text.progress: What is the meaning of this?!
text.completion: You've brought me the head of someone who is... No, best not to think about it too hard. You'll be wanting recompense for your heroic deeds, no doubt.

english.title: A Most Puzzling Circumstance
english.objectives: Take the Head of Onyxia to Arnak Fireblade in the Cleft of Shadow.
english.description: You have accomplished the truly impossible. The brood mother of the Black Dragonflight lies dead at your feet. Seize her head and deliver it to Arnak Fireblade.
english.progress: What is the meaning of this?!
english.completion: You've brought me the head of someone who is... No, best not to think about it too hard. You'll be wanting recompense for your heroic deeds, no doubt.

text.title: 遮天蔽日
text.objectives: 乘一头落地的双足飞龙飞往塔伦迪斯营地上空，摧毁6座塔伦迪斯投刃车并轰炸指挥中心。
text.description: $n！搭把手，成不？格尔斯奇在镇子里的“想吃多少吃多少”海鲜连锁店里吃坏了肠胃，我们就少了个驾驶员。$B$B我原本的任务是在咱们的空中力量被撕成碎片之前解决掉那些精灵箭塔。坐上这头双足飞龙飞上天空！我的掷弹兵会和你一同升空，在你指挥下对目标进行轰炸。$B$B哦还有！给暗夜精灵指挥中心直接来上一颗，就是往南桥边上那个大建筑。光荣上阵！

english.title: Blacken the Skies
english.objectives: Mount a Grounded Wind Rider and fly over Talrendis Point. Destroy 6 Talrendis Glaive Throwers and bomb the Command Center.
english.description: $n! Give us a hand here, will ya? Gorsch here had a bad experience at the all-you-can-eat seafood joint back in town, and now we're short a pilot.$B$BMy job was to take out those elven glaive throwers before they cut our air units to ribbons. Hop on this wind rider and take to the skies! One of my bombardier buddies will ride with you and bomb the targets at your command.$B$BAnd hey! Chuck a bomb straight at the night elven command center - the large building south of here, beside the bridge. Glorious!

text.title: 被浸透的配方
text.objectives: 将被浸透的配方交给达拉然城中的克莉丝蒂·斯多克顿。
text.description: 看起来，这张被水浸透的纸上应该是记录着一种烈性酒的酿造配方。也许达拉然“再来一杯”的店主会对这个感兴趣……
text.progress: Wine is only as fine as the person drinking it, I always say.
text.completion: This is quite a find, $N.  I can't have you selling this to anyone else, so I'm willing to offer generously.

english.title: Waterlogged Recipe
english.objectives: Bring the Waterlogged Recipe to Christi Stockton in the Dalaran city.
english.description: This appears to be the remains of a mixture for potent wine.  Perhaps the proprietor of One More Glass in Dalaran would be interested in it....
english.progress: Wine is only as fine as the person drinking it, I always say.
english.completion: This is quite a find, $N.  I can't have you selling this to anyone else, so I'm willing to offer generously.

text.title: 告别晕船
text.objectives: 破浪号的埃鲁纳克要你从航海者之墓带回3个咸水海星和1个海螺壳。
text.description: 欢迎乘坐破浪号，$c。$b$b我是埃鲁纳克，是这艘曾经风光无限的大船上唯一幸存的乘客。$b$b你要经历的艰难才刚刚开始。纳迦的攻击就没有停止过。$b$b虽然以你现在这身装备很难在水底下帮上什么忙，但是我可以帮助你改进。$b$b这里附近生活着一种奇特的海星。将它们以及一个海螺壳带回来给我。这样我就能施展法术，提升你存活的机会。
text.progress: It is good to see that you're still alive, $r.$b$bHave you found the items I require?
text.completion: Here you are, $c. With this you should find maneuvering in the sea to be nearly effortless. $b$bNow we must get to work. There is much to be done in little time.

english.title: Sea Legs
english.objectives: Erunak in The Briny Cutter wants you to bring him 3 Saltwater Starfish and a Conch Shell from Seafarer's Tomb.
english.description: Welcome to The Briny Cutter, $c.$b$bI am Erunak, the last surviving passenger of this once-proud vessel.$b$bI'm afraid your travails have only just begun. The naga have been attacking here relentlessly.$b$bYou're not equipped to be of much help down here yet, but I can remedy that.$b$bJust outside this ship live a special breed of starfish. Bring me some of them along with a conch shell. I'll prepare an enchantment that should help to increase your chances of survival.
english.progress: It is good to see that you're still alive, $r.$b$bHave you found the items I require?
english.completion: Here you are, $c. With this you should find maneuvering in the sea to be nearly effortless. $b$bNow we must get to work. There is much to be done in little time.

text.title: 让他们心惧胆寒
text.objectives: 攻进塔伦迪斯营地，击败12名塔伦迪斯防御者和6名塔伦迪斯哨兵。
text.description: 我们的士兵固然勇猛，可缺乏主动性。他们在前线拼杀的时候，像你这样的$c，就能独力深入敌后，在阵地上制造真正的破坏。$B$B像把毁灭的尖刀插在塔伦迪斯的心脏上，$n！让敌人自以为安全的防区见红，给他们尝尝后院失火的味道。

english.title: Let Them Feast on Fear
english.objectives: Fight your way across Talrendis Point, slaying 12 Talrendis Defenders and 6 Talrendis Sentinels.
english.description: Our grunts are strong but have no initiative. They're fighting toe-to-toe on the front lines. But an independent $c like yourself - well, someone like you can slip behind the lines and cause some real havoc deep within the enemy redoubt.$B$BCut a swath of destruction through the heart of Talrendis, $n! Slay our foes in territory they think is secure, leaving blood and fear in your wake.

text.title: 特种天兵
text.objectives: 杀掉5名塔伦迪斯博学者，在塔伦迪斯营地某处找到博学者召唤石。
text.description: 你能感觉到这里地脉的振颤么，$n？我偶尔能感到阵阵敲打，仿佛琴弦拨动一般。我感应到的是一种远程召唤魔法的共鸣。塔伦迪斯的博学者们在用他们可笑的原始法术，打算从达纳苏斯召唤援兵。$B$B我们可以利用这一点，$n。假如你能对付他们的召唤石，我们就可以将一支精锐特种兵小队传送到敌后。$B$B找到位于塔伦迪斯的召唤石！

english.title: Commando Drop
english.objectives: Slay 5 Talrendis Lorekeepers and locate a Lorekeeper Summoning Stone somewhere within Talrendis Point.
english.description: Are you sensitive to the tremors of the local ley-lines, $n? I can feel the occasional thrum, like the plucking of a string. It's the kind of resonance I'd expect from a long-range summoning spell. The Lorekeepers in Talrendis, with their laughably primitive magics, are trying to summon in backup from Darnassus.$B$BWe can use this to our advantage, $n. If you can compromise their summoning stone, we can teleport a crack team of commandos behind enemy lines.$B$BLocate the summoning stone in Talrendis!

text.title: 扫尾
text.objectives: 在破碎海岸杀死12只恶鞭纳迦。
text.description: 海滩上还有纳迦剩着，看来你有脏活儿要干了，$G小伙儿:姑娘;。

english.title: Mop Up
english.objectives: Kill 12 Spitelash Naga on the Shattered Strand.
english.description: There are a lot of naga left on this beach. Looks like you have some wet work ahead of you, $G son:girl;.

text.title: 天使降临
text.objectives: 在破碎海岸8个受伤的士兵身边呼叫空降牧师。
text.description: 海滩上到处是我们的“士兵”，想白死好赖掉该干的活。找到这些混球，用这把信号枪呼叫牧师，让他们来处理。$B$B我们可不能让人觉得我们好对付。

english.title: Halo Drops
english.objectives: Call in Airborne Priests at the bodies of 8 Wounded Soldiers on the Shattered Strand.
english.description: We've got "soldiers" all over the beach trying to get out of their work by dying on us. Find the slackers and use this flaregun to call in a priest to take care of the situation.$B$BWe can't have men thinking they can get off that easy.

text.title: 先到先得
text.objectives: 沿着破碎海岸主要房产用地放置拉克卡斯的占地之旗。
text.description: 岸边有好些不错的滩头地，建成实业能让我挣10倍。$B$B主要是这么几块地皮，南边的纳迦宝塔，临海的高塔，海滩北端尽头的遗迹。你趁他们还没打完赶紧给我把地给占了，事成之后我会给你些铜板的。

english.title: First Come, First Served
english.objectives: Plant Ruckus' Territorial Claim Flag next to the prime real estate locations along the Shattered Strand.
english.description: There's some gorgeous beach front property along the shore. I can market this stuff for 10 times what construction will cost me.$B$BThe prime spots are that naga pagoda to the south, the tower right next to the water, and the ruins at the far northern end of the beach. I'll give you some coin if you claim them for me before the fighting clears out.

text.title: 逃亡
text.objectives: 搭乘格雷迈恩庄园楼下的马车。
text.description: $n，我们别无选择，必须向内陆转移。$B$B我不得不承认，这里很不安全。$B$B返回庄园楼下的马厩。我们得将大家送往东边。希望不会太迟。
text.completion: Thanks for stopping, $N.  Our carriage got hit pretty bad.$B$BThe one in front of us got it worse.

english.title: Exodus
english.objectives: Board a carriage below Greymane Manor.
english.description: We have no choice, $n.  We must move further inland.$B$BI don't like it one bit, but we're vulnerable here.$B$BReturn to the stables below the manor.  Let's get everybody on carriages and send them eastbound.  I pray it's not too late.
english.completion: Thanks for stopping, $N.  Our carriage got hit pretty bad.$B$BThe one in front of us got it worse.

text.title: 征服艾萨拉
text.objectives: 击败塔伦迪斯营地的指挥官加罗迪努斯，取回他的徽记。
text.description: $n！是你驾着双足飞龙轰炸指挥中心的吗？那可是直接命中！$B$B我的斥候告诉我你重挫了加罗迪努斯，逐星夜精灵飞行管理员暨对方指挥官。$B$B进攻的时机就是现在——我没时间组织全军推进了。对指挥中心发动冲锋，在后援到来之前杀掉指挥官加罗迪努斯。把他的徽记带来……艾萨拉就是我们的了！
text.giverWindow: 这个暗夜精灵就是阻挠我们获得胜利的障碍。

english.title: The Conquest of Azshara
english.objectives: Slay Commander Jarrodenus in Talrendis Point and collect his head.
english.description: $n! Was it you who piloted the wind rider who bombed the command center? It was a direct hit!$B$BMy scouts tell me that you gravely wounded Jarrodenus, flight master of the night-elven skychasers and de facto commander of the opposition.$B$BThe opportunity to strike is now - I don't have time to assemble a full assault. Rush the command center building and kill Commander Jarrodenus before his backup arrives. Bring me his head... and Azshara is ours!
english.giverWindow: One head stands between us and victory. This is that head.

text.title: 净化冰蹄之井
text.objectives: 对冰蹄水井使用冰蹄之井净化图腾。
text.description: 我已经把净化冰蹄水井的图腾做好了。现在，你要拿上它，到水井那里去举行净化仪式。水井就在东南方，但要小心：不管犯人是谁，他可能还在那里。$B$B这个任务也许会非常危险，$n。要当心……不要让污染我们水井的人逃了。
text.completion:
The Grimtotem...

<Mull scowls.>

I'd hoped to see the end of my days before $r attacked other $r senselessly on the very plains of Mulgore.  But be proud, $N.  You have done a great thing for the land, and for our people.
text.completed: 去找血蹄村的穆尔·雷角。

english.title: Winterhoof Cleansing
english.objectives: Use the Winterhoof Cleansing Totem at the Winterhoof Water Well.
english.description: I have crafted the totem to cleanse the Winterhoof Water Well.  Now, you must take it to the well and perform a cleansing ritual.  The well is to the southeast, but be warned: whoever did this may still be there, laying in wait.$B$BThis may prove very dangerous, $n.  Be careful...but do not let the defilers of our well escape.
english.completion:
The Grimtotem...

<Mull scowls.>

I'd hoped to see the end of my days before $r attacked other $r senselessly on the very plains of Mulgore.  But be proud, $N.  You have done a great thing for the land, and for our people.
english.completed: Return to Mull Thunderhorn at Bloodhoof Village.

text.title: 雷角图腾
text.objectives: 获取6只草原捕食者的爪子和6只平原狮的爪子。
text.description: 还有更多的事情要做。我们必须制作一个新图腾来净化雷角水井。$B$B你要收集的是莫高雷平原上捕食者的爪子。杀掉草原捕食者，可以获得草原捕食者的爪子；平原狮的爪子则在平原狮身上可以取得。将它们带给我。$B$B草原捕食者和平原狮在东边和西边都有。
text.progress: $N, do you have the claws I sent you to gather?  The Thunderhorn Water Well grows more tainted with each passing hour!
text.completion:
Thank you, $N.  The purity with which these beasts hunt is vital in the creation of the next cleansing totem.

The Thunderhorn Well is a symbol of my own tribe, and to know it is being desecrated by our own kind raises a fury in me I haven't felt for years.

english.title: Thunderhorn Totem
english.objectives: Collect 6 Stalker Claws and 6 Cougar Claws.
english.description: There is more work to be done.  We must create a new totem to cleanse the Thunderhorn Well.$B$BYou must gather the claws of the predators of the Mulgore plains.  Hunt prairie stalkers for their stalker claws and flatland cougars for their cougar claws, then return to me.$B$BYou will find the prairie stalkers and flatland cougars to the east and west.
english.progress: $N, do you have the claws I sent you to gather?  The Thunderhorn Water Well grows more tainted with each passing hour!
english.completion:
Thank you, $N.  The purity with which these beasts hunt is vital in the creation of the next cleansing totem.

The Thunderhorn Well is a symbol of my own tribe, and to know it is being desecrated by our own kind raises a fury in me I haven't felt for years.

text.title: 克瓦迪尔的进攻计划
text.objectives: 取得迷雾之心，将它和克瓦迪尔进攻计划一同交给银色比武场的裁决者玛蕾尔·图哈特。
text.description: 你仔细查看这份缴获的进攻计划，在其中发现了东部王国和卡利姆多的地图。所有大型居民点都在这些地图上被逐一列出。阅读过计划中写明的命令，你了解到克瓦迪尔的将领们策划了一系列毁灭性的袭击行动。$B$B根据这些命令，克瓦迪尔军队将在唤雾者伊戈瓦尔“向迷雾之心征询过意见”之后开始行动。也许你能够阻截从唤雾者洞穴中送出的预兆信息，以此延迟克瓦迪尔的进攻。唤雾者洞穴就在洛斯加尔登陆点的西侧。完成阻截行动之后，你还应该将此事告知裁决者玛蕾尔·图哈特。
text.progress: What is it that you've found, $N?
text.completion: <Mariel accepts the orders and the captured seeing crystal and examines both.>$B$BGood work, $N, and quick thinking. I'm sure the theft of this trinket won't slow them down for long, but I think you've bought us time to warn the leaders of the Horde and Alliance about the impending attacks.

english.title: Battle Plans Of The Kvaldir
english.objectives: Recover the Heart of the Mists and bring it and the Kvaldir Attack Plans to Justicar Mariel Trueheart at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
english.description: Looking over the captured attack plans, you find a map of the Eastern Kingdoms and Kalimdor with major settlements marked. Reading over the orders, you learn that  Kvaldir captains have drafted plans for a series of devastating raids.$B$BAccording to the orders, the attacks are to begin after Mistcaller Yngvar "consults the Heart of the Mists." Perhaps you could delay the attacks by capturing the omen from the Mistcaller's Cave on the western side of Hrothgar's Landing and notify Justicar Mariel Trueheart.
english.progress: What is it that you've found, $N?
english.completion: <Mariel accepts the orders and the captured seeing crystal and examines both.>$B$BGood work, $N, and quick thinking. I'm sure the theft of this trinket won't slow them down for long, but I think you've bought us time to warn the leaders of the Horde and Alliance about the impending attacks.

text.title: The Captured Hunter
text.objectives: Obtain a Crude Key from one of the Bristleback Quilboar, and use it to unlock the Quilboar Cage holding Honu Staghunter.
text.description: The quilboar have not only razed our buildings, but have taken tauren captives. I saw them take Honu Staghunter, a young hunter trainer of ours, away in one of their foul cages.  Please, find a key on one of the quilboar's bodies and go save her!

text.title: The Captured Druid
text.objectives: Find Keshu Treehoof.
text.description: It's fallen to some of our youngest to defend our camp, $n, and many of our bravest apprentices are out there as we speak, fighting the quilboar.  I fear for their safety...$B$BPlease, look for the young druid Keshu Treehoof to the east, deep within quilboar territory. If you find her and the other apprentices alive, they may be able to help you.
