text.title: Words of Power
text.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Shadow Word: Pain, then cast it 5 times on training dummies.
text.description:
Now, if ya DO want to become somethin' special, ye'll need to talk to me.  A priest is nothin' without his spells.  And how do you learn new spells?

Ya go and get more experience. So go out, get stronger, and then come show me what ya learn.

text.title: 说他们的语言
text.objectives: 在刺背竞技场中吹响挑战之角，一对一击败刃鼻。
text.description: 野猪人之所以展开攻击，是因为他们感觉到了对手的软弱。力量是他们唯一明白的语言，因此我们将向他们展示我们的力量。$B$B<玛卡巴从背包里拿出一只巨大的号角来。>$B$B这东西有点粗糙，不过能派上用场。刺背的头领们用类似的号角互相挑战，争夺支配权。$B$B$n，我要你去挑战刺背的勇士刃鼻，一对一，在他的追随者面前打败他。到正南方的刺背竞技场中吹响这个号角。
text.progress: Have you taken the Bristlebacks down a peg or two?
text.completion:
What? He attacked you with a dozen boars? I guess quilboar have their own ideas of what "single combat" means.

Still, the Bristleback will be left reeling after the blow you delivered. It will not be long before a new champion rises amongst them to stir up trouble... but at least this buys us some time to get these refugees relocated safely.

Thank you, $N. The survivors owe you a great debt.
text.giverWindow: 吹响挑战号角，与刃鼻交战。

english.title: Speaking Their Language
english.objectives: Blow the Horn of Challenge in the Bristleback Challenge Ring, and defeat Sabersnout in single combat.
english.description: The quilboar are attacking because they perceive weakness. Strength is the only language they understand. So we will show them strength.$B$B<Makaba withdraws a large horn from his satchel.>$B$BThis is admittedly crude work but it'll do. Bristleback leaders use horns like these to challenge one another for dominance.$B$B$n, I want you to challenge the Bristleback champion, Sabersnout, to single combat. Defeat him in front of his followers. Blow the horn at the Bristleback challenge ring due south of here.
english.progress: Have you taken the Bristlebacks down a peg or two?
english.completion:
What? He attacked you with a dozen boars? I guess quilboar have their own ideas of what "single combat" means.

Still, the Bristleback will be left reeling after the blow you delivered. It will not be long before a new champion rises amongst them to stir up trouble... but at least this buys us some time to get these refugees relocated safely.

Thank you, $N. The survivors owe you a great debt.
english.giverWindow: Blow the Horn of Challenge to engage Sabersnout.

text.title: 萨洛瑞安·寻晨者
text.objectives: 访问萨洛瑞安·寻晨者的遗体，获得他的祝福，以使用奎尔德拉。
text.description: $n，如果你真的拥有奎尔德拉，我也许可以让你进入太阳之井。也许你知道这把剑的历史，知道萨洛瑞安·寻晨者曾经挥舞它对抗天灾军团，守卫太阳之井。他牺牲的地方就是今天的死亡之痕。正是因为他舍身血战，才为他的族人赢得了进行战争准备的时间。你可以在这座岛的死亡之痕南端找到他的遗迹。去那里看看，如果他的灵魂赐予你祝福，我就会让你进入太阳之井。
text.completion: I confess that I did not expect Thalorien's spirit to recognize you as the heir to Quel'Delar, but I defer to his judgment. You may enter the Sunwell, but I remind you that you are a guest in our most sacred of precincts, and you should act accordingly.

english.title: Thalorien Dawnseeker
english.objectives: Visit Thalorien Dawnseeker's Remains and obtain his blessing to wield Quel'Delar.
english.description: If you truly bear Quel'Delar, $n, I might be able to admit you to the Sunwell. If you know the blade's history, you recall that it was borne by Thalorien Dawnseeker in defense of the Sunwell against the Scourge. He fell in what is now the Dead Scar, buying time for his men to make their own preparations. You will find his remains near the southern end of the Dead Scar on this isle. Visit them, and if his spirit gives you its blessing, I will allow you to enter the Sunwell.
english.completion: I confess that I did not expect Thalorien's spirit to recognize you as the heir to Quel'Delar, but I defer to his judgment. You may enter the Sunwell, but I remind you that you are a guest in our most sacred of precincts, and you should act accordingly.

text.title: 恶臭的东西
text.objectives: 使用滑栓的空气分析器测试6位带有浓郁香气的卫兵周围的空气，然后返回奥格瑞玛，去见侦探斯奈普·滑栓。
text.description:
这种家伙有不少，对不对？多年以来，热砂集团一直控制着这里的节日生意。但突然之间，这些家伙一下子涌进了市场。他们不是热砂集团的，所以集团派我来调查这件事。这东西并非只有香气，还散发着一股臭味。

拿上这个设备，去分析一下那些卫兵周围的香气云。我想知道他们在那里都加了些什么。这很不正常。
text.progress: You analyze that reek yet, kid?
text.completion: Hey, thanks, kid. Give it over, let's take a look.$B$B<He takes the device from you and fiddles with it.>$B$BOh, that ain't good.

english.title: Something Stinks
english.objectives: Use Snagglebolt's Air Analyzer to test the air around 6 heavily perfumed guards, then return to Detective Snap Snagglebolt in Orgrimmar.
english.description:
Get a load of these guys, would ya? Steamwheedle's been handling the business of holidays for years, and all of a sudden, these guys bust into the market. They're not Steamwheedle; the cartel hired me to get to the bottom of this. Something stinks here and it ain't just perfume.

Take this device I brought and go analyze the perfume clouds around the guards. I want to know what they're putting in that stuff. Things ain't natural.
english.progress: You analyze that reek yet, kid?
english.completion: Hey, thanks, kid. Give it over, let's take a look.$B$B<He takes the device from you and fiddles with it.>$B$BOh, that ain't good.

text.title: 植物的攻击
text.objectives: 消灭丛生蔓藤，救下被抓住的5名陶拉祖难民。
text.description: 营地本建在丛林的边缘，现在已经被疯长的植物所包围了。一定是发生了什么非自然的事情！$B$B早前我犯下了一个错误，派稍微健康点的难民去收集坚果和浆果。据那些回来的人说，野生植物居然抓住了他们的脚，甚至把他们吊了起来。我担心那些还没有回来的人。$B$B$C，请把营地附近困在丛生藤蔓里的难民们救回来。
text.completion:
Thank you, $N. But now on to the larger question:

Where is this overgrowth coming from? And why is it raging out of control?

english.title: When Plants Attack
english.objectives: Rescue 5 Taurajo Refugees by killing the Grasping Overgrowths that ensnare them.
english.description: This camp was built at the edge of this jungle, and already it is overwhelmed by plant growth. Something unnatural is happening here!$B$BEarlier I made the mistake of sending some of the healthier refugees out to gather nuts and berries. Those that returned talked about the plant life actually grasping at their legs or even picking them up. I worry about those that haven't come back yet.$B$B$C, please rescue the refugees trapped in the grasping overgrowth around the camp.
english.completion:
Thank you, $N. But now on to the larger question:

Where is this overgrowth coming from? And why is it raging out of control?

objectiveDetails.description: 救下丛生蔓藤里的陶拉祖难民

text.title: 战争之舞
text.objectives: 打败石爪小径的奥尔诺·恐怖图腾。
text.description: 有人认为我们的人是温和的巨人，或是高尚的蛮族。他们从未见过我们和自己人……和内部的叛徒战斗的样子。$B$B出于仁慈，恐怖图腾只是遭到了流放，他们糟蹋了自己的家园，怨恨我们。这在莫高雷将不再被容许。$B$B我已经派我们的部队前去将他们赶出北边的石爪小径。你在对恐怖图腾的作战中表现很勇敢，$n。我要求你再次加入战斗。去吧，帮他们展开最后的一击。
text.completion:
Welcome back, $N.



What was done was not for revenge, or pride. It was simply to protect Thunder Bluff, and all our people, from torment and fear. Today, Mulgore is safe once more.

The Earth Mother thanks you for all your brave deeds, $N, as do I. You have earned your reward, hero. May you be welcome in Thunder Bluff always.
text.giverWindow: 击败他！

english.title: War Dance
english.objectives: Defeat Orno Grimtotem at Stonetalon Pass.
english.description: Some see our people as gentle giants, or noble savages. They have never seen us fight against our own kind...against betrayers from within.$B$BThe Grimtotem were offered mercy in exile, and they have scarred their own home to spite us. They will no longer be tolerated in Mulgore.$B$BI've already sent our warriors ahead to drive them out through Stonetalon Pass, to the north. You have fought bravely against the Grimtotem, $n; I ask that you join the battle again. Go, and help deal this final blow.
english.completion:
Welcome back, $N.



What was done was not for revenge, or pride. It was simply to protect Thunder Bluff, and all our people, from torment and fear. Today, Mulgore is safe once more.

The Earth Mother thanks you for all your brave deeds, $N, as do I. You have earned your reward, hero. May you be welcome in Thunder Bluff always.
english.giverWindow: Defeat him!

text.title: 香水行动
text.objectives: 被伪装成一个送包裹的人之后，前往奥格瑞玛大门外皇冠药剂公司的物资存放处，然后将他们给你的包裹交给奥格瑞玛的侦探斯奈普·滑栓。
text.description:
我就知道他们干不了什么好事！那里有一些能够影响神志的化学药剂，但现在我手中的样品太少，没办法对它进行分析。我需要更多这种药剂。

不要去花钱买那种东西！我可不想给那些恶棍一个铜板。你要想其它办法把它弄过来。

我会把你伪装成一个送包裹的。我看到那些恶棍正在城门外看守着一批那种货物。过去取包裹，千万不要逗留，否则他们就会认出你！他们会扔给你一只箱子。把箱子带到这里来。
text.progress: Did they toss ya a crate to deliver?
text.completion: You got it, huh? Good job, kid. Top notch. Let's see what we what we got here.$B$B<He cracks open the crate and rummages around inside.
text.end: 从奥格瑞玛外皇冠药剂公司物资存放处偷取香水包裹。
text.completed: 去找在奥格瑞玛的侦探斯奈普·滑栓。

english.title: Pilfering Perfume
english.objectives: While disguised as a package-runner, go to the Crown Chemical Company's stockpile outside the gates of Orgrimmar, then return the package they toss you to Detective Snap Snagglebolt in Orgimmar.
english.description:
I knew they were up to no good! There's some sort of mind-affecting chemical in here, but I can't get a handle on it with such a small sample. I need the real stuff.

Don't just go over there and buy it! I don't want you giving these scumbags one copper. Nah, you gotta get it from the source, discreet-like.

I'll disguise you as a package runner. I saw a stockpile guarded by their goons outside the gates. Go run by, and DON'T stop, or they'll make you! They'll toss you a crate. Bring it back here.
english.progress: Did they toss ya a crate to deliver?
english.completion: You got it, huh? Good job, kid. Top notch. Let's see what we what we got here.$B$B<He cracks open the crate and rummages around inside.
english.end: Steal perfume package from Crown Chemical Co. outside Orgrimmar
english.completed: Return to Detective Snap Snagglebolt in Orgrimmar.

text.title: 一朵奇怪的花
text.objectives: 在蔓生绿洲里初生的花朵上获得不寻常的花芽。
text.description: 大德鲁伊纳拉雷克斯出现在了贫瘠之地这里。他要么是这场混乱的主使，要么就是来修复它的。不管如何，你都应该趁丛林把整个世界都吞没之前，和他谈谈！他就在东南边一座不大的牛头人营地里。$B$B如果可以的话，你可以在路上收集一些植物样本给他去研究。初生的花芽会把最近在丛林里发生的许多变化都告诉他。
text.progress: I am extremely busy, $c.
text.completion: Ah, samples from different parts of the overgrowth? These will be immensely helpful, yes. Thank you, $c.

english.title: A Curious Bloom
english.objectives: Gather ten Unusual Flower Buds from Budding Flowers in the Overgrowth.
english.description: The great archdruid Naralex recently appeared here in the Barrens. He's either behind this mess or trying to fix it. Either way, you should talk with him before this jungle engulfs the whole world! He's in a small tauren camp to the southeast.$B$BAlong the way, it would be helpful for you to gather plant samples for him to study. The newest flower buds will tell him a great deal about the most recent changes in the jungle.
english.progress: I am extremely busy, $c.
english.completion: Ah, samples from different parts of the overgrowth? These will be immensely helpful, yes. Thank you, $c.

text.title: 妻离子散
text.objectives: 去找南贫瘠之地世仇哨站的基尔格·锐角。
text.description: 你看到的这些孩子都是在战斗开始时从陶拉祖救出来的。我试着想找到他们的父母。$B$B你从野猪人手上救下的一个难民认出了那个最强壮的孩子，就是基尔格和玛芙蕾·锐角夫妇的儿子。还有，他说基尔格就扎营在鲜血旷野，陶拉祖屠杀现场的北边。$B$B$n，请你到那里去，告诉基尔格·锐角，他的孩子还活得好好的！
text.completion:
<Kirge listens intently and then falls to one knee.>

Alive! My boy still lives! Praise to the earthmother, I still have a son.

<Kirge composes himself.>

$c, my boy's mother didn't make it out of Taurajo alive. I will avenge her death, even if it means my son grows up without either of his parents.
text.completed: 去找南贫瘠之地世仇哨站的基尔格·锐角。

english.title: A Family Divided
english.objectives: Find Kirge Sternhorn at Vendetta Point in Southern Barrens.
english.description: The children you see here were all rescued from Taurajo when the fighting started. I'm trying to track down their parents.$B$BOne of the refugees you rescued from the quilboar recognized the strongest child as belonging to Kirge and Mawre Sternhorn. Moreover, he said Kirge was camped at the Fields of Blood, just north of the Taurajo massacre site.$B$B$n, please go there and tell Kirge Sternhorn that his child is alive and well!
english.completion:
<Kirge listens intently and then falls to one knee.>

Alive! My boy still lives! Praise to the earthmother, I still have a son.

<Kirge composes himself.>

$c, my boy's mother didn't make it out of Taurajo alive. I will avenge her death, even if it means my son grows up without either of his parents.
english.completed: Find Kirge Sternhorn at Vendetta Point in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 神圣的和堕落的
text.objectives: 将圣光的复仇、25块源生萨隆邪铁、腐面的酸性血液和烂肠的酸性血液放进冰冠堡垒大领主莫格莱尼的符文熔炉中。$B$B腐面的酸性血液和烂肠的酸性血液只能在25人模式的冰冠堡垒中获得。
text.description: $r，我其实不该把这个任务交给你，也许这会导致你的毁灭。$b$b不要理会我的这些话了，听听我要你去完成的任务吧。我会为你提供足够的信息和资源帮助你完成这个任务。$b$b你必须返回霜之哀伤洞穴，取得圣光的复仇——那把被阿尔萨斯丢弃的锤子。用萨隆邪铁重新铸炼它，在它上面用巫妖王奴仆的酸性血液雕刻符文。它会成为我们实行计划的基础。
text.progress: As you draw near, the forge's flame seems to burn even more ravenously...

english.title: The Sacred and the Corrupt
english.objectives: Place Light's Vengeance, 25 Primordial Saronite, Rotface's Acidic Blood, and Festergut's Acidic Blood in Highlord Mograine's runeforge in Icecrown Citadel.$B$BRotface's Acidic Blood and Festergut's Acidic Blood may only be obtained in the 25 person difficulty setting of Icecrown Citadel.
english.description: It is against my judgment that I present you this errand, $r, as it will likely end in your undoing.$b$bIgnore my counsel and embark on the endeavor, and I shall provide you with the knowledge and resources to see it through.$b$bYou must return to Frostmourne Cavern and recover Light's Vengeance, Arthas' discarded hammer. Reforged with saronite and etched with the acidic blood of the Lich King's abominations, it will provide the foundation for our work.
english.progress: As you draw near, the forge's flame seems to burn even more ravenously...

starters.name: 大领主达里安·莫格莱尼

text.title: 贫瘠之地的防线
text.objectives: 在鲜血旷野占领一座中立的山丘，并抵御联盟的反攻。
text.description: 联盟的烧杀抢掠在贫瘠之地上留下了一道焦痕。必须阻止他们继续扩张，否则我们将丧失所有领地。$B$B鲜血旷野上有若干座战略型山丘，由木质塔楼和中立的灰色旗帜标示。只有占领这些山丘，才能阻止联盟的攻势！$B$B占领陶拉祖废墟北面、东面以及南面的山丘。夺取一面中立旗帜并抵御联盟的反攻！
text.completion: So you held your ground! With tenacity like yours we may yet drive the Alliance from our lands.

english.title: A Line in the Dirt
english.objectives: Capture a neutral hill in the Fields of Blood and defend it against an Alliance counterattack.
english.description: The Alliance scorches a trail of murder across the Barrens. We must stop them here or there is nothing left for us.$B$BAcross the Fields of Blood there are a number of strategic hills, marked by wooden towers and neutral gray banners. We must take and hold these hills if we hope to slow the Alliance advance!$B$BLook for the towers to the north, east, and south of what's left of Taurajo. Claim a neutral flag and defend the hill against counterattack!
english.completion: So you held your ground! With tenacity like yours we may yet drive the Alliance from our lands.

text.title: 灵魂盛宴
text.objectives: 大领主达里安·莫格莱尼希望你用影锋在冰冠堡垒消灭50个巫妖王的爪牙。在10人或25人模式中都可以收集灵魂。
text.description: 影锋是$c手中最强大的武器之一。$b$b你对力量的欲望已经满足了吗，$r？$b$b<你感觉到莫格莱尼的目光仿佛要将你刺穿。>$b$b我相信你没有。我最后要给你一个警告……$b$b现在你已经陷入了最危险的境地。控制住自己的欲望，如果你的决心中掺杂了私欲，那么你的生命和灵魂都有可能因此而毁灭。$b$b你所握持的武器只不过是一个空壳，一个真实力量的影子。

english.title: A Feast of Souls
english.objectives: Highlord Darion Mograine wants you to use Shadow's Edge to slay 50 of the Lich King's minions in Icecrown Citadel. Souls can be obtained in 10 or 25 person difficulty.
english.description: Shadow's Edge is among the greatest weapons a $c could hope to obtain.$b$bIs your lust for power sated, $r?$b$b<You feel Mograine's penetrating gaze.>$b$bI thought not. A final warning then...$b$bYou now embark on the most treacherous leg of your quest. Bridle your aspirations, for if your aims are impure then your life, your very soul, is forfeit.$b$bThe weapon you hold is but an empty husk, a mere shadow of what it may become.

starters.name: 大领主达里安·莫格莱尼

enders.name: 大领主达里安·莫格莱尼

text.title: 碎裂的王座
text.objectives: 大领主达里安·莫格莱尼要你收集50块影霜碎片。$B$B影霜碎片只能在25人模式下获得。
text.description: 巫妖王的王座再一次成为了他的牢狱。它是基尔加丹亲手从扭曲的下层位面中雕刻出来的冰晶容器。制作它的唯一目的就是封锢耐奥祖的灵魂。$b$b当阿尔萨斯用霜之哀伤击中这块冰晶的时候，他就释放了耐奥祖的灵魂，并让这个充满仇恨的灵魂和他融为一体。而这次打击所迸出的冰封王座碎片也散落在冰冠堡垒各处。$b$b我需要用这些碎片封印你的剑刃中蕴含的力量。而这些碎片都在巫妖王最强大的仆人手中。

english.title: The Splintered Throne
english.objectives: Highlord Darion Mograine wants you to collect 50 Shadowfrost Shards.$B$BShadowfrost Shards may only be obtained in the 25 person difficulty setting.
english.description: The Lich King's throne once served as his prison. Kil'jaeden himself crafted the vessel of icy crystals from the twisting nether, its sole purpose to hold Ner'zhul's vengeful spirit.$b$bWhen Arthas struck the crystal with Frostmourne, he released Ner'zhul's soul, allowing it to merge with his own. Splinters from that impact are now scattered throughout the citadel.$b$bI shall require those shards, held only by the Lich King's most powerful servants, to seal the power contained in your blade.

starters.name: 大领主达里安·莫格莱尼

enders.name: 大领主达里安·莫格莱尼

text.title: Shadowmourne...
text.objectives: Highlord Darion Mograine wants you to bring him Shadow's Edge.

english.title: Shadowmourne...
english.objectives: Highlord Darion Mograine wants you to bring him Shadow's Edge.

starters.name: 大领主达里安·莫格莱尼

enders.name: 大领主达里安·莫格莱尼

text.title: 雷霆崖之旅
text.objectives: 跟雷霆崖的贝恩·血蹄谈一谈。
text.description: 井水得到了净化，莫高雷的水再次变得清澈甘甜。你救了我们……但你也发现了恐怖的事态。一定要把恐怖图腾行动的消息传递出去。$B$B是时候让你进入我们建造在台地上的最宏伟的城市雷霆崖了。去找我们的首领，凯恩之子贝恩·血蹄。他必须知道这个消息。
text.completion:
Welcome to Thunder Bluff, $N. You've done great things for our people.

Tell me of your journey.

english.title: Journey into Thunder Bluff
english.objectives: Speak with Baine Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff.
english.description: The wells are cleansed, and Mulgore's waters run sweet and clear once more. You've saved us...but you've also uncovered grim happenings. The actions of the Grimtotem must be made known.$B$BIt is time for you to enter Thunder Bluff, our great city atop the mesa.  Go to our leader, Baine Bloodhoof, son of Cairne. He must hear of this.
english.completion:
Welcome to Thunder Bluff, $N. You've done great things for our people.

Tell me of your journey.

text.title: 晋见新头领
text.objectives: 杀死北卫军侦察兵并收集10枚塞拉摩军功奖章。
text.description: $n，加杜尔指挥下的贫瘠之地保卫战进行得并不顺利。加尔鲁什派了血柄督军来接管军务。他就在营地里，如果你想给督军留个好印象的话，最好积极一点。$B$B去东边的鲜血旷野寻找北卫军侦察兵。如果你能呈上一叠他们的军功奖章，督军会对你刮目相看的！
text.progress: You look like the type of $c who gets things done. What news do you have from the field?
text.completion:
<Bloodhilt looks at the badges, then allows them to spill from his hands onto the sands below. His lips curl open into a toothy grin.>

Now THIS is what I like to see, $c! What is your name again?

You will go far here.

english.title: Meet the New Boss
english.objectives: Kill Northwatch Recon patrols and collect 10 Theramore Merit Badges.
english.description: Our defense of the Barrens hasn't gone well under Gar'dul's command, $n. Garrosh has sent Warlord Bloodhilt here to take control of the situation. He's here in camp, and if you want to make a good impression, you'll demonstrate some initiative.$B$BHead east into the Fields of Blood and seek out Northwatch recon units. Bringing the new Warlord a stack of their merit badges will help you make a name for yourself!
english.progress: You look like the type of $c who gets things done. What news do you have from the field?
english.completion:
<Bloodhilt looks at the badges, then allows them to spill from his hands onto the sands below. His lips curl open into a toothy grin.>

Now THIS is what I like to see, $c! What is your name again?

You will go far here.

text.title: 狮子的尊严
text.objectives: 任意杀死5只原野徘徊狮或原野傲鬃狮。
text.description: 想找联盟入侵者报仇的话，不妨仔细观察一下贫瘠之地最凶猛的掠食者。$B$B狮子在草丛间悄无声息地前行，它们生性奸诈且具有极强的爆发力。你可以从狮子身上了解战斗的真谛，而那正是我们需要的精神。$B$B捕杀原野徘徊狮和傲鬃狮，然后告诉我你学到了什么。狮群通常栖息在树荫下。
text.completion: Lion's Pride

english.title: Lion's Pride
english.objectives: Kill any combination of 5 Plains Prowlers or Plains Pridemanes.
english.description: If you seek vengeance on our Alliance invaders, you would do well to observe the fiercest of predators in the Barrens.$B$BThe lions that stalk amongst the tall grass do so with cunning, stealth, and power. Learn from their example and you will understand the kind of war we need to fight.$B$BHunt the plains prowlers and pridemanes, then return to me to discuss what you have learned. You will often find them in the shade of large trees.
english.completion: Lion's Pride

text.title: 奎尔德拉的净化
text.objectives: 将淬火的奎尔德拉浸入到太阳之井中。准备好进入太阳之井高地后，就同太阳之井守卫交谈。
text.description: 我承认，我一直怀疑你不可能重铸奎尔德拉，也不相信萨洛瑞安的灵魂会赐予你祝福。你不可能明白，奎尔德拉的重生对于我们一族意味着什么。$B$B我会履行诺言，让你进入太阳之井。你将在那里找到银月的领导者。将这把剑浸入到太阳之井中。当这把剑恢复了力量的时候，如果你举起它，就像萨洛瑞安说的那样，它就会与你绑缚在一起。

english.title: The Purification of Quel'Delar
english.objectives: Immerse your Tempered Quel'Delar in the Sunwell. Speak to a Warden of the Sunwell when you are ready to enter the Sunwell Plateau.
english.description: I admit, I was skeptical that you had actually re-forged Quel'Delar and I did not expect Thalorien's spirit to reveal itself to you. You cannot understand what it means to me and to the rest of my people that Quel'Delar has been recovered.$B$BAs promised, I will admit you to the Sunwell and you will find the leaders of Silvermoon within. Carry the sword to the chamber of the Sunwell and immerse it. The blade will bond to you. When that happens, carry it to Caladis Brightspear at Quel'Delar's Rest.

text.title: 残破的剑柄
text.objectives: 将残破的剑柄交给奎尔德拉之冢的麦雷昂·阳炎。他就在银色比武场的南边。
text.description: 这把残破的剑柄也有过好日子。当它的剑刃还没有折断的时候，它应该是代表着高超铸造工艺的一件杰出作品。$B$B它上面的精致雕刻和奇异宝石表明这件武器可能属于一个非常强大的人。夺日者一定会对它感兴趣的。去找到他们在奎尔德拉之冢的代表人。他应该就在银色比武场的南边。

english.title: The Battered Hilt
english.objectives: Bring the Battered Hilt to Myralion Sunblaze at Quel'Delar's Rest, south of the Argent Tournament Grounds.
english.description: This battered old sword hilt has seen better days. Before the hilt was snapped from the blade, it must've been a magnificent example of the blacksmith's art.$B$BThe graceful symbols and exotic gemstones decorating the hilt suggest that the weapon may have belonged to a powerful person. Surely, the Sunreavers would be interested in hearing about the recovery of such an artifact. Seek out their representatives at Quel'Delar's Rest, to the south of the Argent Tournament Grounds.

text.title: 巨龙所知道的
text.objectives: 同龙眠神殿顶端的克拉苏斯交谈。
text.description: 肯定错不了——这把剑柄曾经是一件古老强大的武器。但具体情况我就不清楚了。我从没有见过或听说过有这种花纹标记的剑。但这不代表没有人认识它。$B$B克里奥斯塔兹，他更广为人知的名字是克拉苏斯。他一直都是奎尔多雷和肯瑞托的朋友，并拥有广博无边的知识学养。对此他一定知道些什么。到龙眠神殿的顶端，向他询问一下这件事。然后向达拉然夺日者圣殿的魔导师哈瑟尔报告。
text.completion: We must recover that book from the Silver Covenant. Without that book from Krasus, we stand little chance of solving the mystery of the sword in Icecrown or unlocking its power.

english.title: What The Dragons Know
english.objectives: Speak to Krasus at the top of Wyrmrest Temple.
english.description: There's no mistaking it - this hilt comes from a powerful, ancient weapon, but which one? I do not recognize these particular markings, but we haven't hit a dead end yet.$B$BKorialstrasz, better known as Krasus, has long been a friend to the quel'dorei and the Kirin Tor. With his vast knowledge and resources, he's certain to know something. Travel to the top of Wyrmrest Temple and seek his counsel, then report to Magister Hathorel inside Sunreaver's Sanctuary in Dalaran.
english.completion: We must recover that book from the Silver Covenant. Without that book from Krasus, we stand little chance of solving the mystery of the sword in Icecrown or unlocking its power.

objectiveDetails.description: 询问克拉苏斯关于刀柄的来历

text.title: 适当的伪装
text.objectives: 从山迪·格罗斯那里取得“借来的战袍”。
text.description: 进入银色领地绝不是说说那样简单。只有那些穿着银色盟约制服的人才能进入圣殿。如果我们能得到一件这种制服，只要一个简单的法术就能解决所有问题了。$B$B在命运丝线上方的露台上，你会找到山迪·格罗斯。过去我帮过他几次，他欠我一个情。他负责为这座城市中的各种人洗涤衣物。也许他能想办法“暂借”你一件衣服。
text.progress: Was Shandy able to help you get a Silver Covenant tabard?
text.completion: I knew Shandy would find a way to make it work. Let me get this enchanted and ready for you to use. With any luck, the tabard's owner won't even know it's missing and Shandy will cover the rest of our tracks.

english.title: A Suitable Disguise
english.objectives: Obtain a Borrowed Tabard from Shandy Glossgleam.
english.description: Getting you inside the Silver Enclave will be tougher than it appears. Only those who possess Silver Covenant tabards are permitted entry to sanctuary. If we can get our hands on one, a simple enchantment will do the rest of the work.$B$BOn the balcony above Threads of Fate, you'll find Shandy Glossgleam. I've helped him a few times in the past, so he owes me a favor. He handles laundry for a wide variety of people in the city. Maybe he can find a way to 'lend' you a tabard for a while.
english.progress: Was Shandy able to help you get a Silver Covenant tabard?
english.completion: I knew Shandy would find a way to make it work. Let me get this enchanted and ready for you to use. With any luck, the tabard's owner won't even know it's missing and Shandy will cover the rest of our tracks.

text.title: 银色盟约的计谋
text.objectives: 取得银色盟约命令。
text.description: 我在达拉然下水道的一个线人发现一名银色盟约密探正在咒语和乌鸦旅店收集情报。银色盟约通常不会出现在那些下水道里。他们在那里一定有着某种不可告人的计划。$B$B到达拉然下水道去，找到那名银色盟约密探，把他处理掉，然后在他身上寻找一切有用的情报。也许我们能从他身上知道那部龙眠宝典的所在位置。我们绝不能让银色盟约的人把它带回到冰冠冰川去。
text.progress: Did you find anything of use on that agent?
text.completion: <Magister Hathorel reads the captured orders.>$B$BThe agent you intercepted was supposed to deliver the Wyrmrest tome to Icecrown, after meeting with one Arcanist Tybalin inside the Silver Enclave. We have to reclaim that book, $N, and we only have one chance before it leaves the city. We have to work quickly.

english.title: The Silver Covenant's Scheme
english.objectives: Capture the Silver Covenant Orders.
english.description: One of my contacts in the Underbelly caught sight of a Silver Covenant agent gathering information at the Cantrips and Crows Tavern. Silver Covenant members aren't normally found in the sewers, so they must be plotting something.$B$BGo into the Underbelly, find this Silver Covenant agent, and eliminate him. Search the body for any information that might give us a lead on the location of that tome from Wyrmrest. We can't let those simpering Silver Covenant weaklings get it back to Icecrown before we do.
english.progress: Did you find anything of use on that agent?
english.completion: <Magister Hathorel reads the captured orders.>$B$BThe agent you intercepted was supposed to deliver the Wyrmrest tome to Icecrown, after meeting with one Arcanist Tybalin inside the Silver Enclave. We have to reclaim that book, $N, and we only have one chance before it leaves the city. We have to work quickly.

text.title: 去见麦雷昂·阳炎
text.objectives: 将上古龙铸之刃交给奎尔德拉之冢的麦雷昂·阳炎。
text.description: 我们必须立刻将这本书交给麦雷昂·阳炎。你能帮我这个忙吗？你已经证明自己有足够的实力击败银色盟约，除了你以外，我无法信任其他人能够完成这个任务。$B$B带着这本书前往奎尔德拉之冢。它就在冰冠冰川银色比武场的南边。麦雷昂会等着你。如果他能鉴别出这把剑，我们就能以艾萨斯·夺日者的名义拥有它，让达拉然和联盟都明白，进攻巫妖王的冲锋将由我们来统率。
text.progress: We've been expecting your return. What has kept you?
text.completion: <Myralion accepts the heavy book and begins leafing through it.>$B$BThose symbols on the blade seemed familiar and now there's little wonder why. This is certainly a dragon blade, gifted to one of the mortal races, but which blade is this, and how did it come to rest in Icecrown?

english.title: Return To Myralion Sunblaze
english.objectives: Bring Ancient Dragonforged Blades to Myralion Sunblaze at Quel'Delar's Rest.
english.description: We must get this book to Myralion Sunblade. Would you bring it to him? I cannot rely on anyone else to transport the book and you have proven adept at evading the Silver Covenant's men.$B$BTake it with you to Quel'Delar's Rest, south of the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown. Myralion will be waiting for you. If he can identify that blade, we may be able to claim it in the name of Aethas Sunreaver and show Dalaran and the Alliance that we will lead the charge against the Lich King.
english.progress: We've been expecting your return. What has kept you?
english.completion: <Myralion accepts the heavy book and begins leafing through it.>$B$BThose symbols on the blade seemed familiar and now there's little wonder why. This is certainly a dragon blade, gifted to one of the mortal races, but which blade is this, and how did it come to rest in Icecrown?

text.title: 利剑的重铸
text.objectives: 取得5块注能的萨隆邪铁锭和熔炉之主的巨锤，将它们和奎尔德拉的残片融为一体，制造出重铸的奎尔德拉。
text.description: 我们不能让奎尔德拉就这样只是一堆耻辱的碎片。带上这把剑的残片和你发现的剑柄，到冰冠堡垒的萨隆矿坑去。$B$B巫妖王强迫许多奴隶在那里采掘熔炼萨隆邪铁矿石。我们要用萨隆邪铁重铸奎尔德拉。$B$B你必须取得注能的萨隆邪铁锭和熔炉之主的大锤，然后用它们在熔炉之主的铁砧上重铸这把剑。
text.progress: Were you able to reconstruct Quel'Delar?
text.completion: You have remade the blade of Quel'Delar in defiance of that Blood-Queen Lana'thel's pronouncement! Now, the blade must be tempered before we can show her the folly of her words.

english.title: Reforging The Sword
english.objectives: Obtain 5 Infused Saronite Bars and the Forgemaster's Hammer, then combine them with the Remnants of Quel'Delar to create the Reforged Quel'Delar.
english.description: We cannot allow Quel'Delar to remain broken and disgraced. Take the remnants of the sword, along with the battered hilt you discovered, and venture into the Pit of Saron within Icecrown Citadel.$B$BIn the pit, the Lich King uses slaves to mine, process, and transform saronite ore. This infused saronite is what we will use to rebuild Quel'Delar.$B$BYou must gather bars of infused saronite and capture the forgemaster's hammer, then bring them to the forgemaster's anvil and reforge the sword.
english.progress: Were you able to reconstruct Quel'Delar?
english.completion: You have remade the blade of Quel'Delar in defiance of that Blood-Queen Lana'thel's pronouncement! Now, the blade must be tempered before we can show her the folly of her words.

text.title: 锻造利剑
text.objectives: 在灵魂坩锅锻造已经重铸的奎尔德拉。
text.description: 破碎的奎尔德拉终于完整如初了，但如果不经过适当的锻打，你还无法使用它作战。它参差不齐的萨隆邪铁边缘仍然脆弱易碎。$B$B你可以在冰冠堡垒深处的灵魂洪炉对它进行深度锻造。把奎尔德拉带到噬魂者的住所去，找到那里的坩埚。将这把剑放进坩埚里，对它进行锻造，然后再回来见我。我会在冰封大殿等你。
text.progress: Until the sword is tempered, it will be useless.
text.completion: Tempering the sword should've restored the blade. Why hasn't it worked?

english.title: Tempering The Blade
english.objectives: Temper the Re-forged Quel'Delar in the Crucible of Souls.
english.description: At last, the pieces of Quel'Delar are rejoined and the blade is whole, but it cannot see battle until you have tempered it. That jagged saronite edge is brittle and will shatter the moment it strikes anything.$B$BDeep in Icecrown Citadel's Forge of Souls is a place where the blade can safely be tempered. Take Quel'Delar with you to the abode of the Devourer of Souls and look for the crucible. Plunge the blade into the crucible to temper it and bring it back to me. I'll be waiting in The Frozen Halls.
english.progress: Until the sword is tempered, it will be useless.
english.completion: Tempering the sword should've restored the blade. Why hasn't it worked?

text.title: 映像大厅
text.objectives: 将淬火的奎尔德拉带到映像大厅里面的剑冢去。
text.description: 你已经重铸了这把剑，并对它进行了锻造，但它仍然只是静静地躺在剑鞘里，丝毫没有显示出它应有的力量。你说这把剑在吸引你，就好象它拥有自己的意志？$B$B你敢把它带到它想去的地方吗？这把剑不应该如此沉默，但如果你不把它带去那个地方，也许我们将永远不知道这是为什么。把它带进冰冠堡垒的映像大厅。在那里一定要万分小心！我会在冰封大殿等你。
text.progress: What happened inside the Halls of Reflection?
text.completion: How can evil take root in such a sword? I would not have thought it possible if the evidence wasn't here before my eyes. If the greatest of dragonkind's creations could be corrupted and turned against them, why not a mere sword?$B$BI believe Uther is right. You must heed his advice quickly, $N.

english.title: The Halls Of Reflection
english.objectives: Bring Quel'Delar to Sword's Rest inside the Halls of Reflection.
english.description: You have re-forged and tempered the sword, yet it sits quietly in its sheath, little different from a mundane blade. You say the sword pulls you, as though it possesses a will?$B$BDare you bring it where it wishes to go? It is not right that the sword should be this silent and this insistent, yet I fear that if you do not take the sword to its destination, we will never learn why. Bear it with you to Icecrown Citadel's Halls of Reflection, but be on your guard. I will wait for you in The Frozen Halls.
english.progress: What happened inside the Halls of Reflection?
english.completion: How can evil take root in such a sword? I would not have thought it possible if the evidence wasn't here before my eyes. If the greatest of dragonkind's creations could be corrupted and turned against them, why not a mere sword?$B$BI believe Uther is right. You must heed his advice quickly, $N.

objectiveDetails.description: 将奎尔德拉带到映像大厅

text.title: 太阳之井之旅
text.objectives: 在奎尔丹纳斯岛，太阳之井高地入口处同哈杜伦·明翼交谈。
text.description: 尽快将奎尔德拉带到太阳之井，$n。要相信乌瑟尔的话，他说过，当这把剑受到巫妖王邪恶力量的影响时，你无法彻底控制它。你必须前往奎尔丹纳斯岛，在那里，设法进入太阳之井，只有在那你才能净化这把剑。$B$B太阳之井的守卫会阻拦你前往太阳井高地，所以你必须找到哈杜伦·明翼，他会在那里巡视那些守卫。
text.progress: What brings you here?
text.completion: I hope you understand that I can't just admit you to the Sunwell, $N. This is the most sacred place known to the sin'dorei and we have only recently regained control over it.$B$BYou would raise the hopes of our people with tales of Quel'Delar? Without proof of the truth of your claims, I see no reason to take you at your word.

english.title: Journey To The Sunwell
english.objectives: Speak with Halduron Brightwing at the entrance to the Sunwell Plateau on the Isle of Quel'Danas.
english.description: Take Quel'Delar to the Sunwell as quickly as possible, $n. Trust in Uther's words when he says that you will not always be able to control the blade while it is subject to the evil of the Lich King's influence. You must travel to the Isle of Quel'Danas, and there, seek entry to the Sunwell itself, where you can cleanse the sword.$B$BThe guardians will try to stop you from entering the Sunwell Plateau, but make yourself known to Halduron Brightwing, who will be inspecting the guards there.
english.progress: What brings you here?
english.completion: I hope you understand that I can't just admit you to the Sunwell, $N. This is the most sacred place known to the sin'dorei and we have only recently regained control over it.$B$BYou would raise the hopes of our people with tales of Quel'Delar? Without proof of the truth of your claims, I see no reason to take you at your word.

text.title: 萨洛瑞安·寻晨者
text.objectives: 访问萨洛瑞安·寻晨者的遗体，获得他的祝福，以使用奎尔德拉。
text.description: 你就是那个帮助过麦雷昂·阳炎的人？我知道一个办法可以测试这把剑。$B$B也许你知道这把剑的历史，知道萨洛瑞安·寻晨者曾经挥舞它对抗天灾军团，守卫太阳之井。他牺牲的地方就是今天的死亡之痕。正是因为他舍身血战，才为他的族人赢得了进行战争准备的时间。你可以在这座岛的死亡之痕南端找到他的遗迹。去那里看看，如果他的灵魂赐予你祝福，我就会让你进入太阳之井。
text.completion: You truly do carry Quel'Delar. This is a great day for all of Quel'Thalas and the sin'dorei. You have my leave to enter the Sunwell and finish the sword's restoration. Keep your head high, $N. The children of Silvermoon have dreamt of this day for years.

english.title: Thalorien Dawnseeker
english.objectives: Visit Thalorien Dawnseeker's Remains and obtain his blessing to wield Quel'Delar.
english.description: You are the one working with Myralion Sunblaze, arent you? I know of a way we can test the sword.$B$BIf you know the blade's history, you recall that it was borne by Thalorien Dawnseeker in defense of the Sunwell against the Scourge. He fell in what is now the Dead Scar, buying time for his men to make their own preparations. You will find his remains near the southern end of the Dead Scar on this isle. Visit them, and if his spirit gives you its blessing, I will allow you to enter the Sunwell.
english.completion: You truly do carry Quel'Delar. This is a great day for all of Quel'Thalas and the sin'dorei. You have my leave to enter the Sunwell and finish the sword's restoration. Keep your head high, $N. The children of Silvermoon have dreamt of this day for years.

text.title: 奎尔德拉的净化
text.objectives: 将被污染的奎尔德拉放入太阳之井。准备好进入太阳之井高地后，就同太阳之井守卫交谈。
text.description: $n，你的面前就是太阳之井和奎尔德拉流亡的终点。$B$B你会在太阳之井中找到奎尔萨拉斯的摄政王洛瑟玛·塞隆和大法师罗曼斯。一定要对他们保持警惕，不要掉进他们的政治陷阱中。$B$B但你主要的精力必须集中在你的任务上。当你准备进入太阳之井时，就和一名太阳之井守卫谈谈。将新的奎尔德拉放进太阳之井中，完成这把神剑的重生。如果你举起它，就像萨洛瑞安说的那样，它就会与你绑缚在一起。

english.title: The Purification of Quel'Delar
english.objectives: Immerse your Tempered Quel'Delar in the Sunwell. Speak to a Warden of the Sunwell when you are ready to enter the Sunwell Plateau.
english.description: The Sunwell and the end of Quel'Delar's exile await, $n.$B$BYou will find Lor'themar Theron, the regent of Quel'Thalas, and Grand Magister Rommath standing within. Be wary and do not allow them to entrap you in their political scheming.$B$BInstead, remain focused on your task here. Speak to a Warden of the Sunwell when you are ready to enter the Sunwell. Immerse the reformed Quel'Delar in the Sunwell to complete the restoration. Afterward, show the blade to Myralion Sunblaze at Quel'Delar's Rest.

text.title: 生物干预
text.objectives: 杀掉5条变异恐齿迅猛龙和5只变异平原陆行鸟。
text.description: 这里释放的能量在野生动物中爆发了，将它们扭曲成强大而不稳定的形态。若是放任它们散布到林地以外，这场变异将使现有的生态系统遭到涂炭，它们会吞噬掉当地的猎物并把相对弱小的自然生物驱赶殆尽。$B$B你必须去削减疯狂生长的种群数量。任务完成后再回来找我。
text.completion: Thank you, $N. I'm pleased to see you return intact; the viciousness I've been seeing among these creatures is startling.

english.title: Biological Intervention
english.objectives: Kill 5 Deviate Terrortooths and 5 Deviate Plainstriders.
english.description: The energies unleashed here have surged through the wildlife, twisting them into powerful and unstable forms. If allowed to spread beyond this grove, these deviates will wreak havoc on the existing ecosystem, devouring local prey and driving out the weaker natural creatures.$B$BYou must go and cull the population of the overgrowth. Return when this task is done.
english.completion: Thank you, $N. I'm pleased to see you return intact; the viciousness I've been seeing among these creatures is startling.

text.title: 播种解决方案
text.objectives: 在6头变异恐齿迅猛龙或变异平原陆行鸟身上使用抚慰之种，观察结果。
text.description: 基于你带给我的东西，我想我们或许有一个解决方案。我在鞭藤的种子里附上了治疗能量。$B$B只要和它接触，就可以将足够的能量注入到生物中去，把堕落的影响给逼出来。$B$B去把种子撒在变异的迅猛龙和平原陆行鸟身上，试着治疗它们，把结果报告给我。
text.completion:
Oh dear. It seems the forces at work here are a bit difficult to control...

Please, don't bother Naralex with this. It will only upset him.

english.title: Sowing a Solution
english.objectives: Use Soothing Seeds on 6 Deviate Terrortooths or Deviate Plainstriders and observe the results.
english.description: Based on what you've brought me, I think we may have a solution. I've imbued the lashvine seeds with healing energies.$B$BSimple contact with these should imbue the creatures here with enough energy to force out the corrupted influence.$B$BGo and attempt to heal the mutated raptors and plainstriders by sprinkling the seeds on them, and report the results back to me.
english.completion:
Oh dear. It seems the forces at work here are a bit difficult to control...

Please, don't bother Naralex with this. It will only upset him.

text.title: 参加预选赛
text.objectives: 跟科赞岛卡亚罗运动场的克罗斯彻克教练谈一谈。
text.description: $n，锈水海盗队的头儿克罗斯彻克教练正在找你。$B$B他说锈水海盗队正在与热砂港大鲨鱼队争夺分区冠军，而你是比赛获胜的唯一关键人物！$B$B朝西走进入镇子，你不可能错过卡亚罗运动场的！$B$B足球明星。这头衔对你的个人形象非常有好处！
text.completion: There you are, my $g boy : girl;! Quick, there's no time to waste! We need to get one of these shredders back in working order.$B$BI'm bringing you off the bench... you're going to win the game and the title for us!

english.title: Report for Tryouts
english.objectives: Speak with Coach Crosscheck at Kajaro Field on Kezan.
english.description: $n, Coach Crosscheck is looking for you. He's the leader of our fearless footbomb team, the Bilgewater Buccaneers.$B$BHe says that the division title against the Steamwheedle Sharks is on the line and that you're the only one that can bring it home for us!$B$BHead west into town. You can't miss Kajaro Field.$B$BA footbomb star. This is going to be great for your image!
english.completion: There you are, my $g boy : girl;! Quick, there's no time to waste! We need to get one of these shredders back in working order.$B$BI'm bringing you off the bench... you're going to win the game and the title for us!

text.title: To the Walls!
text.objectives: Speak with Winnoa Pineforest at the Fields of Blood in order to defend the gates of Mulgore from attack.
text.description: $N, they're massing at the gates! The Alliance is trying to push their way into Mulgore, using footsoldiers to overwhelm the guards.$B$BWe have so little with which to defend the walls. We've kept pots of water boiling to repel the attackers until help arrives... Those will have to do.$B$BBut we need someone to coordinate our defenses. Say the word and I can give you an eagle-eye view of the battlefield.$B$BWe need you, $N!
text.completed: Return to Winnoa Pineforest at Vendetta Point in Southern Barrens.

english.title: To the Walls!
english.objectives: Speak with Winnoa Pineforest at the Fields of Blood in order to defend the gates of Mulgore from attack.
english.description: $N, they're massing at the gates! The Alliance is trying to push their way into Mulgore, using footsoldiers to overwhelm the guards.$B$BWe have so little with which to defend the walls. We've kept pots of water boiling to repel the attackers until help arrives... Those will have to do.$B$BBut we need someone to coordinate our defenses. Say the word and I can give you an eagle-eye view of the battlefield.$B$BWe need you, $N!
english.completed: Return to Winnoa Pineforest at Vendetta Point in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 摧毁攻城武器
text.objectives: 莫高雷巨门处的4个北卫军攻城弩车。
text.description: $n，你在鲜血旷野的表现证明了自己的实力。但是联盟对牛头人的威胁尚未解除。$B$B架在莫高雷城门外的攻城武器就像一根瞄准心脏的长矛。我要你前往南方的城门，摧毁那些攻城器械。$B$B来，带上这些粘性炸弹。它们是新盟友地精送来的礼物。看上去地精将火药粉塞进了……嗯……裹满了油脂的短袜。不过这玩意儿很管用的。
text.progress: Why did Gar'dul allow the Alliance to create such a buildup of heavy siege vehicles? Why wasn't a strike ordered until I got here? Gar'dul will have to answer for this...
text.completion:
Very good. Now, should they storm the gates, they will have to do so with infantry.

Do you think they have the stomach for that?

english.title: Siegebreaker
english.objectives: Destroy 4 Northwatch Siege Engines at the Mulgore Gates.
english.description: $n, you've proven yourself on the Fields of Blood. But the Alliance still threatens our tauren friends.$B$BThe siege machinery outside the gates of Mulgore is like a spear aimed at our heart. I want you to go to the gates, south of here, and remove those siege vehicles from play.$B$BHere, use these stickybombs. They're courtesy of our new goblin allies. It looks as though they stuffed explosive powder into ... what looks like ... grease-covered socks. But they'll do.
english.progress: Why did Gar'dul allow the Alliance to create such a buildup of heavy siege vehicles? Why wasn't a strike ordered until I got here? Gar'dul will have to answer for this...
english.completion:
Very good. Now, should they storm the gates, they will have to do so with infantry.

Do you think they have the stomach for that?

text.title: 蝰蛇排除法
text.objectives: 捕捉5条衰弱的蝰蛇。
text.description: 要想找到有效的方法对抗在这里爆发的腐化，我们就要研究它。$B$B幸运的是，并非所有的生物都遭到了转化。小型的蛇喝的水不多，也不吃植物，因此暴露在它们身上的能量也最小，不过它们所吸收到的那点能量还是令其改变了颜色。$B$B去蔓生绿洲把这种蛇抓来给我，我们好知道动物们到底发生了什么事。
text.progress: Have you collected enough? We'll need several for proper comparison.
text.completion: These will do perfectly. Bright colors like these don't occur naturally in the barrens, but they haven't developed any other mutations so far.

english.title: Adder Subtraction
english.objectives: Collect 5 Enervated Adders.
english.description: The corruption unleashed here must be studied if we're to find a way of properly fighting it.$B$BLuckily, not all the creatures have been as altered as others. The smaller snakes drink little water, and do not eat plants, so their exposure to the energies here has been minimal. They've still absorbed enough to change coloration.$B$BGo collect these snakes from the overgrowth and return them to me, so we can see just what is happening to the creatures here.
english.progress: Have you collected enough? We'll need several for proper comparison.
english.completion: These will do perfectly. Bright colors like these don't occur naturally in the barrens, but they haven't developed any other mutations so far.

text.title: 鞭藤种子
text.objectives: 从鞭藤身上采集4颗苦痛之种。
text.description: 一定有办法能治好这些可怜的生物，而不用夺走它们的生命。我有一个主意，但我需要你的帮助，$c。$B$B游荡在这里的鞭藤所持有的种子里充满了原始的能量。把这种东西给我带来一些，让我们看看是不是能做些什么。
text.progress: Do you have the seeds?
text.completion: I'm concerned by how...active these are. Nevertheless, it simply means we must continue to act quickly before the corruption here becomes worse.

english.title: Lashvine Seeds
english.objectives: Collect 4 Writhing Seeds from Lashvines.
english.description: There's got to be a way to cure these poor creatures without having to take their lives. I have an idea, but I'll need your help, $c.$B$BThe lashvine plants that roam here hold seeds full of the primal energy of this place. Collect these for me and bring them back, and we'll see if something can be done.
english.progress: Do you have the seeds?
english.completion: I'm concerned by how...active these are. Nevertheless, it simply means we must continue to act quickly before the corruption here becomes worse.

text.title: 夺回陶拉祖
text.objectives: 在陶拉祖废墟中杀死8名陶拉祖强夺者。
text.description: $n，你在城门保卫战中的表现非常出色！联盟的主力部队已经开始撤离了。但是我并不满意这个结局。$B$B他们袭击了陶拉祖，连一座小小的猎人营地也不放过。所谓“联盟”，不过是一帮无耻的屠夫。$B$B现在还有一小撮人在陶拉祖废墟处徘徊，翻捡着残留的财宝。$B$B<血柄将战斧往地上一扔。>$B$B让他们尝到痛苦的滋味。
text.completion: Excellent. I'll have their bodies strung up along the gold road as a message to the Alliance.

english.title: Taking Back Taurajo
english.objectives: Kill 8 Taurajo Looters in the ruins of Taurajo.
english.description: Outstanding work at the gates, $n! The main body of the Alliance force is in general retreat. But I'm not satisfied.$B$BThey sacked Taurajo, which was little more than a hunters' camp. This 'Alliance' is unmasked at last for what it really is: A renegade band of butchers.$B$BEven now a group of humans linger behind to pick at the bones of smouldering Taurajo.$B$B<Bloodhilt hurls an axe into the dirt.>$B$BMake them suffer.
english.completion: Excellent. I'll have their bodies strung up along the gold road as a message to the Alliance.

text.title: 纪念亡者
text.objectives: 对陶拉祖废墟中克鲁姆、德拉恩、犹纳达以及欧姆萨的尸体使用葬礼图腾。
text.description: 威胁已经解除，你能不能再帮我们处理一件棘手的事务？$B$B依照牛头人的风俗，我们从不掩埋死者，而是将遗体放置在神圣的陵园中，让其回归自然。我们尚未为陶拉祖大屠杀中丧命的同胞举行葬礼仪式，我担心误闯进来的联盟士兵会焚烧遗体。$B$B$n，请带上这根图腾前往陶拉祖，为克鲁姆、德拉恩、犹纳达和欧姆萨举行仪式。他们……不幸罹难。
text.progress: Have their spirits found peace with the Earthmother?
text.completion:
<Winnoa bows her head.>

Thank you.

english.title: Honoring the Dead
english.objectives: Use the Funerary Totem on the corpses of Krulmoo, Dranh, Yonada, and Omusa in the ruins of Taurajo.
english.description: With the immediate threat gone, can you help with some grim business?$B$BWe tauren do not bury our dead, we prepare the body for its return to the elements and place it at our sacred grave sites. Those killed in the Taurajo massacre have had no funeral, and I worry misguided Alliance soldiers will burn the bodies of the dead before the proper rites have been performed.$B$B$n, please take this totem to Taurajo and perform services for Krulmoo, Dranh, Yonada, and Omusa. They ... didn't make it out of there.
english.progress: Have their spirits found peace with the Earthmother?
english.completion:
<Winnoa bows her head.>

Thank you.

text.title: 收获混沌
text.objectives: 杀死5株蔓生植物，并找到一颗蠕动之心。
text.description: 如果我真的把混沌种了下去，那么现在就是收割的时候了。$B$B疯狂生长的蔓生植物正在缓缓趟过此地的魔法脉流，$n。它们是造成该地区变异的不稳定力量的直接显现。尽你所能把它们除掉，或许我们能够减缓疯狂生长的进一步扩散。$B$B你在做的时候……记得留意它们看起来明显腐化的部分。把那样的东西带来给我。
text.progress: Cutting down the outgrowth will merely buy us some time. Have you found any suspicious pieces?
text.completion:
<Naralex slowly takes the squirming heart from you, visibly disturbed.>

I've been a fool. The one truth I did not want to accept has been staring me in the face this entire time...this foul thing is proof of that.

You and I have much work to do.

english.title: To Harvest Chaos
english.objectives: Kill 5 Outgrowths and find a Squirming Heart.
english.description: If I have truly sown chaos, it is time for reaping.$B$BThe lumbering outgrowths of plant life shamble through the imbued stream here, $n. They are a direct manifestation of the unstable forces mutating this area. Slay as many as you can, and we might be able to slow the spread of the overgrowth further.$B$BAnd while you're at it...be on the lookout for parts of them that appear especially corrupted. Bring any such pieces to me.
english.progress: Cutting down the outgrowth will merely buy us some time. Have you found any suspicious pieces?
english.completion:
<Naralex slowly takes the squirming heart from you, visibly disturbed.>

I've been a fool. The one truth I did not want to accept has been staring me in the face this entire time...this foul thing is proof of that.

You and I have much work to do.

text.title: 解放村民
text.objectives: 进入烬石矿井，释放5名被奴役的村民。
text.description: 近来，我们发现烬石村的村民在数次狼人诅咒的爆发中均幸免于难。$B$B但是他们却未能抵御被遗忘者的入侵。$B$B许多村民沦为被遗忘者的囚徒，被赶往附近的矿洞进行作业。
text.completion: You've done it again, $N.  The freed villagers are eager to help us against the Forsaken in any way they can.

english.title: Liberation Day
english.objectives: Free 5 Enslaved Villagers inside the Emberstone Mine.
english.description: We recently found out that the villagers at Emberstone survived most of the ravages of the Curse.$B$BUnfortunately their village wasn't as fortunate when it came to the Forsaken invasion.$B$BThe Forsaken have taken the villagers prisoner and are forcing them to work the nearby mine as slaves.
english.completion: You've done it again, $N.  The freed villagers are eager to help us against the Forsaken in any way they can.

objectiveDetails.description: 释放被奴役的吉尔尼斯人

text.title: 友善地交谈……
text.objectives: 前往奥格瑞玛城中的飞艇塔，向斯内维尔·拉斯罗凯特询问关于供给物资的事情。然后带着他给你的证据回去。
text.description: <你向洛卡讲述为什么要追查斯内维尔。洛卡的脸上露出厌恶的表情。>$B$B你是说，我一直被一名炼金师的法术控制着？真是无法相信，我竟然会蒙受这样的欺骗！如果我抓住那个奸诈的小地精，我一定会将它撕碎！$B$B如果他已经完成了使命，那么他现在应该正赶往奥格瑞玛中部的飞艇塔！$n，绝对不能让他登上飞艇逃跑！$B$B赶快到飞艇塔去！
text.progress: Did you find the guy, or did he crawl under a rock?
text.completion: You got his ledger? Really? That's great, $N. There's probably loads of good information in here.

english.title: A Friendly Chat...
english.objectives: Go to the zeppelin tower on the central bluff in  Orgrimmar and question Snivel Rustrocket about the supplies. Return with any evidence he gives you.
english.description: <Roka listens with disgust as you tell her why you're trying to track down Snivel.>$B$BYou mean I've been under the spell of an alchemist all this time? I can't believe I fell for that fraud! If I ever get my hands on that conniving little goblin, I'll tear him apart!$B$BIf he's finished his errands, he's on his way down to the zeppelin tower in the middle of Orgrimmar! Whatever you do, $n, you can't let him board that zeppelin and get away with all this!$B$BHurry to the zeppelin tower before you miss him!
english.progress: Did you find the guy, or did he crawl under a rock?
english.completion: You got his ledger? Really? That's great, $N. There's probably loads of good information in here.

text.title: 视察凄凉要塞
text.objectives: 跟血柄督军谈一谈，然后前往凄凉要塞通知加杜尔说血柄督军随后就到。
text.description: 谢谢你帮助我们解除了迫在眉睫的威胁。但是我在贫瘠之地的工作才刚刚开始。$B$B加杜尔任职期间，荣耀岗哨失陷，陶拉祖遇袭。酋长派我来收拾他的烂摊子。$B$B我希望你先行前往南部的凄凉要塞，通知加杜尔准备接受惩罚。$B$B你准备好了就跟我谈谈，我会派前锋护送你的。
text.completion:
<Gar'dul breaks into a sweat.>

Look - ah - let's not discuss this here, in front of the men...

english.title: Desolation Hold Inspection
english.objectives: Talk to Warlord Bloodhilt, then ride into Desolation Hold and inform Gar'dul that Warlord Bloodhilt is on his way.
english.description: Thanks to you, the immediate threat is over. But my work here in the Barrens is only beginning.$B$BHonor's Stand was captured and Taurajo was sacked while Warlord Gar'dul was in charge of the region. The Warchief has sent me here to clean up his mess.$B$BI would like you to ride into Desolation Hold to the south in advance of me and let Gar'dul know that it is time for a reckoning.$B$BTalk to me when you are ready to leave and I will assemble my vanguard to accompany you.
english.completion:
<Gar'dul breaks into a sweat.>

Look - ah - let's not discuss this here, in front of the men...

text.title: 黑瘴林
text.objectives: 调查风谷村外的布莱德肖磨坊。
text.description: 我颇费了一番功夫。虽然资料不是特别详尽，但总算知道这里发生过什么了。$B$B诅咒爆发后，幸存的村民们躲进了风暴海崖的山林中。$B$B只有布莱德肖，也就是这本日记的主人，留了下来。他发现狼人突然间停止了攻击，转而闯进了黑瘴林。$B$B镇子的东北方有一座废弃的磨坊，是布莱德肖的旧居。去那里看看有没有什么线索吧。
text.completion: I've been expecting you, $N.  Do not be alarmed.$B$BMy name is Belysra.  I am a priestess of the moon... a night elf.$B$BYou might not know my people, but the destinies of our two races have been linked since the Curse befell you.

english.title: The Blackwald
english.objectives: Investigate the Bradshaw mill just outside Stormglen Village.
english.description: It took a while, but I think I've put together what happened here.  At least partially.$B$BThere were survivors of the Curse in this town.  They joined others in the mountains, in Tempest's Reach.$B$BEveryone left, except the man who kept the journal, old man Bradshaw.  He noticed that the worgen attacks had stopped all of a sudden and decided to venture into the Blackwald.$B$BThere is an abandoned mill just northeast of town, it was where Bradshaw lived.  See if you can find any clues there.
english.completion: I've been expecting you, $N.  Do not be alarmed.$B$BMy name is Belysra.  I am a priestess of the moon... a night elf.$B$BYou might not know my people, but the destinies of our two races have been linked since the Curse befell you.

text.title: 消灭萨塔里奥！
text.objectives: 消灭萨塔里奥。$B$B这个任务可以在任何难度和规模的团队副本中完成。
text.description: 黑岩守护者萨塔里奥正在看守着暮光巨龙的卵。他就在龙眠神殿下方龙神之厅的黑曜石圣殿里。$B$B六人议会已经决定要消灭萨塔里奥！

english.title: Sartharion Must Die!
english.objectives: Kill Sartharion.$B$BThis quest can be completed with any difficulty or size raid.
english.description: Sartharion, the Onyx Guardian, watches over the eggs of the Twilight Dragonflight. He rests within the Obsidian Sanctum in the Chamber of the Aspects underneath Wyrmrest Temple.$B$BThe Council of Six has decreed that Sartharion must die!

text.title: 阿努布雷坎必须死
text.objectives: 消灭阿努布雷坎。$B$B这个任务可以在任何难度或者任何规模的团队副本中完成。
text.description: 阿努布雷坎曾经是尼拉布帝国强大的蜘蛛君王。而现在，巫妖王夺取了他的帝国，并将那里变成亡灵之地。$B$B现在阿努布雷坎变成了一个坟墓君王，盘踞在纳克萨玛斯的蜘蛛区，为克尔苏加德经营着各种阴谋。$B$B六人议会已经做出决定，必须消灭阿努布雷坎。

english.title: Anub'Rekhan Must Die!
english.objectives: Kill Anub'Rekhan.$B$BThis quest can be completed with any difficulty or size raid.
english.description: Anub'Rekhan, once-mighty Spider Lord of the nerubian empire, has been taken by the Lich King and corrupted into a state of undeath.$B$BNow a crypt lord, he sits in his parlor in the Arachnid Quarter of Naxxramas, spinning strategies for Kel'Thuzad.$B$BThe Council of Six has decreed that Anub'Rekhan must die!

text.title: 消灭药剂师诺斯！
text.objectives: 消灭药剂师诺斯。$B$B这一任务可以在任何难度和规模的团队副本中完成。
text.description: 药剂师诺斯是一个懦夫和叛徒！他所犯下的罪行仅次于巫妖王！$B$B赶快到纳克萨玛斯去。他就在瘟疫区，躲在他的亡灵爪牙后面。$B$B一定要消灭他！这是六人议会做出的决定！
text.completion: That's one less thorn in our side. With Noth destroyed, Scourge research into refining the means of creating the undead will grind to a halt.

english.title: Noth the Plaguebringer Must Die!
english.objectives: Kill Noth the Plaguebringer.$B$BThis quest can be completed with any difficulty or size raid.
english.description: Noth the Plaguebringer, traitor and coward! Second only to the Lich King himself for the number of souls that have been Scourged!$B$BMake haste to Naxxramas. You will find him within the Plague Quarter hiding behind his undead minions.$B$BDestroy him! The Council of Six has decreed that Noth must die!
english.completion: That's one less thorn in our side. With Noth destroyed, Scourge research into refining the means of creating the undead will grind to a halt.

text.title: 消灭教官拉苏维奥斯！
text.objectives: 消灭教官拉苏维奥斯。$B$B这个任务可以在任何难度和规模的团队副本中完成。
text.description: 教官拉苏维奥斯昂首阔步地走在纳克萨玛斯军事区，一副自鸣得意的样子。据说，只有他亲自训练出来的死亡骑士才可能有机会抵挡住他的剑威。$B$B你和你的队员将去推翻这一说法。$B$B六人议会已经下令除掉拉苏维奥斯！

english.title: Instructor Razuvious Must Die!
english.objectives: Kill Instructor Razuvious.$B$BThis quest can be completed with any difficulty or size raid.
english.description: Instructor Razuvious smugly struts about the Military Quarter of Naxxramas. It is said that only a death knight personally trained by him could possibly even withstand the prowess of his blade.$B$BYou and your group are going to prove everyone wrong.$B$BThe Council of Six has decreed that Razuvious must die!

text.title: 消灭帕奇维克！
text.objectives: 消灭帕奇维克。$B$B这一任务可以在任何难度和规模的团队副本中完成。
text.description: 那个所谓的“战神”帕奇维克是个极度恐怖的憎恶。他在龙骨荒野杀害了我们无数的战士。$B$B希望你能带同你的战友，进入纳克萨玛斯的构造区。分解他的构造。$B$B六人议会已经做出了消灭帕奇维克的决定！

english.title: Patchwerk Must Die!
english.objectives: Kill Patchwerk.$B$BThis quest can be completed with any difficulty or size raid.
english.description: The so-called "avatar of war", Patchwerk is the ultimate abomination. It is also taking a heavy toll upon on our forces in the Dragonblight.$B$BI want you to assemble your companions and enter the Construct Quarter of Naxxramas. Disassemble the construct.$B$BThe Council of Six has decreed that Patchwerk must die!

text.title: 消灭玛里苟斯
text.objectives: 消灭玛里苟斯。$B$B这一任务可以在任何难度和规模的团队副本中完成。
text.description: 我们的资源相当紧张。织法者玛里苟斯正在将这个世界的全部魔法力量吸干，灌入永恒之眼里。如果没有了魔法，我们只有死路一条。$B$B$C，魔枢战争必须结束。六人议会已经做出决定，玛里苟斯必须被消灭！
text.completion: With Malygos defeated, the Nexus War should come to a swift conclusion. You have the gratitude of the Kirin Tor, $N.

english.title: Malygos Must Die!
english.objectives: Kill Malygos.$B$BThis quest can be completed with any difficulty or size raid.
english.description: Our resources are strained. Malygos, the Spell-Weaver, is draining all of the magic out of the world, consolidating it in the Eye of Eternity. Without magic, we are doomed.$B$B$C, the Nexus War must be brought to an end. The Council of Six has decreed that Malygos must die!
english.completion: With Malygos defeated, the Nexus War should come to a swift conclusion. You have the gratitude of the Kirin Tor, $N.

text.title: 烈焰巨兽必须死！
text.objectives: 消灭烈焰巨兽。$B$B这个任务可以在任何难度或规模的团队副本中完成。
text.description: 在练兵场中坐落着奥杜尔的第一道防线：烈焰巨兽。$B$B肯瑞托得到的情报表明，这些守护者制造的机器即将被送往一处秘密地方，它们将对艾泽拉斯的生灵造成灾难性的破坏。$B$B必须阻止这一切的发生。六人议会已经宣布了烈焰巨兽必须死！
text.completion: I never cease to be amazed by the horrors that can be created through the use of technology.

english.title: Flame Leviathan Must Die!
english.objectives: Kill Flame Leviathan.$B$BThis quest can be completed with any difficulty or size raid.
english.description: Within the Formation Grounds sits Ulduar's first line of defense: Flame Leviathan.$B$BThe Kirin Tor have been provided with information suggesting that this Keeper-created machine is soon to be transported to an undisclosed location and let loose to wreak havoc upon the mortals of Azeroth.$B$BThis must not come to pass. The Council of Six has decreed that Flame Leviathan must die!
english.completion: I never cease to be amazed by the horrors that can be created through the use of technology.

text.title: 消灭锋鳞
text.objectives: 消灭锋鳞。$B$B这一任务可以在任何难度和规模的团队副本中完成。
text.description: 锋鳞通常都待在奥杜尔巨人熔炉附近她的巢穴中。但最近，她经常出现在那片巨型泰坦建筑群以外横行肆虐。$B$B虽然这头母龙有自己悲伤的故事，但她现在对于整个诺森德都是一个严重的威胁。六人议会已经下达命令，锋鳞必须被消灭！
text.completion: Now Veranus can finally rest in peace.

english.title: Razorscale Must Die!
english.objectives: Kill Razorscale.$B$BThis quest can be completed with any difficulty or size raid.
english.description: Razorscale normally keeps to her aerie near the Colossal Forge in Ulduar. Of late, however, she has been spotted raining fire down upon lands outside of the titan complex.$B$BThough the broodmother's is a sad tale, she poses an imminent threat to all of Northrend. The Council of Six has decreed that Razorscale must die!
english.completion: Now Veranus can finally rest in peace.

text.title: 消灭掌炉者伊格尼斯！
text.objectives: 消灭掌炉者伊格尼斯。$B$B这个任务可以在任何难度和规模的团队副本中完成。
text.description: 巨大的火焰巨人——掌炉者伊格尼斯在奥杜尔的巨人熔炉奋力工作。依照洛肯的命令，伊格尼斯打造了充斥着他们那可怕力量的武器。$B$B六人议会已下令除掉伊格尼斯！
text.completion: I trust that you did not have to face too many of his iron construct assistants?

english.title: Ignis the Furnace Master Must Die!
english.objectives: Kill Ignis the Furnace Master.$B$BThis quest can be completed with any difficulty or size raid.
english.description: The great fire giant, Ignis the Furnace Master toils away inside of Ulduar's Colossal Forge. Under orders from Loken, Ignis creates weapons that are terrifying in their power.$B$BThe Council of Six has decreed that Ignis must die!
english.completion: I trust that you did not have to face too many of his iron construct assistants?

text.title: 消灭XT-002拆解者！
text.objectives: 消灭XT-002拆解者。$B$B这一任务可以在任何难度和规模的团队副本中完成。
text.description: 米米尔隆的怪异制造物还有一个，实际上，XT-002拆解者一直认为自己是米米尔隆的儿子。不要被它伪装的天真所欺骗。那可是一部致命的机器！$B$B你会在奥杜尔的废料场找到那部拆解者。六人议会已经决定，必须消灭XT-002拆解者！

english.title: XT-002 Deconstructor Must Die!
english.objectives: Kill XT-002 Deconstructor.$B$BThis quest can be completed with any difficulty or size raid.
english.description: Yet another strange construct of Mimiron, the XT-002 Deconstructor actually thinks that it is the keeper's son. Do not be fooled by its feigned innocence. It is a deadly machine!$B$BYou will find the Deconstructor within Ulduar's Scrapyard. The Council of Six has decreed that XT-002 Deconstructor must die!

text.title: 消灭加拉克苏斯大王！
text.objectives: 消灭加拉克苏斯大王。$B$B这一任务可以在任何难度和规模的团队副本中完成。
text.description: 大法师提迈尔预见到了一件可怕的事情。一名愚蠢的侏儒术士将无意中召唤一个燃烧军团的艾瑞达君主进入到十字军的试炼之中。$B$B在这件事发生的时候，你必须在场，$c。如果加拉克苏斯大王逃脱了，他就会打开传送门，让燃烧军团再一次涌入我们的世界。$B$B六人议会已经做出决定，必须消灭加拉克苏斯大王！
text.completion: All of Azeroth is fortunate that Timear foresaw the Eredar lord's arrival and that you were there in time to slay him.

english.title: Lord Jaraxxus Must Die!
english.objectives: Kill Lord Jaraxxus.$B$BThis quest can be completed with any difficulty or size raid.
english.description: Archmage Timear has foreseen a horrible event, which is about to transpire. A foolish gnome warlock is about to accidentally summon an Eredar lord of the Burning Legion into the middle of the Trial of the Crusader.$B$BYou must be there when it happens, $c. If Lord Jaraxxus escapes, he will open a portal and the Burning Legion will spill forth into our world once more.$B$BThe Council of Six has decreed that Lord Jaraxxus must die!
english.completion: All of Azeroth is fortunate that Timear foresaw the Eredar lord's arrival and that you were there in time to slay him.

text.title: 消灭玛洛加尔领主！
text.objectives: 消灭玛洛加尔领主。$B$B这一任务可以在任何难度和规模的团队副本中完成。
text.description: 玛洛加尔领主是冰冠尖塔内部的冰封王座守卫。巫妖王用一千名冒险者的骨殖将他拼凑而成，并让他能够操纵冰封王座本身的力量。$B$B如果不消灭这头怪物，我们就绝无可能占领冰冠堡垒。$B$B六人议会已经决定将他彻底消灭！

english.title: Lord Marrowgar Must Die!
english.objectives: Kill Lord Marrowgar.$B$BThis quest can be completed with any difficulty or size raid.
english.description: Lord Marrowgar is the guardian of the Frozen Throne within the Spire Chamber. Pieced together by the Lich King from the bones of a thousand vanquished adventurers, Marrowgar wields the power of the throne itself.$B$BWithout the destruction of this bone wraith, there is no hope of taking Icecrown Citadel.$B$BThe Council of Six has decreed that Lord Marrowgar must die!

text.title: 加杜尔的撤职令
text.objectives: 登上凄凉要塞北部塔楼顶部，帮助血柄督军“解除”加杜尔的职务。
text.description: 血柄既然来了，我希望我们能够——嗯——私下谈谈。你能与我同行，确保一切顺利吗？血柄这家伙，呃……他，他一向不按常理出牌。$B$B<加杜尔试着让自己平静下来。>$B$B去北部塔楼顶部跟我碰面吧，我们一起和血柄谈谈。

english.title: Changing of the Gar'dul
english.objectives: Go to the top of the northern tower in Desolation Hold and help Warlord Bloodhilt "Relieve" Gar'dul of command.
english.description: When Bloodhilt arrives, I'd like to - ah - talk in private. Can you accompany me to make sure things stay on the level? This Bloodhilt is a, ah, he's a, he's a loose cannon.$B$B<Gar'dul tries to compose himself.>$B$BMeet me atop the northern tower and we'll talk with Bloodhilt together.

text.title: 风暴海崖的背叛
text.objectives: 在风暴海崖喝下克雷南的潜行药水，然后击败灰葬男爵和沃登勋爵。
text.description: 格雷迈恩国王被高弗雷勋爵囚禁在了风暴海崖！$B$B他说服了东部的两个领主与他同谋。这些蠢货认为，只要把格雷迈恩交给被遗忘者，就能跟他们达成协议。$B$B仔细听好了，$n。我们要尽量不流血地解决这个问题。$B$B这瓶药水可以让你悄悄潜进去。我要你去击败那些叛变的领主，避免形势失控！
text.progress: Careful, $N.
text.completion: I wish it could've been avoided, $N.  Let us ensure this is resolved without further bloodshed.

english.title: Betrayal at Tempest's Reach
english.objectives: Drink Krennan's Potion of Stealth in Tempest's Reach and assassinate Baron Ashbury and Lord Walden.
english.description: King Greymane has been taken prisoner by Lord Godfrey in Tempest's Reach!$B$BHe managed to convince two of the eastern lords to go with his plan.  The fool seems to think he can strike a deal with the Forsaken by turning Greymane over to them.$B$BListen carefully, $n.  We need to resolve this with as little bloodshed as possible.$B$BThis potion will allow you to sneak in undetected.  We need you to assassinate the traitorous lords before this gets out of hand!
english.progress: Careful, $N.
english.completion: I wish it could've been avoided, $N.  Let us ensure this is resolved without further bloodshed.

text.title: 非人非兽
text.objectives: 饮下宁静之井、平衡之井和狂怒之井的井水。
text.description: $n，是时候了。这药剂……只能暂时抑制你的兽性，效力持续不了太久。$B$B第一批被诅咒的狼人来自我们的新盟友——暗夜德鲁伊。他们摒弃了氏族恪守的平衡之道，任由兽性占据了自己的灵魂。$B$B让德鲁伊为我们清除狼人诅咒的威胁再合适不过了。$C，去吧。饮下塔多伦的井水，获得内心的平静。
text.completion: It is done then, $N.  You are one of us now.

english.title: Neither Human Nor Beast
english.objectives: Drink from the Well of Tranquility, the Well of Balance and the Well of Fury.
english.description: It is time, $n.  This... alchemy that has kept the beast inside you at bay will not last for long.$B$BThe first cursed worgen were night elf druids like our new allies.  They, however, abandoned the balance that the rest of their kind embraced and allowed the beast to take over their minds.$B$BIt is only fitting that their brethren be the ones that deliver us from the Curse.  Go, $C.  Drink from the waters of Tal'doren and make peace with yourself.
english.completion: It is done then, $N.  You are one of us now.

text.title: 奎尔德拉的净化
text.objectives: 将被污染的奎尔德拉放入太阳之井。准备好进入太阳之井高地后，就同太阳之井守卫交谈。
text.description: $n，你的面前就是太阳之井和奎尔德拉流亡的终点。$B$B你会在太阳之井中找到奎尔萨拉斯的摄政王洛瑟玛·塞隆和大法师罗曼斯。一定要对他们保持警惕，不要掉进他们的政治陷阱中。$B$B但你主要的精力必须集中在你的任务上。当你准备进入太阳之井高地时，就和一名太阳之井守卫谈谈。将新的奎尔德拉放进太阳之井中，完成这把神剑的重生。如果你举起它，就像萨洛瑞安说的那样，它就会与你绑缚在一起。

english.title: The Purification of Quel'Delar
english.objectives: Immerse your Tainted Quel'Delar in the Sunwell. Speak to a Warden of the Sunwell when you are ready to enter the Sunwell Plateau.
english.description: The Sunwell and the end of Quel'Delar's exile await, $n.$B$BYou will find Lor'themar Theron, the regent of Quel'Thalas, and Grand Magister Rommath standing within. Be wary of them and do not allow them to entrap you in their political scheming.$B$BInstead, remain focused on your task here. Speak to a Warden of the Sunwell to enter the Sunwell Plateau. Immerse the reformed Quel'Delar in the Sunwell to complete the restoration. Show the blade to Myralion Sunblaze at Quel'Delar's Rest once it is restored.

text.title: The Purification of Quel'Delar
text.objectives: Immerse your Tainted Quel'Delar in the Sunwell. Speak to a Warden of the Sunwell when you are ready to enter the Sunwell Plateau.
text.description: I admit, I was skeptical that you had actually re-forged Quel'Delar and I did not expect Thalorien's spirit to reveal itself to you. You cannot understand what it means to my people that Quel'Delar has been recovered.$B$BAs promised, I will admit you to the Sunwell and you will find the leaders of Silvermoon within. Carry the sword to the chamber of the Sunwell and immerse it. Once the blade is restored, return with it to Caladis Brightspear at Quel'Delar's Rest.

Speak to a Warden of the Sunwell when you are ready to enter the Sunwell Plateau.

Speak to a Warden of the Sunwell when you are ready to enter the Sunwell Plateau.

text.title: 为暴风城之王准备的礼物
text.objectives: 向暴风城的安度因·乌瑞恩国王献上一件可爱的情人符手镯。
text.description: 你想要为暴风城之王制作一款可爱的情人符手镯吗？我相信他一定会非常喜欢这样的礼物。$B$B你已经有可爱的情人符工具箱了吗？

english.title: A Gift for the King of Stormwind
english.objectives: Present a Lovely Charm Bracelet to King Anduin Wrynn in Stormwind.
english.description: Did you want to make a Lovely Charm Bracelet for the king of Stormwind? I'm sure he'd be thrilled.$B$BDo you already have a Lovely Charm Collector's Kit?

text.title: The Purification of Quel'Delar
text.objectives: Immerse your Tempered Quel'Delar in the Sunwell. Speak to a Warden of the Sunwell when you are ready to enter the Sunwell Plateau.
text.description: The Sunwell and the end of Quel'Delar's exile await, $n.$B$BYou will find Lor'themar Theron, the regent of Quel'Thalas, and Grand Magister Rommath standing within. Be wary of them and do not allow them to entrap you in their political scheming.$B$BInstead, remain focused on your task here. Immerse the reformed Quel'Delar in the Sunwell to complete its restoration, then show it to Myralio Sunblaze at Quel'Delar's Rest. Speak to a Warden of the Sunwell when you are ready to enter the Sunwell Plateau.
text.progress: What news do you bring from the Sunwell?
text.completion: Am I truly laying my eyes upon the weapon of Thalorien Dawnseeker? This is a wondrous day for the Sunreavers and for all sin'dorei!

english.title: The Purification of Quel'Delar
english.objectives: Immerse your Tempered Quel'Delar in the Sunwell. Speak to a Warden of the Sunwell when you are ready to enter the Sunwell Plateau.
english.description: The Sunwell and the end of Quel'Delar's exile await, $n.$B$BYou will find Lor'themar Theron, the regent of Quel'Thalas, and Grand Magister Rommath standing within. Be wary of them and do not allow them to entrap you in their political scheming.$B$BInstead, remain focused on your task here. Immerse the reformed Quel'Delar in the Sunwell to complete its restoration, then show it to Myralio Sunblaze at Quel'Delar's Rest. Speak to a Warden of the Sunwell when you are ready to enter the Sunwell Plateau.

english.completion: Am I truly laying my eyes upon the weapon of Thalorien Dawnseeker? This is a wondrous day for the Sunreavers and for all sin'dorei!

text.title: 噩梦之痕
text.objectives: 帮助纳拉雷克斯封印噩梦之痕。
text.description: 这就没错了。这里的生长并非是由单纯的能量过剩引起的。$B$B你明白吗？这比哀嚎洞穴所发生的事情还要严重。在我们所站的这片大地中央，一定撕开了一个通往噩梦的裂口！想来这是我的错……$B$B我厌倦了在这个伤痕的边缘缝缝补补。到西边去，到疯狂生长的中心去，我们将在那里再见。我们要深入这腐化的心脏，强行将它关闭！
text.completion:
We've done it! The nightmare's connection to this place has been severed. The rest of the land is safe from this intrusion now, and in time, the abberations here will be subsumed by the balance of nature.

I cannot thank you enough, $N. By helping to restore order here, you've let me make amends for my foolish actions.

english.title: The Nightmare Scar
english.objectives: Help Naralex seal the Nightmare Scar.
english.description: This confirms it. The overgrowth here is not being caused by a mere overabundance of energy.$B$BDo you understand? This is beyond what happened at the Wailing Caverns now. A rift into the Nightmare must have torn open in the middle of the very land we're standing on! And to think it's my fault...$B$BI'm done picking at the edges of this wound. Go to the west, to the center of the overgrowth, and meet me again there. We will dive into the heart of this corruption and force it shut!
english.completion:
We've done it! The nightmare's connection to this place has been severed. The rest of the land is safe from this intrusion now, and in time, the abberations here will be subsumed by the balance of nature.

I cannot thank you enough, $N. By helping to restore order here, you've let me make amends for my foolish actions.

text.title: 入土为安
text.objectives: 找到5尊被发掘的纪念物。
text.description: $n，在仓皇出逃的时候，我们扰乱了先祖安息地的宁静。亵渎墓地，罪孽深重。$B$B每座吉尔尼斯墓地的上层都铺有一方浅浅的泥土，里面埋着一尊纪念物，这是氏族的传统。逃难的人民在混乱中不慎令这些纪念物曝露出来，激怒了先祖的灵魂。$B$B将它们找来交给我。我们要确保亡者的灵魂得以安息。
text.progress: You're back, $N.
text.completion: Thank you, $N.  Let us hope this works.

english.title: Laid to Rest
english.objectives: Obtain 5 Unearthed Mementos.
english.description: In our hurried escape for safety, we disturbed the resting homes of our ancestors, $n.  A grave sin, if you'll pardon the pun.$B$BIt is tradition that a small memento be buried on top of a Gilnean's graveyard, beneath the shallow earth.  The stampede of people fleeing these tunnels has unearthed these mementos and angered the spirits.$B$BFind them and bring them to me.  We'll see to it that the dead return to their eternal slumber.
english.progress: You're back, $N.
english.completion: Thank you, $N.  Let us hope this works.

text.title: 不要停止砍杀
text.objectives: 杀掉13头钢鬃野猪人。
text.description: 有那么一刹那，我以为我的仇恨宁静了下来。我的妻子已然安息，凶手的血被用来作为最后的献祭，平息她受折磨的灵魂。我以为我能找到平静。$B$B我错了。$B$B除非每一个恶心、啸叫、杀人的野猪人都死无葬身之地，否则我不会罢休！只靠我的两只手，都快忙不过来了。你也去帮我多杀掉一些吧，$r。
text.completion: Good. Take your reward; this is only a prelude.

english.title: Don't Stop Bereavin'
english.objectives: Kill 13 Razormane Quilboar.
english.description: For a moment, I thought my hatred had stilled. My wife laid to rest, a final offering of the blood of her murderers to quell her tortured spirit. I thought perhaps peace would appeal to me.$B$BI was wrong.$B$BI will not rest now until every single filthy, squealing, murderous quilboar lays dead and broken! I cannot kill them fast enough with my own two hands.  Go and slay more for me, $r.
english.completion: Good. Take your reward; this is only a prelude.

text.title: 关心曼科里克
text.objectives: 将玛卡的礼物交给火石岗哨南边的曼科里克。
text.description: 我要你帮个忙，$c。$B$B不久之前，一名孤身上路的战士曼科里克经过了我们的营地。他的妻子很久以前被野猪人杀害了，而他仍然在寻求复仇。我无法忘记他的双眼……无时无刻不燃烧着难以平息的仇恨。$B$B我们没有谈多久，但一想到他独自在外，我就无法忍受。拜托你，把这个交给曼科里克，告诉他是我给的……
text.progress: <Mankrik snarls.>$B$BWhat is it!? I'm busy!
text.completion: Mahka sent you?$B$B<Mankrik's fury quells for a moment.>$B$BIt is a small comfort. But nothing can console me until I am done here.

english.title: Concern for Mankrik
english.objectives: Bring Mahka's Gift to Mankrik, south of Firestone Point.
english.description: I would ask a favor of you, $c.$B$BA warrior named Mankrik passed through our camp not long ago, on a lonely journey. His wife was killed by the quilboar, long ago, and he still seeks revenge. I cannot forget his eyes...burning with inconsolable hatred, every waking moment.$B$BWe did not talk long, but I cannot bear to think of him out there alone. Please, bring this to Mankrik, and tell him it is from me...
english.progress: <Mankrik snarls.>$B$BWhat is it!? I'm busy!
english.completion: Mahka sent you?$B$B<Mankrik's fury quells for a moment.>$B$BIt is a small comfort. But nothing can console me until I am done here.

text.title: 贫瘠之地的血
text.objectives: 从钢鬃野猪人身上获得6副血之碎片饰品。
text.description: 这块鲜亮的红石头是在一个野猪人紧握的爪子里找到的，它被小心地雕刻成了一头强大野猪的样子，背后钢鬃丛生。它的表面光滑，被小心保养过。$B$B这是野猪人做的吗？如果你还能找到其它的，也许火石岗哨的一名萨满可以告诉你更多关于它们的事情。
text.progress: Yes?
text.completion:
These are blood shards. They used to be found all over the Barrens.

It's said they were formed from the blood of Agamaggan, the great demigod that the quilboar sprang from. I knew the quilboar prized them, but nobody would think they'd take the time and care to carve them like this one...

There may be more to learn here.

english.title: Blood of the Barrens
english.objectives: Collect 6 Blood Shard Trinkets from Razormane Quilboar.
english.description: This bright red stone, found clutched in the grasp of a quilboar, has been carefully carved into the likeness of a great boar, with thorny vines sprouting from its back. Its surface is smooth and worn with care.$B$BDid the quilboar make this? If you find others, maybe one of the shaman at Firestone Point could tell you more about them.
english.progress: Yes?
english.completion:
These are blood shards. They used to be found all over the Barrens.

It's said they were formed from the blood of Agamaggan, the great demigod that the quilboar sprang from. I knew the quilboar prized them, but nobody would think they'd take the time and care to carve them like this one...

There may be more to learn here.

text.title: 暗矛的崛起
text.objectives: 与暗矛训练场中的诺泰特谈谈。
text.description: 很久以来，暗矛部族一直都是受害者和流亡者。我们一直在逃离家园……但是这一次，我们并不是为了逃亡而来到这里的。$B$B沃金以他的智慧引领着我们，使我们生存到了今天。现在，这种智慧使我们察觉到了，在加尔鲁什·地狱咆哮的领导下，部落将会有怎样黑暗而混乱的未来。$B$B不，这一次我们不再逃亡了。这一次，我们要为了可以长期定居下去的家园而战。$B$B是时候开始你的训练了，$n。去跟东边的诺泰特谈谈吧。
text.completion: Anotha newblood, eh?$B$BYa actually have a sly look about ya though. Fierce eyes. You might have the makings of a real $c.$B$BLets not waste anymore time 'den.

english.title: The Rise of the Darkspear
english.objectives: Meet with Nortet in the Darkspear Training Grounds.
english.description: Tha Darkspear tribe have long been victims. Outcasts. We found ourselves fleein' our homes time 'n time again... but dis time, it's not fleein' dat drives us here.$B$BVol'jin has offered us leadership through wisdom, and it has kept us alive dis long. Now dat same wisdom offers portents of a chaotic future for tha Horde unda Garrosh Hellscream.$B$BNo, dis time we not fleein'. Dis time, we are fightin' for a home dat will last.$B$BIt's time to begin ya trainin', $n. Speak with Nortet to the east.
english.completion: Anotha newblood, eh?$B$BYa actually have a sly look about ya though. Fierce eyes. You might have the makings of a real $c.$B$BLets not waste anymore time 'den.

text.title: 碎牙
text.objectives: 击败碎牙。
text.description: 我不再关心名誉或荣耀，$c。对我来说唯一重要的就是击败野猪人，无论什么方式，无论谁动的手。$B$B碎牙是这些污秽钢鬃野猪人的酋长，就盘踞在西北边山上的巢穴里。去击败他。$B$B我打算待在这里，消灭我见到的任何一个野猪人，直到没有一头野猪敢从沼泽里跑出来朝着我嚎叫为止……
text.completion: Good.  Good! They will all die!  Their chieftains, and their women, and their children, and their foul pets!

english.title: Mangletooth
english.objectives: Kill Mangletooth.
english.description: I no longer care for honor or glory, $c. All that matters to me is that the quilboar die, by any means, at anyone's hand.$B$BMangletooth, the chief of these filthy Razormane, sits in his lair to the northwest, atop a hill. End his life.$B$BI plan to stay here, and pile these bodies until no more vermin run squealing from the Kraul to face me...
english.completion: Good.  Good! They will all die!  Their chieftains, and their women, and their children, and their foul pets!

text.description: $n，你肯定有满脑子的疑问吧。很快，你就会知晓答案了。$B$B我很清楚你此行的目的以及你要寻找的东西。$B$B我不能眼睁睁地看着你把敌人引来。$B$B希尔瓦娜斯的一名密探正在跟踪你。千万不能将他带往你要去的地方。带上这枚坠饰，沿着北边的道路走。$B$B假意落入探子的陷阱，然后利用坠饰的力量脱身并进行反击。

And they will be answered in time.$B$BI know why you're here and what you're looking for.$B$BI can't lead you there with the enemy tracking you.$B$BOne of Sylvanas's scouts has been following your tracks.  You can't lead the Forsaken to the place you seek.  Take this talisman and walk along the road just north of here.$B$BLet the ranger lure you to her trap and use the power of the talisman to break free and counterattack.

text.title: 塔多伦，野性的家园
text.objectives: 前往位于黑瘴林中心地带的塔多伦，跟达利乌斯·克罗雷谈一谈。
text.description: $n，有很多人跟你一样。他们也感到困惑和迷惘。$B$B去寻找心灵的归属地吧。$B$B塔多伦，野性的家园，狼人德鲁伊教会的故土。$B$B你会在那里找到所有疑问的答案。还有一位老朋友在塔多伦等你，他会为你指引未来的方向。
text.completion: You're all right, $N!  I've been waiting for this day for a long time, it truly is great to see you friend.$B$BI've heard of what you've done and I'm thankful... especially for Lorna -- she's all I've left.  I will send for her right away.

text.title: 夺得战斗之痕
text.objectives: 进入战斗之痕。找到旗帜并杀死10名凯旋先锋。$B$B夺得旗帜可以使战斗之痕的所有部落玩家获得战斗优势。
text.description: 经过战火的洗礼，脚下的土地已经崩裂，好在我们已经迫使联盟暂时休战。这里东边就是战斗之痕，堆满尸体浸透鲜血的壕沟。它不过是贫瘠之地的一条小道，却是我们必须坚守的防线。$B$B战斗之痕中央有一面旗帜，它象征着拥有控制权的势力。去那里侦察情况。$B$B如果旗帜不是我们的，就替部落夺得控制权——这可以让我们享有战争优势。调查战斗之痕，并杀死所有敌人！
text.completion:
Excellent! You're my kind of $c, $N.
